articleTitle: A Preliminary Study on Automatic Detection Technology of Stability Control System Driven by Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The stable operation of the safety and stability control system is the guarantee of power grid security, and improving the detection technology of the stability control device is the key means to reduce potential risks. This paper proposes a knowledge graph framework for stability control strategy, which condenses a large amount of information in the strategy text into a structured knowledge network. Based on the requirements of stability control strategy retrieval, the construction of knowledge graph is divided into strategy entity graph, system conceptual graph, test case graph, state sequence graph, strategy verification graph. The construction can solve the problems of inspectors retrieving strategies and automatically generating test cases. The detection platform framework of a stability control system driven by a knowledge graph is designed to realize the three main points of detection technology: full coverage of detection functions, test automation, and device portability.

articleTitle: Line-Side Converter for DC Voltage Matching Based on Multiplexing of Transformer Windings in Multisystem Locomotives
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Multisystem locomotive can operate in two or more different traction power supply systems (TPSS). At present, for multisystem locomotives, the existing topology under the DC power supply situation may either sacrifice the stability of the DC-link voltage, or complicate the designed structure of the line-side converter. This paper proposes a line-side converter based on multiplexing of transformer windings to achieve DC voltage matching. The proposed line-side converter has the advantage of simple structure. Compared with the line-side converter of the traditional AC-powered locomotive, this line-side converter only adds two electrical switches for structural transformation, and the electrical components in AC and DC mode are almost completely shared. When AC power is supplied, the line-side converter is used as two parallel four-quadrant converters, and the leakage inductances of the traction transformer serve as line-side filter reactors; when DC power is supplied, the line-side converter is multiplexed as two parallel four-switch Buck-Boost converters, and the secondary windings of the transformer are multiplexed as chopping inductors. Firstly, this paper introduces the structure and design ideas of this converter. Then, by sharing the same PI controller of inner loop, the decoupling of the two parallel DC choppers, which were originally coupled by the transformer secondary windings under DC power supply, is realized. The dual-loop control method of the DC choppers is developed. Finally, the feasibility of this converter is verified by simulation based on MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: A Three-Step Power Distribution Strategy for Microgrid Hybrid Energy Storage System Based on High-Order Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To further reduce the DC bus voltage fluctuation and realize the reasonable power distribution of energy storage, this paper proposes a three-step power distribution strategy of hybrid energy storage system for the microgrid based on high-order sliding mode control. The primary power distribution adopts the high-order sliding mode control of the voltage outer loop to obtain the power that needs to be stabilized by the energy storage, which improves the dynamic stability of the bus voltage and further reduces the chattering problem; the secondary power adopts an improved low-pass filtering method for power decoupling, which eliminates the internal power circulation phenomenon of the energy storage, and realizes the Reasonable power distribution of battery and super capacitor; the third power distribution introduces the maximum power limit strategy to avoid the occurrence of overcharge and over discharge of energy storage equipment. The simulation shows the effectiveness of this strategy.

articleTitle: Development of Precision Impulse Current Measuring Device
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the development and characteristic parameters of a high precision impulse current measuring system. The coil is composed of a multi-layer PCB board, including shielding layer, coil layer, through-hole layer and loop layer. The differential signal output is designed to enhance the anti-interference ability. The requirements of different types of integral circuits for coil parameters are studied, and the relationship between the size, turns and high frequency characteristics of Rogowski coil is studied to ensure that the coil has good high frequency characteristics. The step response test of the measuring device shows that the response time is less than 60 ns and the relative overshoot is less than 10%. Compared with the standard Pearson coil, the peak error is less than 0.2%, the time parameter measurement error is less than 0.3%. The linearity of the measuring device is about 0.3% with current range from 5kA to 40kA. The test results show that the impulse current measuring system can measure high frequency current signal.

articleTitle: Modeling and Fault Characteristics of Grid-Interfaced Converters in Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the control strategy and the fault characteristics of the grid voltage asymmetry through theoretical analysis, establishment of fault control model, simulation verification and other methods. Based on the theoretical analysis, the fault recording of a wind farm in Jiangsu is analyzed. Since the voltage and current have the negative sequence component when the grid has asymmetrical fault, a dual decoupling current control model is established. In the model, the notch filter is used to filter the double frequency component in the current, and the phase angle of the voltage positive sequence component is measured by DSOGI-PLL. Research shows that a notch filter can effectively eliminate the double frequency component, but it will reduce the stability of the system. The DSOGI structure has low-pass filtering characteristics. The problem of oscillation of the instantaneous power injected into the grid can be solved by a control strategy.

articleTitle: A test methodology to verify reactive power support ability of wind turbines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The receiving power grid fed by Ultra-high Voltage Direct Current (UHVDC) has higher requirements for the deployment of reactive power support, so renewable energy farms need to have certain reactive power support capacity to meet the power grid stability requirements under abnormal working conditions such as unipolar locking. This paper analyzes the generation principle of reactive power in large wind farms, then a three-stage test methodology is proposed in which the collaborative reactive power regulation of wind turbines and SVG, the emergency reactive power support from wind turbines and the voltage regulation ability of wind turbines are verified respectively. This test methodology was also realistically demonstrated in Lichuan wind farm in Henan, China.

articleTitle: Effects of Electric Field and Temperature on Interfacial Properties of Nano-SiO₂ Doped Silicone Rubber Composites: A Molecular-Dynamics Study
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It is of great significance to clarify the effect of external environment, such as electric field and temperature, on interface region of nano-dielectric materials, which not only help us understand the operational mechanism of nano-dielectric but also guide us to design new nano-dielectric. Based on classical molecular dynamics method, the effects of electric field and temperature on interfacial properties of nano-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> doped silicone rubber composites are studied. The mean square displacement results show that increasing temperature will cause the increase of the movement of SR chains in interface region, which impair the mechanical properties and thermal stability. Meanwhile, the increasing electric field will decrease the movement of chains. The free volume fractions calculations show that the electric field and temperature have little effect on the total free volume fractions. However, the higher electric field and higher temperature both lead to a larger pore size in free volume region, in which the free electron will accelerate to obtain a higher energy. As a result, the increasing temperature and increasing electric field have a synergistic effect on damaging the dielectric properties of nano-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> doped silicone rubber composites. The analysis of interfacial interaction energy shows that the molecular interaction between SR and nanoparticles is dominated by van der Waals interaction and supplemented by electrostatic interaction. The increasing temperature will weaken the van der Waals interaction, while the increasing electric field will enhance the electrostatic interaction.

articleTitle: Analysis of power quality disturbance based on improved HHT and BPSO-SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of complex feature extraction and low classification accuracy of traditional composite Power quality disturbance (PQD) classification methods. This paper combines I. Hilbert-Huang transform (HHT) and Binary Particle Swarm Optimization Support Vector Machine (BPSO-SVM) to analyze PQD. The different disturbance components in the original signal are decomposed into different Intrinsic Mode Function (IMF) components by Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) decomposition, to transform the multi classification problem into a binary classification problem to improve the classification efficiency. Aiming at the problem of modal mixing in the process of EMD decomposition, the frequency information in the same octave that is far apart in the same octave is stripped by adding a preset correction signal to the signal in the decomposition process. The simulation results of Matlab show that the accuracy of the compound disturbance classification is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Equivalent modeling of hybrid modular multilevel converter considering the full bridge capacitor voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The existing hybrid modular multilevel fast equivalent modeling based on Thevenin does not consider insufficient capacitor voltage, resulting in incorrect simulation results of electromagnetic transient simulation when the capacitor voltage is insufficient. Therefore, a hybrid modular multilevel fast equivalent modeling is proposed in this paper. Specifically, the transformer is T-shaped equivalent, the components of each sub module are discretized by trapezoidal integral method. The single port Thevenin equivalent of half bridge sub module and the double port Thevenin equivalent of hybrid sub module are obtained by Stepwise calculation of Thevenin equivalent of local circuit. Then the equivalent model of hybrid modular multilevel converter is established. The validity and accuracy of the model are verified in MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: A Novel Calibration Method for Integrated Energy System Operation optimization based on Hardware-in-Loop System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Operation optimization of integrated energy systems(IES) is an important solution to improve the economy and environmental friendliness of system operation. The operation optimization problem is generally divided into two parts: system modeling and optimization solution. The accuracy of the model constructed in the system has a great impact on the operation optimization strategy. Therefore, it is important to verify the accuracy of the modeling and the feasibility of the optimization strategy. This paper introduces in-loop simulation into the optimization solution algorithm and build a physical environment, iteratively update the linear model of in-loop equipment and operation strategy, to obtain an operation optimization strategy that can be directly used in real integrated energy system scheduling.

articleTitle: Study on impulse aging characteristics of ZnO varistor based on equivalent repeated charge transfer capability
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The frequent high impulse currents during the switching-on process of the AC filter bank can accelerate the aging of AC filter arresters in some ultrahigh-voltage direct-current (UHVDC) and HVDC transmission systems, and the pulse width of the measured impulse current of the AC filter arresters are longer than that of the standard 8/20 ps lightning impulse current. The impulse current stress withstands capacity of zinc oxide (ZnO) varistor of arrester is inconsistent under different pulse width, while the repeated charge transfer capability is specified as an impulse current stress that can be withstood by the ZnO resistors in the standard IEC60099-4:2014. In this paper, combined with the measured impulse current of the AC filter arrester, the amplitude of the 8/20 ps and the 15/35 ps impulse currents were calculated based on the principle of equivalent charge, firstly. Secondly, impulse aging tests were carried out on 10 ZnO varistors in each group, and the DC reference voltage and the leakage current resistive component were measured during the impulse aging. Finally, based on the results, the impulse aging rate of the samples is discussed and analyzed, and found that the impulse aging rate of ZnO varistor under the equivalent charge impulse current is inconsistent, is closely related to the energy absorbed by the sample.

articleTitle: An Importance Ranking Method of Distribution System Component based on Triangular Fuzzy Number
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the distribution system, the reliability and resilience of the distribution system can be improved by strengthening the critical components and repairing them first when they fail. To identify the critical components in the distribution system, this paper proposes an importance ranking method. The inaccuracy of line failure rate is considered by using the triangular fuzzy number, which makes the evaluation results more reliable. Fussell-Vesely importance measure index is used as the criterion to measure the importance of each component to the load node. The importance evaluation structure, which consists of system layer, load layer and component layer, is established according to the three-layer evaluation structure of the analytic hierarchy process(AHP). Finally, the proposed method is verified on a modified IEEE 37-node feeder test system.

articleTitle: Fault Phase Selection Based on the Angle of Neutral Point Voltage for Asymmetric Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The traditional single line-to-ground fault phase selection method for distribution network generally ignores the influence of the parameter asymmetry. When the transition resistance is large enough, it will cause the wrong selection of the fault phase and result in a phase-to-phase short circuit. By measuring the neutral point voltage to divide the coordinate system, a new fault phase selection method is proposed. The proposed method has strong adaptability to the transition resistance and the asymmetry of the three phase parameters of the distribution network. The fault phase can be correctly selected under various neutral grounding modes. Simulations in MATLAB/Simulink verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A Virtual-Rectifier AC/AC Converter-Based Dynamic Voltage Restorer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR) is widely employed to deal with the problems of the voltage sag or surge. The conventional two-stage-based converter uses the large electrolytic capacitor to act as the DC energy storage, which results in a large volume and poor reliability. The direct virtual-rectifier-based AC/AC converter employs the thyristors to realize the voltage compensation, whereas the reactive current will bring in serious commutation problems. Therefore, a virtual-rectifier with IGBT is proposed in this paper. The rectifier is driven with no dead-zone at the zero-crossing of the grid voltage, which facilitates to the continuous flowing of the reactive current. Further on, a low-cost digital control strategy is proposed, which consists of a phase-locked loop control based on the second-order generalized integrator (SOGI-based PLL), and the proportional-integral (PI) control. The zero-crossing point and the root-mean-square (RMS) of the grid voltage is correctly identified by the PLL under the polluted grid condition, and the steady-state error is minimized by the PI controller. Finally, simulation and experimental results validate the correctness of the working principle and the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy. Through the simulation, all the proposed operations are compatible with non-unity power factor loads and feature continuous input and output currents, and the experimental prototype is capable of efficient voltage compensation.

articleTitle: Open-Switch Fault Analysis and Detection Based on FCS-MPC for NPC Three-Level Grid-Tied Inverters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The power electronic inverter suffers from the risk of an open-switch fault. Based on FCS-MPC, this paper proposes an open-switch fault detection method for neutral-point clamped three-level inverters. Common mode voltage is considered in the fault model; therefore, the dynamic behavior after fault can be predicted. The proposed FCS-MPC fault detection method divides one grid cycle into six sectors. This method can recognize two IBGTs in each period and only uses exist imformation. No extra devices or complex calculations are introduced. Simulations are executed to verify the reliability of analysis and fault detection of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Iron Loss Calculation Based on Loss Surface Hysteresis Model and Its Verification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Over the years, iron loss evaluation is still a tough issue. A lot of iron loss models have been developed, and most of them are based on the loss separation model. Another alternative is to calculate the iron loss from the hysteresis loop. One benefit of hysteresis models is that the iron loss can be directly obtained if the B-H hysteresis loops are known. This paper introduces an iron loss estimation method based on the loss surface (LS) hysteresis model and finite element analysis. The proposed method has been applied for iron loss evaluation on different topology specimens. Different excitations with harmonics are investigated. The calculated iron loss is compared with the measured one, which verified the modeling accuracy of the proposed method. The developed LS hysteresis model is applied to calculate the iron loss of an interior permanent magnet synchronous motor. From the evaluation of results, it is shown that the proposed iron loss method can be applied in electromagnetic mechanisms.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic interference of shared tower 5G base station antennas on micro-meteorological online monitoring equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of 5G communication technology and the widespread application of micrometeorological online monitoring equipment, the electromagnetic interference of 5G base station antennas on shared towers to micro-meteorological online monitoring equipment arranged on the same tower has attracted widespread attention. To this end, according to the working principle of 5G base station antennas, analyze the interference mechanism of 5G base station antennas on micro-meteorological online monitoring equipment; Combining the principle of the array antenna and the theory of electrically large-size metal scatterers, a mathematical model of electromagnetic interference of 5G base station antennas on the micro-meteorological online monitoring equipment under the background of the tower is established; Taking the actual shared tower as an example, the electromagnetic interference simulation model of the 5G base station antenna to the micro-meteorological online monitoring equipment was established, and the electromagnetic interference law of the 5G base station antenna to the micro-meteorological online monitoring equipment was calculated under different antenna numbers, powers and inclination angles., Provides a certain theoretical basis for the subsequent study of the electromagnetic environment of shared towers.

Author Keywords: Theory of Electrically Large Metal Scatterers

articleTitle: Harmonic Analysis of V2G System Based on Integrated Filter Inductor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Integrated On-Board Charge (IOBC) is a very promising technique for hybrid/electric vehicle charging and discharging because it reused the existing winding inductance of the traction motor for filtering the harmonics. However, when harmonic components in the power grid is an important factor in evaluating the quality of power supply, the traction motor cannot be treated as an ideal inductance anymore. It is necessary to consider the extra harmonic components bring in by slot effect and saturation effect of traction motors. In this paper, the high fidelity reduced order model of a typical permanent magnet machine is built and adopted in a vehicle to grid charging/discharging system as the filter inductor. The harmonics of the phase currents at different locations are analyzed and compared with that of an ideal filter inductor. It is found that the harmonic generated by the inverter PWM voltage has a very different spectrum when compared with the integrated inductor. To ensure the total harmonic distortion of the system meets the requirement of the power grid, performance and design specifications for the traction motors are suggested.

articleTitle: LCC/MMC Coordinated Control Strategy Applied to DC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Line commutated Converter (LCC) and modular multilevel converter (MMC) are two commonly used converters in AC/DC power grid. LCC has the advantages of large capacity, low equipment cost and low operating loss, but also has the disadvantages such as slow response speed, which cannot control DC voltage well. Compared with LCC, MMC has the advantages of faster response speed, but also brings the disadvantages of higher operating loss, higher equipment cost, and smaller capacity. In order to reasonably exploit the advantages of LCC and MMC, LCC is introduced into DC distribution networks and a coordinated LCC/MMC control strategy applicable to DC distribution network structures is proposed in this paper. In steady-state operation, LCC and MMC perform power distribution according to the set distribution ratio, and LCC can be put into operation or shut down at the right time according to power changes. When power fluctuation occurs in the DC distribution network, DC voltage fluctuation spikes can be reduced by MMC under the action of the virtual direct current generator (VDG) control strategy. The simulation results of MATLAB/SIMULINK verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Research on identification of occasional ultra-high frequency partial discharge in ultra-high voltage GIS based on K-Means
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The on-site live detection process will inevitably suffer from environmental interference and reduce the quality of the collected partial discharge signal. In this paper, based on the live detection of the ultra-high voltage(UHV) substation 1000kV GIS, the original UHF signal is collected as the original data of partial discharge(PD) evaluation, and the K-Means clustering algorithm based on time domain characteristics is proposed to identify the UHF PD of UHV GIS. Firstly, the characteristic parameters of different UHF sensor channel signals are extracted as the clustering eigenvalues to cluster the original UHF signal. According to the clustering results, the clustering boundary criterion and correction coefficient are proposed to effectively eliminate the interference signals of inclusions in the original signal, obtain high-quality partial discharge data, and locate the defects. The positioning results of PD data obtained by this method and the results of manual processing are compared with the positioning results of ultrasonic signal detected in the field. The positioning accuracy of this method is improved by 3.88%, reaching 99.83%, which verifies the effectiveness and accuracy of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Control Strategy for Grid Inetgration of Flywheel Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Compared with the battery energy storage system, the flywheel energy storage system (FESS) applied in the power grid has many advantages, such as faster dynamic response, longer service life, unlimited charge/discharge times, and high power density, etc. However, the control strategy for grid integration of the FESS is critical in practical grid application. Aimed to participate in high frequently power regulation of the grid power using the FESS, this paper studies the charge/discharge process of the FESS and proposes a two-stage control strategy for grid integration of the FESS through the back-to-back converters. The grid side converter controls the DC voltage and the reactive power output to the power grid. The machine side converter controls the rotor speed of the flywheel in the start-up state and then switches to control the active power of the flywheel machine after the rotor speed up to the set value. The grid integrated simulation results of the FESS based on the PSCAD software verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Similarity Laws in Dual-frequency Capacitively Coupled RF Plasmas with Electrical Asymmetry Effect
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electrical asymmetry effect (EAE) in capacitively coupled radio frequency (rl) discharges has been shown to control plasma parameters independently to some extent. One method of generating EAE is to tune the phase angle between the driving fundamental frequency and its second harmonic. The de bias in this type of dual-frequency rf plasmas can be controlled approximately linearly by adjusting the phase. Previous reports have indicated that the similarity law (SL) is an effective method for predicting the fundamental discharge parameters in rf plasmas, requiring that the gas pressure p, discharge gap d, and driving frequency f simultaneously satisfy a proportional relationship. In this work, we use fully kinetic particle-in-cell simulations to investigate plasma parameters control for low-pressure dual-frequency capacitively coupled discharges, via both adjusting the phase difference and scaling combined parameter [p, d, f] under SL conditions. The validity of the SL scaling in dual-frequency rf plasmas with EAE is discussed based upon the simulation results, including the electron density and de bias. The SL scalings of the fundamental parameters are confirmed in electrically asymmetric rf discharges. That is, with EAE the nature of the plasma characteristics is maintained under similar discharge conditions. The results indicate that the combination of EAE and SL scaling allows for more accurate control of rf plasmas, e.g., the plasma density and ion energy properties of interest in microelectronics manufacturing.

articleTitle: Transient Voltage Stability Assessment Of High Proportion Wind Power Transmission End Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A method to evaluate the transient voltage stability of high proportion wind power transmission network is proposed. Starting from the transient overvoltage calculation formula, the calculation formula of the limit short-circuit ratio is derived, and then the limit short-circuit ratio is obtained by taking the transient overvoltage amplitude as the known quantity. Considering the influence of wind farm grid connection on the short-circuit ratio, the calculation formula of the system short-circuit ratio after wind power grid connection is further derived, and then the limit short-circuit ratio is taken as the known quantity, The ultimate wind power permeability corresponding to the ultimate short-circuit ratio is calculated by substituting the formula, which is used as an index to evaluate the transient voltage stability of high proportion wind power transmission terminal system.

articleTitle: Market Clearing of Integrated Electricity and Heat Systems Considering Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the integrated electric-heat system (IEHS), the uncertainties of renewable energy and load increase the adjustable cost of the energy suppliers. To assign the adjustable cost reasonably, this paper proposes a clearing method of the IEHS considering uncertainty to obtain the uncertainty price of wind power and load. First, a robust model of IEHS based on affine policy is proposed, and its dual form is obtained. Second, the calculation method of uncertainty price is developed based on the solution of dual model. Last, the proposed method is testified through simulation, and the obtained solution is analysed.

articleTitle: Plasma Preparation of Graphene and Hydrogen with Different Etching Gases for Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, the chemical redox method is still one of the main methods for preparing graphene powder in the industry. However, this method is expensive, complicated, dangerous, and badly polluted in environment. In recent years, with the continuous development of electrical power sources and materials, the novel plasma technology has shown its unique advantages in the production of graphene and hydrogen by the pyrolysis of methane, wherein, much electrical energy can be transformed into chemical energy. The special layered and stacked structure of graphene nanosheets makes it one of the good choices for electrically conductive material for LIB. Therefore, the development of a plasma-based graphene has a positive effect for the production of graphene (and also hydrogen) on an industrial scale. In this work, graphene nanosheets were successfully fabricated by one-step method in Ar-H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and Ar-CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> by AC gliding arc discharge, and the formation conditions of plasmonic graphene were further understood by thermodynamic calculations. Finally, plasma-processed graphene as a conductive assistant constructs an effective conductive network, which improves the specific capacity of the LiFePO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>/acetylene black electrode with good cycling performance and electrical conductivity.

articleTitle: Research on Levitation Control of Stepped Rotor Type 12/14 Bearingless SRM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The traditional 12/14 bearingless switched reluctance motor (BSRM) with hybrid stator poles cannot self-start at some specific rotor position due to the two-phase structure. The new stepped rotor type BSRM solves the problem of self-start of the motor by optimization of stator and rotor structure. Based on levitation force control scheme in the traditional BSRM, this paper studies the levitation force control scheme for the new stepped rotor type BSRM. According to the natural decoupling characteristics between levitation force and torque, the independent control scheme, including hysteresis current control method and current chopper control method, is proposed to realize the levitation force and torque control. The levitation and torque control adopts PID and PI controller, respectively, to adjust the error between each parameter and the given quantity. Finally, the correctness of the control strategy is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: A Permanent Magnet Synchronous Linear Motor ADRC Position Control Algorithm Research
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the servo performance of the permanent magnet synchronous linear motor, a vector control system based on the ADRC position control algorithm is designed. The traditional PI controller is used for the current and speed loops, and the simplified control model is merged and simplified by the transfer function. More ever, the motor controller parameters are adjusted by using the traditional control theory method, and the speed regulation performance of the linear motor is verified by simulation. In the motor position loop, the control performance of the ADRC controller is verified by comparing it with the PI controller in simulation, which shows that it has some anti-tampering and compensation ability for the variation of the given position.

articleTitle: Cooperation-based DMPC Controller for Two-area Interconnected Power Grid with BESS
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the actual operation of interconnected power systems, there is a certain degree of coupling between different regions. Therefore, when studying the load frequency control (LFC) problem of interconnected power systems, it is necessary to not only ensure the global control effect of the interconnected system but also consider the communication burden between controllers. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a cooperation-based distributed model predictive control (DMPC) strategy for a two-area interconnected power system composed of a traditional thermal power unit and a battery energy storage system (BESS). The controller makes full use of the network communication environment of the power system, completes the information exchange between different subsystems, disperses the global optimization performance index of load frequency control into the control objectives of each subsystem, and completes the optimal control through a certain weighting method, thereby reduces the computational burden in the control process. Finally, in order to verify the feasibility of the proposed cooperation-based DMPC, simulation experiments have been completed on the simulation platform for different working conditions.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Modular Multilevel DC-DC Converter with Minimized Circulating Current
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The transformer-less modular multilevel converter (MMC) dc-dc converter can realize a direct dc-dc conversion without the intermediate ac-ac stage. However, the voltage conversion ratio of the existing transformer-less MMC dc-dc is limited. Otherwise, the ac current that circulating inside the MMC arms is too large to affect the efficiency of the converter. A transformer-less hybrid modular multilevel dc-dc converter with minimized circulating current is proposed in this paper. In the proposed topology, the upper and lower arms are composed of half bridge submodules (HBSMs) that are connected through delta configured arms composed by full bridge submodules (FBSMs). The ac circulating current can be minimized by controlling the delta connected FBSMs which can be operated as a STATCOM. Moreover, benefitting from adopting the FBSMs, the proposed topology not only has the capability of blocking the dc fault but also eliminates the large passive filters. Real-time simulation is carried out to validate the performance.

articleTitle: Towards a More Resilient Restoration Process: PMRM Based Transmission Network Reconfiguration Strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, power system outages caused by extreme events have occurred frequently all over the world, warning people that blackouts are not far away from us. It is of great importance to make a robust scheme for the efficient and successful restoration of system function. Secondary faults or contingencies are rarely considered in the existing research on power system restoration. In view of that, firstly, the necessity of considering the impact of contingency in transmission network reconfiguration scheme is discussed. Then, based on Partitioned Multi-Objective Risk Method (PMRM), a novel resilience index considering the differential influence of contingencies is proposed. Further, an optimization strategy of network reconfiguration considering the active improvement of resilience is proposed, and a practical solving model based on window rolling mechanism is established. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the IEEE 118-bus system.

articleTitle: Suppressing Secondary Magnetic Field Radiation for IPT System Using Dual Detuned Receiving Loops
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the power improvement of inductive power transfer (IPT) systems, severe eddy loss and heating caused by a strong magnetic field are inevitable. Simultaneously, a mass of ferrite cores is needed to avoid magnetic saturation, leading to the increase of system weight and volume. This work proposes an IPT system with LCC-dual detuned series (LCC-DDS) topology, which can suppress the secondary magnetic field by generating two nearly reverse magnetic fluxes. Besides, the phase difference between dual receiving currents is optimized via finite element simulations to achieve a minimum average magnetic flux density ($B_{\text {ave}}$) in the receiver core. Simulation results reveal that the $B_{\text {ave}}$ of the receiver core in a traditional tuned LCC-Series (LCC-S) IPT system is four times higher than that in the LCC-DDS IPT system. Experiment tests are conducted on the LCC-DDS and LCC-S IPT systems at a 540W transfer power, respectively. The core temperature of the LCC-DDS system is 36.4 °C, while that of the LCC-S system is 42.2°C after a 10-minute operation. It indicates that the proposed method can suppress the magnetic field efficiently.

articleTitle: A Robust Measurement-Based Error Signal based on Model Predictive Control for AGC system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Automatic generation control (AGC) plays an important role in maintaining frequency stability for interconnected power systems. However, traditional area control error (ACE) signal used in AGC has its limitations including parameter selection and ignorance of synchronous machines’ nonlinearity. To improve AGC robustness, a novel measurement-based error signal (MBE) is proposed in this paper, which guarantees frequency dynamic performance is not relating to system operational parameters. Moreover, a model predictive control (MPC) is proposed to minimize MBE which has smaller overshoot and quick settle time compared with traditional PID controller. The effectiveness and robustness of proposed error signal and controller are validated through case studies based on Kundur’s two area power systems.

articleTitle: Mechanism Analysis of Subsequent Commutation Failure Considering PLL Dynamics in LCC-HVDC Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the reasons of subsequent commutation failure (SCF) of line commutated converter based high voltage direct current (LCC-HVDC). Firstly, according to the mechanism of commutation failure (CF), it can be found that the actual firing angle, DC current and AC voltage of inverter all have influence on CF. Secondly, based on the generation mechanism of firing pulse in LCC-HVDC, it is pointed out that the phase locked loop (PLL) dynamics can cause the deviation between the actual firing angle and the firing angle order from control system. Then, the transient characteristics of PLL after the first commutation failure (FCF) are analyzed. Compared with other factors that affect SCF, the PLL dynamics in fault recovery period is considered as the main reason leading to SCF. Finally, a method to suppress SCF is proposed, and the effectiveness of the proposed conclusion and method is verified through the simulation of CIGRE benchmark model in PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Research on the integrated fault detection method of primary and secondary fusion intelligent switchgear
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Fault detection of power equipment is the premise of reliable operation of intelligent switch. This paper presents a new method of overall and local integrated testing for complex power equipment. This method is based on the scenario design of single-phase grounding fault under working conditions, the generation method of characteristic waveform library and the complete set of high-precision fault waveform inversion technology, which improves the test efficiency. After comprehensive comparison and comparison with the traditional test methods, the test efficiency is improved by using this test method.

articleTitle: A new method of active power filter using dead beat control and repeated control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A new control method using the deadbeat control and the repetitive control for the line current detection type active filter is proposed. Aiming at the periodicity of the harmonics, the repetitive control is applied to the harmonics compensation control and the deadbeat control is applied to the current regulator. The time leading is introduced to compensate a time delay due to the deadbeat control and a low pass filter. Performance of the harmonics compensation by the proposed scheme is much better improved than the conventional proportional control. In this paper, the theoretical analysis of the control strategy is given, and the superiority and accuracy of active filter using the beat free control and repetitive control are verified by simulation and experiment. The results show that this method has high application value.

articleTitle: Analytical Optimization of Surface-Inset Machines With Eccentric Three-Piece Halbach Magnets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An analytical model of a surface-inset permanent magnet (PM) machine with eccentric three-piece Halbach magnets is proposed. An analytical optimization technique for the proposed model is used to obtain the optimal eccentric height that minimizes the total harmonic distortion (THD) of the air-gap flux density. Compared with the concentric model, the optimized eccentric model has the better electromagnetic performances including the back-electromotive force (EMF), the air-gap field and the electromagnetic torque. The presented analytical predictions are validated by a finite element analysis (FEA).

articleTitle: An IGBT driver protection method applied to NPC three-level topology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The MW-class high-power NPC three-level inverter is prone to electromagnetic interference during operation, which will cause abnormal driving signal, damage of IGBT and other problems. The current IGBT driver protection technology can not avoid this problem well. In this paper, an integral protection method for bridge arm is proposed. This method can monitor all the driving signals of the whole IGBT bridge arm in real time and realize the driving logic protection and timing protection through the driving pattern recognition technology. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Evaluation of Multi-Energy Microgrid Based on Entropy-Independence-Gl Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Multi-energy microgrids show great potential in relieving energy crisis and protecting environment. Energy efficiency is one of the most important indexes in evaluating multi-energy microgrids’ performance. Three indexes as primary energy ratio, renewable energy consumption ratio and primary energy consumption are selected. Entropy-independence-G1 method is proposed for weight calculation. Entropy method determines the weight according to indexes’ variability. Independence method reduces the influence of reduplicative information. G1 method is used to provide subjective preference. Owing to the consideration of both objective information and subjective decisions, the evaluation accuracy can be improved. Case study has been done and the energy efficiency evaluation comprehensive scores are calculated. For a typical multi-energy microgrid, the system has better energy efficiency when operated in grid-connected with power injection mode.

articleTitle: The Pulsed Discharge within Bubbles in Dynamic PEF Treatment Chamber under Repetitive Pulses
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Pulsed electric field (PEF) is a promising non-thermal sterilization technology for liquid foods, and treatment chamber discharge is a bottleneck problem limiting its industrial application. Unlike the static treatment chamber, the pulsed discharge within bubble in the dynamic treatment chamber is influenced by the flow field, and the bubble evolution before discharge may be very different. In this paper, we focus on the differences and similarities between the dynamic and static treatment chambers of pulsed discharge within bubble under repetitive rectangular pulses by using plate electrodes, and study the morphology and subsequent development of the discharge arc within bubbles during pulsed discharge in the dynamic treatment chamber. Findings in this study may provide a reference for the pulse parameters and the selection of the flow rate in the PEF dynamic treatment chamber.

articleTitle: Charged Droplet Population Concentration Calculated by Equivalent Surface Tension
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electric charge usually changes some properties of condensation nuclei. These phenomena are important for cloud condensation nuclei (CCN) and cloud droplet concentration in natural and industrial processes. To explore the relationship between the microphysics of CCN and the macroscopic phenomenon of cloud droplet concentration, the Raoult’s effect and electric charge should be considered, which affect the cloud droplet concentration by reducing the saturated water vapor pressure required for growth on the droplet surface. On the other hand, the polarization in nucleation promoted by the charge is considered, which is also regarded as affecting the cloud droplet concentration. In this paper, the equivalent surface tension is proposed to predict the changing trend of cloud droplet population.

articleTitle: Active Current-Limiting Control Based DC Fault Ride-Through of Full-Bridge MMC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Most of existing current protection strategies of flexible DC systems mainly rely on fault identification, and then block the converter through the action of the protection system. In this paper, a novel DC voltage with active current-limiting capability has been proposed for DC fault ride-through (DC-FRT) of full-bridge modular multilevel converter (FB-MMC). With this method, the output of DC voltage control has been directly used as the zero-axis component of final modulation signals of FB-MMC, to control the number of positive or negative insertions of the full-bridge sub-modules (FB-SMs), with the final purpose for current-limiting in DC-FRT. In addition, a simple DC voltage feedforward control has been adopted to improve DC voltage dynamic, to reduce the peak value of the transient fault current. The PSCAD/EMTDC simulation results show that the proposed control can effectively limit the peak fault current and provide a stable steady-state fault current without relying on fault detection.

articleTitle: A new preliminary design method of switched reluctance motor to ensure the acceleration time of high-speed and large-inertia flywheel rotor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the field of pulse power system, high-power and high-energy pulse alternator such as homopolar inductor alternator is used to provide intense pulses. The rotor is designed to be large and can store enough energy for satisfying multi-shot requirement. How to design a suitable and compact drive motor, make full use of the performance of the motor, and accelerate the flywheel rotor to the target speed with the required acceleration time (AT) is a matter of concern. For this reason, this paper proposes a new preliminary design method for switched reluctance motor (SRM). This paper first uses the operating characteristic of SRM to avoid the precise analysis of the torque and determines the appropriate rated power and rated speed through the AT requirement. Secondly, considering the limits of each parameter in the design process, the value range of rated current, stator inner diameter and number of coil turns is obtained. Third, combined with the classic control method of SRM, considering the limit cases in the control process, the constraints at three moments in the design process are obtained. Finally, the effectiveness of the design method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Pollution Flashover Prediction of Insulators Based on Combined Probability Density of Infrared Image Temperature and Leakage Current
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increase of the capacity of the power grid and the voltage level, the pollution flashover accidents of insulators in the power system frequently occur, which leads to the decrease of the stability of the power grid and affects the production and domestic electricity consumption. At present, the prediction of insulator pollution flashover mainly relies on the characteristic parameters obtained by various single-function detection devices and the prediction accuracy is low. In this paper, the pollution flashover probability of insulators is predicted by exploring the evolution law of discharge defects of polluted insulators. By combining infrared image temperature and leakage current detection data, the probability density distribution of infrared temperature and leakage current envelopes is studied and a joint probability density function is constructed. Based on the joint probability density function, the probability of insulator pollution flashover is predicted and verified by experiments. The experimental results show that the prediction of insulator pollution flashover based on the joint probability density has higher accuracy than the prediction of single characteristic parameter which is of great significance for insulator pollution flashover warning.

articleTitle: Multi-Time Granularity Line Loss Prediction for Distribution Network Based on MIC and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of smart grid construction and the increasing maturity of big data and artificial intelligence technologies in recent years, the exponential growth of grid operation measurement data has provided effective support for accurate prediction of distribution grid line loss. However, the traditional prediction method based on physical mechanisms cannot effectively analyze the non-linear hidden connection between the multiple sources of the data and the transmission line loss of the distribution power grid. Thus, this article proposes a multi-time granularity prediction way for the transmission line loss of the distribution power grid based on the maximal information coefficient (MIC) and deep learning, which quantitatively describes the correlation between input features and output features. Compared with linear correlation analysis, the feature selection method based on MIC is more comprehensive and can explore the nonlinear correlation between input features and output features. And based on the selected input feature set, combined with the deep LSTM neural network, a multi-time granularity prediction pattern of the transmission line loss is constructed, and the prediction accuracy is further improved. Finally, the proposed prediction method is validated by combining the real line loss data.

articleTitle: Zero Trust Security of Energy Resource Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The security of Energy Data collection is the basis of achieving reliability and security intelligent of smart grid. The newest security communication of Data collection is Zero Trust communication; The Strategy of Zero Trust communication is that don’t trust any device of outside or inside. Only that device authenticate is successful and software and hardware is more security, the Energy intelligent power system allow the device enroll into network system, otherwise deny these devices. When the device has been communicating with the Energy system, the Zero Trust still need to detect its security and vulnerability, if device have any security issue or vulnerability issue, the Zero Trust deny from network system, it ensures that Energy power system absolute security, which lays a foundation for the security analysis of intelligent power unit.

articleTitle: A Multiple Load CPT System with Independent- Load Output Voltage for Railway Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electronically controlled pneumatic (ECP) system is essential to ensure the railway transportation system’s braking safety. Traditionally, the ECP system needs a long cable to supply power for each train body’s brake controller. However, there are many bumps in a train, and the transmission lines and plugs are easy to fall off simultaneously. It brings a big challenges to the safe and reliable operation of the railway system. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a capacitive power transfer (CPT) system to supply power for a multiple-load ECP brake system. The proposed system can supply power to multiple loads simultaneous and the change of load resistance will not affect the other load. The transmitter of the proposed CPT system adopts CL compensation, while the receivers adopt LCCL topology. The receiver is not only receiver the electric power for load but also transfer the power to the next load. To verify the proposed theory, a scale-down experimental prototype with three loads was implemented. The experimental results agree well with the analysis. With a 200mm misalignment (2/3 length of coupler plates), the output power can reach 83.32W (150W rated). The change rate of the output voltage is less than 12% when other receivers are moved out.

Author Keywords: Wireless power transfer (WPT). Electronically controlled pneumatic (ECP)

articleTitle: A New Three-Phase L-Type Double Active Bridge Buck-Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Non-isolated bidirectional DC-DC converters have been widely used in hybrid DC grids and energy storage systems. Aiming at the scenarios of wide ranges of input and output voltages and bidirectional power transmission, a new three-phase L-type dual active bridge Buck-Boost converter design is proposed. The proposed design not only realizes the forward and reverse flows of power and the bidirectional buck-boost function, but also has the advantages of high efficiency, low cost and small size of non-isolated DC converters. The adopted three-phase interleaved structure reduces the output current ripple and improves the power level of the converter. The working principle of the converter is analyzed, the single-phase equivalent circuit of the converter is obtained, and the mathematical expressions of the inductor current in different switching states under two operating modals are obtained, then the power transfer characteristics of the converter are deduced, Aiming at the three phase current unbalance problem in actual working conditions, an inductor current balance control strategy based on phase-shift control is proposed, which effectively suppresses the three phase current imbalance problem. Finally, the theoretical results are verified by experiments, which prove the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed topology and control strategy.

articleTitle: Harmonic Suppression Strategy Of 12-Pulse Controlled Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the harmonic suppression ability of 12-pulse controlled rectifier, a DC-side harmonic suppression scheme based on predictive current control strategy is studied. The control strategy improves the input current waveform of the rectifier by adding a boost converter circuit on the DC-side to meet the requirements of input current harmonic suppression under different load conditions. According to the current relationship between AC and DC sides of 12-pulse rectifier and the ideal current waveform at DC side, this paper analyzes and gives the input current waveform of boost converter circuit, and uses PWM method to adjust the input current of boost converter. Simulation results show that this method can effectively suppress the input current harmonics of 12-pulse controlled rectifier.

articleTitle: A high voltage pulse power supply based on piezoelectric transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The piezoelectric transformer has the advantage of high power density, high boost ratio and low electromagnetic interference. It is often used to generate AC and DC high voltage, but there are few studies on the generation of pulse high voltage. In this paper, a quasi-pulse power supply system based on piezoelectric transformer is proposed and designed. The control of the power supply system consists of two parts. The first part is the tracking control of the resonant frequency of the piezoelectric transformer, and the second part is the specific harmonic control method of the piezoelectric transformer. The hardware circuit of the power supply system is designed, and a fast decomposition calculation method of resonant current component is proposed to realize the fast sampling of harmonic amplitude and phase. A prototype of pulse power supply based on piezoelectric transformer is designed and manufactured, and a plasma jet is generated using the prototype.

articleTitle: Prediction of Conducted Disturbance in Drive System of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the drive system of permanent magnet synchronous motor, high dv/dt and di/dt are generated due to the rapid on-off of the switching device, thereby giving rise to significant conducted electromagnetic disturbance, which generates severe obstruction to both adjacent equipments and itself. To solve this problem, relevant research focus on the simulation accuracy of the high-frequency parasitic parameters since it is closely related to such electromagnetic disturbance in the drive system. This paper clarifies the disturbance source and propagation path of the drive system, details the extraction process of high-frequency parasitic parameters,proposes a modeling and prediction methodology for the conducted disturbance of permanent magnet synchronous motor drive system and then carries out simulation and experiment to verify the proposed methodology. Experiments show that the methodology can effectively predict the conducted disturbance waveform of the motor drive system,which sheds lights on the study of electromagnetic disturbance problems of drives in various permanent magnet synchronous motor.

articleTitle: Control Strategy of Three-port DC Converter based on Energy Balance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the widespread access of new energy sources, the degree of power electronics in the power system has been greatly improved. As an important part of the power electronic power system, the DC transformer is the key equipment for connecting the medium and low voltage DC bus. In the case of ensuring the withstand voltage of the device, how to realize the stable transmission of power is a hot research topic at present. The modular three-port DC converter combines modular multi-level converter (MMC) with input-series output-parallel (ISOP), which not only solves the problem of device voltage stress, but also realizes multi-port energy interaction and improves power density. Based on this modular three-port DC converter, a comprehensive control strategy based on energy balance is proposed in this paper. The characteristic of this control strategy is that it not only stabilize the voltage on the low-voltage side, but also suppress the fluctuation of the capacitor voltage of the sub-module on the medium-voltage side. The simulation results show that the control strategy has good dynamic response ability and anti-disturbance ability.

articleTitle: Whole-system Potential and Benefit of Energy Storage by Vehicle-to-grid (V2G) under Carbon Neutrality Target in China
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to high penetration of renewable energy, the new electricity system oriented to carbon neutrality will face the bottleneck of insufficient flexibility resource. Electric vehicle (EV) shall become a core hub of energy consumption and storage. This paper proposes a coupled transportation-energy-electricity framework to evaluate the technical potential and whole-system value of smart orderly charging and vehicle-to-grid (V2G) in China. This approach simultaneously optimizes power supply installation, transmission network, storage capacity, as well as unit commitment, power dispatch and system reliability for real-time nationwide energy balancing, while considering EV ownership development, travel behavior and charging demand. Scenarios of unmanaged charging, smart charging and V2G are carried out for cases of 2025, 2030, 2040, 2050 and 2060. Results show that, in 2040, the total installed energy of EV batteries will be over 20 TWh and the flexible adjustment capacity exceeds 10 TWh. The V2G operation can reduce up to 730 Mt CO2 emission annually. The levelized whole-system cost for low-carbon transformation can be declined by up to 49.7% till 2060 under V2G scenario compared with unmanaged charging. Considering thermal power freely developing as business-as-usual case, the unit decarbonization cost could even be reduced by 100.2% to be minus through V2G integration in 2050.

articleTitle: Digital Control Method of Synchronous Rectification for Bidirectional CLLLC Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low efficiency and high temperature of the switches under a wide range of working conditions of the bidirectional CLLLC resonant converter, this paper proposes a digital controller of synchronous rectification for the rectifier on the secondary side of the high frequency transformer. Based on the analysis of operating mode of different frequency, the relationship between driving time of the synchronous switch on the secondary side and the driving time of the active device on the primary side is obtained. In a wide operating frequency range, the delayed turn-on and leading turnoff time of driving signal for the synchronous devices is obtained respectively by calculation and piecewise linear function fitting methods. Compared with other synchronous rectification control, this method is realized by pure digital control, and can be flexibly applied to high-power applications with a wide range of bus voltage variation. Furthermore, this method is suitable for bidirectional converters. The shortcoming that the analog control chip is sensitive to bus voltage variation can be overcomed by using this method. Meanwhile, the proposed control method is simple to be implemented and is very cost-effective. Finally, a simulation platform and experimental prototype were built to verify the proposed method. The results of simulation and experiment show that this strategy can increase the efficiency of the CLLLC system by about 3%, and the temperature of the synchronous switches are greatly decreased.

articleTitle: Summary and Prospect of Technology Development of MVDC and LVDC Distribution Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Compared to the AC distribution network, DC distribution network has the advantage on reliability, transmission capacity and power flow control. This article firstly introduces the current development of DC power distribution technology and the power distribution demonstration projects at home and abroad, and sorts out the main technical standards of DC power distribution system voltage levels. On this basis, the five typical application scenarios of DC power distribution technology are clarified and the main characteristics of various scenarios are further analyzed. Study the structural differences and configuration requirements of various typical medium-voltage DC distribution networks. By comparing and analyzing the technical characteristics of various AC/DC converters, DC transformers and DC circuit breakers, the technical requirements of various DC power distribution equipment in terms of topology, control strategy, and magnetic integration technology are put forward. Furthermore, in view of the advantages and disadvantages of different control methods, research requirements for multi-operation state conversion, circulation suppression, and energy optimization are proposed. Finally, the protection requirements of AC side faults, converter faults, DC side faults and other types of faults are analyzed, and the basic requirements for DC distribution protection configuration and technical requirements for fault identification, fault location, coordination and cooperation of multiple voltage levels are put forward.

articleTitle: Extended Load Flexibility of Industrial P2H Plants: A Process Constraint-Aware Scheduling Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The operational flexibility of industrial power-to-hydrogen (P2H) plants enables admittance of volatile renewable power and provides auxiliary regulatory services for the power grid. Aiming to extend the flexibility of the P2H plant further, this work presents a scheduling method by considering detailed process constraints of the alkaline electrolyzers. Unlike existing works that assume constant load range, the presented scheduling framework fully exploits the dynamic processes of the electrolyzer, including temperature and hydrogen-to-oxygen (HTO) crossover, to improve operational flexibility. Varying energy conversion efficiency under different load levels and temperature is also considered. The scheduling model is solved by proper mathematical transformation as a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP), which determines the on-off-standby states and power levels of different electrolyzers in the P2H plant for daily operation. With experiment-verified constraints, a case study show that compared to the existing scheduling approach, the improved flexibility leads to a 1.627% profit increase when the P2H plant is directly coupled to the photovoltaic power.

articleTitle: Online Learning Enabled Hierarchical Distributionally Robust Model Predictive Control of Green-Hydrogen Microgrids under Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel online-learning enabled hierarchical operation framework for a green-hydrogen microgrid (MG) with a high penetration of renewable energy (RE) and hybrid energy storage. The operation framework features a bi-level multi-timescale structure which integrates a day-ahead optimal scheduling with online learning distributionally robust model predictive control (OL-DRMPC). Day-ahead scheduling optimization is employed at the high level to provide MG energy dispatch references, while the OL-DRMPC is carried out in the low level for reference-tracking under uncertainties incurred by RE and load forecast errors. To confront the imperfect knowledge of forecast-error distributions, distributionally robust conditional value-at-risk constraints are imposed on MG system states, namely the storage of battery and hydrogen, for a family of distributions called ambiguity set. By exploiting a Dirichlet process mixture model, a streaming-data-driven ambiguity set for uncertain parameters is devised over the runtime of controller and flexibly captures multimodal structure and fine-grained moment information of each mixture component. Enabled by online learning, the proposed strategy enjoys the merit of offering a reliable and intelligent MG operation. Case studies are used to demonstrate its effectiveness and superiority.

articleTitle: Research on the strategy of the fault recovery and emergency repair of distribution network with distributed generation under extreme conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the situation that the distribution network is prone to multiple failures in the process of fault repair under extreme weather such as typhoon, thunderstorm, rain and snow, a distribution network fault recovery and emergency repair strategy including distributed generation (DG) is proposed. In the process of fault repair, the objective function is to minimize the economic loss. Then, in the fault recovery strategy, the main network and island partition coordinated control are used for recovery. In the fault repair strategy, the inertia weight is dynamically adjusted and the similar particles are mutated to solve the premature issue of particle swarm optimization (PSO). In view of the multiple faults in the emergency repair process, the optimal recovery and repair strategy is adjusted for each fault to ensure that the distribution network is reliable and quickly repaired to normal operation. Finally, the IEEE-33 node system is used for example analysis. Simulating the multiple faults occur in the distribution network, the studied strategy optimizes the fault recovery and emergency repair scheme of distribution network after each fault, which shortens the recovery time and reduces the economic loss. The results verify the superiority of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Short-Term Wind Power Interval Prediction Based on GD-LSTM and Bootstrap Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wind power forecasting plays a significant role in the stability, security and reliability of power system. Compared with point forecast, interval forecast is able to quantify the uncertainty effectively. In this paper, a novel interval forecast method based on modified Gaussian-Dropout long short-term memory (GD-LSTM) network and block bootstrap is proposed to predict short-term wind power. In this model, prediction uncertainty is concerned to come from model parameters and data noise. Bootstrap is used to generate multiple subsets firstly, and then LSTM models are trained by these subsets. The test dataset prediction intervals (PIs) are generated with confidence levels ranging from 85% to 95%. The results demonstrate that the PIs generated by proposed method can always reach the targets, the coverage probability generated by block bootstrap may lower than other methods in sometimes, while the comprehensive scores are always the best.

articleTitle: Hardware-in-loop based Digital Twin Technology for Integrated Energy System: A Case Study of Guangyang Island in Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Digital twin technology is a virtual representation technology for representing the dynamic process or states of physical object. This paper explore the feasible approach of using digital twin technologies in integrated energy system (IES) and propose a hardware-in-loop based digital twin solution infrastructure. The infrastructure combines the digital simulator, external communication terminal, physical equipment and independent physical equipment simulators as a feasible digital twin system for integrated energy system that can support the planning and operation. The case study establishes a digital twin system and model the IES on Guangyang Island, Chongqing. The digital twin model can verify the operation plan of the IES and let the system operation in various optional environments, which can effectively support the design and operational scheme of the IES.

articleTitle: Coordinated Operation Strategy of Multi-energy Flow System with 5G Base Station Participating in Comprehensive Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The future energy system will integrate multiple energy sources such as electricity, gas, and heat. The mode of independent operation and dispatch of each subsystem will not be suitable for the operation and dispatch of the tightly coupled integrated energy system. For this reason, the integrated demand response of electricity, gas, and heat is introduced into the integrated energy system, in which a 5G base station is taken into consideration for the electric load, to give full play to the scheduling potential of the load side. Then, in order to improve the economy of system operation and the level of new energy consumption, the day-ahead optimal energy flow scheduling model is constructed to minimize the total operating cost of the system. Based on the difference in steady-state transmission characteristics of electricity/gas/heat and the response time of energy equipment, the intraday optimization stage is decomposed into two-time scales. In the longer time scale, the gas and heat subsystems are dispatched and the integrated gas and heat load response is activated. While in the shorter time scale, the power subsystem is finely dispatched and the electric load demand response is activated. Finally, based on the theory of second-order cone relaxation and incremental piecewise linearization, the non-convex and nonlinear problems in the day-intraday optimization model are dealt with, and the day-intraday optimal scheduling strategy of the multi-energy flow integrated energy system is formulated. The results of calculation examples show that the mixed time-scale coordinated scheduling considering 5G base station participating in comprehensive demand response can ensure the safe and economical operation of the system, and realize resource complementarity and energy mutual benefit.

Author Keywords: 5G base stations participating in comprehensive demand response

articleTitle: Optimal Stepwise Inertial Control of Wind Turbine Based on Fuzzy Control and Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing installed wind power capacity, large-scale wind power integration into the grid will reduce the equivalent inertia of the power system and weaken the frequency response characteristics of the system. In order to improve the system frequency control capability, the wind turbine (WT) needs to participate in the grid frequency regulation process. The WT adopts the stepwise inertial control (SIC) to provide a step power increase after load fluctuation to participate in the grid frequency regulation, which helps to suppress the lowest frequency drop. However, the traditional SIC strategy is decoupled from the frequency of the power grid, which causes the WT cannot perceive the change of the frequency. And the serious secondary frequency drop (SFD) will occur when switching the reference power curve during the speed recovery stage. Therefore, this paper proposes an optimal stepwise inertial control of wind turbine based on fuzzy control and deep neural network(DNN) to establish the relationship between frequency state quantity, speed change quantity and SIC strategy so that the WT can dynamically adjust the output power according to the system frequency change and WT speed. The strategy can avoid the secondary frequency drop while improving the performance of the WT frequency regulation. The fuzzy control parameters are optimized by particle swarm optimization (PSO) and the optimal fuzzy control parameters are learned by DNN. The simulation results show that the proposed strategy can overcome the shortcomings of the traditional SIC strategy, effectively smooth the switching process of WT frequency regulation state and make the frequency regulation process more stable. The lowest point of the first frequency drop is better than the traditional SIC strategy and SFD is eliminated.
