articleTitle: Heavy Rare Earth Doped Nd-Fe-B Permanent Magnetic Material Performance Enhancement Methods and Their Motor Application Research
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: NdFeB rare earth permanent magnets are widely used in permanent magnet motors due to their high remanence, high coercivity and high magnetic energy product. However, their relatively poor thermal stability and low senice temperature limit the application of NdFeB magnets. The coercivity can be effectively improved by doping with heavy rare earths to compensate for the flux loss at high temperature. However, the antiferromagnetic coupling between heavy rare earth atoms and Fe atoms will also reduce the remanent magnetization and magnetic energy product of NdFeB magnets. The influence of heavy rare earth doping on the remanence and magnetic energy product of NdFeB magnets can be reduced by process selection and process optimization control while increasing the coercivity as much as possible. The improvement of the performance of heavy rare earth doping can effectively avoid the local demagnetization of magnets, thus expanding its application prospects and potential in permanent magnet motors.

articleTitle: Bidding Behavior Analysis in Joint Electricity and Carbon Market by Hybrid Experimental Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It is important to model the causality behind social behaviors in the electricity market. Existing methods, including theoretical models and economic experiments, are difficult to be applied in practice. In this paper, a data-driven approach, named Hybrid Experimental Learning (HEL) which combined machine learning and experimental economics, is proposed to model social behavior. With the historical and experiment data, HEL applies a machine learning generative model for understanding social behaviors. The output of the generative model is fed into a causal estimator to explain the causality. According to the pilot spot market rule and potential carbon market rule in Guangdong, bidding strategies of generators are generated by Wasserstein generative adversarial networks (WGAN). In addition, an instrumental variable (IV) method based on the local surrogate model is applied for the causal inference between the inputs and outputs of WGANs for coal generators, which can be described as their bidding mechanisms. The effectiveness is verified on bidding strategies simulation in a simplified Guangdong power system.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Energy Consumption Assessment Based on Industry Energy Consumption Structure Part II: Assessment and Forecasting of Energy Consumption in Key Industries at Zhejiang
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Facing the new requirements of energy development and transformation, adjusting the energy consumption structure and controlling the total energy consumption has become the focus of our country’s current urban energy management. Aiming at six key industries in Ningbo, Zhejiang, China, this paper selects five factors that affect the structure of energy consumption from two dimensions of economy and technology, and uses time series data and grey relational analysis method to evaluate the correlation between the five factors and the energy consumption structure of each industry. On this basis, the importance of factors affecting the structure of energy consumption and its industrial characteristics are deeply analyzed. In addition, according to the historical data characteristics of energy consumption in the six key energy-consuming industries in Ningbo, from 2010 to 2020, the trend extrapolation method is used to directly predict the proportion of electric energy consumption in the future years, and the estimation formula of comprehensive energy consumption and comprehensive carbon consumption of the industry is given.

articleTitle: An Economic study of Power Secondary Frequency Regulation with Different Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the power grid structure has undergone great changes, and the penetration of renewable generations challenges the reliable and stable operations of the power grid. As a flexible resource, energy storage systems can be applied to the field of secondary frequency regulations which support conventional thermal units and improves the stable operations. In this paper, an optimal operation strategy of energy storage systems in a regional power grid is presented, and the economic feasibility of different types of energy storage system participating secondary frequency regulation market is studied. Firstly, the mathematical modeling and analysis of the power system frequency regulation with energy storage systems and conventional thermal power units in a regional grid is carried out. Then, a comprehensive economic feasibility study of different energy storage systems participating secondary frequency regulation market is performed. Finally, a comprehensive performance analysis of the secondary frequency regulation is performed according to the system auxiliary service policies and frequency regulation performance indices. The case study results verify that the energy storage systems can greatly improve the secondary frequency regulation performance. However, from the investment point of view, certain economic compensations are required to ensure the economic feasibility of the energy storage systems operations.

articleTitle: A bi-level multi-objective planning method for microgrid with offshore wind power
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The anti-peak characteristics of offshore wind power makes the large-scale offshore wind power cluster integration have a great negative impact on the power system in coastal areas. In order to ensure the safe and stable operation of power system and give consideration to both economy and energy efficiency, a bi-level multi-objective planning model of microgrid with offshore wind power is proposed. Firstly, the microgrid and its investment, operating and maintenance cost model are established. Secondly, a multi-objective function model is established to meet the requirements of economy and energy efficiency. Thirdly, the bi-level multi-objective planning model is established. The upper level is formulated as an optimal capacity allocation problem, while the lower level is an optimal operation scheduling model, and the improved multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the upper and lower models. Finally, a simulation example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

Author Keywords: improved multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm

articleTitle: Short-term load forecasting for industrial users based on Transformer-LSTM hybrid model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Accurate load forecasting for industrial users is crucial segment of promoting the economic operation and green transition of modern power systems, which is helpful to speeding up the process of achieving carbon peak and neutrality goals proposed by China. However, it is challenging to predict the individual industrial load precisely by cause of its significant volatility and randomness. This study proposes a novel short-term load forecasting hybrid model that is integrated of Transformer model and long short-term memory (LSTM) network for industrial users. Transformer model is capable to seize intricate dynamic relationship in long-term temporal data efficiently and accurately, which is used for feature extraction. LSTM is known to be good at time series forecasting, and it is used to forecast industrial users’ loads. The superiority of the proposed method is verified by experiments using three real data sets from different industries in China and Ireland. The analysis results of the three examples show that the proposed model has an obvious improvement in prediction performance compared with the comparison model.

articleTitle: Predictive Optimal Control of Grid-connected Photovoltaics to Support System Frequency
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the high penetration of renewable energy in modern power systems, the necessity for photovoltaics (PVs) to support system frequency tends to be apparent. In view of limited available energy, the manner for PVs to participate the system supporting deserves studies. In this paper, a frequency supporting strategy of the grid-connected PVs based on optimal control and predictive algorithm is proposed. Considering the constraints of available energy and the objective to mitigate the frequency deviation, an optimization model is formulated to derive the optimal reference for PV outputs by Gauss pseudo-spectral method. On this basis, the model predictive control strategy is used to track the optimal reference curve, which is expected to demonstrate a better dynamic response. Finally, a simulation example is constructed in PSCAD/EMTDC to validate the correctness and the superiority of the proposed frequency supporting strategy for PVs.

articleTitle: Life Cycle Assessment-based Carbon Emission Analysis for the Integrated Energy Station
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a life cycle assessment-based carbon emission analysis method for a 110 kV integrated energy station. Life cycle carbon emission calculation of the transformer equipment, solar photovoltaic system, energy storage system, and charge station in the integrated energy station is carried out. Result shows that carbon emissions in the operation and maintenance phase account for the largest proportion, and carbon emissions mainly come from the transformer equipment. The analysis results are helpful for designers to take corresponding measures to realize the low-carbon living and the low-carbon operation of the integrated energy station.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation of Hydropower Stations: Technical Route, Maturity Evaluation and Content Planning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Hydropower is clean, low-carbon renewable energy which has the advantages of low power generation cost, high efficiency and flexible regulation, etc. Therefore, With the deepening of power system reform, hydropower develops rapidly. However, the low level of intelligent production management and the weak ability of intelligent analysis and decision-making of traditional hydropower stations limit the further development of hydropower stations. The digital transformation of traditional hydropower stations can be used to promote the clean, efficient and intelligent power supply of hydropower stations. But there are few studies on the digital transformation of hydropower stations. Therefore, this paper studies and analyzes the technical route, maturity evaluation and construction planning of hydropower digital transformation. Firstly, the overall technical route of digital transformation of hydropower stations is put forward. Secondly, based on the evaluation and grade division of digital maturity, the digital transformation stage of the hydropower station is divided. Finally, the specific construction content planning of digital transformation of hydropower stations is carried out according to the stage progressive mode. This study brings new thought and references to the digital transformation path planning and construction contents of hydropower stations.

articleTitle: Cloud and Electricity Portfolio Optimization for Internet Data Centers under Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The introduction of cloud and electricity markets brings in promising economic potentials for cloud service providers (CSP) to increase profits. However, it is a challenging task to optimize the CSP’s portfolio decisions in both markets in the face of market dynamics and uncertainties. The goal of this paper is to investigate the strategic behaviors of a CSP in the context of cloud and electricity markets under uncertainties. A two-stage portfolio optimization framework is proposed. The first stage optimizes the CSP’s dynamic cloud pricing scheme, biddings in day-ahead wholesale electricity markets, and resource management. While the second stage considers the CSP’s real-time resource management and trading decisions in a cloud spot market and real-time wholesale electricity markets after capturing the actual values of cloud demands, market prices and renewable output fluctuations. An opportunity profit due to server redundant provisioning in the first stage is proposed, which can reflect the potential economic benefits in the second stage. Numerical studies are conducted to show the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of energy efficiency of AC and DC power supply systems in different regions and buildings
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the advantages of high-efficiency access to distributed photovoltaic power sources and energy storage, DC power distribution systems have gradually become one of the key power distribution forms for the development of net zero energy building structures. This research aims to explore the influencing factors of AC and DC energy efficiency improvement and find a distribution network system that is more in line with future net zero energy buildings under the premise of sustainable development. The energy efficiency and the improvement of AC and DC energy efficiency are compared after the factors that are in line with the characteristics of net zero energy buildings are substituted into various power grids. In terms of energy efficiency, find a more efficient topology of AC and DC systems. In order to better simulate the net zero energy building structure, the energy storage-friendly energy efficiency calculation method and fifteen different regional samples in Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen were used in the study. And through correlation analysis and control variable method to verify the advantages of different types of power distribution systems for different environments. Research has discovered a power distribution transmission system with a separate topology structure that is more in line with the efficient energy use of net zero energy buildings. The results provide theoretical support and calculation guidance basis for the future development of net zero energy buildings and the selection of power distribution systems with multi-regional structures.

Author Keywords: AC and DC energy efficiency improvement

articleTitle: Comparison and improvement of key feature selection methods for intelligent assessment of transient power angle stability
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Key feature selection is of great significance for intelligent assessment of transient power angle stability of power system. This paper proposes a key feature selection method for improved Relief. Through analyzing and comparing the applicability of correlation coefficient, mutual information and Relief, three representative key feature selection methods, in the intelligent assessment of transient angle stability of power system, the applicability of Relief is better. The Relief index reflects the strength of the feature to classify transient power angle stability and instability. By eliminating redundancy and increasing the weight of unstable samples, the accuracy of index calculation and the ability to adapt to sample imbalance are improved. Based on improved Relief, feature is selected by iterative optimization, which can automatically screen out the optimal key feature set. The effectiveness of the method is verified by an example of power grid.

articleTitle: Mitigation Strategy of Sub/Supersynchronous Oscillation of PMSG Based on Additional Active Disturbance Rejection Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) is completely decoupled from the power grid with back-to-back converters, and have been widely used in new power systems under the carbon peak and neutrality target. However, the new type of sub/super-synchronous oscillation caused by the interaction between the PMSG and the weak AC grid seriously affects the safety and stability of the power grid. Aiming at the problem of sub/super-synchronous oscillation, the frequency coupling characteristics of the sub/super-synchronous oscillation of the PMSG considering the dynamics of the phase lock loop (PLL) are analyzed firstly. Then, a PMSG sub/super-synchronous oscillation suppression strategy based on the additional active disturbance rejection controller (ADRC) is proposed. Owing to the good adaptability of ADRC to different frequency components, the sub/super-synchronous oscillation current removing the basic frequency component is suppressed to zero. Finally, a simplified equivalent model of Xinjiang power grid with wind farms was built in PSCAD/EMTDC. The simulation results show that the proposed strategy can quickly and effectively suppress the sub/super-synchronous oscillations of PMSG and maintain the stability of the wind power integrated system.

articleTitle: Optimal configuration for battery energy storage system assisting thermal unit in primary frequency regulation: A practical application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Battery energy storage systems (BESS) have gained research interests in assisting thermal units in primary frequency regulation (PFR) due to their extremely fast ramp rate. In most previous works regarding PFR control, BESS is designed to track frequency deviation to the best of its ability, namely strategies of full compensation. Although such strategies try hard to reduce penalty costs, they are not necessarily cost-effective since operation costs are ignored in strategy design. This drives to the idea of deriving an optimal target compensation degree by deciding a tradeoff between operation costs and penalty costs. Therefore, first, we establish an optimal BESS operation strategy assisting thermal units in PFR, featured with an optimized target compensation degree. Then, based on the operation strategy, we investigate the optimal size of BESS to minimize operating costs and penalty costs. Finally, numerical simulations are conducted on a commercially-operating 1000MW thermal unit in Shanghai City, where the penalty costs are calculated according to local PFR assessment rules. Simulation results based on practical data have shown that the proposed methodology offers a viable solution to maximize the economic benefits for thermal units equipped with BESS participating in PFR.

articleTitle: Network-Storage Collaborative Planning Method for Low-Voltage AC and DC Flexible Interconnected Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that flexible interconnection devices, energy storage devices and line capacity are not involved in the coordinated development of distributed power and distribution networks, a network-storage planning method for low-voltage AC and DC flexible interconnected distribution systems is proposed. Firstly, the flexible interconnection mode of low-voltage distribution network is proposed, and the control modes of the flexible interconnection device under normal and fault operating states are analyzed; secondly, the cooperative planning model of flexible interconnection device, energy storage and line capacity with normal and fault operation strategies embedded is constructed, the planning layer aims to minimize the comprehensive cost of distribution network planning and operation, and the operation layer is based on the power flow optimization considering the power flow regulation of flexible interconnection devices and the role of energy storage peak shaving and valley filling, and put forward the fault transfer strategy and reliability evaluation method of flexible interconnected distribution network; thirdly, in the face of the discrete and continuous variable mixed integer nonlinear characteristics of the model, a solution method based on particle swarm optimization and cone programming is proposed; finally, the effectiveness and rationality of the proposed method are verified by an example.

articleTitle: Optimal day-ahead scheduling for distributed cleaning heating system with minimal carbon emissions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To coordinate renewable energy consumption and distributed clean heating supply, this paper introduces heat pumps and electric boiler-heat storage devices, constituting an integrated electrical and thermal energy system with wind power, thermal power, and combined heat and power. The power flow method is used to construct an overall dynamic power flow model containing transfer, dynamic conversion, and storage processes. A case to minimize carbon emissions is developed by considering each component constraint equation’s overall system constraint equations. The day-ahead scheduling results can provide power curves, storage water temperature, SOC, and thermal resistance of heat exchangers. Meanwhile, as the distributed heat load rate grows 10%, the wind abandonment rate decreases by 5.5% and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions decrease by 1.5%. In addition, the mass flow rate ratio in the electric boiler coupled heat storage tank can minimize the wind abandonment rate and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission within a specific range. Finally, the results provide a significant basis for the carbon reduction of the integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Research on fault diagnosis and fault tolerant control of PMSM current sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In conventional magnetic field directional control of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) systems, position and current sensors are required. However, the sensors are prone to various faults, which reduces the reliability. Therefore fault diagnosis and fault-tolerant control for current sensors has attracted the attention of scholars as a new research area. To address this problem, a fault diagnosis scheme based on algebraic differential observation theory is proposed in this paper to monitor the operating status of current sensors. And combined with the current linear expended state observer (LESO) based on the idea of error reconstruction. The reconstruction space vector error projection is used as the correction term to complete the estimation of the fault phase current through the LESO for the current sensor fault diagnosis and fault-tolerant control. Finally, experiments are conducted on the dSPACE real-time simulation system as the core of the SPMSM platform to verify the effectiveness of fault diagnosis and fault-tolerant control.

articleTitle: Safety boundary analysis for lithium-ion batteries via overcharge-to-thermal runaway
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Acquiring the safe boundary of battery is beneficial to the safety risk evaluation of power battery and to offer the early warning signs. The method to accurately measure the overcharging capacity was studied, and it was verified through the overcharging test of three types of batteries (ca. 55 Ah) with different energy densities (250, 280, and 300 $\mathrm{W}\mathrm{h}\cdot \mathrm{k}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$). Additionally, accelerating rate calorimetry test was conducted to study the self-heating behavior of cells under the adiabatic conditions. The effects of active materials and overcharging current on the safety performance of batteries were given. The safety performance of battery with energy density of 280 $\mathrm{W}\mathrm{h}\cdot \mathrm{k}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ is worse than that of 250 $\mathrm{W}\mathrm{h}\cdot \mathrm{k}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ with the same cathode materials, due to the dominant factor of the 7.6% higher cell capacity. Meanwhile, the $\mathrm{L}\mathrm{i}\mathrm{N}\mathrm{i}_{0.8}\mathrm{C}\mathrm{o}_{0.15}\mathrm{A}1_{0.05}\mathrm{O}_{2}(\mathrm{L}\mathrm{C}\mathrm{A})$ cathode material with higher energy density shows better overcharging performance than the LiNi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</inf> Co<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</inf> Mn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</inf> O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>(LCM811) cathode material, which shows that LCA has a preferable thermal stability. Moreover, it is found that increasing the oxidation potential of the electrolyte and increasing the thermal stability of electrode material are the two effective ways to improve the overcharge performance of lithium-ion battery.

articleTitle: Oscillation Mechanism Analysis of AGC Dynamics Based on Damping Torque Analysis Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Frequency oscillation events take place occasionally in recent years which are strongly related with AGC (automatic generation control) dynamics. In order to investigate the triggering and influence mechanism of AGC oscillations, this paper establishes the multi-area AGC model containing different types of generating units and AGC control types. Then, the oscillation properties and mode identification between AGC and PFR (primary frequency regulation) modes are expounded in detail. On this basis, the DTA (damping torque analysis) theory is studied for frequency stability analysis as it has a clear physical meaning and can reflect oscillation damping characteristics. Then, the model of DTI (damping torque index) is established conduct mode distinguishing and parameter influence analysis. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method are verified in case studies and some conclusions are drawn from simulation results.

articleTitle: Electric vehicle identification and demand response capability assessment based on non-intrusive monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The current rapid development and large number of applications of electric vehicles make it necessary to further strengthen the research on the state sensing and demand responsiveness of electric vehicles for residential measurements. Based on the non-intrusive load monitoring technology and deep learning algorithm, the user’s power data is processed to obtain the start and end time of possible EV charging behavior, and then the user’s power magnitude data and the obtained possible charging start and end time data are used as the input data of BP neural network to identify the EV charging behavior and establish the load sensing model of residential EVs. Based on the load perception model of electric vehicles, we identify the electric load data of residential measurement, obtain the charging status information such as power and electricity of electric vehicles of users, and use the status information as the data base to evaluate the demand response capability of residential measurement electric vehicles. Finally, the simulation modeling of the above method shows that the method can identify the charging status of electric vehicles more accurately and effectively evaluate the ability of residential measurement electric vehicles to participate in demand response.

articleTitle: A TMR based Current Measurement Sensor for HVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In HVDC transmission systems, reliable current measuring device is required to monitor the operation state of the systems. In this paper, a current measurement method based on the principle of Tunneling magnetoresistance (TMR) was proposed and the corresponding current sensor array was designed. Firstly, the spatial magnetic field expressions of flat conductors and cylindrical conductors were calculated. It provided a theoretical basis for subsequent TMR-based current measurement in the paper. Then the measurement principle of TMR was analyzed. And aiming at solving the nonlinear error for TMR chips, the nonlinear output function of TMR chips based on piecewise linear approximation method was proposed. On this basis, a range-adjustable rectangular current sensor array was designed, which can measure the current flowing through flat conductors and cylindrical conductors. Finally, the experimental platform was built to obtain the nonlinear output function of TMR chips, and to carry out the current measurement experiment using four kinds of conductors. The maximum relative error of the experiment was less than 2%, and the average relative error was less than 1%. It verified the measurement accuracy of the measuring method and the array.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Energy Consumption Assessment Based on Industry Energy Consumption Structure Part I: Analysis of Energy Consumption in Key Industries
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the trend of urban energy transformation, the proportion of non-renewable energy consumption mainly based on fossil fuels is gradually decreasing, while the proportion of renewable energy generation and electricity consumption is gradually increasing, and the total amount of electric energy consumption keeps increasing. Electric energy is a high quality, clean, convenient and efficient energy, so using electric power to replace other terminal energy has obvious economic and environmental benefits. Considering the development status of industrial energy consumption under the background of urban energy reform, this paper firstly analyzes the overall situation of dual-control energy consumption in Ningbo, compares the difference between Ningbo and other cities in Jiangsu and Zhejiang province, and analyzes the total energy consumption and energy intensity level of Ningbo. Secondly, the energy consumption situation of industrial sectors is analyzed based on the consideration of energy consumption and output value, and six key industries are determined for energy consumption analysis. Thirdly, according to the selected industries, from ningbo and other cities of industry energy consumption status and energy consumption of ningbo industry history trend analysis, both by ningbo six key industries regional difference and temporal characteristics of energy consumption structure. At last, this paper analyzes the evolution direction of the level of electrification of industry energy consumption, providing reference of comprehensive energy consumption and comprehensive carbon consumption analysis for power grid companies.

articleTitle: Influencing Factors and Suppressing Methods of Current Imbalance for Parallel-Connected SiC MOSFETs: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Silicon carbide MOSFETs are often applied in parallel connection because of low monolithic current level. However, current imbalance caused by parallel connection challenges the stable and efficient operation of devices. In the article, influencing factors of current imbalance, including mismatch of device parameters, circuit parameters and drive parameters are analyzed. Meanwhile, methods to suppress the current imbalance are summarized in terms of three influencing factors respectively. Then, these methods are compared and evaluated along perspectives of types of current imbalance suppressed, time, cost, volume, expansibility and integration. The development direction of the current balance methods is prospected. The methods are expected to suppress current imbalance on three factors simultaneously with more merits such as high switching speed.

articleTitle: Power Market Regulation: Review and Prospect
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A scientific and feasible power regulatory system can effectively prevent potential risks and promote its harmonious development of the power market. With the advancement of China’s power spot market construction, the regulatory mechanism of the power market has again attracted the attention of the related designers. Since the power spot markets in North America, Australia, Europe, and other countries and regions have been maturely developed, they have accumulated rich practical experiences in handling with energy structure transformation, opening up power market competition, and improving the power regulatory system. Firstly, it introduces the electricity regulatory systems of various countries and elaborates the history of their electricity regulatory reforms; secondly, it analyzes the functions of electricity regulatory agencies in various countries in depth; then, it well compares and analyzes the regulatory agency evaluation mechanisms of the electricity markets in Australia, Europe and the United States; finally, based on the current situation of China’s power market construction, we provide suggestions on the energy and power law and regulation system in the power market, improving the functions of regulatory agencies, strengthening regulatory informationization, and improving evaluation mechanisms.

articleTitle: Carbon Emissions Forecasting Based on Stacking Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Excessive carbon emissions have become a significant cause of global warming, how to accurately predict carbon emissions is the key point to address the environmental crisis. To tackle this problem, firstly, this paper establishes a two-layer ensemble model for predicting fossil energy consumption based on stacking ensemble learning. Meta-learner of the second layer combines the predictions of base learners from the first layer and generates the final prediction of fossil energy consumption. Then, the prediction of fossil energy consumption and electricity consumption will be converted into carbon emissions. According to the empirical results, the MAPE and RMSE of the proposed model are 4.30% and 0.000535, respectively, which are smaller than the other prediction models.

articleTitle: Analysis of the decision-making process of prosumers in the transactive energy market : From the perspective of traditional economics and behavioral economics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to implement the concept of green development and realize the solemn commitment of carbon peak and carbon neutral, the energy sector is undergoing reform and innovation from top to bottom On the user side, a large number of consumers equipped with distributed power supply are transformed into “prosumers” who can both produce and consume electricity. With the gradual opening of the electricity market to distributed players, the participants in the emerging market are no longer mere price takers but can participate in the transactive energy market through independent quotations to obtain reasonable remuneration. A seller can sell a surplus to a local customer at a price higher than the feed-in tariff, while a buyer can buy electricity from the local market at a price lower than the real-time tariff. Behavioral economics combines economics and psychology to study the reasons why prosumers deviate from rational assumptions in the decision-making process. This paper will analyze the factors affecting prosumer decision-making, introduce the application theories of traditional economics and behavioral psychology in establishing prosumer models, compare their characteristics, and finally summarize the existing research on prosumer psychological considerations in the process of establishing prosumer models. A thorough understanding of the demand and behavior characteristics of prosumers is beneficial to fully mobilize the market resources they control, design a sustainable transactive energy market mechanism, and realize the economic and efficient use of electricity.

articleTitle: Research on Response Surface Modeling Method of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Sequential Experimental Design
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The optimization process of traditional permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) based on finite element calculation and control variable method has problems such as time-consuming and difficulty in achieving optimal design. It affects the solution efficiency and target response expectation of the PMSM multi-objective optimization problem. In order to solve the problem of high coupling degree of PMSM design factors and difficulty in visualizing the graph, the response surface nonlinear models with torque ripple and average torque per unit current as optimization objectives are established respectively in this paper based on factor significance analysis and central composite sequential experimental design method to realize the nonlinear mathematics modeling of PMSM under multi-variable interactive response. Subsequently, an improved response surface modeling method based on experimental space optimization is proposed to solve the problem of prediction deviation in response surface nonlinear modeling. This method constitutes a second-order response surface test scheme by adding appropriate test data points on the basis of the factorial experiment design, which can effectively improve the nonlinear modeling efficiency of the PMSM response surface.

articleTitle: Bus load forecasting method based on DWT-SSA-Bi-LSTM neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Bus load forecasting is of great significance for the safe and stable operation of power grid and the balance of supply and demand. Due to the randomness, uncertainty and the impact of renewable energy, it is difficult to access high-precision prediction of bus load. Aiming at the problems existing in bus load forecasting, such as the non-stationary load curve, the lack of feature extraction, and the dependence on experience in hyper-parameter setting, this paper firstly used discrete wavelet to transform the bus load sequence, getting more periodic high-frequency and low-frequency components, then constructing the variant network of LSTM-Bidirectional LSTM. Sparrow search algorithm (SSA) is used to search the optimal hyper-parameters which contain the learning rate, the number of hidden neurons and the number of iterations. The final prediction results are obtained by predicting and re-constructing different components respectively. The experimental results are compared with SSA-Bi(Bi-bidirectional)-LSTM, Bi-LSTM, LSTM and BP neural network transformed by DWT(Discrete wavelet transform) and non-transformed SSA-Bi-LSTM, and it shows the prediction performance of DWT-SSA-Bi-LSTM proposed in this paper is better.

articleTitle: Effective Carbon Tax Learning via Cap and Trade
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Global warming warrants the global adoption of carbon reduction schemes, among which the two most popular ones are carbon tax (CT) and the cap-and-trade (CAT) program with quite different implementations. CT levies taxes on the energy generation while CAT directly limits the total carbon emission in the system. Hence, in practice, CAT is more adjustable than CT due to the long legislation process for altering tax rate, though CT is much easier to implement. In this paper, we seek to learn the most effective tax rate through CAT programs by establishing the equivalence between CT and CAT. Through bridging the two schemes, we use numerical study to highlight the different dynamics for the schemes to converge to the equivalent point.

articleTitle: Hybrid modulation strategy of deep low carrier ratio in full wind speed for direct-drive permanent magnet wind power generation system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In high power wind turbines, the switching frequency is low because of the limitation of switching loss and system heat dissipation. In order to improve the performance of wind turbine control system, the hybrid modulation strategy of wind speed and deep carrier ratio is proposed for different speed of wind turbine. The modulation algorithm of the system is divided into 7 operating modes, and the optimal modulation strategy is selected based on the harmonic distortion rate and the maximum harmonic current amplitude. In view of the problems in the process of switching between different working sections, a three-phase synchronous switching method is proposed to realize the smooth switching between different operating modes. The correctness and feasibility of the proposed strategy has been verified in the MATLAB/Simulink simulation platform.

Author Keywords: Permanent magnet direct drive wind power generation system

articleTitle: Regulation of pulse DC power on the Long lived reactive species concentration of AC excited plasma in liquid phase
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Plasma Activated Medium (PAM) can effectively inactivate bacteria and induce apoptosis and necrosis of cancer cells because of the presence of active particles. In order to explore the relationship between the particle concentration in PAM and the phase difference, power supply position and pulse width during dual power supply discharge. articleTitle: Learning the Marginal Fuel Type for Effective Carbon Reduction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Global warming is corning, which warrants effective carbon reduction measures. While classical measures (including the carbon tax, cap-and-trade program) are proposed, they are still far from global implementation. The countries adopting such measures are in a non-favorable position in the global economic competition. This work proposes an alternative to enable carbon reduction, which directly relies on the current market price signals in the power grid. It is a common belief that arbitrage in response to market prices helps to reduce carbon emissions. However, much can be improved as the relationship between locational marginal price and carbon emission rate is non-monotonic. This work highlights that often it may result in increased carbon emissions to arbitrage naively following the market price. To better characterize such non-monotonicity, we employ an explainable machine learning framework to identify the carbon emission level using publicly available market data, whose remarkable performance is validated by numerical studies. Such information is valuable to design incentive-based carbon reduction mechanisms. The numerical study further shows that an arbitrage strategy responding to our learning outputs can effectively reduce the carbon emission rate while maintaining economic efficiency based on field data.

articleTitle: Out or Home? Scrip System for User Commitment on Peak Shaving and Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the blooming of Internet, scrip system for online system’s resource allocation has been well investigated in the last two decades. From thousands of different systems online today, it is increasingly clear that a well-designed scrip system can help achieve the desired user behaviors when trading with real money is not appropriate. Foreseen an active market in the power system, we introduce a scrip system into smart grid. We consider the scenario where the retail agents negotiate with the grid operator to have a better long term tariff. For example. the retail agents can guarantee an upper bound for total load and provide certain range of frequency regulation to the grid. Each user attached to the retail agent should then fulfill its user commitment by providing its EV at some particular time slot. Clearly, real money is not appropriate here considering the fairness issue. More importantly, the retail agent may fail to encourage the users participation with real money. Thus, we implement a scrip system and show that there is a stable $\epsilon$-Nash equilibrium in this system. Furthermore, by carefully designing the total amount of scrip in the system, this $\epsilon$-Nash equilibrium maximizes the social welfare. Finally, we validate the theorems via simulation and analyze the impact of non-standard users on the system, such as altruists, hoarders, and free riders.

articleTitle: Summary of Hydrogen Industry Development and Application Prospect: The Case of China
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the face of the major strategic opportunities of green energy development, the research and application of hydrogen-containing multi-energy supply, demand and utilization can support for the realization of the national strategic goal of “carbon peaking and carbon neutralization”. Firstly, the basic concept and development background of hydrogen energy are summarized in this paper, and then it is explained that hydrogen energy has been paid more and more attention. The development status of hydrogen energy industry is introduced from the perspective of industrial chain distribution and industry development pattern. China has initially formed a comprehensive pattern in the field of hydrogen energy from basic research, applied research to demonstration, and laid out a relatively complete hydrogen energy industry chain. Secondly, the future development prospect of hydrogen energy industry in China is predicted, where the combination of hydrogen energy and fuel cell with digital innovation industry will accelerate the transformation of energy structure, and the development space of hydrogen energy will be further expanded in general. Then the core of hydrogen energy utilization in China is to do a good job in top-level planning, strengthen standard formulation and solve pain points and difficulties under the goal of “double carbon”. Finally, the inspiration of hydrogen energy development in China is discussed from different perspectives, and the main direction of hydrogen energy research in China is introduced through a major project guide of “basic theory and key technologies for the collaborative operation of hydrogen multi-energy supply and demand system”.

articleTitle: Wind Power Scenario Generation Considering Wind Power Variations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The uncertainty of renewable energy brings adverse effects to renewable energy consumption, and therefore, how to accurately describe the uncertainty of renewable energy becomes more and more important. Though great progress has been made in this field, these existing methods cannot consider the variation characteristic of wind power well. To tackle this problem, this paper decomposes the historical data of wind farms into state components and variations, where state components of wind power output are used to train WGAN-GP. Through the game training of WGAN-GP, the generative model can establish the mapping between noise distribution and wind power state component set. Then, variations are sampled from the corresponding t location-scale distribution and later added to the state component to generate scenarios of wind power. The simulation results show that the generated data by the proposed model closest imitates the probability distribution of historical data.

Author Keywords: Generative Adversarial Networks with Wasserstein distance

articleTitle: A Distributed Method to Evaluate Total Energy Supply Capability of Integrated Power Distribution and Natural Gas System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The proliferation of gas turbines and power to gas technologies have increasingly intensified the interaction between the power system and natural gas system. This paper proposes a distributed method to evaluate the total energy supply capability (TESC) of integrated power distribution and natural gas system (IDGS). Firstly, a mathematical TESC evaluation model is developed for IDGS, and the difference of convex procedure (DCP) is utilized to deal with the nonconvex AC power flow and Weymouth gas flow equations. Then, the alternating direction multiplier method (ADMM) algorithm is adopted to decompose the model and solve it in a distributed manner, which can preserve the privacy of the distribution system and natural gas system. Numerical studies validate the effectiveness of the proposed model and solution methodology.

articleTitle: Passivity-Based Instability Analysis and Suppression Method for Traction Network-Electric Train Interaction System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The harmonic instability caused by the dynamic interactions of traction network and electric trains is threatening the safe operation of trains. Due to the high-power and low-switch-frequency characteristics of the traction converter of electric trains, besides the delay of the inner current loop, the coupling of the control loops is also the main cause of harmonic instability. This paper presents a systematic analysis on the impedance passivity of electric trains based on frequency-domain passivity for investigating the high-frequency impedance characteristic of the electric train. Meanwhile a passivity-based feedforward is introduced to the traditional control system that makes a passive output impedance of electric trains, which improves the interaction system stability. The frequency-domain analysis, simulation tests validate the effectiveness of the suppression method.

articleTitle: Multi-agent edge-learning based real-time voltage control for active distribution network with prediction uncertainties tolerance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Voltage control in high photovoltaic penetrated active distribution network features nonlinearity and stochasticity, which are unable to be efficiently tackled via model-driven methods. Thus, this paper proposes an interval state estimation and multi-agent reinforcement learning-based real-time voltage control strategy. First, a deep learning-based interval state estimation method for probabilistic distribution of voltage is proposed, where uncertainty of distributed energy resources (DER) and load is encapsulated. Then, high-dimensional stochastic security constraints are reduced to deterministic confidence interval. At the last, a multi-agent reinforcement learning is introduced to model edge voltage controllers, where each only takes local information towards global near-optimal control actions. Simulation shows that the proposed method can effectively de-risk voltage over-limits, and significantly outperforms conventional model-based method w.r.t. efficiency.

articleTitle: Wire/Cable Connection Method for ECSO Design Introduction and Estimation and Verification Software for Estimating Introduction Benefit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This study developed a construction method for introducing Environmental and energy cost-based Conductor Size optimization (ECSO) design and software for estimating and verifying the effect of introducing ECSO designs. First, the construction methods for introducing ECSO designs are explained, and the experimental results that verified satisfaction of various Japanese standards are described. Next, software for estimating the introduction effect of ECSO design is explained, and the estimation results are described. Finally, the results of introducing an ECSO design are described.

articleTitle: Electric vehicle charging load clustering and load forecasting based on long short term memory neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing number of electric vehicles, the charging load of electric vehicles has a huge impact on the scheduling and operation of the grid. Therefore, the charging load forecasting of the electric vehicle population has important significance to the safety and stability of the grid. This paper proposes an electric vehicle load forecasting model based on fuzzy C-means and long short term memory neural network. Firstly, the daily loads of electric vehicles are clustered by fuzzy C-means to obtain different daily load types. Then, this paper selects the factors affecting the load as input characteristics, such as temperature, precipitation. Neural network parameters of different load types are trained, and all types of loads are predicted. Next, predicted loads of various types are added to the total forecast load. Finally, the method of this article is verified by using the actual data of a certain place. The results show that the accuracy of the forecasting methods mentioned in this paper is relatively high.

Author Keywords: long short term memory neural network

articleTitle: A Brief Review of Digital Twin in Electric Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Digital twin technology is an excellent way to integrate electromechanical devices with various information technologies. At first, this article presents the theoretical development process and application practice of digital twin technology. After that, it focuses on the utilization of digital twin in electric power industry, basically including digital twin in electric power grid construction, digital twin power plant structure construction, digital twin power equipment and other aspects. Finally, the characteristics of digital twin in electric power industry are summarized and some application prospects are put forward as well.

articleTitle: Multi-Parameter Online Identification of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Dynamic Forgetting Factor Recursive Least Squares
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problems of degenerate-rank, slow convergence and low identification accuracy of recursive least squares with forgetting factor in permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) multi-parameter identification model, an online identification method based on dynamic forgetting factor recursive least squares (D-FFRLS) is proposed for PMSM. First, a full-rank parameter identification model is established to realize the online identification of the inductance, stator resistance and permanent magnet flux linkage. Then, the forgetting factor that changes dynamically with the error of the identification model is used to improve the convergence of parameter identification. Finally, the control algorithm is verified by simulation experiments. The results show that the proposed control algorithm can realize multi-parameter online identification within 0.5ms when the parameters of the motor change slowly or abruptly at the same time, or when a single parameter suddenly changes under the rated operating condition. In addition, it has good anti-interference and robustness because of adaptive adjusting dynamic forgetting factor.

articleTitle: Discussed of the operation range, wave compensation and working mode of generalized electric spring
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The direction of power flow in high penetration microgrid is frequently uncertain, which directly leads to the working mode of generalized electric spring including critical section line impedance is far more than that of traditional electric spring. Based on the concept of generalized electric spring proposed in this paper, the operating boundary of generalized electric spring is analyzed according to circuit theory, and its compensation ability to network fluctuation is discussed. Combined with the power grid background of Single-end Power Supply and Dual single-end Power Supply for critical section feeder, 64 working modes of generalized electric spring are discussed by using phasor diagram.

articleTitle: Analysis and Comparison of Inductor Current Characteristics for Non-Inverting Buck-Boost Converter With Four-Mode Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The non-inverting buck-boost (NIBB) converter is a non-isolated converter with bidirectional step-up and step-down capabilities. To realize the continuous regulation of output voltage, four-mode modulation is preferred. However, there are various pulse position allocation strategies, and their differences are rarely discussed. In this article, four different pulse width modulation (PWM) methods are introduced. Then, their effects on the characteristics of inductor current are discussed, including average value, ripple value and root-mean-square (RMS) value. Analytical solutions are given and compared to guide the converter design and inspire future research. Finally, the analysis and comparison are verified on a 200V, 400W output prototype. Experimental results show that there is about 0.2% efficiency difference when using different modulation methods.

articleTitle: A Triple-Voltage-Vector Model-Free Predictive Current Control Scheme for Voltage Source Inverters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Model-free predictive current control (MFPCC) method is a promising method to enhance the robustness of model predictive current control. However, conventional MFPCC methods apply only a voltage vector per control period, resulting in a large output ripple. They also have updating stagnation issue which affects the accuracy of current gradient and degrades the performance of voltage source inverters (VSIs). This paper proposes a triple-voltage-vector (TVV) MFPCC strategy for VSIs based on an advanced current gradient updating method. In the proposed strategy, a TVV-MFPCC is developed to improve current performance and enhance parameter robustness. Furthermore, an advanced current gradient updating method is proposed to eliminate stagnation effect of current gradient by considering the relationship between current gradient of different VVs. Simulation and experimental comparisons on a VSI assess the performance of the proposed TVV-MFPCC scheme.

articleTitle: Edge-Based NILM System with MDMR Filter-Based Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) leverages disaggregation algorithms to obtain appliance-level power consumption from the mains measurement. Coupled with edge computing, NILM can realize real-time load disaggregation, as well as energy conservation and privacy protection. However, the high feature dimensionality and complex disaggregation algorithm of NILM are both memory-demanding in terms of the edge devices. In this paper, we propose an edge-based NILM system, with a Raspberry-based edge device as validation. To address the memory demand problem, we propose a novel feature selection method based on max-discrimination and min-redundancy (MDMR) filter, which not only reduces the feature space, but also improves the classification performance. Meanwhile, several typical supervised algorithms are trained and compared to determine an optimal solution with the best disaggregation performance and least algorithm complexity. The evaluation results reveal that the MDMR filter-based feature selection enables our e-NILM system with 64.29% feature space reduction and 97.12% accuracy.

articleTitle: State Estimation for Power System Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The structure of power grid is becoming more and more complex, and the proportion of clean energy in power grid is increasing, which puts forward higher requirements for power system state estimation. The traditional algorithm only uses the measurement data of supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) system and wide area measurement system (WAMS) at the same time section for state estimation, fails to make effective use of WAMS measurement data, and the time resolution is low. Therefore, based on graph neural network model, this paper proposes a fast state estimation method of nodes in the whole network. This paper simulates on 57 nodes in New England and generates three different data sets. The example results show that compared with the traditional algorithm, this method can effectively use WAMS measurement data for high-precision and high-time resolution state estimation of the whole network.

articleTitle: Deadbeat Active Disturbance Rejection Controller for the Current Control of Electric Drives in the Presence of Two-step Delay
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Generally, the PWM updating causes one-step delay in the digital current control system, hence the deadbeat current control can be easily achieved by predicting the current with one more step. However, in the control system implemented on the platform based on the dSPACE DS1103, two-step delay exists in the platform. In this paper, the effect of the two-step delay on the classical deadbeat current control (DBCC) is investigated. It shows that the classical DBCC will be unstable even when the inductances are matched. Since one-step delay and two-step delay appear alternately in the system, the two-step prediction method cannot be used. As a result, a deadbeat active disturbance rejection control (DB-ADRC) is employed. A digital extended state observer (ESO) is developed to improve the system’s robustness to both the parameter variations and delay variation. Effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by experimental results.

articleTitle: Virtual power plant integration with smart grids: a Review
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the growing share of distributed energy and renewable energy in the grid and electricity market, virtual power plant (VPP) technology has received a lot of attention from a wide range of researchers. Virtual power plants can integrate distributed power sources, energy storage, controllable loads and electric vehicles to achieve resource aggregation and collaborative optimization, and participate in power markets and grid operations. This paper is an overview of virtual power plant operations.

articleTitle: Object detection of UAV power line inspection images based on federated learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power lines are widely distributed and scattered in power system. The inspection images collected by various power supply companies are existing in the form of data fragments and island. The data sharing is sometimes forbidden because of privacy protection. This means a single data owner (e.g. a regional power supply company) cannot always train good generalized models when dealing with inspection images by deep learning based methods. In this work, we propose a federated learning method to detect the insulators in power line inspection images which have different data distribution from different power companies by Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). The experiment results show that through participating in the federated training a single power company can effectively improve the detection accuracy and generalization of the object detection model.

articleTitle: Joint forecasting of regional wind and solar power based on attention neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the future high proportion of renewable energy grid-connected scenario, a large number of centrally developed wind farms and photovoltaic power stations will be integrated into the power system. There is a certain spatial and temporal correlation between wind and solar resources, which can provide additional information to help improve the power prediction accuracy. However, most of the existing wind and solar power prediction methods are focus on a single energy form, a single station or a single unit, which cannot fully and effectively reflect the space-time correlation between wind and solar resources. In addition, a single-field power prediction is no longer well enough to meet the needs of grid dispatching agencies. On the one hand, the power system as a whole, the dispatchers are more concerned about the total amount of uncertainty in the wind and solar power prediction; on the other hand, in order to make reasonable dispatch to the grid and avoid some off-grid events, the cluster power prediction is needed. Therefore, this paper proposes a joint forecasting method of regional wind and solar power. With NWP wind speed, irradiance and temperature data of several wind farms and photovoltaic power stations as input and measured power data as prediction target, based on the attention neural network algorithm, constructs a joint forecasting model which can reflect the spatial-temporal correlation of regional wind and solar resources. The proposed method is verified with the data of 8 wind farms and 7 photovoltaic power stations. The analysis results show that the proposed model can not only improve the power prediction accuracy, but also obtain the power prediction results of each target stations at the same time, which reduces the workload and has certain engineering application value.

articleTitle: Generation Potential and Economy Analysis of Green Hydrogen in China
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The clean and zero-carbon “green hydrogen” represented by electrically producing hydrogen from renewable energy, is the most important development direction of hydrogen production technology in the future. “Green hydrogen” plays the key role connection renewable energy sources and some cases of end-use energy. Performing research on the potential distributions and related economies of green hydrogen production will promote the development of the green hydrogen industry in China. In order to evaluate the production potential and economics of the green hydrogen, this work proposed a set of evaluation algorithms and optimization models for the potential and cost of green hydrogen production, based on Global Renewable-energy Exploitation Analysis Platform, GREAN. Therein, the potential of green hydrogen production in China is obtained, and the cost optimization map is drawn as well. In addition, a detailed analysis of the areas with abundant green hydrogen resources and excellent economy in China was carried out.

articleTitle: A Quantification Method of Promoting Variable Renewable Energy Accommodation by Pumped Storage Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Pumped storage is a mature and grid-scaled energy storage technology that can effectively promote variable renewable energy (VRE) accommodation into grid. This paper establishes a quantification method of promoting VRE accommodation by pumped storage power plant (PSPP) during pumping period and peak load period, based on the functions of energy storage, peak shifting and operation reserve. Taking the PSPP of Yixing in Jiangsu Province as an example, the VRE accommodation promoted by PSPP is quantified with typical daily operation data to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Power Quality Based on Improved TOPSIS Method and Combination Weights
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to fully consider the influence of each power quality evaluation index, a comprehensive evaluation method of power quality based on improved TOPSIS method and combination weights is proposed. Firstly, the objective weight and subjective weight of each indicator are determined respectively by using CRITIC weighting method and the improved Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). Secondly, a virtual negative ideal solution is constructed and the traditional Euclidean distance is replaced by the weighted distance and the improved distance to calculate the closeness in TOPSIS (Approaching Ideal Solution Distance Method) model. Finally, an example analysis is carried out through the measured data of a monitoring point in a certain place. The evaluation results show that this method can comprehensively consider the information of each evaluation index, and conduct a reasonable and accurate hierarchical and quantitative evaluation of power quality, which verifies the reliability and feasibility of the evaluation method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Impedance-Based Stability Analysis of LCC-HVDC Connected to Weak Grid Considering Frequency Coupling Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of high-voltage direct-current (HVDC) in the power system, there will be interaction stability problems when the line-commutated converter based HVDC (LCC-HVDC) is interconnected with the weak grid, and the oscillation frequencies will show the characteristic of frequency coupling. Aiming at the frequency coupling phenomenon of LCC-HVDC rectifier station, the impedance model was established by double Fourier transform, and the influence of frequency coupling characteristic on the stability analysis of the interconnection system between LCC rectifier station and weak grid was studied. The conclusions were verified by time-domain simulation.

articleTitle: Power Control Method for LCC-LCC Wireless Power Transmission Without Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the wireless power transmission system, DC-DC converter is often cascaded in order to achieve power regulation. However, due to the constant current source characteristics of the dual LCC compensation topology, the right-half-plane (RHP) zero is introduced in the control of the DC-DC converter, which leads to the deterioration of the dynamic performance of the system or even make the system unstable. This article will propose a double closed loop power control method, and the influence of the RHP zero on the stability and dynamic performance of the system is analyzed. The proposed control method does not rely on the communication between primary and secondary sides. Through experiment, the overshoot of the system has been improved, which is less than 10%.

articleTitle: Magnetic-Structural Coupled Simulation of Power Transformer Winding Cumulative Effect
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power transformers play a vital role in electric energy transmission and transformation system. Invisible damage after short-circuit fault is the main cause of transformer instability. Therefore, it is necessary to study the winding cumulative effect of multiple short-circuit impacts. In this work, the electromagnetic and mechanical characteristics of transformer are simulated in a short circuit by coupling magnetic field and structural field. Furthermore, the accumulation of stress and deformation under multiple short-circuit shocks is studied. The results show that the leakage flux of the three-winding transformer during short-circuit fault generally concentrates on the medium and low voltage windings close to the iron core. Under the effect of electromagnetic force, the distribution of winding stress, displacement and plastic strain show that the low-voltage winding is compressed inward and the medium-voltage winding is stretched outward. The middle of the winding is the focus of attention on the short-circuit resistance. Residual stress and winding deformation cause accumulative invisible damage during multiple short-circuit impacts, which will gradually make the transformer stabilization system collapse. This is worthy of attention in the evaluation of the short-circuit stability of the transformer.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Cyber Physical Power System considering Attack Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The close coupling between cyber and physics makes malicious attacks seriously affect the security of power system. Firstly, this paper analyzes the possible attack scenarios, establishes the attack graph model, and proposes the calculation method of the attack probability. On this basis, combined with the security and stability control business, the impact on the power primary system is analyzed, and the risk assessment method of malicious attack is proposed. Finally, an example illustrates the improvement of cyber - physical analysis, and proves that cyber - physical analysis technology has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Investigation on SiC MOSFET’s Avalanche and Short-Circuit Failure Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Avalanche and short-circuit failure are both common reliability problems for SiC MOSFET in industrial applications. Methods in prior research based on experiments are difficult to clarify mechanisms of SiC MOSFET’s avalanche and short-circuit failure. By using TCAD simulation software, a cell-level simulation model is established and failure mechanisms are investigated from a micro perspective. Combining external characteristics and internal parameters distribution inside the cell during failure happens, we clarify the physical mechanisms of both failures. Results show that the common reason for SiC MOSFET’s avalanche and short-circuit failure is that high temperature increases bipolar leakage current of parasitic BJT, forming positive feedback increasing channel current and temperature, which make the parasitic BJT unable to turn off. In avalanche failure mode, BJT’s current amplification effect accelerate increase of parasitic BJT’s current. Finally, we analyze impacts of SiC MOSFET’s cell-design parameters on short-circuit tolerance, which are proved by simulations.

articleTitle: Infrared Image Segmentation Method of Current Transformer Based on DeepLabv3+ Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Intelligent infrared image analysis is an effective method for transformer substation equipment fault diagnosis, and target device segmentation is its key technology. In order to solve the problem that it is difficult to partition the current transformer in a complex background, this paper uses the DeepLabv3+ neural network based on ResNet50 to train the semantic segmentation model with the current transformer. Using image transformation to expand the sample dataset for the collected samples, semantic segmentation network training semantic segmentation model is built. 420 current mutual inductor infrared images are tested and compared with other mainstream network models. The results show that the average crossover ratio (MIoU) of this method is 94.2%, which is significantly better than other network models and can accurately segment current mutual inductor devices from the test images. It paves the way for subsequent intelligent fault diagnosis of a current transformer.

articleTitle: Studies on Loss of a Motor Stator Iron Core with High Silicon Electrical Steel Considering Temperature and Compressive Stress Factors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Temperature and stress have obvious influence on the iron loss performance of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), which directly affects the performance of the motor. In order to obtain an accurate iron loss calculation model for a 6.5%Si iron core motor, a high silicon motor iron loss model considering temperature and compressive stress factors is proposed. The magnetic field, temperature field and stress field of PMSM were calculated by finite element method. The iron loss experiment under multi-physics coupling was carried out for, 10JNEX900 (6.5%Si), B27AHV1400, and T-100, three silicon steel materials, and the reasons for the insignificant deterioration of 10JNEX900 under stress and temperature were analyzed from the perspective of materials science. Finally, the experimental test on the prototype verifies the accuracy of the experiment and the model.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Transfer Learning Approach for Small-Sample High-Voltage Circuit Breaker Fault Diagnosis On-site
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Although the data-driven fault diagnosis method can achieve satisfactory diagnosis of high-voltage circuit breakers (HVCBs) under the massive data built in the laboratory, it is still a challenge to train a high-precision and robust diagnosis model under the condition of small samples on-site at this stage. To this end, this paper proposes a novel hybrid transfer learning to realize small-sample HVCB fault diagnosis on-site. To fully learn domain discriminative features and domain matching, this paper simultaneously introduces domain adaptation transfer learning and domain adversarial training into small-sample HVCB diagnosis on-site. At the same time, the two kinds of feature transfer learning are combined through ensemble learning to get the final diagnosis. In order to extract discriminative features that characterize HVCB faults, this paper constructs a one-dimensional attention residual convolutional neural network, which can ensure that the network pays attention to important features while fully extracting temporal fine-grained information. The experimental results show that the hybrid transfer learning approach proposed in this paper achieves 94.69% accuracy of small-sample HVCB fault diagnosis on-site, which is significantly higher than other methods. It has laid a solid foundation for small-sample HVCB fault diagnosis on-site.
