articleTitle: Low Carbon Economic Dispatch of an Integrated Electricity-Heat-Gas Interconnected Energy System with Improved Stepped Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to optimize the total operation costs of the integrated energy system (IES) and reduce carbon emissions, a low carbon optimal dispatch model is proposed, in which both of the low carbon and economic efficiency are taken into account. Firstly, a model of integrated energy system is established, which includes coupled components such as electricity to gas (P2G), gas-fired cogeneration units (gas-fired CHP) and gas-fired boilers (GB), etc. The carbon trading mechanism is introduced into the dispatch model of the system, and an improved stepped carbon trading model is established, in which the carbon trading price is set by carbon emission intervals. A low carbon economic dispatch model for the electricity-thermal-gas interconnection energy system is then established, taking into account the carbon trading costs and system operation costs. Finally, the dispatch results of four dispatch models are compared and analyzed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Module-Level Fault Diagnosis of Photovoltaic Array based on Wireless Sensor Networks and Inverter Activated I-V Scanning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) technology has become a promising renewable energy in the recent decade. The intelligent operation and maintenance of PV system is one of the hottest research issues in PV industry. In this paper, the module-level fault diagnosis is proposed based on the developed wireless sensor networks and inverter activated current-voltage (I-V) scanning. The voltage waveform of PV module is measured during the scanning of I-V characteristic curve activated by the inverter. Then, the open-circuit voltage and voltage at maximum power point are obtained and used to diagnose the pattern of partial shading, short-circuit of bypass diodes of PV module, and open-circuit faults. Using the real-time monitoring in the developed virtual reality (VR) environment, the efficiency of fault localization and diagnosis of PV array is enhanced. The experimental results show that the proposed module-level fault diagnosis of PV array based on wireless sensor networks and inverter activated I-V scanning is effective and feasible, especially suitable for the PV string that few PV modules are slightly shaded or one of its bypass diodes is short-circuited.

articleTitle: A Grouping Strategy and Day-ahead Scheduling Method of Electric Vehicles for Peak Shaving
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of electric vehicles (EVs), the charging load will exert more pressure on the regional power grid. The higher penetration may intensify the peak-valley difference and force the distribution transformer to be overloaded. This paper proposes a grouping strategy and day-ahead scheduling method of EVs participating in peak shaving. It fully considers the match between the resource characteristics of EVs and load regulation requirements of the grid to form a grouping method, in order to improve the performance as well as reduce the difficulty in plan generating process. Combined with the improved particle swarm algorithm, a day-ahead plan for EVs to participate in peak shaving is generated. Through the case studies, the strategy proposed is proved effective in optimizing the peak shaving performance and reducing the calculation amount of the plan generation process.

articleTitle: Low-carbon Economic Dispatch of Integrated Energy System Considering P2G and Carbon Trading Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the context of energy transition and low-carbon electricity, a low-carbon economic dispatching model of the integrated energy system (IES) is built, which considers power-to-gas (P2G) and carbon trading mechanism to improve energy efficiency and minimize carbon emissions. Firstly, the operating characteristic of P2G is analyzed, and an interval-adaptive ladder-type carbon trading mechanism considering the emission reduction benefit of P2G is proposed. Then, the proposed carbon trading mechanism is introduced into the system, and the low-carbon economic dispatching model of IES taking account the uncertainty of renewable energy output is constructed. Finally, The numerical case study is used to verify the low-carbon and economic benefits of the proposed model, as well as to analyze the effect of carbon trading parameters and renewable energy output uncertainty on the system’s dispatching results.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional Free Positioning Wireless Charging System Based on Tilted Long-Track Transmitting Coil Array
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As an emerging technology, wireless power transfer (WPT) can be applied in many fields such as consumer electronics. Due to the limited charging area, the user experience of wireless charging for consumer electronics needs to be enhanced. Based on the tilted long-track transmitting coil array, this paper proposes a high-degree-of-freedom WPT system to achieve free positioning wireless charging when the receiver is placed horizontally on the charging plane. Using long-track transmitting coils can enlarge the charging area along the track direction. Using the transmitting coil array and supplying power via two adjacent transmitting coils when the receiver is placed in between the transmitting coils can enhance the charging area along the direction perpendicular to the track direction. The adopted LCC-S (inductor-capacitor-capacitor-series) topology facilitates wireless charging with a weak coupling. The proposed system can achieve free positioning wireless charging horizontally, based on a limited number of transmitting coils and no selection switches. The experimental results have validated the proposed WPT system.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Large-Thrust and Small-Deformation Double-Sided Linear Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To obtain a large-thrust and small-deformation linear switched reluctance motor (LSRM) for industrial applications, a double-sided LSRM is developed in this paper. The structures of multi-tooth mover, double-sided stator, and thickened stator yoke are applied to increase thrust of the LSRM. Aiming at the design goal of maximum thrust of 300 N, the mathematical relationship between the thrust and the dimensions of the mover and stator is established based on the magnetic circuit of the mover and stator. With the mathematical relationship, the number of turns and the dimensions of the mover, stator, and coil are selected. In order to reduce the stator deformation, the motor structure is optimized using the finite element method. The electromagnetic force performance is analyzed via the results obtained from the finite element method. The effectiveness of the developed double-sided LSRM is verified by the results and performance analysis.

articleTitle: A Switching Control Method Based on Three-vector MPC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Model predictive control (MPC) uses the current sampled to predict the next period current, and selects the optimal voltage vector from eight voltage vectors to act on the next control period. The voltage vector selected by the three-vector MPC control method is the synthesis of three of the eight voltage vectors. Compared with MPC, although the increase in the number of voltage vectors helps to improve the motor performance in steady-state, its dynamic characteristics is reduced. For the purpose of improving the dynamic characteristics of the motor on the basis of ensuring the steady-state performance of the three-vector MPC, a switching control method based on the three-vector MPC is proposed. This method uses single vector control at dynamic time and three vector control at steady-state time to obtain better dynamic characteristics and good steady-state performance. Experimental results exhibit that the proposed method can obtain better dynamic characteristics and good steady-state performance at the same time.

articleTitle: Analysis on Energy Conservation Effects of Hubei Power Grid in 2020
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Energy conservation is of great significance to improve the efficiency of power enterprises. Reducing transmission and distribution losses has become the primary task of power enterprises. This article briefly introduces the overall energy conservation of Hubei Power Grid in 2020, proposes evaluation methods for transformers, electric lines and reactive power compensation devices, and evaluates energy conservation effects of major projects of Hubei Power Grid in 2020.

articleTitle: A Weighting Factor Semi-Online Tuning Method based on Correlation Look-up Table for Model Predictive Torque Control on PMSM of EV
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the optimal values of the weighting factors in model predictive control (MPC) are continuously changing, better performance can be achieved by using the online weighting factor tuning methods. But these methods are not widely applied because of the serious calculation burden. To solve this problem, a kind of semi-online weighting factor tuning method based on a correlation look-up table (LUT) is proposed in this paper. The method that is proposed in the paper can fit a basic plant model and the coefficients of the model are online adjusted according to the operating states. Advantages of using the method that is proposed in this paper included lower speed integrated time and absolute error (ITAE), phase current total harmonic distortion (THD) and suitable calculation burden are demonstrated by the simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: Modeling of the DD planar coil with ferrite for the wireless power transfer system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The DD planar coil is widely used in the wireless power transfer system for electric vehicles. Modeling of the coil helps to optimize the structure and parameters of the coupler. In this paper, an analytical model is proposed for computing the self-inductance and the mutual inductance of the two mutually coupled DD planar coil with ferrite used in the wireless power transfer system. The contribution of each turn in the coil to the mutual inductance and self-inductance is analyzed separately. The mirror image method is used to eliminate the influence of the ferrite simplifying the analytical model. For verifying the correctness and accuracy of the proposed model, the calculated values obtained from the proposed model are compared with the results by finite-element analysis (FEA). Finally, the laboratory prototype is also built to verify the proposed model. The theoretical value is in good agreement with the experimental simulation value.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling of Model Route for PV in Power System with Integrated Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The micro turbine (MT), modeling interface (MI) develop into a necessary component when it is used for combining electrical power, natural gas power, heat and cool in power system with integrated energy (PS-IE), which is a typical most widely used energy transformation tool. As MI is limited in AC-AC system connection, the conception of model route (MR) is proposed in this paper considering the dynamic characteristic of natural gas (NG) transmission, wind, photovoltaic (PV), and traditional electrical. Besides, extended modeling interface (EMI) is proposed to extend MI for the connection of PV with AC power grid (DC-AC system) in MR for PS-IE. Finally, an inter-simulation system inter-connected by EMI of MR for PV with AC power grid are formed to ensure the safety and steady operation of PS-IE. The simulation results indicate the validity of the EMI connection of PV with AC power grid (DC-AC system) in MR for PS-IE.

articleTitle: Switch fault diagnosis and location of NPC three-level inverter based on line voltage deviation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the switch fault diagnosis of diode neutral point clamped (NPC) three-level inverter, by studying the changes of circuit working conditions after the switch fault of NPC three-level inverter, a switch fault diagnosis and location strategy of NPC three-level inverter based on line voltage deviation is proposed. In this strategy, the estimated line voltage of the inverter under normal operation is obtained from the switching state of the inverter circuit, and the line voltage deviation is obtained by comparing the actual line voltage with the estimated line voltage. By judging the value of line voltage deviation, the fault flag output after inverter circuit fault is realized. Then, by studying the characteristic law of line voltage deviation after the failure of different switches, the location of specific faulty switches is realized. This method outputs the diagnosis results in real time and quickly, and there is no need to add additional sensors. The feasibility of the proposed scheme under the conditions of three-phase load balance and three-phase load imbalance is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: SOC estimation of lithium battery with weighted multi-innovation adaptive Kalman filter algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the second-order equivalent circuit model of lithium batteries, in order to improve the accuracy of the extended Kalman filter (EKF) algorithm, a weighted multi-innovation adaptive Kalman filter (MI-AEKF) method is investigated for battery SOC estimation. Improve information utilization by expanding the single innovation from current time to multiple innovations containing current and historical time information Considering the influence of present and past data, a weighted multiple information theory is studied. Experiments are carried out under different working conditions. Considering noise variation, a recursive noise estimation based extended Kalman filter algorithm is adopted to realize adaptive correction of noise, and the results show that the method effectively reduces the divergence of the filtering and enhances the estimation accuracy and stability of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A 90~150 kHz Dual-side Tuning Encrypted Wireless Power Transfer System Based on Steplessly Variable Switch-controlled Capacitor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Switch-controlled capacitor (SCC) is a kind of variable capacitor with the merits of steplessly variable capacitance, soft-switching and small size. This paper applies SCC to both transmitter (TX) and authorized receivers (RXs) to implement a dual-side tuning encrypted wireless power transfer (WPT) system. Compared with the single-side tuning system where only authorized RXs are tuned, the proposed system is advanced in power transfer efficiency and output power because frequency matching of authorized power channels can be fully achieved. Moreover, A charge increment ratio (CIR) method is proposed to calculate the equivalent capacitance of SCC. Compared with the traditional fundamental wave approximation (FWA) method, the calculation result of proposed method is more accurate because of the absence of any approximation during derivation process, which leads to more precise tuning and higher efficiency. In addition, an explicit expression can be obtained by the CIR method which is much simpler than FWA method where numerical computation is needed. So CIR method is suitable for online real-time computing. The effectiveness of proposed method has been proved by theoretical analysis, simulations, and experiments.

articleTitle: Design-Oriented Transient Stability Analysis of Virtual Synchronous Generators Under Mode-Switching FRT Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Mode-switching fault ride through (MFRT) control is an efficient control strategy for virtual synchronous generators (VSGs) to limit fault current, which would turn the VSG into PLL-synchronization control (PLC) mode during fault periods and return to power synchronization control (PSC) mode after fault clearance. However, transient instability probably occurs due to improper control design of MFRT. To deal with this issue, design-oriented transient stability analysis of VSGs under MFRT is carried out in this paper. First, discrete transient model of the VSG in PSC mode and PLC mode is established. Then, transient stability mechanism is revealed through extended equal area criterion (EEAC). The results indicate that transient stability of the VSG in PLC mode is determined by the voltage balance while the initial operating angle has great effects on the transient stability of the VSG in PSC mode. Based on the theoretical analysis, control design consideration is given to improve transient stability. Finally, simulation results based on PSCAD/EMTDC validate the correctness of theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Portfolio of Wind-Photovoltaic-Loads Toward Green Hydrogen Development
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As a clean secondary energy carrier, hydrogen has great application potential in the decarbonization of the power grid, helping to solve the problem of renewable energy consumption in the power system. To further promote hydrogen energy development and renewable energy consumption, this paper proposes a wind photovoltaic load coupled hydrogen production system (WPLHS) and conducts Provincial-Level differentiated technical and economic analysis on it. First, we discuss the significance of developing WPLHS, and then give the structural framework and optimization model of WPLHS. Finally, based on the annual maximum daily power load data of 5 representative provinces and the wind and solar power generation data of 40 municipalities, we conduct a technical and economic analysis as well as sensitivity analysis of the provincial levelized cost and system cost of power to hydrogen (P2H) under various wind and solar combinations. The results show that the levelized cost of hydrogen LCOH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and the system cost composition are significantly different for various wind and solar combinations. The fluctuation of power load also has a significant impact on LCOH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. In addition, the conversion efficiency of P2H is the most critical factor affecting LCOH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, while the investment cost of ES and the investment cost of P2H have the most negligible impact on LCOH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>.

articleTitle: A Novel Input-Parallel Output-Series High Gain DC- DC Boost Converter with Voltage-doubler Cell
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High step-up DC-DC converters are essential to be applied in a plenty of manufacturing fields, suchlike photovoltaic (PV), fuel cells, electric vehicles and other new energy power generation systems. This article introduces a novel input-parallel output-series high-step-up boost converter with a voltage-doubler cell in CCM. On the one hand, the converter can achieve 6 times the voltage gain of the established interleaved boost converter, which greatly improves the voltage gain and alleviates the current problem of insufficient boost capacity of non-isolated converters. On the other hand, the inherent structure of the converter brings the characteristics of lower input current ripple and lower switches and diodes voltage stress. This paper calculates the voltage gain and the voltage stresses across the power semiconductors, gives the analysis of the input current ripples. Finally, an experimental prototype with an output power of 250W is constructed to confirm the correctness of theoretical investigation and practical dependability.

articleTitle: CMTI Improvement Circuit for Digital Isolator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved Common mode transient immunity (CMTI) circuit for digital isolator. SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> film is used as the isolation dielectric for the digital isolator, and on-off keying (OOK) modulation is adopted as the methods of modulation and demodulation. At the same time, the input signal is transmitted as a fully differential signal. As one of the most important features of the isolator, poor CMTI performance will lead to wrong transmission when the voltage domain of transmitter (TX) or receiver (RX) changes. The CMTI performance can be improved by two aspects, i.e., firstly, reducing the offset of DC operating point. Secondly, increasing the common mode rejection ratio. This paper utilizes an active common mode filter circuit and a fully differential gate cross-coupled preamplifier to improve the CMTI performance to achieve 150 kV/us.

articleTitle: Review of the Development of Hubei Power Grid during the 13th Five-Year Plan Period and Prospect of the 14th Five-Year Plan
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: During the 14th Five-Year Plan period, Hubei Power Grid will inevitably face the changes and challenges that are brought by power system transformation. This paper introduces basic situation of Hubei Power Grid during the 13th Five-Year Plan period, such as social economy, power grid structure, installed power capacity, total electricity consumption and load, electricity demand, power grid equipment and line loss rate, analyzes critical influencing factors during the 14th Five-Year Plan period, and puts forward the trend of line loss rate of Hubei Power Grid during the 14th Five-Year Plan.

articleTitle: Transformer Fault Diagnosis Based on Dissolved Gas Analysis in Oil and Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Dissolved Gas Analysis (DGA) in oil is one of the most commonly used methods for transformer fault diagnosis, and artificial intelligence is an effective means to realize transformer faults. However, due to the large difference in the number of fault samples of different types of transformers, a single artificial intelligence method combined with DGA is prone to bias the parameter update of the majority class samples while ignoring the correct classification of the minority class samples during the goal realization process. In order to improve the transformer fault diagnosis accuracy in the unbalanced sample scenario, this paper proposed an ensemble model based on DGA and AM2-CT (Adaboost.M2-Classiflcation Tree). Meanwhile, IEC three ratio method, Duval triangle method, Rogers ratio method, percentage method and nine ratio method were selected to preprocess the original fault data of the transformer, and the obtained noncode ratios were used as the input feature sets of the model respectively. The proposed ensemble model effectively alleviates the training problem of imbalanced data at the level of algorithm optimization. Compared with Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes (NB), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Decision Tree (DT), the accuracy of AM2-CT increased by 7.2%, 8.2%, 18.6%, 4.4% respectively.

articleTitle: A High-Efficiency Bidirectional LLC Resonant Converter Based on Current-Doubler Rectification Circuit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of microgrids, DC/DC converters for bidirectional energy transmission between DC bus and energy storage batteries have received more and more attention. In order to convert the high voltage of the DC bus and the low voltage of the batteries, the converters with high-ratio transformers are widely used. However, high transformation ratio brings large secondary winding current, which causes large loss. To improve this defect, the current-doubler rectifier circuit and the LLC resonant converter is combined to build a new bidirectional DC/DC converter. The proposed topology not only reduces the secondary winding current but also reduces the number of MOSFETs, thus improving the efficiency of the converter. The working principle of the proposed converter is introduced, and the problem of voltage spikes in reverse operation is solved by means of ideally inverse coupled inductors. Through comparison and analysis, the feasibility of the proposed topology is verified and the results show that the proposed converter has higher efficiency than the traditional bidirectional LLC converter.

articleTitle: Inductor Multiplexing Equalization Circuit with Fuzzy Controller for Lithium Battery Equalization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, an inductor multiplexing equalization for Li-ion battery is designed. Compared with the typical inductor equalization circuit, it can reduce the number of inductors and circuit volume. Then, a fuzzy controller based on balancing time and loss is designed. Simulation experiments on typical inductor equalization circuit and inductor multiplexing equalization circuit are carried out. The simulation results show that the inductor multiplexing equalization circuit based on the fuzzy control strategy has faster equalization speed and higher equalization accuracy.

articleTitle: Highly Efficient Three Level Sparse NPC Inverter for Ultra-High-Speed PMSM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: One of the promising applications of ultra-high-speed (UHS) motors is the fuel cell’s turbo compressor. In fuel cell systems high efficiency at all operating conditions is one of the main requirements. Most commercial high-speed drives use two-level (2L) inverters due to the simple structure, reliability, and low cost. However, better performance characteristics at a slightly higher cost can be achieved with the three-level (3L) topologies. In this work, a comparative analysis of different 3L topologies for the usage in UHS drives is conducted. Based on the comparison results 3L Sparse-NPC (SNPC) topology is chosen for the performance evaluation. The switching losses are analyzed for each switching transition. Based on this analysis, the modified switching sequence considering the application in UHD drive is proposed. It has the inherent zero-voltage switching (ZVS) capability for the 2L stage and thus can further reduce the switching losses. Finally, a complete sensorless drive system based on the SNPC inverter and the UHS motor is simulated in MATLAB/Simulink. The simulation results demonstrate that this topology is able to efficiently control the UHS motor at the whole operating range. The results also demonstrate that relatively good voltage balancing capabilities can be achieved with the ZVS-based switching sequence.

articleTitle: Evaluation method of renewable energy accommodation capacity based on time series production simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of China’s renewable energy installed capacity, the randomness and volatility brought about by renewable energy power generation have put forward new requirements for the safe and stable operation of the power grid. Accurately evaluating the accommodation capacity of renewable energy in the power grid has important practical significance for improving the power quality and safety in the power grid. Based on the traditional time series production simulation model, this paper introduced a time series production simulation model considering power flow constraints. After linearizing the model, a time series production simulation model considering linear power flow constraints in key time periods is obtained. Considering the critical time section can not only ensure the safety of power grid operation, but also improve the calculation efficiency. Based on the load data of each substation in the Zhangjiagang area on a typical day in 2020, the method introduced in this paper is used to evaluate the accommodation capacity. The method is used for simulation evaluation, which provides an effective foundation for the planning of renewable energy and power system in this region.

articleTitle: Day-ahead optimal dispatch of regional power grid based on electric vehicle participation in peak shaving pricing strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of power fluctuation, high dispatch cost and poor operation stability caused by large-scale grid connection of electric vehicles (EV) and new energy power generation such as wind power and photovoltaics, this paper proposes a regional power grid based on the participation of electric vehicles in the pricing strategy of peak shaving. optimize the scheduling plan. Firstly, according to the EV load operating characteristics, four types of EV load models, namely rigid, schedulable, flexible and intelligent power exchange, are established. The EV peak shaving pricing strategy is given; then based on this strategy, the regional power grid is optimally dispatched before the day: take the minimum load peak-to-valley difference as the goal, and make decisions on the EV peak shaving pricing under this goal to reduce the peak shaving capacity adjustment of the power system Regional grid load distribution. Finally, the validity and rationality of EV participation in peak shaving pricing are verified by example simulation.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic design of excitation winding of 10MW superconducting wind generator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Superconducting wind turbine has the advantages of small size and light weight, especially suitable for the development of large capacity offshore wind power. Conventional superconducting motor design uses superconducting tape winding directly, resulting in high inductance value of excitation winding and high excitation induction voltage. In this paper, a superconducting wind generator excitation winding structure using high current YBCO superconducting cable is proposed. The designed wind turbine has a capacity of 10MW, a rated armature voltage of 3.3kV and a rated speed of 9rpm.The superconducting excitation windings are of 20-pole structure and are made of high-current cables of the same structure. The operating current is 3.6kA. Electromagnetic simulation results show that the maximum magnetic induction intensity on the surface of superconducting coil is 4.52T, and the average magnetic induction intensity at the half tooth height of stator winding is 1.4T. Through the development of small YBCO superconducting coil, the validity of the manufacturing process of the racetrack structure superconducting coil is verified.

articleTitle: Electric field simulation analysis of typical defects of 220kV molded joints of polypropylene cable
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The intermediate joint of the cable is prone to defects during manufacturing or installation, which deteriorates its insulation performance. The molded joint has improved the compatibility at the interface to some extent, however, there are still possible defects in some positions of the joint. In order to study the impact of defects in the molded joint of high voltage cable on electric field distribution, the article firstly analyzed three typical defect types of the molded joints of 220 kV polypropylene cable, then established the 3-D simulation model based on COMSOL simulation software, and finally calculated the electric field distribution. The results show that all three kinds of defects will lead to different degrees of electric field distortion. The enhanced electric field strength at the defect site of the joint may accelerate insulation deterioration or even lead to early electrical failure.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Circulating Current in Main Feeding Cable armor of Common Ground Electrode
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The ground electrode is an important equipment of HVDC transmission system, providing a path for the ground current and unbalanced current. Due to the limitation of land resources, common ground electrodes have increasingly become the choice for HVDC transmission system. Most of the ground electrodes of China Southern Power Grid Corporation are common ground electrodes. Therefore, this paper takes the common ground electrode of a ±800 kV HVDC project as an example, and analyzes that characteristics of circulating current of cable armor in common ground electrode center, which causes cable burnt out. The research results show that the terminal tower of electrode station is located outside the electrode ring, which increases the potential difference between the two ends of the armor layer of feeder cable, and tens of amperes circulating current during the feeder cable. This eventually caused the cable joint to catch fire, damaging the cable.

articleTitle: The Vector Control Strategy And The Copper Loss Optimization Under Unity Power Factor Control of Sinusoidal Doubly Salient Electro-magnetic Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Sinusoidal double salient electro-magnetic machine (SDSEM) is a new type of double salient electro-magnetic machine (DSEM). Compared with DSEM, the back electromotive-force waveforms of SDSEM are highly sinusoidal, so the vector control strategy can be used. In this paper, the basic mathematical model of SDSEM is established based on the analysis of its electromagnetic characteristics, and the vector control system based on $i_{d}=0$ and unity power factor control is constructed. To reduce the copper loss of SDSEM under unity power factor control, in this paper, a control strategy to minimize the copper loss under unity power factor control by taking advantage of the adjustable magnetism of SDSEM is presented. Simulation analysis based on MATLAB/Simulink. The results show that SDSEM has good performance under $i_{d}=0$ and unity power factor control. The proposed control strategy can minimize the copper loss of SDSEM.

articleTitle: Windage Loss and Torque Ripple Reduction in Stator-permanent Magnet Flux-switching Machines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper designs a windage loss and torque ripple (or cogging torque) reduction rotor for stator-permanent magnet flux-switching (SPM-FS) machines. By modifying the rotor teeth shape, and the use of ribs to connect the rotor teeth. The torque ripple (or cogging torque) can be reduced by about 89.12%, and the windage loss is reduced by about 66.19%. Additionally, the quasi-cylindrical shape of the proposed rotor makes the air in the air gap still maintain high heat dissipation capacity, and also reserves buffer space for radial deformation of the ribs. Mises stress analysis and deformation analysis also verified the mechanical reliability of the proposed rotor. This paper can also provide an important reference for direct-drive servo and high-speed application of SPM-FS machines.

articleTitle: Study on Temperature Parameter Characteristics of Needle-Plate Air Discharge Plasma
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Diagnosis of atmospheric pressure low-temperature plasma parameters is of great significance to study the mechanism of plasma discharge and promote research in related application fields. For example, accurate and effective measurement of the molecular rotational and vibrational temperatures of gas discharge plasma can be used in many fields such as plasma spraying, plasma medical treatment, and aerospace combustion technology. The research content of this paper focuses on the diagnosis of plasma molecular temperature parameters in atmospheric pressure. Taking the needle-plate air discharge as an example, the plasma discharge emission spectrum data is obtained by a high-precision spectrometer, and the second positive system of nitrogen molecules $(C^{3}\Pi_{\mathrm{u}^{-}}B^{3}\Pi_{\mathrm{g}})$ is calculated and analyzed by the optical emission spectroscopy, which aims to study and analyze the temperature parameter characteristics and internal mechanism of gas discharge plasma under different experimental conditions. In the experiment, the similarities and differences of plasma temperature parameters in different discharge states generated by positive and negative DC power supplies with different needle-plate distances are compared and analyzed. At the same time, in view of the low efficiency of manual fitting of emission spectra, we build a spectral data set using Python script and use the grid iteration method to achieve high-efficiency fitting of temperature parameters. The content of this paper is of great significance for promoting the research of plasma discharge mechanisms and the development of related application fields.

articleTitle: Linearized Frequency Deviation Based Frequency-Constrained Unit Commitment with Support from Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The frequency security is being challenged with the increase of renewable power penetration in the power system. The frequency response equation (FRE) of the system is a high-order differential equation about frequency deviation $(\Delta f)$, which makes it hard to obtain the analytical expression of $\Delta f$. This paper proposes a frequency-constrained unit commitment (FSC-UC) considering frequency support from wind farms. The maximum rate of change of frequency (RoCoF) constraint and quasi-steady-state (QSS) frequency constraint are derived based on the average system frequency (ASF) model. The sufficient condition of frequency nadir constraint is analytically derived with a linearized $\Delta f$ method, which takes into account that the system inertia changes with the combination of online units. The comparison between conventional unit commitment (C-UC) and FSC-UC demonstrates that the proposed FSC-UC can schedule sufficient system inertia and primary frequency response (PFR) resources to ensure the security of system frequency.

articleTitle: Research on Efficiency Optimization for the Induction Motor by Pole Changing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To improve the overall efficiency of the pure electric vehicle motor drive system under different operating conditions, we studied a new induction motor combined with inverters to change the magnetic poles and phase. The pole changing speed regulation method of induction motor is employed to obtain the input-output power and efficiency characteristics of the motor in the speed range of 0-1500 rpm and torque range of 0-100 Nm based on ANSYS finite element simulation analysis. From the simulation results, we draw the efficiency map of two-pole mode, four-pole mode and mixed mode to compare the overall efficiency of the motor in different working conditions. The results of our analysis verify the possibility of improving the efficiency of induction motor by pole changing, which is of guiding significance for the optimization and upgrading of motor system and energy saving.

articleTitle: A Platform for Investigating Pulsed Vacuum Arc in Micro-cathodic Arc Thruster
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A platform used for researching the pulsed vacuum arc and its erosion in the application of micro-cathodic arc thruster, has been designed, established, and commissioned. This article describes the design and preliminary experiments of the platform. A programmable high-voltage pulsed-power source is used to drive a microsecond discharge in the vacuum. In the initial experiment, a copper block is used as anode, and an aluminum one as cathode, with a distance of 2 mm on a A1<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> plate base. Vacuum discharges are initiated at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> Pa, and diagnoses including electro-physical parameters and high-speed self-emission images are applied. According to the experimental results, the arc development stage and the influence of the circuit parameter pulse width and current limiting resistance size on the discharge are preliminary clarified. The platform has been shown to be capable of performing micro-cathodic arc thruster arc experiments. These results also provide the potential for further applications of this platform, such as research on arcs, electrodes, and conductive films of micro-cathode arc thrusters.

articleTitle: A novel support vector machine multi-classification strategy for power transformer fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power transformers are considered as the important equipment in power transmission and distribution. Therefore, it is necessary to carry out monitoring and fault diagnosis for transformer. Traditional transformer fault diagnosis methods are usually based on established criteria, which are too stiff and lead to misdiagnosis of samples near the classification boundary. As an excellent pattern recognition tool, the Support Vector Machine (SVM) has been applied to transformer fault diagnosis. However, there is no targeted design for SVM multi-classification strategy at present. The direct application of traditional multi-classification strategy will lead to the difficulty in balancing training efficiency and classification accuracy. As a novel SVM multi-classification strategy for transformer fault diagnosis, the reverse merge strategy is proposed in this paper. The separability index is calculated based on within-class scatter matrix and the between-class scatter matrix. By reverse merging, the structure of classification decision tree is determined. The transformer online monitoring data provided by the State Grid Corporation of China and IEC TC 10 data are adopted for simulation verification. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed SVM multi-classification strategy can simultaneously improve the training efficiency and classification accuracy of diagnosis model.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control of Segmented Long Stator PMLSM Based on Inductance Disturbance Compensation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The segmented structure of the long stator permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (LS-PMLSM) will cause the significant variation of the stator inductance, which will cause additional disturbance to the sensorless control when the mover is pasing through the stator segment. Aiming at this problem, this paper uses the disturbance observer to compensate the disturbance feed-forward, eliminates the fluctuation of the observed back EMF when the mover is over-segmented, and improves the accuracy of the velocity observation of the speed sensorless control of the permanent magnet linear synchronous motor. Finally, simulations results demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Analysis Methodology for Multiple Resonators in Wireless Power Transfer Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Multiple resonators architecture is widely applied in wireless power transfer (WPT) systems, such as relay coils and metamaterials to increase the coupling coefficient, transmission efficiency and distance. However, the addition of extra LC resonators undoubtedly influences the overall performance of the whole system. In this paper, an analysis methodology is proposed to investigate the resonant frequencies and the response to external excitations of the WPT system, which is equipped with multiple resonators based on the similarity of multi-degree-freedom vibration equation and multi-resonators’ circuit equation. In addition, some case studies applying the proposed method and the corresponding analysis results are presented. Similarities and differences between relay coils and metamaterials are discussed.

articleTitle: Cogging Torque Reduction in A Transverse-flux Flux-reversal Permanent Magnet Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The transverse-flux flux-reversal PM motor (TF-FRM), which combines the technologies of transverse-flux motor and flux-reversal motor, has been proposed in forgoing work to improve the torque generation capability of motor. However, one issue of TF-FRM is the high cogging torque during rotation, especially, when the motor is designed as an external rotor structure with a large gap diameter. This paper aimed to propose an improved configuration based on structural parameter optimization for cogging torque reduction in TF-FRM. Firstly, the mathematical expression of cogging toque in TF-FRM is derived analytically. Then, the preliminary optimization of basic dimension is done by finite element method to reduce the cogging torque. At last, the performance comparison is done between original configuration and improved one. The result indicates that the proposed topology can effectively reduce cogging torque and torque ripple, meanwhile, slightly increase the electromagnetic torque.

articleTitle: Structure and Capacity Configuration of Substation Microgrid with Hydrogen Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to propose a photovoltaic hydrogen storage microgrid in substation. An operation strategy is proposed to ensure the reliability of substation load under normal operation and fault operation, and the capacity configuration of the microgrid is calculated by genetic algorithm. Finally, the calculated microgrid parameters and operation strategy are simulated, and the conclusion is drawn that the proposed microgrid can run stably in normal operation and fault condition of the substation to ensure the load demand of the substation.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Energy Storage Peak Shaving Considering Full Life Cycle Cost
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As an effective means to improve the wind power consumption capacity of power system, the economy of energy storage participation auxiliary service has received extensive attention from academic circles. In this paper, the cost composition of the whole life cycle of the electrochemical energy storage system is comprehensively considered, and the economic analysis of different Wheres of electrochemical energy storage participating in peak shaving auxiliary services is conducted according to the operation rules of the power market in northeast China. Firstly, four widely used electrochemical energy storage systems were selected as the representative, and the control strategy of source-side energy storage system was proposed for real-time peak modulation in wind farms. Secondly, the peak shaving economic model based on the life cycle cost of energy storage is constructed. Finally, by selecting the annual data of a wind farm in northeast China, the economic benefits of different Wheres of electrochemical energy storage are analyzed and compared, and the reasonable opinions on improving the benefits of energy storage are given.

Author Keywords: operation rules of northeast electric power market

articleTitle: Research on LC series resonant high voltage capacitor charging power supply
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the pulse power system using capacitor as energy storage unit, the performance of capacitor charging power supply (CCPS) determines the stability of output voltage. With the rapid progress of high-frequency and high-power devices, high-frequency converter charging power has become the mainstream. Among them, the LC series resonant converter is an ideal charging power topology due to its excellent anti-short-circuit ability, constant current characteristics and soft switching. In this paper, the working characteristics of the LC series resonant converter are studied. Based on a CCPS with charging voltage of 10kV and charging capacity of 25kVA, a constant current-constant power charging control strategy is designed to improve the charging speed of CCPS. Simulation results show that this strategy reduces the charging time by 37.5% compared with the traditional constant current control strategy. At the same time, the influence of the stray capacitance of the transformer on the LC series resonant converter under the high voltage and high power situation is analyzed.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Distributed Photovoltaic Carrying Capacity in Distribution Network Based on Voltage Sensitivity Ranking
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increase of the proportion and dispersion of distributed PV connected to the distribution network, the possibility of extreme PV configuration is decreasing. However, the traditional bearing capacity evaluation includes a large number of extreme photovoltaic configuration scenarios, and the calculation results are too conservative. At the same time, the traditional evaluation method ignores the limitation of reverse power transmission to the main network at the time of large photovoltaic generation in the distribution network. For the above problems, a distributed photovoltaic carrying capacity evaluation method based on voltage sensitivity ranking is proposed. The method includes access scheme modification layer and index inspection layer: the voltage sensitivity ranking method is introduced into the access scheme modification layer to optimize the access scheme in each iteration and eliminate the extreme value distribution of photovoltaic. In the index inspection layer, the voltage deviation index and reverse power transmission of high proportion distributed photovoltaic distribution network are introduced to judge the rationality of the optimization scheme and feed back to the modification layer of the access scheme. The two-layer iteration finally obtains the calculation results of the distributed photovoltaic carrying capacity of the network. This method is closer to reality, reduces the conservatism of calculation and improves the adaptability of calculation. It has certain guiding significance for the photovoltaic planning and construction of the actual distribution network.

articleTitle: Full-Speed Sensorless Control Strategy for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this manuscript,a full-speed position sensorless control strategy for high-speed interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) is proposed. The combination of the rotating high-frequency signal injectionand back electromotive force (BEMF) observation method is employed in the proposed strategy. In the zero and low-speed stages, the rotating high-frequency voltage signal in the quadrature form is injected into the α-axis and β-axis of the IPMSM. The heterodyne method is adopted to extract the rotor position information from thecurrent signals, and the polarity of the initial position is judged and obtained through the injection of two reverse pulse voltage values into the d-axis.In the medium and high-speed stages, the BEMF observation method is directly employed toestimate the rotor position without requiredvoltage sensors.Finally, the effectiveness of thecontrol strategy forIPMSM is verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: An Identification Method for Dominant Mode of Low Frequency Oscillation in Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It is helpful for dispatchers to master the dynamic security and stability characteristics of the system after fault according to the analysis results of low frequency oscillation. Firstly, the principle of low frequency oscillation mode identification using Prony algorithm is introduced in the paper. Then the reasons for a big difference in the identification results of dominant mode after small fluctuation of curve are analyzed. According to analysis results, a dominant mode identification method of low frequency oscillation in power system based on Prony algorithm and correlation analysis is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the example of ideal signal and actual system simulation curve.

articleTitle: Design of Ultra-High-Speed Flux Switching Permanent Magnet Machine with Amorphous Alloy Core
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Flux switching permanent magnet machine (FSPM) has great potential for high speed operation owing to its compact rotor structure. However, the velocity of FSPM is restricted by high rotor core loss and low permanent magnet (PM) utilization. This article proposed a design of ultra-high-speed FSPM operating at 100krpm with amorphous alloy core. Amorphous alloy core highly reduces the core loss, and a production method for stator core is proposed to make the slotting process feasible and economical. Parallel-hybrid magnetization is adopted to increase PM utilization. Rotor strength analysis and electromagnetic analysis are conducted, and verifies that the proposed design with amorphous alloy exhibits capability at increasing the efficiency at ultra-high speed application.

articleTitle: Suppression Strategy of Subsynchronous Oscillation Caused by Grid-connected Direct-drive Fan
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The subsynchronous oscillation caused by the grid-connected direct-drive fan is a new type of oscillation mode, which has an adverse effect on the stability of the system. Aiming at the influence of current inner loop, voltage outer loop parameters in grid-side converter control and grid-side lines on subsynchronous oscillation, a two-layer objective optimization model predictive control method considering delay compensation is proposed to replace traditional PI control. The control method tracks the reference current with the rolling optimization method, designs a two-layer objective function, and considers the current error and the DC voltage error at the same time. Through simulation comparison and verification, the proposed method has better stability and adaptability in weakly connected power grids and other working conditions.

articleTitle: Common-mode Voltage Suppression and Synchronous Modulation Strategy for Double Dual-three-phase Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The technology of pulse width modulation (PWM) voltage source inverters is very mature and is widely used in traction drive inverters. But when the inverter is operating in a pulsed state, it generates a common-mode voltage (CMV). CMV will form common-mode (CM) current through the CM loop, which will pose a great threat to the motor. In addition, the high switching frequency will produce large switching losses. In this paper, a parallel inverter is used to drive double dual-three-phase induction motors to achieve zero common-mode (Zero-CM) voltage by combining the synchronous modulation and CMV elimination modulation algorithm. Meanwhile, a synchronous modulation strategy is adopted to reduce switching loss by making the inverter work at a lower switching frequency. Simulation and experiment show that the proposed control algorithm can effectively suppress CMV and CM current while realizing synchronous modulation in the process of speed up and down.

articleTitle: Influence of Water Blocking Tape Parameters on the Electric Field Distribution of the High Voltage Cable Buffer Layer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, buffer layer failures of high-voltage corrugated aluminum cable have occurred many times. The typical characteristics are ablative holes, white powders on the surface of water blocking tape, while the failure mechanism of buffer layer ablation has not been clearly stated. In this paper, a finite element simulation model of 110 kV corrugated aluminum cable with cross-section of 800 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is built, and the influence of volume resistivity and relative permittivity of water blocking tape and air gap distance on the electric field of buffer layer is studied. The results demonstrates that the maximum electric potential and field intensity of the buffer layer rise with the increase of volume resistivity and decrease of relative permittivity. With the air gap distance between water blocking tape and aluminum sheath decreases from 0.6 mm to 0.01 mm, the maximum potential of the buffer layer remains constant when the air gap is larger than 0.1 mm, while increases when the air gap is smaller than 0.1 mm. But for the water blocking tape without white powders, the change of air gap distance has little effect on the field intensity.

articleTitle: Failure Mechanism Analysis of Bond Wire of High Power IGBT under Different Load Current
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: By means of finite element simulation, the power cycling test of as submodule of a 3300V/1500A IGBT module is simulated. The influence of different current and turn-on time combinations on the diffusion of temperature is studied, and the power cycling lifetime of the bond wire is calculated by Coffin-Mason model. The simulation results show that the IGBT power cycling with the same junction temperature fluctuation and highest junction temperature, and the maximum surface temperature of IGBT chip under large current with short turn-on time is much higher than that of IGBT chip under low current with long turn-on time, shows a larger temperature gradient, which leads to the failure of the bond wire more easily for high power IGBT. This paper can provide guidance for the lifetime prediction and aging mechanism of the high power IGBT module.

articleTitle: Investigation of Torque Contributions of Main-order Working Harmonics in Consequent-pole PM Vernier Machines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the torque contributions of the main-order working harmonics in consequent-pole permanent magnet (CPM) Vernier machines are investigated and quantified to provide an in-depth understanding of their torque production mechanism. Two typical CPM Vernier machines with regular and split-teeth structures are selected and comparatively studied with conventional CPM machine. Due to the unipolar PM magneto-motive force (MMF) distribution and double-side slotting effect, the CPM designs exhibit various air-gap permeance components and resultant multiple air-gap field harmonics for torque generation. The torque contributions of the main-order working harmonics are identified and quantified by Maxwell stress tensor (MST) method. Moreover, the influence of the torque proportions of the three CPM machines with different gear ratios are subsequently investigated. Besides, the torque contributions of the corresponding surfaced-mounted PM (SPM) counterparts are also studied to present a comparison of their difference.

articleTitle: Design and Development of High-Speed and High-Power Drive Motor for Heavy Commercial Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to meet the performance requirements of the power system of heavy-duty commercial vehicles, a special drive motor is designed in this paper, which has the characteristics of high speed, heavy load, and continuous high power. The permanent magnet synchronous motor is selected, and an optimized design is made for the motor components including stator and rotor punching, winding, rotating shaft, cooling system, sealing structure, etc. The accurate simulation and analysis methods are used to calculate and check. Finally, after the prototype test, all the indexes meet the design requirements. Compared with a low-speed and high-power motor, the design results have obvious performance advantages.

articleTitle: Voltage Control of Single-Phase Inverter Based on Compound SRFPI and LADRC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The synchronous reference frame proportional-integral (SRFPI) control possesses the feature of zero steady-state error with employing PI regulators. Even if the accurate mathematical model of system is unacquainted the linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) can still achieve excellent anti-interference ability. In this paper, a modified voltage control strategy for single-phase inverter based on compound SRFPI and LADRC is proposed, which inherits the advantages of the two controllers. Theoretical analysis as well as the feasibility of the controller has been effectively proved by simulation with MATLAB/Simulink and experiments. The research results show that the system achieves low total harmonic distortion (THD), little steady-state error and voltage tracking error, and fast transient response.

articleTitle: Study on Influence of Magnetic Properties of Ultrathin Unoriented Silicon Steel Sheet in Service
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Hydrogen fuel cell air compressor plays an important role in hydrogen fuel, usually using an ultrahigh-speed permanent magnet motor as a power drive. Compared with the traditional motor, it has a wide range of working speeds, from thousands of revolutions, a minute to hundreds of thousands of revolutions a minute, and the working frequency is up to thousands of Hertz. Using silicon steel sheet data under standard operating conditions for the motor design will bring greater error. We selected0.05mm thick ultra-thin non-oriented silicon steel strip as the core material. We first studied the influence of high-frequency magnetic properties of non-oriented silicon steel sheets under service conditions. Secondly, the motor design is completed and its performance data are input into the simulation software to complete the calculation. Finally, the motor prototype was made with a 0.05 mm thick ultra-thin non-oriented silicon steel strip and tested. By comparing and analyzing the prototype test results and simulation results, it is found that there is a good consistency.

articleTitle: A New Technique for Detecting Partial Discharge of Micro Electrical Tree Defect
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electrical tree (ET) defect is the main cause of XLPE cable and accessories breakdown. For micro electrical tree defects, the partial discharge (PD) detection method has the disadvantages of high PD initial voltage and low sensitivity, and the detection effect is poor at low voltage. In this paper, X-ray is used to excite the PDs of micro electrical tree defect to realize the purpose of detecting defect under low applied voltage. Firstly, XLPE sample was made in the laboratory to produce micro ET defect, and an X-ray excited experiment platform was built. The experimental results show that X-ray can reduce the partial discharge initial voltage (PDIV), X-ray can reduce the PDIV from an average of 6.3 kV to 5.5 kV, which is reduced by 12.6%. X-ray can also increase the discharge repetition rate at the same time, taking 6.8 kV as an example, under X-ray irradiation the discharge repetition rate becomes 2.3 times of the natural state. The research results will provide a new idea for detecting micro electrical tree defects of XLPE cable and accessories.

Author Keywords: X-ray Project supported by Beijing Natural Science Foundation (3192037).

articleTitle: Security Analysis of Integrated Energy System under Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Currently, the power system is being transformed into a new generation of clean and low-carbon integrated energy system. Not only the intermittent and random nature of renewable energy output will affect the normal operation of integrated energy power system, but also the disturbance caused by extreme events to individual energy systems may trigger chain failures within the scope of integrated energy power system. However, the complex coupling relationship of integrated energy systems has been a difficult problem for safety analysis, and little research has been done in this area. Fortunately, the successful application of complex network theory in other fields provides a reference for this purpose. Therefore, this paper first models the integrated energy system based on complex network theory, then analyzes the network characteristics of the integrated energy system to illustrate the feasibility of using complex network related theory to study the safety of the integrated energy system, and finally verifies the possibility of risk transmission across space in the integrated energy system by means of the dependency model. The results of the paper can provide theoretical support for the study of the security problems in integrated energy systems under complex network theory.

articleTitle: AC Copper Loss Analytic Modle Considering for Multiple Hairpin Winding Configurations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents an analytical model for predicting AC copper loss in the hairping winding. The proposed model can predict the copper loss in the case of arbitrary conductor configurations. Finite element analysis has been used to verify the accuracy of the proposed model. The results show that the more times of conductors interleave with different phases, the smaller the slot magnetic leakage flux and conductor loss. Meanwhile, with the increase of the saturation degree in stator core, the loss induced by permanent magnet field in the conductors becomes larger but the AC loss coefficient becomes smaller.

articleTitle: Small-Sample Interval Prediction Model based on Transfer Learning for Solar Power Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a small-sample interval prediction (SIP) model based on Transfer Learning (TL) method for solar power prediction under the condition of limited amount of training data. Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) is employed as base predictor to construct interval boundaries and Direct Quantile Regression (DQR) method is utilized for training. Based on TL approach, TrAdaBoost for interval prediction method is proposed to enhance the prediction performance in the scenario of limited data. Comprehensive experiments based on realistic solar power data are conducted to confirm the superiority of the proposed model.

articleTitle: A Remedial Method Based on Field-Oriented Control for Five-Phase PMSM Under Single-Phase Open-Circuit Fault
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Field-oriented control (FOC) based on vector space decomposition (VSD) is a common method for the high-performance operation of five-phase motors. In this paper, a remedial method based on FOC for five-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor (FPMSM) with sinusoidal back electromotive force (EMF) is proposed to suppress the current distortion and torque ripple under single phase open-circuit fault (OCF). For FPMSM with sinusoidal back EMF, the circular trajectory of current in the stationary $\alpha-\beta$ frame can produce circular rotating magnetomotive force to output constant torque. After single phase OCF, the motor model based on VSD keeps unchanged because the prefault normal matrix is adopted in the decoupling transformation. However, the modulation voltages of the inverter are no longer equal to the phase voltages of the motor, resulting in current distortion and torque fluctuation. By analyzing the inverter model and motor model under single phase OCF, a remedial method is proposed, which the disturbances are suppressed by reconstructing the voltage transformation matrix and using voltage feedforward. Compared with conventional methods based on PR or double PI controllers, the structures of current controllers are no need to be changed, so this method has the advantages of simple application and avoiding complex parameter design. The simulation verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on SVM-DTC Control Strategy of PMSM Based on Super-Twisting Sliding Mode Active Disturbance Rejection Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the problems of easy overshoot, poor robustness and difficult parameter tuning in the SVM-DTC speed control system of PMSM, the super-twisting sliding mode active disturbance rejection control (STSM-ADRC) speed controller is proposed. Firstly, in order to reduce the adjustable parameters of ADRC, a second-order linear tracking differentiator is designed. Then, the super-twisting sliding mode algorithm is proposed to replace the nonlinear state error feedback (NLSEF) in the ADRC to further reduce its adjustable parameters and improve its robustness, whilst the stability of the controller is verified. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Non-Intrusive Load Decomposition Based on Graph Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Demand-side power management and energy efficiency analysis are crucial to reducing energy consumption and improving power efficiency. Non-intrusive load decomposition is one of the important links to improve demand-side power management and energy efficiency analysis. In view of the fact that most of the current non-intrusive load decomposition methods focus on the analysis of traditional load characteristics and the optimization of algorithms, and lack of sufficient mining of user’s electricity behavior habits, a nonintrusive load decomposition model based on graph convolutional network (GCN) is proposed. The model firstly constructs the power sequence into graph data as network input based on the spectral graph theory, using the time characteristics extracted from the user’s electricity behavior habits. Then, based on the graph convolutional neural network, the power attribute features of each electrical appliance and its time-related structural features are extracted to achieve non-intrusive load decomposition. Specifically, it has a total of five layers of structure, including four layers of graph convolution layer and one layer of graph pooling layer. The ReLu activation function is used to improve the nonlinear expression, the dropout and L2 regularization measures are used to alleviate overfitting, and the bath size is used to improve the training speed. AMPds2 dataset is used for experimental testing. The experimental results show that the proposed decomposition model can accurately detect the switches of electrical appliances, and achieve better decomposition and effective tracking of the power of each electrical appliance.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation of wind-storage power generation system considering fatigue failure of wind turbine gearbox
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The gearbox of the wind turbine is an important part of the transmission system, and the fatigue failure caused by its long-term operation cannot be ignored. At the same time, the randomness and intermittency of wind power output should also be paid attention to. Therefore, this paper proposes a reliability assessment strategy for wind-storage power generation systems considering fatigue faults of wind turbine gearboxes, introducing fatigue faults into the traditional reliability assessment model of power generation systems, and connecting the energy storage system. The Monte Carlo method is used to calculate the reliability parameters of the power generation system, and the changes of reliability parameters under different operating scenarios are analyzed. The results show that considering the fatigue failure of the wind turbine gearbox can improve the accuracy of the power generation system reliability assessment, and the connection of the energy storage system can improve the reliability of the power generation system.

articleTitle: LADRC-based DC Bus Voltage Control for Single-phase Boost PFC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As a front-end AC/DC converter, the power factor correction (PFC) circuit is widely applied in electric vehicles, microgrids, and other fields. Single-phase Boost PFC has become the most commonly used topology in medium power applications, which has the advantages of continuous input current, simple switching tube drive, small conduction loss, etc. To improve Boost PFC's robustness and anti-interference capability, a voltage outer loop control method based on Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control (LADRC) is proposed. The optimized tracking performance even in the presence of disturbances and uncertainties by properly choosing the observer bandwidth factor is achieved. Simulation results show that compared with traditional PI control approaches, the proposed control method is characterized by improved robustness performance against various disturbances and uncertainties have better disturbance rejection and robustness.

articleTitle: An Integrated Optimization Design Method of Single-Phase PV Inverter Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to minimize the filter mass and loss, optimize controller parameters, this paper proposes an integrated optimization design method for filter and controller of single-phase grid-connected PV inverter based on machine learning (ML). Support vector machine (SVM) is used to judge the feasibility of the filter design scheme, and artificial neural network (ANN) establishes the mapping relationship from system parameters to optimization goals. In the model, the optional capacitance data is discretized, ensuring that the results are current commercial models. Similarly, the parameters of the current loop controller are optimized by ML to obtain the minimum current ripple. In this paper, the performance comparison of the system with different filter and controller design schemes is conducted in simulation, the results indicate the validity and superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Sinusoidal Current Control Method for SPMSM Considering Uneven Demagnetization Fault
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Irreversible demagnetization is one of the drawbacks of permanent magnet synchronous machines(PMSMs). This article first investigates the influence of uneven demagnetization fault on the current control of surface-mounted PMSMs with fractional-slot winding configurations. The characterization of permanent magnet flux linkage under rotor fault is presented by means of two-dimensional finite element analysis in a 12-slot/10-pole surface-mounted PMSM, and the mathematical model containing interharmonics is built. Then, a proportional-integral-resonant (PIR) current controller is introduced to suppress the interharmonics and reduce the undesired harmonic losses. Finally, experimental results are presented to prove the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic optimal configuration of net zero energy building based on whole-process energy efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The hybrid photovoltaic-thermal (PV/T) system has been focused with the development of net zero energy technology, due to the advantage of being able to convert solar energy into electric energy and heat energy at the same time, so as to achieve full energy absorption. A new whole-process energy efficiency calculation (WPEEC) algorithm is proposed based on the utilization of new energy in terms of PV/T renewable energy utilization. In this article, the electric energy and thermal energy are analyzed, combined with the system structure and PV/T principle structure diagram. Moreover, the energy efficiency of the microgrid, photoelectric conversion, and photothermal conversion of the heat pump system are calculated respectively, so as to obtain the total solar energy efficiency. Finally, an office building in Beijing is selected as a case study. The WPEEC algorithm is used to simulate and calculate the influence of PV/T laying area, power supply and storage ratio, and heating storage tank capacity on the energy efficiency of solar energy utilization in the whole process.

articleTitle: Design of a Nonintrusive Current Sensor with Large Dynamic Range Based on Tunneling Magnetoresistive Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Current sensors are widely used in power grid for power metering, automation and power equipment monitoring. Since the tradeoff between the sensitivity and the measurement range needs to be made to design a current sensor, it is difficult to deploy one sensor to measure both the small-magnitude and the large-magnitude current.
