In this research, we design a surface-mount current sensor by using the tunneling magneto-resistance (TMR) devices and show that the tradeoff between the sensitivity and the detection range can be broken. Two TMR devices of different sensitivity degrees were integrated into one current sensor module, and a signal processing algorithm was implemented to fusion the outputs of the two TMR devices. Then, a platform was setup to test the performance of the surface-mount current sensor. The results showed that the designed current sensor could measure the current from 2 mA to 100 A with an approximate 93 dB dynamic range. Besides, the nonintrusive feature of the surface-mount current sensor could make it convenient to be deployed on-site.

articleTitle: Research on GSSA Model of Wireless Power Transfer System Using a quasi Z-source Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the large number of dynamic components and the complexity, the dynamic modeling of wireless power transmission(WPT) systems has always been a difficult problem. The generalized state-space average(GSSA) modeling method is suitable for wireless power transfer systems because of its fast time-varying characteristics. Based on this, Fourier coefficients and switching functions is introduced to connect the state variables of the circuit with the generalized state variables, a large-signal model of the Quasi-Z-source WPT system is established in the shoot-through and phase-shift control mode, and the transfer function model of the system is further derived with the help of the small-signal perturbation method. The model is used to analyze the steady-state and dynamic characteristics of the system, which provides an important reference for the design of the system controller. In this paper, an experimental platform for wireless power transfer system using Quasi-Z-source converters is built, and the basic principles and theoretical models of the system are experimentally verified through digital PI controllers. The results show that the theoretical model has sufficient accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Digital Twins System in Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous economic development, the scale of domestic distribution network is getting larger and larger. If the short-circuit current calculation of the entire distribution network is carried out by manual calculation, it is very time-consuming and energy-consuming. And for some complex grids, such as ring networks, the calculation is even more difficult and prone to errors. By using computer calculations, the workload can be greatly reduced, and the calculation accuracy has also been greatly improved. Therefore, the development of a distribution network fault calculation system suitable for actual physical engineering can improve calculation precision and work efficiency, which greatly benefits the current distribution network planning, construction and management.This paper researches a digital twin system of grid distribution network by combining the digital twin technology with the short-circuit current calculation.

articleTitle: A Fault Detection and Location Technique for Inverter-Dominated Islanding Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Microgrids are attracting increasing interest since they are allowed to work under islanding mode by being disconnected from large-scale commercial distribution networks when large disasters occur. However, disconnected microgrids do not contain appropriate protection systems, which in most cases are installed only at distribution substations. Moreover, the fault currents are significantly limited due to the high penetration of inverter-based distributed generators (IBDGs). Therefore, a protection system or scheme targeted at islanding microgrids is required. In this paper, we develop a transient analysis for islanding ungrounded microgrids, in which multiple IBGDs are deployed under different control strategies, during different types of faults. Furthermore, we propose a fault detection and location method based on two-terminal measurements instead of the single-terminal measurements often utilized in conventional protection schemes such as overcurrent protection. The proposed method does not rely on heavy information exchange. We monitor zero-sequence components, negative-sequence components, and phase currents for locating different types of faults in islanding microgrids. It is verified in our simulation study that the proposed method works well in islanding microgrids with lower fault current levels.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Hybrid Stator Pole Type Bearingless Switched Reluctance Motor with Simulated Annealing Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of traditional 12/14 hybrid stator pole type bearingless switched reluctance motor (BSRM), such as small starting torque and large torque ripple, a BSRM based on stepped rotor structure was designed in this paper. Then, the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is studied and improved, and the simulated annealing particle swarm optimization (SAPSO) algorithm is proposed and its effectiveness is verified. In addition, the response surface method is used to replace the finite element calculation, and the mathematical model is combined with SAPSO algorithm to optimize the structural parameters of the motor. Finally, the basic characteristics, including inductance, torque, suspension force and coupling characteristics, of the original and optimized BSRM were analyzed and compared to verify the effectiveness of the proposed SAPSO algorithm.

articleTitle: Auxiliary Decision-making Method for Reactive Power Compensation Configuration of AC Grid-connected Offshore Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Integrating into the grid by the AC submarine cable has become one of the main connecting modes of offshore wind farm. Because of the excessive charging power and the overvoltage of AC submarine cables, the reactive power compensation scheme for offshore wind farm is more complicated than onshore wind farm. By summarizing the influencing factors of offshore wind farm reactive power compensation, this paper proposes the idea and method of generating an auxiliary decision-making toolbox for offshore wind farm reactive power compensation configuration based on neural network. According to specific offshore wind farm projects, the reactive power compensation configuration scheme can be obtained using the toolbox, and the rationality of the reactive power compensation scheme is verified on three aspects: reactive power balance, power frequency overvoltage and voltage fluctuation. The workload for reactive power compensation configuration can be reduced.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Distributed Photovoltaic Admission Capability Based on Voltage Sensitivity and Multi-Scenario Power Flow Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the Background of ‘Carbon peaking and Carbon neutrality’ goals, with the rapid development of clean energy, power system is gradually transforming to low-carbon. The proportion of distributed photovoltaic in the distribution network increases rapidly, and the uncertainty of its output and the randomness of the access scheme can easily lead to dramatic changes in line power flow and bring about operational safety problems. Aiming at the problem that high proportion of distributed photovoltaic access affects the safe and stable operation of distribution network, this paper proposes a distributed photovoltaic acceptance ability evaluation method based on voltage sensitivity and multi-scenario power flow simulation. The method uniformly generates the possible access scheme of distributed photovoltaic in the network and simulates the multi-power flow. Finally, by comparing the peak voltage of each scheme, the distributed photovoltaic carrying capacity of distribution network is evaluated. Taking IEEE 14-bus system as an example, the results show that the proposed method can effectively solve the calculation problem of distributed photovoltaic carrying capacity of distribution network.

articleTitle: Fast DC Optimal Power Flow Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The optimal power flow is the cornerstone of the operation and management of electric power systems. However, the stochastic and intermittent uncertainty due to the proliferation of renewable energy resources (RES) poses a non-trivial challenge to timely obtain the optimal operation point of the power system. To address the computational burden issue, a deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) model is proposed to learn the mapping from the injections to the optimal objective. The DCNN reduces the training parameters as well as improves the approximation accuracy. IEEE 14/118/300 bus power systems are conducted, and the optimal power flow model is solved by Gurobi/Python. Simulation results show that DCNN speeds up the calculation time by up to 100 times in comparison to the state-of-the-art solver and simultaneously maintains the required accuracy.

articleTitle: Discussion on 5G Business Model in Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: 5G has the characteristics of high speed, low delay, interconnection of all things and low power consumption. The application requirements of the power industry are highly matched with the technical characteristics of 5G. The three technical features of 5G provide differentiated network service capabilities for different businesses of the power grid, and bring new opportunities for the transformation and upgrading of the power industry. 5G mobile communication technology has a wider range of applications. The application of relevant technologies in the power communication system can improve the shortcomings of the power communication system and bring far-reaching changes to the power industry. This paper introduces 5G and its application in power industry, analyzes the characteristics of business model, and further discusses the business model of 5G in power industry.

articleTitle: Analysis and Modeling of a Magnetically Levitated Synchronous Permanent Magnet Planar Motor with Concentric Structure Winding
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper deals with the characteristic analysis and modeling of a magnetically levitated synchronous permanent magnet planar motor (MLSPMPM) with concentric structure winding. Topology of this MLSPMPM is introduced, the planar motor is suitable for long-stroke applications because the mover can move on the stator freely. Characteristics of the MLSPMPM, such as flux density, thrust and back-EMF are obtained analytically. These results will be compared with the finite element simulation results. And the analytical values matching the simulated ones well.

articleTitle: Rolling optimization of Wind Power and Pumped Hydro Storage System based on W-IGDT
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Affected by wind speed, wind power(WP) output has strong intermittent and fluctuation. The influence of uncertainty needs to be fully considered in power system dispatching. With the development of electricity power market, joint bidding of pumped hydro storage (PHS) station and renewable energy has become a trend. The PHS has the function of cutting peak, shifting load and promoting the consumption of renewable energy. In this paper, the combination of WP and PHS are allowed for rolling energy bidding in the day-ahead and intraday market. The weighted information gap decision theory (W-IGDT) is used to deal with the uncertainty of WP output. A WP-PHS joint dispatching model based on W-IGDT is proposed. According to the risk preference of decision makers, the risk-averse and risk-seek strategy are formulated. Finally, the results of case study show that the proposed strategy can allocate different scheduling plans according to the decision makers’ risk preference, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research the Influences of the Thickness of Air Gap and Iron Core on the Vibration of the Shunt Reactor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The UHV shunt reactor is one of the main sound sources in the substation, and it can be a great significance to optimize the internal structure for reducing the noise of the reactor. According to the characteristics of the core of the UHV shunt reactor composed of gaps and discus alternately stacked, a simulation model is established based on the method of multi-physics coupling. The Maxwell force is the essential reason for the vibration between the core cakes and the dominant effect of the core vibration, then the influences of the thickness of the reactor core and gap on the Maxwell force between the discus and the vibration characteristics are calculated and analyzed. In addition, the experiments have been carried out, and the vibration characteristics of the iron core were measured and analyzed, and the variation of the iron core vibration with the voltage was also obtained.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Diamond-shaped Distribution Network under Large-scale Distribution generation integration Access
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the new distribution network form of the diamond-type distribution network, this paper considers the development trend of large-scale distributed generation (DG) access to the new distribution system, and considers the impact of large-scale photovoltaic and energy storage access to the distribution network. Through Monte Carlo simulation, the island operation model of distributed power and energy storage system microgrid is established, and the reliability of the typical grid structure of diamond-type distribution network is evaluated. At the same time, this paper considers the influence of different power distribution system automation levels and different proportions of new energy access on reliability. The conclusion shows that the access of large-scale new energy can improve the reliability of the distribution network to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Compatibility study of eco-friendly Insulating Dielectric C5-PFK-CO₂ with silver material
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: C5-PFK gas has extremely low greenhouse effect and excellent insulating properties, and is a kind of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> substitute gas with great application prospects. However, it has poor compatibility with conductive copper materials, and will corrode the copper surface at high temperature and cause self-decomposition. In this paper, the compatibility with C5-PFK-CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> at different temperatures after electroplating silver protective layer on copper surface was tested. The research shows that C5-PFK-CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> has good compatibility with the silver protective layer, and there is no corrosion on the silver surface before and after the test. The decomposition of C5-PFK gas is also mainly caused by the hydrolysis reaction caused by the trace moisture contained in the equipment, and the decomposition products are mainly CHF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> and C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> HF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>. The silver-plated protective layer on the copper surface can well protect the internal copper material and improve the problem of poor compatibility between the copper material and C5-PFK-CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. The related research results provide a solution to the problem of poor compatibility between C5-PFK-CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and conductive copper materials.

articleTitle: Optimizing Method of Measuring Point Position of Transformer Core Vibration Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It is very important to choose the location of the transformer core vibration monitoring measurement point for the transformer core vibration monitoring. This paper explores a method for optimizing the position of sensor measurement points based on the vibration acceleration cloud map of the transformer core. In this method, the transformer core is modeled and analyzed, and the core model is subjected to electric-magnetic-force multi-physics simulation through finite element software, the vibration acceleration distribution on the surface of the transformer core is analyzed, and the optimal core vibration measurement point location is selected. Vibration signals are collected at the selected measuring points through the optical fiber vibration sensor to obtain higher quality vibration acceleration data, which provides a basis for the state recognition of the iron core.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Sheath Development of Cathode during the Instability Stage of Vacuum Arc
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The vacuum arc enters the pre-zero instability phase when the equivalent impedance fluctuates dramatically, interacting with the complex external circuit, resulting in high frequency oscillations in the voltage and arc current of interrupter. This paper analyses the changes in each characteristic parameter in pre-zero instability phase, focusing on the oscillations of the interrupter voltage and arc current during the instability phase as well as the movement of the last cathode spot. The characteristics of the voltage and current waveforms are summarized, and the two most typical voltage spike variation processes are identified. Finally, the typical phenomena of the unstable phase are linked to the changes in the sheath development during cathode emission, and the correspondence between cathode emission and voltage spikes is proposed.

articleTitle: Fast reactive power control technology of photovoltaic inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This report first studies the structure of photovoltaic inverter, establishes the photovoltaic inverter model, including the mathematical model of photovoltaic array, filter and photovoltaic inverter system in different coordinates; builds a single-stage grid connected photovoltaic power generation system model based on MATLAB / Simulink simulation platform, studies the fast reactive power control principle of photovoltaic inverter, and simulates and analyzes the photovoltaic power generation system Reactive power control strategy of unified quota.

articleTitle: Design Considerations and Validation of Three Compensation Approaches to Deal With Problem of Phase Difference for Grid-Connected Current Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The phase difference between the grid voltage and current in grid-connected current source inverter is affected by the PI controller parameters, filter inductor and equivalent resistance. To eliminate the phase difference, three phase compensation strategies are proposed: phase compensation based on phase detection, phase compensation based on output power detection, and filter inductance regulation. The inverter mathematical model is established firstly. Then, the compensation principle and its parameters design method are given. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed strategies in eliminating phase difference and improving power factor are verified by using the Matlab/Simulink simulation model and experimental platform.

articleTitle: Research on the characteristics of corona discharge ionic wind of needle-to-plate electrode
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The ionic wind has been widely used in many fields because of its characteristics of no rotating parts, low noise, and low energy consumption. In this paper, the needle-plate electrode structure is used to study the effects of different voltage levels, different power supply polarities, and different needle-plate distances on the corona ionic wind characteristics through particle image velocimetry (PIV) technology, and the possible mechanism behind the experimental phenomenon is discussed. The research results show that under the same power supply polarity, the ionic wind velocity increases with the applied voltage. Under the same voltage level, the wind velocity and jet range of the negative corona ionic wind are greater than those of the positive corona. Under the same polarity and the same voltage level, the ionic wind velocity increases with the decrease of the needle-to-plate distance. The research results of this paper have certain guiding significance for improving the ionic wind velocity and further understanding the development process of ionic wind.

articleTitle: Simultaneous detection of H2S and CO based on cantilever enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Cantilever beam enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy gas detection technology has attracted extensive attention due to its high detection sensitivity, but the quantitative detection of multi-component in mixed gas has not been carried out yet. In this paper, two infrared laser beams with central wavelengths of 1578.13nm and 1568.04nm are coupled into the same optical fiber with a wave combination, and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S and CO are quantitatively detected in binary mixture gas $\mathrm{H}_{2}\mathrm{S}/\mathrm{N}_{2}, \mathrm{C}\mathrm{O}/\mathrm{N}_{2}$ and ternary mixture gas $\mathrm{H}_{2}\mathrm{S}/\mathrm{C}\mathrm{O}/\mathrm{N}_{2}$. Based on the analysis of the cross interference mechanism of infrared absorption S lines, a quantitative detection method of H2S and CO in H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S/CO/N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> termist mixture was proposed, and the influence of background gas types on PAS signal intensity was analyzed. The results show that the maximum SNR values of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S and CO gases both appear at 45Hz in the range of 20-300hz. In mixed gas, there is a linear relationship between the pure PAS signal value and gas concentration. For the terrestrial-mixed gas, the total PAS signal can be regarded as the linear superposition of the respective PAS signals of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S and CO, and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S needs to be quantified first, and then CO. The results provide an idea for multi-component quantitative detection of fault gas in power equipment.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy for Black Start of Wind Farm Assisted by Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For a regional power grid lacking conventional black start power source, its black start capability can be improved if new energy power stations, such as wind farms, are able to provide black start service. However, wind turbine (WT) cannot be started without external power source, which limits its participation in black start of power grid. With the increasing application of energy storage system (ESS) in wind farm, it can be used to assist the self-starting of WT. Therefore, this paper proposes a coordinated control strategy of ESS and WT to realize the black start of wind farm. Firstly, as a black start power source, the ESS adopts a two-layer control scheme that consisted of the device and system layer to establish and maintain frequency and voltage of the isolated black start system. Furthermore, the no-load grid-connection control method for WT is adopted to reduce the power impact in the instant of connecting the WT to the system. The rationality and validity of the proposed control strategy is verified with the dynamic simulation for black start process of wind farm.

articleTitle: Dispatch Potential Evaluation of Generalized Electric Vehicle Charging Stations Based on Traffic Flow
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The effective dispatch of the power system can meet the severe challenges of electric vehicles connecting to the grid, for which the mining of demand-side scheduling potential provides reliable data support. At present, the research on dispatching potential only focuses on the electric vehicles that have been connected to the grid, which has great limitations. We expand the research object to the road network area near the charging station, introduces traffic flow parameters and establishes a vehicle prediction model based on LSTM. At the same time, considering the capacity limitation of the actual charging station, this paper proposes the occupancy time parameter of the charging pile, establishes a generalized energy storage model of the charging station based on Minkowski, and reasonably predicts its dispatchable potential. Finally, the rationality and feasibility of the proposed model are verified by a specific case analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Separation Method of Partial Discharge Mixed Signal in Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the switchgear is running, there may be multiple insulation defects inside it, resulting in mixed PD signals collected by the partial discharge (PD) sensor, which affects the subsequent PD pattern recognition and positioning. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes an improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) optimization joint approximate diagonalization (JADE) PD mixed-signal blind source separation algorithm, which optimizes the inertia weight formula of the traditional PSO algorithm to improve the global search of the PSO algorithm. The improved PSO algorithm and the JADE algorithm are combined in the PD mixed signal separation to overcome the shortcoming that the JADE algorithm is easy to fall into the local optimum. Finally, the PD mathematical model of the switchgear is used to construct PD mixed signals with different trigger time differences, and the performance of the algorithm is tested by adding noise of different intensities. The coefficient is significantly higher than other separation algorithms, and the algorithm execution time is shorter, and the accurate signal separation can still be ensured in the case of small trigger time difference and strong noise, indicating that this method can effectively separate mixed PD signals under different working conditions., which provides an important reference for evaluating the operating status of the equipment and arranging the maintenance cycle.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization Analysis of Double-Stator Bearingless Flux Switching Permanent Magnet Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to overcome the disadvantage of low power density of bearingless flux switching permanent magnet motor, a new double-stator bearingless flux switching permanent magnet motor was designed. Firstly, the topological structure of the motor is given, and according to the given rated speed and rated power, the relationship between the motor power and the structure size is utilized to build a preliminary design scheme of the motor. Then, the rotor structure is optimized by using finite element analysis to improve the output torque and suspension performance of the motor. Finally, the electromagnetic performance of the optimized motor is analyzed, including torque, suspension force, coupling and loss. The results show that the designed motor has excellent decoupling performance and low loss under the premise of satisfying suspension and torque output.

Author Keywords: Bearingless flux switching permanent magnet motor

articleTitle: A two-tier demand response scheduling strategy based on users’ equipment level
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Demand response (DR) can effectively improve the stability of electrical power systems. The construction of an energy network reaches the state sensing of user electricity equipment, which provides the row data support for DR. Therefore, a two-layer DR scheduling strategy based on user equipment level is proposed. The strategy can be used in different scenes which contain the difference of subjective response willingness of residential users and the uncertainty of electricity adjustment of different equipment. There are two parts to the strategy which are the upper layer that is the equipment level DR scheduling and the lower layer that is the feedback of customer satisfaction. The upper layer and lower layer are interrelated and mutually constrained. After analysis and simulation, it shows that the strategy can improve the efficiency of customers’ electricity consumption, guarantee the safe and economic operation of the power system, and enhance the competitive vitality of the power market.

articleTitle: Hierarchical coordination control strategy of multiport energy hub in the honeycomb active distribution network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To cope with the wide access of high-proportion distributed generations, the multiport energy hub based honeycomb active distribution network is proposed and studied. With the honeycomb structure, microgrids are interconnected with multi-port energy hub through their respective public connection points. The honeycomb active distribution network has the ability to realize the mutual energy transfer among microgrids, thus to improve the accommodation of new energy. This paper proposes a hierarchical coordinated control strategy based on multi-port energy hubs to realize the stable power regulation in honeycomb distribution network with energy storage. The upper-layer control coordinates and controls the power distribution between the energy storage system. The converters at each port is controlled according to the SOC state of the energy storage system, so as to smooth the fluctuation of renewable energy within a certain period of time. The lower-layer control performs rapid compensation by feeding back the change rate of the output active power of the energy storage system to the reference current of the converter that interconnected with the AC microgrid. Therefore, the energy storage system and the converters at each port coordinately respond to transient power fluctuations in the energy hub. A hierarchical coordination control strategy including energy storage system and multi-port energy hubs is established, and the stability of the system is analyzed. The multi-port energy hub is simulated by Matlab/Simulink, and the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified by comparing the simulation and experimental results under different working conditions.

articleTitle: Suspended Particle Purification by Negative Corona Discharges of Multi-needle Electrode
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> and other fine particles are one of the indoor air pollutants that pose a great threat to human health. Long-term exposure to dust will cause heart and lung diseases and even cancer. A large number of high-energy electrons and active particles in low-temperature plasma can directly act on harmful substances in the air, which has high potential in purifying PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf>. In order to achieve high purification efficiency of PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf>, multi-needle electrode was used to generate large area plasma through negative DC corona discharge, and the purification characteristics of PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> were investigated. It is found that increasing the number of electrode needles can improve the purification efficiency of PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> under different applied voltages, but saturation effect may exist. The electrode humidity will affect the efficiency of PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf>, and the efficiency in wet state is slightly higher than that in dry state.

articleTitle: A High-precision Oscillator with Fast Start-up
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This article presents a fast start-up high-precision oscillator. Compared with the traditional three-stage voltage controlled oscillator in current starvation topology, the oscillator has a faster start-up speed and higher frequency accuracy. The oscillator uses a high-pass signal filter to filter out low-frequency signals in the start-up stage to speed up the start-up speed. In addition, it transmits the signal to the frequency-voltage conversion network through negative feedback to achieve closed-loop control of the frequency, so as to achieve high precision the oscillation frequency. The circuit is designed based on the SMIC 180nm CMOS process. Based on the simulation results, the circuit has a good performance in terms of start-up speed and frequency accuracy.

articleTitle: Self-Adaptive Balance Control Strategy of Cascaded H-Bridge Multilevel Power Conversion System of Battery Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Cascaded H-bridge multilevel power conversion system of energy storage (CHB-PCS) generally has the issue of battery state of charge (SOC) imbalance among phases. To address this issue, the traditional zero-sequence voltage injection method has been commonly used, but it has slow speed and overmodulation problems when the extent of imbalance is high. Concerning this problem, this study analyzed the influencing factors of the injected zero-sequence voltage, studied the relationship between balance coefficient ($\Lambda$) and general vector $(\Delta SOC\mathrm{g})$, and proposed a zero-sequence voltage injection balance strategy based on self-adaptive balance coefficient. The proposed self-adaptive balance control strategy is able to regulate the coefficients during the balancing process and accelerate the balancing process without causing over-modulation, thus ensuring the safe and stable operation of the system. A simulation of CHB-PCS was built in MATLAB/SIMULINK which verified the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Study on the Power Loss of Ground Wire in Parallel Transmission Lines Under Different Phase Sequence Arrangement
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the magnetic coupling between the phase line and the ground wire, the induced electromotive force is formed in the ground wire, producing inductive current and power loss in the current circuit between the ground wire and the earth, reducing the efficiency of power deliver. With the increase of power deliver and the improvement of the voltage level of the power network in China, especially the emergence of UHV AC transmission line, the power loss of ground wires caused by the magnetic coupling cannot be overlooked. At present, many studies focused on how to reduce the power loss of ground wires and various engineering measures have been adopted to reduce the power loss of ground wires, such as single point grounding, graded insulation and transposition technology, etc. However, most researches are based on the case that conductors and ground wires are installed in the same tower, while there is no relevant research on the parallel transmission lines where conductors and ground wires are installed in the different tower, especially those researches about the influence of phase sequence arrangement on the power loss in parallel transmission lines. Taking the 750kV parallel transmission lines now widely constructed in northwest China as example, this paper studies the characteristics of ground wire power loss under different phase sequence arrangement and different parallel distance, so as to illustrate the best energy saving phase sequence arrangement.

articleTitle: Optimization of thermal storage capacity of solar tower power considering peak regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Solar thermal power generation technology is an environment-friendly power generation technology that can make full use of solar energy. The power generating model and economical model of the concentrating solar power (CSP) station are established in this paper. The reliability of the power generation system is calculated based on the sequential Monte-Carlo method, and then the influences of solar multiple and thermal storage time on expected not supplied energy (EENS), internal rate of return (IRR), and Levelized cost of energy (LCOE) of CSP station are studied. Taking EENS, IRR, and LCOE as the optimization goal, the multi-objective optimization algorithm based on genetic algorithm was used to obtain the Pareto optimal solution. Results show that EENS decreases, and the LCOE decreases first and then increases with the increase of SM. The IRR is in contrast with LCOE. At last, a Pareto front is obtained to decide the parameters with different LCOE, IRR, and EENS.

articleTitle: A Study on Model-Based optimization of Multiple Energy Carriers in Integrated Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The overall efficiency of the energy system can be improved by the comprehensive planning and scheduled optimization of the integrated energy system to meet the regional energy demand. To solve the problems of insufficient equipment coordination within the energy station and the mismatch between the designed and actual loads, this paper presents a model-based scheduling optimization method for integrated energy systems. Firstly, this study establishes the model of the source energy station according to the equipment parameters and energy flow topology. After that, we carry out the clustering analysis of energy consumption data according to the actual operation data of the user. Then, the modular optimization model is built and solved for the daily scheduling scheme to achieve the lowest economic cost. This method was applied in a case study to optimize the cool and heat supply strategy. The optimized plan showed better economy and stability, saving about 2.3% for the system operation cost.

articleTitle: Grid Carbon Footprint Tracking Algorithm Based on Electrical Profiling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For power grid regulation, it is critical to understand the carbon footprint of the grid and the trend in carbon emissions. To begin, this project creates a power supply carbon emission model in order to study power supply carbon emissions under various operating situations. Then, based on electrical dissection, we propose a grid carbon footprint tracking algorithm to create a real-world carbon footprint map of a certain region, which can dynamically track and display the distribution of carbon flow in a certain region, a, the direction of carbon flow of different power sources, and the carbon emission of different regions, allowing dispatchers to grasp the grid's carbon emission trend and provide auxiliary support for grid regulation.

articleTitle: Analytical Calculation of Electromagnetic Performance in Dual-winding Bearingless Flux-Switching Permanent Magnet Machines Considering Rotor Eccentricity
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Dual-winding bearingless flux switching permanent magnet motors (BFSPMM) are doubly salient, the magnetic field distribution of the motor will be more complicated when the rotor is eccentric. A subdomain model method considering the rotor eccentricity of dual-winding BFSPMM is proposed in this paper to analyze the electromagnetic characteristics of the rotor eccentricity with slots on both sides of stator and rotor. Based on retaining the original polar coordinates at the geometric center of the stator, a new polar coordinate system is established at the geometric center of the rotor. The Laplace and Poisson equations of each subdomain are established in two different coordinate systems respectively. In the developed model, the entire air gap area is divided into the non-uniform and uniform air gap area. The electromagnetic parameters under the condition of rotor eccentricity are analyzed, such as flux density, back-EMF, and suspension forces. The analytical model are verified through the finite element method (FEM) and prototype experiment.

articleTitle: Techno-economic comparison of vortex-type and chimney-type solar updraft power-desalination integrated systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To compare and analyze the techno-economic competitiveness of the solar updraft power-desalination integrated systems of vortex-type, chimney-type and wind-supercharged chimney-type and provide reference for commercial application, the techno-economic analysis models of the three systems are established through the mathematical models of heat transfer and cash flow calculations. The results show that among various integrated systems, wind-supercharged chimney-type has significant advantages in power output. Even considering the chimney shadow, its power output is still 26.89% higher than that of vortex-type, but the vortex-type has the highest freshwater output. In the investment of various integrated systems, the cost of collector and distillation pond accounts for a large proportion, and the investment cost of vortex-type is the lowest. During the lifetime, the annual net income of each integrated system increases year by year, and the annual net present value first increases and then decreases. Compared with wind-supercharged chimney-type, the total net income and total net present value of vortex-type increase by 44.57% and 107.14% respectively. The vortex-type enters the profit status in the first year, while chimney-type and wind-supercharged chimney-type will not formally enter the profit status until the 8th and 4th year respectively, showing the obvious advantage of vortex-type in quick profit.

articleTitle: Adaptive Step-Size Relaxed Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers for Coordination Combined Cooling, Heating and Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP) system has attracted increasing attention. However, due to data privacy, it is challenging to exchange detailed topology or operation states between electric power system (EPS) and district heating and cooling (DHC) system, so it is necessary to carry out distributed optimization for the CCHP system dispatch problem. This paper is focused on CCHP system dispatch problem and first establishes its mathematical model. Then, based on the relaxed alternating direction method of multipliers (R-ADMM) algorithm, this paper proposes the adaptive step-size R-ADMM algorithm using the strategy of adaptive step-size to reduce iteration times. Simulation results show that the adaptive step-size R-ADMM algorithm can significantly reduce the number of iteration times compared with the classic alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM).

articleTitle: Electricity Meter Detection and Recognition Algorithm Based on Mixed Feature Perception Neural Network and Classification Fitting Pointer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The meter detection and recognition algorithm based on neural network and cluster analysis is often used in power vision, but the recognition accuracy and speed should still be improved. Therefore, this paper proposes a new pointer reading strategy for feature extraction and classification fitting of power meters, in order to improve the speed and accuracy of pointer reading method and simplify the complexity of algorithm. Firstly, the median filter of noise adaptive fuzzy switching and homomorphic enhancement are used to preprocess the image. Secondly, AEMYOLOV5-EOSHHO model is proposed to remove irrelevant background factors and obtain regions of interest, the attention enhancement module is added to the YOLOV5 overall structure, and the Elite opposition-learning strategy based Harris hawks optimization (EOSHHO) method is used for hyperparameter optimization. Thirdly, the binary table cluster analysis method is used to binarize the region of interest, and the disk part is retained according to the clustering situation. Finally, the method of rotating straight line fitting meter reading is proposed to fit the pointer, so as to obtain the pointer reading. The experimental results show that the algorithm can accurately find the region of interest, and read the pointer reading of the meter.

articleTitle: Simulation and Measurement of Vibration Characteristics of Magnetic-valve Controllable Reactor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The magnetic-valve controllable reactor (MCR) has been widely applied in power system because of its excellent working characteristics and continuously adjustable capacity. Due to the special core magnetic valve structure and AC/DC co-excitation working mode, the vibration and noise problem of MCR is serious, which has become the main factor restricting the development of MCR. This article establishes the three-dimensional core magnetic field-mechanical coupling model based on the distribution of finite element software. For the centralized magnetic valve structure, the magnetic field and vibration displacement of iron core under different DC control current are numerically calculated. Besides, the vibration acceleration and noise of MCR surface under different loads are also measured and the frequency spectrum of vibration and noise signals are analyzed. According to the simulation results, the magnetic flux density at the magnetic valve is significantly higher than other parts. The value of displacement around the magnetic valve area and “T-type” contact surface are larger. The sound pressure of MCR is higher under load 18600kvar condition and the low frequency harmonic component of time domain waveform increases. The results can provide calculation method and experimental data for the analysis of the vibration characteristics of MCR.

articleTitle: Low Computational Estimated Position Error Compensation and Phase-locked Loop Normalization for PMSM Sensorless Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the back-electromotive force (EMF) phase lag caused by the introduction of the sigmoid function and deduces the estimated position error compensation formula. Simultaneously, in view of the bandwidth change of the conventional phase-locked loop (PLL), the necessity of normalizing the PLL is analyzed. However, the computation required by these two algorithms takes a long time on the digital signal processor (DSP). To solve this problem, this paper proposes a low-computational estimated position error compensation algorithm and a low-computational PLL normalization method, which save one division, one arctangent, and one square root operation. They are of great significance for high switching frequency or the application of complex algorithms. To verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed algorithm, experiments are carried out on a surface-pasted permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM).

articleTitle: Research on Self-adaptive Network Partitioning Algorithm for Electromagnetic Transient Parallel Simulation of Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The electromagnetic transient simulation of large-scale power system is often accelerated by parallel simulation with sub-networks. However, the general network partitioning method based on geographical location information is not self-adaptive, resulting in seriously constrained sub-network numbers, uneven scales, and many associated lines. This paper proposes a self-adaptive network partitioning algorithm based on the k-way thought, making use of the high sparsity of power system. This algorithm combines the mapping relationship between the original data and the graph structure of power system, the preprocessing skills of simplifying complex graph structure and the linear deterministic greedy algorithm to overcome the shortcomings of general network partitioning method and further improve the speed of electromagnetic transient parallel simulation of power system. The algorithm’s results are applied to the electromagnetic transient parallel simulation, verifying its reliability and acceleration effect.

articleTitle: Moisture Assessment of the ERIP Insulation bushing Based on Self-Adaptive Particle Swarm optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Epoxy resin impregnated paper (ERIP) insulation is the main component of the high-voltage (HV) graded bushing. However, the penetration of moisture into ERIP insulation would reduce the electrical strength of HV graded bushing. Therefore, in order to evaluate the moisture content in the ERIP insulation, the moisture content presented in it is investigated in detail by extracting the parameters of Havriliak-Negami (H-N) model based on the self-adaptive particle swarm optimization (SA-PSO) algorithm. Firstly, ERIP insulating samples with different moisture contents are prepared. Then, the frequency domain dielectric spectroscopy (FDS) test is applied to the samples at the same temperature. Finally, the SA-PSO algorithm is used to extract the parameters of H-N model, which can fit the real and imaginary part of complex permittivity under different moisture contents. Based on the model, the characteristic parameters, which can quantitatively characterize the moisture content of the ERIP insulation, are studied in the paper. By this way, the relationship between characteristic parameters and the moisture content of the ERIP insulation are established. The research results show that the two extracted parameters can effectively characterize the moisture content of ERIP insulation. The parameters have a linear function relationship with the moisture content of ERIP insulation. This method can quantitative evaluation of ERIP insulation and provide a theoretical basis for the diagnosis of the state of ERIP insulation bushing.

articleTitle: The collision efficiency between the charging droplets and charging aerosol particles considering the image force
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The collision efficiency of droplets and aerosol particles in the cloud has been extensively studied. However, most studies underestimated the effect of short-range image force when considering the effect of charge on collision efficiency. It is worth noting that the short-range imaging force has a large effect on the collision efficiency when the droplet is close to the aerosol particle. In this paper, a new method for analyzing the collision efficiency of droplets and aerosol particles in the cloud is proposed after considering the effect of image force. The concrete expression of collision efficiency is deduced and further quantitative analysis of collision efficiency is carried out through the research of collision model and theory. In addition, the effects of droplet radius and charging state on the collision efficiency of droplets and aerosol particles are studied. The results show that the presence of electric charges will improve the collision efficiency when the droplets or aerosol particles are charged. Therefore, the growth of water droplets in the cloud can be promoted by applying an electric charge, thereby increasing the probability of rainfall. It provides an idea for the future research of artificial rainfall.

articleTitle: Research on performance and application efficiency of GaN SiC Cascode devices
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Cascode Junction Field Effect Transistor is a combination structure that uses a low-voltage MOSFET as an auxiliary switch to convert a high-voltage normally-on JFET into a normally-off device. In this article, we combine the advantages of GaN’s fast switching speed, simple gate drive circuit, and the high breakdown voltage of SiC. Firstly, a 650V normally-off cascode device is built using a low-voltage GaN and a high-voltage normally-on SiC JFET. The Miller platform is no longer available during the gate turn-on and turn-off process of the SiC JFET, and the SiC JFET can work at higher frequencies. The working principle and switching process of the Cascode device are analyzed in detail, and then the double pulse test and the half-bridge LLC resonance are built. The converter experiment platform compares the switching loss and switching speed of GaN/SiC Cascode, Si/SiC Cascode and Si MOSFET at different current levels, and conducts efficiency tests in actual application circuits. The results show that compared with other devices, GaN/SiC Cascode devices have faster switching speeds, smaller switching losses and higher efficiency, and have good application prospects.

articleTitle: Analysis on Abnormality of 220kV Metal Oxide Lightning Arrester
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Metal oxide arresters are widely used in power systems of various voltage levels. They are prone to moisture or aging due to long-term use of power frequency voltages, resulting in excessive leakage current, which seriously affects the safe and stable operation of power grid equipment. In this paper, through routine tests on metal oxide arresters, it is found that the DC leakage current at 75% U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1mA</inf> exceeds the standard, and it is judged that the valve may be aging or the possibility of porcelain cracks. Then, the disassembly inspection of the problem arrester can find out the cause of the arrester failure and verify it. Preliminary test results can better guide the manufacture and operation and maintenance of arresters.

articleTitle: Study on multi-timescale cascading failure in multi-infeed HVDC systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With more power electronics deployed in power system, the propagation of cascading failure become more complex and it is necessary to investigate the mechanism of cascading failure in the novel power system. This paper reveals a new cascading failure mode in multi-infeed high voltage direct current (HVDC) systems. Firstly, the mechanism of multi-timescale cascading failure is proposed. Then the simulation results of multi-infeed HVDC systems which is carried out in Power system department-Bonneville power administration (PSD-BPA) indicate that the dominant cascading failure modes in different timescales are different and they are coupling with each other. Finally, several dominant factors of different timescale cascading failure modes are pointed out.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Contaminated Insulators Based on Heterologous Entropy Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Pollution flashover of insulators is one of the common faults in the field of power transmission and transformation. In order to improve the reliability of non-contact detection of insulator contamination state, a fault diagnosis method for contaminated insulators based on the fusion of infrared image and leakage current feature level is proposed. Extract insulator infrared images and leakage current entropy features from normal to severe fault states respectively, and then feature selection according to Fisher criterion to obtain feature quantities that can effectively characterize insulator operating conditions. The Bayesian decision theory is used to fuse the heterogeneous entropy features and faults diagnosis. The experimental results show that the infrared image and the leakage current entropy feature can effectively characterize the operating state of the insulator. The accuracy rate of the fusion diagnosis method is significantly higher than that of the infrared or leakage current feature alone, which provides a new method for insulator fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: A particular solution of cylindrical rarefied plasma systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: We explore a cylindrical plasma system in the unmagnetized regime. The plasma is tenuous enough so that any effects of the magnetic field can be neglected. Due to the same reason, we idealized the gaseous plasma and omit any external or internal gravitational forces as well as any kind of viscous forces. We first list dominating differential equations which are vital to the plasma system. Then we obtain a particular solution to these differential equations and further study its corresponding properties. Most importantly, the particular solution represents a steady flow which is not only time-invariant but shows singular characteristics in the neighbourhood of the symmetric axis.

articleTitle: Improved VSG Control Strategy for Wind Turbines Connected to Non-Synchronized Grid Under Commutation Failure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The non-synchronized grid refers to a 100% renewable energy power system without synchronous generators. The wind turbines connected to the non-synchronized grid adopt virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control strategy to provide virtual inertia of power system. Commutation failure is a typical failure of the non-synchronized grid to send renewable energy through the ultra-high voltage (UHV) dc transmission system. The commutation failure can cause severe overvoltage on the non-synchronized sending terminal AC grid. The transient current characteristics of wind turbines adopting VSG control under commutation failure are analyzed. An improved VSG control strategy is proposed to suppress the overvoltage of the sending terminal grid under commutation failure. The effectiveness of the improved VSG control strategy is verified by a simulation model of wind turbines connected to an UHV dc transmission system based on Matlab/Simulink. In addition, the simulation model also verifies that the proposed strategy can reduce the overcurrent of the wind turbine under commutation failure.

articleTitle: A Novel Heteropolar Hybrid-Magnetic-Circuit Memory Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to address the main issues of the existing hybrid-magnetic-circuit variable-flux memory machines (HMC-VFMMs) in terms of crowded rotor space, excessive PM usage, and limited flux adjustment range, a heteropolar HMC-VFMM (HHMC-VFMM) with series and parallel magnetic circuits separately arranged within adjacent magnetic poles is proposed in this paper. With the novel rotor design, the merits of enlarged design space, improved torque performance, beneficial load MS stabilizing capability and wide control range of MS can be obtained simultaneously. Firstly, the variable flux principle of traditional parallel and series VFMM is introduced, and on this basis, the performance trade-off of the hybrid VFMM based on a simplified hysteresis model is pointed out. Furthermore, the critical design points and main advantages of the proposed HHMC-VFMM are analyzed. Then, the design parameters of HHMC-VFMM are globally optimized. Finally, the electromagnetic characteristics of the novel HHMC-VFMM and its single magnetic circuit counterparts are investigated and compared to clarify the advantage of the HHMC design.

articleTitle: Point potential modulation strategy for three-level PWM rectifiers in unbalanced grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In practical application, the phenomenon of power grid imbalance is becoming more and more common, which makes PWM rectifier have abnormal working conditions of low power factor and low harmonic content.In order to solve the problem of mid-point potential fluctuation of three-level PWM rectifier under unbalanced grid, this paper uses the elimination of negative sequence components to give control to find out the desired power and desired current of the rectifier under unbalanced grid, and uses repetitive control to achieve the static-free tracking of the desired current, the harmonic content of current at the grid side is reduced,and proposes the improved VSVPWM modulation strategy, reconstructs the virtual small vector and virtual mid-vector, realizes the active control of mid-point potential by introducing the duty cycle coefficient, and verifies the correctness and stability of the improved VSVPWM by experiment.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Feedforward Current Compensation Strategy for Permanent Magnet Linear Synchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The maglev train is a large inertia system. In order to improve the dynamic response of the train speed, it is usually necessary to add feedforward compensation with a mass term to the speed loop. However, the mass of maglev trains changes as passengers get on and off. In this paper, a fuzzy control strategy is proposed to estimate the mass of the maglev train, which avoids the problem that the mass of the feedforward compensation differs greatly from the actual mass of the train, resulting in poor train speed control. This control strategy can reduce the cost of installing weight-measuring sensors. The effectiveness of the strategy proposed in this paper is proved by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Simulation of indoor temperature and humidity control in intelligent greenhouse
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper takes the greenhouse exhibition hall as the research object to establish the corresponding physical model and heat transfer model, and carries on the working condition analysis and the load calculation. The indoor temperature and humidity control under different working conditions is simulated and optimized. Through simulation, two different control schemes are proposed to adjust the shortcomings of the original scheme.

articleTitle: Experimental analysis of internal damp of gapless zinc oxide arrester
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, through the built damp platform inside the arrester, the experimental simulation method of damp defects inside the gapless zinc oxide arrester is designed, and the damp degree is divided according to the damp degree. Before and after simulating internal moisture, the DC reference voltage, leakage current under 0.75U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1mA</inf>, V-I curve, resistive current and other electrical quantities of dry arrester, slight internal moisture, general internal moisture and severe internal moisture are tested and analyzed by using DC electrical quantity test platform and AC electrical quantity test platform. In this paper, it is found that the fault characteristic quantities such as DC electrical quantity and AC electrical quantity change obviously, and the variation law of electrical quantity when the lightning arrester is damp is summarized.

articleTitle: Electrical Topology and Control of Four-wheel Hub Motor Pure Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Full-electric powertrains with four-wheel-drive offer great potential for vehicle performance and environmental protection. In this paper, a novel electrical topology of the electric vehicle driven by the four-wheel hub motor is proposed to realize the control concerning the energy supply and feedback. The novel topology consists of four Voltage Source Converters (VSC) connected with Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSM) in the AC sides and a common isolated Dual Active Bridge (DAB) converter in the DC sides. The voltage of the power battery is boosted by DAB converters, then the four PMSMs are driven by independent VSCs in driving mode, and the electric energy would be fed back to the power battery by the DAB in feedback mode. The isolated DAB converter would be used to keep the DC bus stable. The voltage stability of the DC bus is beneficial to control the motor and improve the power output capability. The mathematical modeling has been derived using the state vector method and small signal method for the proposed system topology. The simulations results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the system.

articleTitle: Passivity-Based Harmonic Suppression Method of LCL-Type Inverter Output Current in Weak Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development and popularization of renewable energy distributed generation systems such as photovoltaic and wind power, grid-connected inverters need to keep working stably and efficiently in weak grid. In this paper, a three-phase LCL-filtered inverter-current feedback grid-connected inverter is studied. Capacitor voltage feedforward and phase compensation resonant controllers are used for harmonic suppression. The output impedance of the inverter is reconstructed based on passivity-based theory. Finally, the grid-connected inverter can keep stable in a wide short circuit ratio range and get excellent harmonic suppression ability of output current in the meantime.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Sag Amplitude Propagation Model and Lateral Propagation Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and rapidity of voltage sag location and traceability in China’s domestic distribution network, a propagation model and analysis method of the voltage sag amplitude under the same voltage level is proposed. Firstly, a horizontal propagation model of the voltage sag amplitude of the distribution network is established. Taking the size of the fault resistance and the electrical distance from the fault point to the monitoring point as the key fault parameters, the fault resistance and fault distance characterization forms of the voltage and line current at each monitoring point are proposed. Secondly, the propagation characteristics of voltage and the current with the fault resistance and fault distance are analyzed; Finally, the simulation verified the validity of the voltage sag propagation model and the correctness of the propagation characteristics.

articleTitle: Variation of Surface roughness and Corona Characteristics of Transmission Lines in Shandong Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aging conductors used in high voltage transmission lines in Shandong province of China were carefully selected and sampled. The Effect of the pollution area and service year on surface conditions and corona discharge was analyzed. Experiment results show that general environment had a significant effect on the surface conditions. The surface roughness increased as the pollution grade increased, and the same was with service years. At the same pollution grade, corona discharge of the longer operated lines is more serious, and the law was the same with the service year.

articleTitle: Effects of armature material and armature-coil distance on the performance of electromagnetic reconnection launcher
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The armature of the electromagnetic reconnection launcher (EMRCL) is a critical factor in accelerating large-mass loads, which can convert electromagnetic energy into kinetic energy. In order to design high-efficiency armatures that launch large-mass payloads, the effects of armature material, armature, and coil distance on EMRCL performance are analyzed. A three-stage EMRCL platform is built to verify the accuracy of the simulation results. Simulation and experimental results show that the efficiency improvement of copper material is more significant as the payload mass increases. Simulation results show that when the coil is not in contact with the armature, the smaller the distance, the higher the efficiency. The experimental results are in good agreement with the simulation results, which provide a valuable reference for the design of the EMRCL large-mass payload armature.

articleTitle: Reasearch on fine-Evaluation Model of Substation Primary Equipment Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the electric power system, there are many types of condition monitoring of electric power equipment and many advanced monitoring methods. Electric power companies implement condition overhaul of electric power equipment, which in turn avoids the drawbacks of traditional overhaul methods and achieves the purpose of extending the service life of electric power equipment. For all kinds of electric power equipment, after launching condition overhaul, the corresponding data can be collected in real time, and the amount of device status of various automatic monitoring and surveillance devices can be recorded, so as to judge whether the devices are in a healthy state, thus changing the traditional. The blindness of regular maintenance reduces the number of equipment maintenance without fault disconnection, and greatly improves the availability of power equipment. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved substation primary equipment condition fine evaluation model system based on the practice and historical data of the State Grid Henan Province Company in recent years, and the practice results show that the application of this model method has a greater role in promoting the company’s lean operation and maintenance level.

articleTitle: Single Line-to-Ground Fault Section Location Method Based on the Phase Angle Difference of Measurement Admittances
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the active arc suppression device is applied in the distribution network, the fault characteristics are changed, so the existing single line-to-ground fault line selection methods may misjudge. A novel method based on the phase angle of three phase measurement admittances is proposed, which can directly locate the fault section to narrow the fault determination range. The proposed method is applicable to both the neutral ineffectively grounded systems and the distribution network with application of the active arc suppression device. The judgment result of the method is not affected by the transition resistance and the asymmetry of three phase parameters. Simulations in MATLAB/Simulink verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of the temperature reference range for the verification of smart energy meter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A structured model of smart energy meter is firstly established in this paper, and the main factor that leads to smart energy meter errors is analyzed, that is the gradual change of reference voltage of AD converter with temperature. Then, the mathematical models of CMOS bandgap reference and AD converter affected by temperature are given. And by using the correlation analysis, the influence and relationship between the reference voltage of smart energy meter and temperature is investigated. The relationship curve between the error change of smart energy meter and the temperature change with time is given through experiments. Finally, according to the accuracy level of the tested smart energy meter, the suggestions on reference temperature conditions of smart energy meters is proposed.

articleTitle: Effect of functional group introduction on the trap energy level distribution of SiR
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The interfacial charge of silicone rubber (SiR) has been an issue of widespread interest. In the case of industrial production, the introduction of chemical functional groups intensifies the charge accumulation, so it is significant to study the effect of the introduction of different functional groups on the internal trap depth of SiR. In this paper, the energy bands and surface electrostatic potentials of SiR small molecules containing double bonds at both ends and side chains attached to a benzene ring were calculated separately using density functional theory(DFT). On this basis, the causes of the formation of such traps and their possible sites are determined, and the trap depths formed by both are analyzed. The results indicate that the chemical defects are caused by these small molecular groups, and at the same time, these small molecular groups introduce more localized states, dominated by electronic traps. This suggests that these small molecular groups may be responsible for exacerbating the space charge accumulation.

articleTitle: A Cooperative Scheduling Strategy of Renewable Energy and Electric Vehicle Considering Reactive Power Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the reform of energy structure, renewable energy systems (RESs) and electric vehicles (EVs) have been rapidly developed worldwide. However, the fluctuation output of RESs and the randomness charging behavior of EVs bring tremendous pressure to the safe and stable operation of the distribution network. With the expansion of the scale of EVs, the impact of disorderly charging on the peak-valley load difference of the system is becoming more significant. In order to avoid this situation, a cooperative scheduling scheme of EVs and RESs based on the vehicle-to-grid (V2G) concept is proposed. By implementing the time-of-use price tariff according to the equivalent load in the EV charging station, the EV owners are encouraged to carry out staggered charge/discharge, and the dispatching center uniformly formulates the charge/discharging plan. Then, the cooperative scheduling scheme of EVs and RESs is introduced in detail, and a two-level model is established for optimization. The goal of the upper model is the charge/discharge power of EVs at each period, which is solved by quadratic programming. The lower model considers the reactive power response of EV and RES plants, which is solved by second-order cone programming. Finally, the simulation is carried out with the improved IEEE-33 node system. The results show that the proposed scheduling strategy can effectively reduce the active power loss and improve the system voltage quality.

articleTitle: Optimal Arrangement of the Acoustic Monitoring Measurement Points for Transformer Winding Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The generation and propagation of transformer vibration energy are briefly analyzed in this paper. Through finite element simulation, the sound signal at different monitoring points has been described by using structural sound intensity method. Besides, the influence of the fuel tank wall structure and the transmission medium on the energy distribution has been analyzed. Meanwhile, the frequency characteristics of the structural sound intensity at different positions have been compared. On the basis of this, the points with reduced vibration transmission attenuation or strong fundamental frequency component acquisition ability can be selected effectively to optimize the position of the transformer sound signal monitoring measurement point, which can be proved with the test data. The calculation results show that it’s better to place the sensors on the front of the tank near the lower part of the winding, rather than irregular structures such as stiffeners and weld joints.

articleTitle: Temporary Frequency Response of a Doubly-Fed Induction Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the large-scale wind power integrations in a power gird, the system frequency stability was seriously decreased when the wind power generators operate in maximal output power tracking mode.
