This study suggests a temporary frequency response (TFR) scheme to enhance the frequency response capability of the doubly-fed induction generators (DFIGs) by designing a frequency deviation-dependent control coefficient. With the proposed TFR strategy, DFIGs can adaptively adjust the kinetic energy injected into the grid based on the frequency deviation so as to provide suitable frequency support after detecting a frequency event. Based on EMTP-RV (electromagnetic transients’ program) software, a four-machine two-area system model is established to verify the effectiveness of the proposed TFR scheme. Results clearly indicate that DFIGs with the suggested TFR scheme provide better performance in alleviating the maximum frequency deviation under various wind power penetrations.

articleTitle: Hybrid Modeling Method for Thermal Analysis of Hairpin Winding Permanent Magnet Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a hybrid thermal model is developed for thermal analysis of a hairpin winding permanent magnet machine. The proposed model combines two dimensional finite element model with lumped parameter network model, which possesses the advantages of both accuracy and computational effectiveness. Compared with three dimensional transient field finite element analysis, the proposed model possesses fast calculation speed. On the other hand, compared with traditional lumped parameter network model, the proposed model gives more insight results of permanent magnet machine. In addition, iterative coupled electromagnetic and thermal analysis is also investigated to realize multi-physics analysis of permanent magnet machine. In order to validate the effectiveness of the proposed model, simulation results comparison between commercial software and the proposed model is carried out, and good agreement is achieved.

articleTitle: A Novel Stochastic Optimal Scheduling Strategy for Wind-Solar-Pumped Storage Power System Considering Scenario Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy sources, the inherent fluctuation and variability pose great challenges to the stability of power system. Pumped storage has raised widespread concerns due to its appealing ability to compensate power fluctuations flexibly and efficiently. To facilitate the operation of wind-solar-pumped storage power system effectively, this paper proposes a stochastic optimal scheduling strategy. Firstly, serval scenarios are generated via Monte Carlo simulation, and typical reduced scenarios are extracted by K-means method. Then, A mixed-integer linear program is formulated to maximize the net profits of combined system while satisfying the relative constraints. Finally, Numerical results are presented to validate the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Potential Assessment Method of Integrated Demand Response and Its Utilization in Park Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Integrated energy system (IES) has the characteristic of multi-energy complementarity, which increases the ability of integrated demand response (IDR). In this paper, IDR potential is divided into three parts, cuttable load, transferable load and substitutable load. IDR potential assessment index system is established to obtain the theoretical IDR potential of the park. To verify the accuracy of theoretical calculations and the economic benefits that IDR can bring, the operation model of the industrial IES at park level is established. The lowest operating cost is the goal, power balance constraints and equipment operation constraints are considered. According to the result, the park saves operating cost, which ensures its willing to participate in IDR. Comparing theoretical IDR potential with the simulated potential from optimal operation, the difference is very small. The results demonstrate that the IDR potential assessment method proposed in this paper is reasonable.

articleTitle: Equivalent Ratio of Primary Frequency Regulation Resources Considering Multi-aspects of Frequency Profile
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Traditional frequency regulation is mainly undertaken by thermal power and hydropower units. With the increasing kinds of the frequency regulation resources are becoming available for the power systems, the performance of different frequency regulation resources varies greatly. It is necessary to consider the performance of different frequency regulation resources in the operation of the power system and the power market. Based on the performance of different frequency regulation resources in primary frequency response, this paper presents a method to calculate equivalent ratio of primary frequency regulation resources considering multi-aspects of frequency profile. Firstly, considering the profile of primary frequency response, frequency profile characteristics considering multi-aspects of frequency profile is analyzed. Then, in order to explore the performance characteristics of different frequency regulation resources, a method for calculation the equivalent ratio of primary frequency regulation resources considering multi-aspects of frequency profile is proposed. Finally, the effects of various parameters on the calculation of equivalent ratio are studied through simulation.

articleTitle: Dual Coupled-inductors based Bidirectional DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: DC-DC converter with high gain and low input current ripples is an essential requirement of DC power system such as photovoltaic and energy storage systems. This paper proposed a dual coupled-inductor based bidirectional two stage DC-DC converter. The main structure of converter adopts input parallel output serial (IPOS), which can not only reduce input current ripple, but also increase voltage gain. Introduction of double coupled-inductor and voltage multiplying unit can further increase the voltage gain, and decrease power switch voltage stress as well as widen suitable applications of power switches. During step-down mode, the power switches are fully controlled, which can obtain greater step-down voltage ratio to avoid extreme duty cycle. The simulation results prove the correctness and feasibility of the proposed topology.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Stochastic Dispatch for Combined Heat and Power System Considering Flexible Carbon Capture Device under Source and Network Coordination
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Combined heat and power system plays important role in urban power supply and heating supply. However, “the heat-led” operation mode of combined heat and power units will cause difficulties in renewable energy accommodation and peak regulation, and a large amount of carbon dioxide will be emitted during operation. In order to reduce carbon dioxide emission, a carbon capture device (CCD) is introduced. Compared with crude CCD, flexible CCD can provide more operation flexible by means of setting flue gas bypass and solvent storage tanks. The flexible CCD can realize “peak load shifting” while reducing carbon dioxide emissions. Firstly, the mathematical formulation of a power plant with flexible CCD is studied. Secondly, a two-stage stochastic dispatch model for combined heat and power systems considering flexible CCD is proposed to handle the uncertainty of the wind power output. Finally, numerical results performed on the IEEE 24-bus system demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model on the reduction of carbon emissions and the promotion of wind power accommodation.

articleTitle: Robust Optimal Dispatch for Virtual Power Plant Considering Green Certificate Trading
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The high investment cost, operation and maintenance cost as well as the low consumption have posed a difficult dilemma for the development of renewable energy in China. In this study, the renewable energy certificate (hereinafter referred to as green certificate) trading system is introduced into the existing virtual power plant (VPP) transaction and management against the backdrop of renewable power quota system. The optimal dispatch model considering green certificate trading is established which deals with the uncertain factors facing virtual power plants including electricity price and green certificate price with the stochastic robust optimization method, reducing the risks. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model and method is verified by the simulation example.

articleTitle: Torque Estimation Base on Quasi-Direct Drive Actuators
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Quasi-Direct Drive Actuators are built by combining such high torque density Permanent magnet synchronous motor with a low gear ratio planetary reducer. It has high open loop force controller bandwidth, high force transparency, highly backdrivability, and is widely used in robots. The output torque of Quasi-Direct Drive Actuators is generally estimated by motor’s stator current, but there are errors in the estimated actuator output torque due to the friction and inertia of the planetary gears. To solve this problem, an optimization method of torque estimation using stator current was proposed in this paper. By establishing a mathematical model of planetary reducer in the actuator, the reflection inertia of planetary reducer was calculated quantitatively, and the torque constant and offset of actuator were obtained through the repeated experiments. The relationship between the stator current and the output torque can be obtained by compensating the offset and inertia value to the model. The experimental results indicate that the error between the optimized output torque and the actual torque measured by the sensor is small, and the estimation accuracy is high.

articleTitle: Rotor Position Estimation of Three-stage Synchronous Machine Based on Quadrature Signal
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a rotor position estimation method of sensorless starting control for aviation three-stage synchronous machine (TSSM) is proposed. The 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> harmonic voltage caused by the rotating rectifier is employed as the high-frequency (HF) signal injected into the field winding of the main generator (MG). Based on quadrature signals obtained by delaying the HF response voltage signals extracted from the armature windings of MG, a simplified rotor position demodulation strategy without the low-pass filter (LPF) is presented. The rotor position estimation error caused by the filters and signal delay modules is also analyzed, and the corresponding compensation strategy is given. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the experiment results.

articleTitle: Deep Search Based Carbon Footprint Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It is important to grasp the carbon footprint of power grid and grasp the carbon emission trend of power grid for the regulation of power grid. This paper firstly constructs a power supply carbon emission model to analyze the carbon emission of power supply under different operating conditions. Then, we propose a depth search-based carbon footprint tracking algorithm to build a real-world carbon footprint map of a certain area, which can dynamically track and display the distribution of carbon flows in a certain area, the direction of carbon flows of different power sources and carbon emissions of different regions, so as to facilitate dispatchers to grasp the carbon emission situation of the power grid and provide auxiliary support for power grid regulation and control.

articleTitle: Thermal Conductivity and Dielectric Properties of Epoxy Composites Co-doped with BN with Different Morphology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electronic devices are developing towards high voltage, high power, miniaturization and integration. As an insulating packaging material—epoxy resin, higher requirements are put forward for its thermal conductivity and dielectric properties. In this paper, BN with excellent insulation performance and thermal conductivity is selected as the inorganic filler, and the effects of nano-hexagonal BN (h-BN) single doping and nano-hexagonal BN co-doping with micron-BN whisker (w-BN) on EP performance are comparatively studied. It is found that the dielectric constant of the high content h-BN/w-BN/EP composites is higher than h-BN/EP composites. The dielectric loss of h-BN/EP is lower than EP at $10^{0}-10^{6}$ Hz. The dielectric loss of h-BN/w-BN/EP is higher than that of pure EP at $10^{0}-10^{3}$ Hz, and lower than pure EP at $10^{3}-10^{6}$ Hz. The addition of h-BN and h-BN/w-BN will reduce the breakdown field strength of the composites. With the content of h-BN increases, the breakdown field strength of h-BN/EP decreases first and then increases. The breakdown field strength of h-BN/w-BN/EP composites decreases gradually with the content increasing, and the breakdown field strength of pure EP is 198.5 kV/mm, while the breakdown field strength of 30 wt.% h-BN/w-BN/EP composites is 89.43 kV/mm, which is 45.05 % of the pure EP. The introduction of h-BN, h-BN/w-BN can increase the glass transition temperature of epoxy resin. The h-BN and h-BN/w-BN can effectively increase the thermal conductivity of EP, and h-BN/w-BN enhance more obviously. The 30 wt.% h-BN/w-BN/EP composites have a thermal conductivity of 0.351 W/(m·K), which is 206 % of pure EP.

articleTitle: Virtual DC Machine Control Strategy for Stability Improvement in DC Microgrid with Constant Power Loads
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With a large number of constant power loads connecting to DC microgrid, the negative damping characteristics of constant power loads reduces the stability of DC microgrid. In order to improve the system stability, a voltage stability control strategy based on virtual DC machine (VDCM) is proposed in this paper. This paper focused on the bidirectional DC/DC converter with droop control strategy. By introducing the VDCM link into the feedback branch of double closed-loop droop control strategy, the VDCM control strategy improves the system stability without affecting the performance of voltage loop and current loop. Then, the small signal model of the system is established to analyze the system stability by using the Middlebrook criterion. The analysis results show that the VDCM control strategy can effectively increase the system damping and improve the system stability. Finally, a simulation model is built by PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: A Type of Electric Spring Topology Based on A Kind of Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electric spring (ES) is mainly used to stabilize the voltage of the critical load (CL) under the condition of power fluctuation in the grid. Through the bidirectional flow of energy, the DC side energy storage system of ES can flexibly compensate active and reactive power in the distribution network. However, the DC side has a large volume and lacks systematic energy monitoring and management due to the high voltage level. In this paper, an ES topology based on modular multilevel converters (MMC) is proposed to simplify the storage side structure, and a digital energy management strategy based on the proposed topology is proposed. The effectiveness of the proposed topology is verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Balance analysis model of provincial power system considering co-generation flexibility improvement
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: EnergyPLAN is a balance analysis model widely used for integrated energy systems of national/provincial scale. Actually, its assessment results deviate from the actual situation when analyzing electro-thermal coupling energy system in northern China with large coal-fired CHP plants as the main source. The reason is that the unit commitment constraint is not considered in EnergyPLAN and it is not reasonable to characterize the stability constraint by “minimum grid stabilisation share”. In this regard, this paper improves the EnergyPLAN model and constructs a balance analysis model for power systems of the provincial scale. The proposed model is more suitable to energy system dominated by large-scale coal-fired units. This model takes into account the unit commitment constraint by adding the thermal unit dynamic aggregation module and the start-up capacity decision module of coal-fired units with a daily cycle. The “minimum grid stabilisation share” of coal-fired unit is replaced by the thermal power minimum operating output constraint to characterize the stability issue more reasonably. Case studies compare the two methods based on actual power grid data. The proposed model is verified to be more suitable for integrated power and heating systems dominated by large-scale coal-fired CHP plants in northern China.

articleTitle: Analysis of Transformer Oil Paper Insulation Discharge Signal Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the key equipment of UHV transmission system, transformer insulation status plays an important role in the stable operation of transmission system. Oilpaper insulation is the main form of internal insulation of oil-immersed transformer, and its aging degree is of vital importance to the insulation performance of transformer. Partial discharge (PD) is the precursor of insulation aging, so the research on PD signal denoising and its characteristics has become a significant topic. To solve this problem, we set up an experimental platform of oilpaper insulation partial discharge under AC voltage. Taking the most typical pin-plate model as the example, it is used to simulate the situation of extremely uneven electric field, and the constant AC voltage is applied, and the experimental data are collected by pulse current method. Then, based on wavelet packet denoising algorithm, the measured partial discharge signal is denoised. Finally, the spectral characteristics of the pinplate model under AC voltage were analyzed according to the experimental data. The characteristics of local release were clearly understood and the experimental results were summarized accordingly.

articleTitle: An Instantaneous Torque Model and the Practical Caculation Method for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces an instantaneous torque model for permanent magnet synchronous machines(PMSMs). Compared to the previous studies, we denotes the torque directly with the flux linkages and currents to fully consider the magnetic saturation based on the actual ABC windings. An approximation calculation method is adopted to resolve the torque model. Then an in-wheel motor is established in the finite element method software to compare our original torque model with the previous study. The simulation results presented demonstrate not only the accuracy of the instantaneous torque model but the feasibility of our calculation method as well.

articleTitle: Electrical Tree Performance of Epoxy Resin Used in Power Electronic Transformer under Bipolar Square Wave Voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The electrical tree characteristics of epoxy resin used in power electronic transformer under bipolar square wave voltage are investigated. The results show that the number of electrical tree branches increases with voltage amplitude while decreases with voltage frequency. The increase of voltage amplitude and frequency accelerates the growth of electrical tree and reduces the withstanding time of the epoxy resin exposed to electrical tree. In addition, it is found that electric breakdown lead to great release of CO, CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and hydrocarbon gases in epoxy resin.

articleTitle: Improved Comprehensive Inertial Control for ESS Participating Primary Frequency Regulation Based on Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: ESS (energy storage system) has many advantages such as flexible control, large throughput capacity and fast response speed and can provide strong support for system frequency stability with larger-scale renewable energy. In order to enhance the frequency regulation effect of ESS, this paper proposes an improved comprehensive inertia control strategy based on FC (fuzzy control). The conventional droop control is replaced by fuzzy control to improve the regulation performance and adaptivity of the whole process. SOC (state of charge) is adopted as the input of FC to consider the secure and stable constraints of ESS. In addition, FC is also applied to adjust the virtual inertia coefficients online. The proposed strategy combines the advantages of comprehensive inertial control and adaptive control and improve the frequency supporting ability of ESS under different operation conditions. Finally, simulations are conducted to demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research and Optimization of blocking schemes of Backup Power Switch-in equipment Using Bus-bar Differential Protection in 110kV Substations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The blocking schemes of backup power switch-in equipment using bus-bar differential protection under the enterprise standard Q/GDW10767 are likely to cause whole substation blackouts. In order to solve this problem, two configurations and setting schemes of 110kV power line protection were compared, and two blocking schemes of backup power switch-in equipment using bus-bar differential protection are analyzed in this paper, and the optimal solution is obtained by a combination of both. According to the analysis, the approach of equipping 110kV power supply lines with optical fiber current differential protection, and setting the protection range of power line protection (inter-phase distance protection I and grounding distance protection I) to cover 70%~80% of the whole power line is the most favourable solution. In addition, the method of tripping section breaker before tripping all the breakers in the faulty bus and only blocking the related breakers instead of all the 110kV breakers of backup power switch-in equipment is the most satisfying blocking scheme.

Author Keywords: Blocking schemes of backup power switch-in equipment
configurations and setting of relay protection

articleTitle: Fault Waveform Construction Method for Detecting the Intelligent Switch based on GAN and CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The data source for detecting the Intelligent Switches is limited, and the data con not reflect actual fault condition, this paper proposes a fault waveform construction method for detecting the intelligent switch. By extracting the features in time and frequency domain of the fault waveform, a multi-dimensional fault feature matrix is constructed, and the fault waveform construction model is obtained through convolutional neural network(CNN) and generative adversarial network(GAN) training. In the model, the GAN model is used to construct fault waveform and the constructed waveforms are classified to various fault conditions by CNN network. Accurate fault waveform can be generated through the model. Finally, the constructed waveform is tested through experiments.

articleTitle: Bi-level Planning Method for Internet Data Center and Distribution Network Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a bi-level optimal planning framework for Internet data centers (IDCs) and the distribution network considering demand response (DR). Firstly, according to the characteristics of IDC, the energy consumption characteristic model of IDC is established, and the demand response model is established from the perspective of three types of data loads: time-transferable load, reducible load and rigid load. On this basis, the information transmission and interactive response relationship between IDC and distribution network are analyzed, and a bi-level optimization planning model is established, in which distribution network operators (DNO) is the upper leaders to determine the node price to maximize its interests, and data center operator (DCO) is the lower follower to determine the location and capacity configuration to minimize its costs. The rationality and validity of the model are proved by the results of numerical examples.

articleTitle: Data Driven Assessment Algorithm of Wind Farm AGC System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, wind farms connected to the grid are required to have automatic generation control (AGC) regulation capability. Assessment of wind farm AGC system is of great significance for the economic distribution and maintenance of the station. In this paper, a data driven assessment algorithm for evaluating the regulation ability of wind farm AGC system is proposed. Firstly, the principle of wind farm participating in AGC regulation is introduced. Secondly, a data cleaning method based on sliding window standard deviation is used to improve the field data quality. Then, identification framework for judging wind farm AGC working conditions and assessment algorithm under various AGC working conditions based on linear fitting and least square are established. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by analyzing the historical AGC system operation data of an actual wind farm in China. And the assessment algorithm can evaluate AGC tracking performance of wind farm in real time effectively.

articleTitle: Integrated Generation and Transmission Planning with Carbon Emission Trading
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to achieve the carbon emission goal in 2030 and 2060, the research of low-carbon factors covers many fields including science and technology, transportation, ecology and politics. Because of the use of coal-fired power plants, the power system produces a lot of carbon emissions. This paper researches an integrated low carbon generation and transmission planning with multi-scenarios considering carbon emission trading. In order to deal with the uncertainties of renewable energy and load, K-means clustering based on historical data is used in the model to generate scenarios. Using the IEEE-24 system to test the model, it tends to construct wind and hydropower units with zero emission and gas units with low emission in result.

articleTitle: Dynamic Access Control Architecture of Distribution Master Station Based on Extended Trust Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Considering the hidden danger of illegal access to distribution master station with current digital certificates and traditional access control measures, a dynamic access control architecture is formed by combining identity management with continuous trust evaluation. Based on the concept of “zero trust”, fine-granularity resources accessing from terminals and users authorized by the distribution master station are achieved.

articleTitle: Fabrication and performance analysis of TiN/W superlattice electrodes for low-power phase change memory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High thermal conductivity of electrode materials in Phase Change Memory (PCM) is one of the reasons for the power consumption during the reset process. How to effectively reduce the thermal conductivity of electrode materials is of great significance to the development of low-power PCM. In order to obtain metal electrodes with low thermal conductivity, superlattice structures were fabricated on silicon substrate by magnetron sputtering based on two common electrode materials of PCM, Titanium Nitride (TiN) and Tungsten (W). The period of TiN/W superlattice is 6, and the thickness of single-layer is designed to be 10nm and 5nm respectively. The cross section SEM images of the two samples indicates that the interface between layers is clear and the total thickness of the two samples is 123nm and 64nm respectively. Thermal conductivity is characterized as 1.682W/$\mathrm{m}\cdot\mathrm{K}$ and 0.721W/$\mathrm{m}\cdot\mathrm{K}$ respectively by 30) method, which is much lower than the bulk thermal conductivity of TiN and W. In addition, the thermal field distribution of Reset process of PCM was simulated. The results show that the fabricated superlattice electrode can confine the heat inside the PCM better and resulting in a 13% reduction in the voltage required for the Reset process compared with the traditional electrode with single-layer W. In summary, TiN/W superlattice electrodes with low thermal conductivity were successfully fabricated by magnetron sputtering, which is profit to reduce the power consumption for PCM.

articleTitle: Adaptive Torque Sharing Function Control Strategy of Switched Reluctance Motor Based On Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive torque sharing function (TSF) control strategy of switched reluctance motor(SRM) based on neural network is proposed, which has the advantage of using BP neural network to automatically adjust the overlap angle online according to different speeds. This paper introduces the driving system and mathematical model of SRM, expounds the conventional TSF control strategy and its disadvantages caused by fixed overlap angle, and explains the reason why this disadvantage causes large torque ripple. According to this shortcoming, an adaptive TSF control strategy is proposed. This adaptive control strategy uses back propagation (BP) neural network to establish the nonlinear relationship between the speed and the overlap angle, and automatically adjusts the overlap angle according to the speed. Compared with the conventional control method, this control strategy significantly reduces the torque ripple.

articleTitle: Anti-icing performance and mechanism of hydrophobic cycloaliphatic epoxy resin modified by polysiloxane
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Composite insulator is the key insulation equipment of outdoor transmission line. Hydrophobic cycloaliphatic epoxy resin is a new type of insulation material used in insulators. Ice accretion on insulators is a common phenomenon in alpine regions, which seriously threatens the safety of power grid. However, the anti-icing performance of hydrophobic cycloaliphatic epoxy resin has not been studied. In this work, the effect of polysiloxane content on the hydrophobicity and roughness of cycloaliphatic epoxy resin was studied. Then, the icing drop test and icing shear strength test were designed to analyze the effect of polysiloxane content on the anti-icing performance of cycloaliphatic epoxy resin. The results show that polysiloxane can significantly improve the static contact angle of cycloaliphatic epoxy resin. With the increase of polysiloxane content, the static contact angle increases. Polysiloxane has little effect on the surface roughness of cycloaliphatic epoxy resin, which shows that the change of static contact angle of cycloaliphatic epoxy resin is mainly affected by surface tension. Polysiloxane content is the dominant factor causing the change of surface tension. Polysiloxane modified cycloaliphatic epoxy resin can shorten the icing drop time, reduce the icing shear strength and improve the anti-icing performance. The anti-icing mechanism of polysiloxane modified cycloaliphatic epoxy resin can be described by icing shear strength of water freeze in Cassie state model. The static contact angle is the main reason affecting the icing performance of polysiloxane modified cycloaliphatic epoxy resin.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling method of wind power-photovoltaic-photothermal integrated energy system with flexibility in mind
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the influence of randomness and fluctuation of high permeability wind power and photovoltaic output on power grid dispatching, a flexible optimization scheduling method of wind power - photovoltaic - photothermal integrated energy system was proposed.The regulation of the solar thermal power station with heat storage can be used to optimize the scheduling jointly with wind power and photovoltaic to reduce the wind and light abandonment of the system and improve the economy of the system. Consider integrated energy system flexibility requirements, the establishment of grid-connected wind power - photovoltaic solar-thermal joint optimization scheduling two-layer model, In the lower decision-making model, the flexibility index is introduced to represent the flexibility of the system, and the upper model is modified by judging the probability of insufficient flexibility of the system.Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Power Loss-Oriented Transmission Network Expansion Planning Considering Pyramidal Approximation Power Flow and N-1 Contingency
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the promotion of transmission price policy, power loss has drawn increasing attention in the planning and operation of the power system. This paper proposes the power loss-oriented transmission network expansion planning (TNEP) considering pyramidal approximation (PA) power flow and N-l contingency. The objective of the proposed method is selected as the sum of the power loss cost and the line construction cost. The pyramid approximation is used to linearize the branch flow model for tractable calculation of the power loss. N-l contingencies are considered to guarantee the security of the planning results. Case studies in the Garver 6-bus test system validate the economic improvement and operational security under the proposed method.

articleTitle: Losses Calculation in distribution networks considering the influence of power quality
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Considering the effects of harmonics, three-phase unbalance and voltage deviations in the actual low-voltage distribution network makes it difficult to ignore the additional losses in the distribution network, it is therefore important to calculate the additional losses caused by power quality problems in the distribution network and to analyse the impact of network losses caused by different power quality problems for the economic operation of the network. In this paper, the additional losses caused on the lines and transformers are theoretically derived and a practical engineering calculation model is established for the distribution network. Then, through the Matlab/Simulink simulation platform, the loss calculation and analysis are carried out for the distribution network system of IEEE33 nodes. The results show that three-phase unbalance generates more additional losses on the line than on the transformer, while harmonics and voltage deviations cause more additional losses on the transformer.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Method of Reducing the Induced Voltage and Current of Ground Wire
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In China, the transmission lines with rated voltage of 500 kV and above generally have double ground wires. Among them, the CGW is generally insulated with one point grounded, and the OPGW is often grounded at each tower. However, with OPGW grounded at each tower, it is prone to lightning strike and loss increase. Therefore, it is necessary to study the induced voltage and current of overhead ground wire in different grounding modes. In this paper, simulation is carried out for a voltage transmission line. The results show that the amplitude of induced voltage of OPGW is proportional to the segment length when the OPGW is insulated with one point grounded. When the transmission line is in-phase sequence, the amplitude of induced voltage of OPGW and CGW is highest. When the transmission line is in inverse order, the amplitude of induced voltage of OPGW and CGW is lowest. Furthermore, the induced voltage can be further reduced by the transposition of the ground wire.

articleTitle: A WPT Study of Mixed Resonance Stabilized Output Power
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the output current and power are easily changed due to coil misalignment, a hybrid topology combining a series (SS) network with LCL-LCL network is proposed to transmit power in wireless power transmission system. The proposed hybrid topology has two groups of power transmission loops, which are used to transmit the fundamental and third harmonic power respectively. Comparing with only transmitting the fundamental power system, the proposed hybrid WPT system can improve the output power. And due to the compensation characteristics of the hybrid topology, the current and power fluctuations can be effectively reduced at a certain misalignment range. In order to verify the correctness of the theory, an experimental prototype is built with an output current of 2A and an output power of 400 watts. The experimental results show that the coupling coefficient varies from 0.53 to 0.63, the output current and power remain basically unchanged, whose fluctuation peak is 10% and 15%, respectively

articleTitle: Adaptive restart strategy of flexible DC grid suitable for double-terminal MMC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the frequent occurrence of transient faults on overhead lines, the use of DC reclosing strategy can effectively improve its power supply reliability. However, when the DC grid coincides with a permanent fault, it will cause a secondary impact problem, endangering system operation and equipment safety. An adaptive restart strategy of flexible DC grid suitable for double-terminal MMC is proposed. This paper first researches the transient characteristics of pole to pole fault, then introduces the active control strategy after the fault and proposes a current reference signal with adaptive restart capability. Finally, the simulation model of typical double-terminal DC network is built in PSCAD/EMTDC. The simulation results show that the proposed adaptive restart strategy can determine the nature of the fault within 25ms, and finally restart quickly within 150ms.

articleTitle: Research on influencing factors and changes of DC current after commutation failure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Commutation failure is one of the most common faults in HVDC operation, and the DC current surge caused by it is not only one of the characteristics of commutation failure, but also an important basis for overcurrent protection of DC systems. This paper introduces the factors that affect the DC current change after commutation failure in the DC system, makes some modification to the simplified mathematical model of the DC system, and compares the theoretical calculation results with the simulation results. Finally, an extreme case is considered, so that the calculation result covers the most serious fault situation, which provides a reference for the protection of the DC system.

articleTitle: A Five-Level Space Vector Modulation for Interleaved Vienna Rectifier With Reduced Harmonic Distortion and Line Current Ripple
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: T-type Vienna rectifier are applied in various occasions due to fewer switching devices and lower line current ripple. Parallel converters with interleaved operation can achieve larger power capacity and improve the efficiency and power density of the converters. In interleaved Vienna rectifiers, the conventional 180° interleaved modulation can reduce harmonic distortion and line current ripple. However, since the parallel three-level converters can be considered as a single five-level converter, the performance of parallel converter is not fully exploited. A novel modulation for dual-channel interleaved Vienna rectifier is proposed, which can reduce the line current ripple and the current harmonic distortion. Compared with the conventional method, the proposed modulation strategy has better performance. Experimental results verify the system performance of the proposed modulation strategy.

articleTitle: An Optimal Control Scheme to Suppress the Current Zero-Crossing Distortion in Critical Mode Single-Phase Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Employing fully digital control to achieve a critical conduction mode (CRM) inverter is considered a cost-effective solution to obtain both high efficiency and high density. However, the distortion of the output current at the zero-crossing makes the inverter unable to provide high-quality power. This paper reveals the reasons for the distortion of fully-digital controlled CRM inverters. First, the generation of fundamental frequency driving signals is not synchronized with that of high-frequency driving signals, resulting in a current overshoot at the beginning of each half fundamental period. Second, there will be no driving signals region at the end of each half fundamental period. This paper proposes a quasi-close-loop control scheme and an improved driving signal generation logic, which combine to form an optimized control scheme to suppress the distortion of the output current. A fully-digital controlled CRM inverter with a rated power of 1kW is built. The effectiveness of the proposed control schemes is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Non-intrusive Load Disaggregation Method Considering State Probability Factors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Non-intrusive load monitoring plays an important role in obtaining electrical power information, which is conducive to strengthening demand-side management, guiding users to use electricity, and realizing energy conservation and consumption reduction. In terms of the variety of electrical appliances and the changeable working state, the means-shift clustering algorithm is utilized to construct load power templates. Based on the load power characteristics, the state probability factors are introduced as a new feature into the fitness function, which can be solved by the genetic algorithm. Furthermore, abnormal state correction is performed on the disaggregation results. Simulation results show that the proposed method can be well applied to non-invasive load identification.

articleTitle: Study on the Dynamic Characteristics of Plasma in the Post-arc Process of Vacuum Arc Interrupting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The recovery speed of the post-arc medium strength directly affects the breaking capacity of the vacuum switch. In this paper, the medium-high frequency current breaking experimental platform was established. The breaking experiments were carried out. The waveforms of post-arc current and voltage were measured. The post-arc equivalent resistance was calculated. The movement of plasma in post-arc process was analyzed. Combined with the experimental results and the emission mechanism, the concept of ‘post-arc plasma depletion zone’ was proposed. The effects of plasma movement and plasma depletion zone on the post-arc equivalent and the value of di/dt were also analyzed.

articleTitle: An NSGA-III based PV’s capacity optimization method considering the load’s long term variation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The increasing penetration of distributed photovoltaic (PV) reduces the voltage stability in the distribution system. Therefore, the reasonable PV planning considering the operation of grid is crucial. In this article, an PV size optimization model considering the influence of long-term load variation has been presented. Since the existing optimization algorithm is not effective in solving the multi-objective PV capacity optimization problem, the NSGA-III algorithm is introduced to generate the Pareto front. In order to evaluate the load’s effect to the optimal size, the annual load is forecasted by partial least square analysis. The performance of model is evaluated with the real-world-based distribution network model and parameters.

articleTitle: Research on testing and simulation analysis of overvoltage waveform on the roof of a moving train
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the roof lightning arrester failure of a moving train set has occurred from time to time, and one of the causes of the failure is roof overvoltage. In order to study the characteristics, a roof overvoltage online monitoring system was built to collect the roof overvoltage waveform of a moving train during the driving process. The waveform of overvoltage on the roof of EMU is collected and a model is established to simulate the current of lightning arrester under overvoltage. Collected overvoltage can be divided into over-phase overvoltage, high harmonic overvoltage, lifting bow overvoltage and steep wave impact overvoltage of four typical overvoltage, analyses the characteristics of four kinds of typical overvoltage, The simulation results show that the current of the lightning arrester under the action of overvoltage is related to the amplitude of overvoltage, and the surge current of the lightning arrester under the steep wave impulse voltage and over-phase overvoltage is higher.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic error of digital input electricity meters for energy internet
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the background of energy internet, the dynamic characteristics of power grid are prominent. Aiming at the dynamic error problem of digital input electricity meters widely used in smart substations, a dynamic error test experiment was designed and conducted in this paper, and the causes of dynamic errors were analyzed. The results show that the digital input electricity meter has advantages in measurement accuracy compared with the analog electricity meter. The analysis process can effectively guide the relevant manufacturers to take corresponding measures to improve the metering performance of digital input electricity meters.

articleTitle: The correlation between current pulses and dark streamer in vegetable insulating oil under lightning impulse voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The current pulse is a signal indicator for lightning impulse breakdown in insulating liquids. This work finds that the amplitude of current pulses is better correlated with the evolution of dark streamers rather than the evolution of luminescent streamers in vegetable insulating oil. Due to the intermittent nature of current pulses, it is reasonable to speculate that current pulses generate from the violent partial discharge inside the dark streamer channel. This work also developed an improved streamer discharge model to verify this speculation. The simulation results demonstrate the presence of a high electric field strength inside the streamer channel, which approves the occurrence of partial discharges inside the streamer channel.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Four-Phase Flux Modulated Doubly-Salient Reluctance Motors With Different Winding Polarity Configurations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To reduce the torque ripple and radial vibration, the flux modulated doubly-salient reluctance motor (FMDRM) drives are investigated, where the conventional quasi square current excitation scheme is replaced by the novel dc-biased sinusoidal current excitation scheme with the guidance of the flux modulation principle. However, the existing investigations mainly focus on the three-phase FMDRM. To evaluate the performance of the four-phase FMDRM, this paper proposes a comparative study of the four-phase FMDRMs with different winding polarity configurations. The electromagnetic characteristics of the four-phase 8/6 FMDRMs with commonly utilized 4N4S and NSNS winding polarity configurations are investigated in detail. The magnetomotive force (MMF), winding inductance, phase back electromotive force (back-EMF), torque output capability, and torque ripple are analyzed and compared. In addition, the corresponding finite element analysis (FEA) results are carried out for motor performance comparison. The results show that, compared to the NSNS winding polarity, the 4N4S polarity can achieve a better overall torque performance in the steady-state. However, the NSNS polarity can achieve better overload capacity.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of distributed fuel cell cogeneration system under different conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to recover the waste heat of proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) and improve the comprehensive energy efficiency of fuel cell system, a design method of distributed fuel cell cogeneration system was proposed. The thermoelectric output model of the system was built to analyze the thermoelectric output characteristics of the system under different current densities, different ambient temperatures and different stack temperatures, and the feasibility and effectiveness of waste heat recovery of PEMFC were verified. This study provides a model basis for the distributed waste heat recovery of PEMFC and provides a feasibility support for integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Risk Blocking Strategies for Urban Power Grids Considering Social-Informational-Physical Risks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Zhejiang is a demonstration area of high quality development and common prosperity, as well as a provincial demonstration area of new power system with renewable energy as the main body.Ensuring the security of urban power supply is the primary task of maintaining urban security.At present, the operational risk of urban power grid is presenting a complex situation of information-physics-society coupling. Once the risk transmission of butterfly effect is initiated, serious consequences may be induced.Based on the current situation of zhejiang urban power grid construction, this paper expounds the existing risks of urban power supply, puts forward the concept of risk conduction chain, and based on the proposed risk chain evolution and transmission theory, gives the corresponding risk blocking scheme, so as to ensure the security of urban power supply.

articleTitle: Comparison of installation process and electric field distribution of prefabricated and molded 35kV Polypropylene cable joint
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Environmental friendly thermoplastic cable has become a hotspot in cable industry. Taking 35kV polypropylene cable as the research object, the installation process of prefabricated joint and molded joint was compared, and the dielectric properties of polypropylene cable insulation material and silicone rubber insulation material were tested at different temperatures and frequencies. The test results were substituted into the simulation software for electrothermal coupling simulation, and the electric field distribution was obtained. The results show that the installation hidden trouble of polypropylene molded joint is lower than prefabricated joint. In the case of the prefabricated joint, the electric field is concentrated on the polypropylene insulation side of the cable because the permittivity of polypropylene is lower than that of silicone rubber, and the electric field is concentrated at the root of the stress cone and the end of the shielded pipe. In another case of the molded joint without stress cone and movable interface, the equipotential line distribution is more uniform and basically consistent with the cable. Combining installation process, material properties and electric field distribution, it can be concluded that the performance of polypropylene molded joint is better.

articleTitle: An Integrated Direct-Drive Wave Power Generation System with Hybrid Battery/Supercapacitor Energy Storage Based on Nine-Switch Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An integrated system based on nine-switch converter is implemented in direct-drive wave linear generator with hybrid battery/supercapacitor energy storage system. Firstly, the connection mode of nine-switch converter, linear generator and hybrid energy storage is determined. Secondly, based on the analysis of the working state of the nine-switch converter, a special carrier based modulation method is adopted as the modulation principle. Then, the zero d-axis current control strategy is applied to linear generator, and the low-pass filter method based on voltage-current loop is used to stabilize dc bus voltage and distribute the current of battery and supercapacitor. Finally, the system simulation model is established in Matlab/Simulink, and the simulation results show that the nine-switch converter can be applied to the direct-drive wave energy storage system and can achieve the same operating characteristics as the conventional topology.

articleTitle: Lightning Protection for the Transmission Line of ± 800kV UHVDC Single Circuit and 500kV EHVAC Double Circuit Erected on the Same Tower
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For some ± 800kV UHVDC projects, due to the limitation of corridor, some transmission lines need ± 800kV UHVDC and 500kV EHV AC circuit to be erected on the same tower. When ± 800kV transmission line and 500kV line are erected on the same tower, the height of the tower is further increased, and the lightning area is increased, so it is important to research the lightning protection and adopt proper lighting protection strengthening measures. In this paper, the lightning protection scheme is determined by the standard named as “Guide for lightning protection of overhead transmission lines”. Based on the transmission line of ± 800kV UHVDC single circuit and 500kV EHVAC double circuit erected on the same tower from Baihetan to Zhejiang, the preliminary results were given. To meet the control value of flashover rate, two lightning protection strengthening measures were proposed, and the results have been used in the design of the transmission line from Baihetan to Zhejiang.

Author Keywords: ± 800kV UHVDC and 500kV EHVAC erected on the same tower

articleTitle: XGBoost-based Evaluation of the Dosing State of the Converter Valve Cooling System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The converter valve cooling system is an important part to ensure the stable operation of the converter station. Circulating water is prone to breeding bacteria and algae and scaling, which seriously affecting the heat exchange efficiency of the converter valve cooling system. In this paper, a method for evaluating the automatic dosing state of the ultra-high pressure converter valve cooling system based on XGBoost is proposed. First, for the main components of the converter valve cooling system, 10 characteristic indicators such as inlet valve pressure, inlet valve temperature, spray water conductivity, and valve hall temperature are extracted. Then the preprocessed data is imported into the XGBoost classifier for training, realizing the parameter optimization through grid search. Finally, the field data of a converter station in Jiangsu Province is utilized to verify the effect of the model. The results show that the model’s evaluation accuracy rate reaches 92%.

articleTitle: Design of DCArc Fault Online Detectors in Photovoltaic Systems Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: DC arc faults in photovoltaic (PV) systems often create serious hazards, so that they need to be detected quickly and accurately. Compared with the traditional time and frequency domain arc fault detection methods, the method combined with machine learning achieves higher detection accuracy under different working conditions. In view of the above-mentioned background, this paper designs an arc fault online detector that can be integrated into PV systems, based on neural network (NN) algorithm. First, an arc fault detection experiment platform is built. By analyzing the measured arc data, the characteristic frequency band of the arc signal is selected. On this basis, a filter circuit is designed. After the filtered signal processed by digital signal processing (DSP), it is transmitted through the serial port to the host computer to complete the data acquisition. Then, the method of selecting, calculating and preprocessing the features of the signal is proposed. Using the processed features, the NN classifier is trained and optimized in the host computer to achieve a classification accuracy of over 99.5%. Finally, the trained parameters are used in the detection code of DSP, and the arc detection can be completed within 4ms, realizing the function of real-time arc fault detection.

articleTitle: Torque Ripple Suppression-Based Fault-Tolerant Model Predictive Current Control of Five-Phase PMSM Drives with Open-Circuit Faults
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this article, a fault-tolerant strategy based on model predictive current control (MPCC) is proposed to improve the output torque capacity and decrease the torque ripple of a five-phase permanent synchronous magnet motor (PMSM) drive under single and multiple open-circuit faults operations (OCFs). On the principle of the optimal current control, the current reference is modified to suppress torque ripple. Finally, the proposed strategy is proved effective by experiments.

articleTitle: Applicability analysis of multi-infeed short circuit ratio in the small-signal stability analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The increasing penetration of renewable energy resources may lead to multiple instability issues under the ac grid with low grid strength. The short-circuit ratio (SCR), as a common index of grid strength, is still lacking the applicability discussions and the theoretical support to reflect the stability mechanism in the multi-infeed power electronic system (MIPES). To this end, this paper mainly focuses on the small-signal stability issue of the MIPES, and elaborates the theoretical basis of the multi-infeed short-circuit ratio (MISCR) including the equivalent circuit-based short circuit ratio (ESCR) and generalized short circuit ratio (gSCR) for the small-signal stability analysis. Further, it is proved that the stability criterion based on gSCR is a sufficient and necessary condition for the small-signal stability analysis in the nominal MIPES system, while the stability criterion based on ESCR still lacks of theoretical basis for the small-signal stability analysis of the MIPES. Finally, simulation results verify the effectiveness of the above conclusions by means of the IEEE 39-node topology example.

articleTitle: Frequency Regulation Strategies of BESS and Doubly-fed Variable Speed Pumped Storage Unit Under Multiple Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Renewable energy generations have limited frequency capability, and their increasing penetration brings severer challenges to the frequency regulation of power grids. Meanwhile, emerging electrical devices such as doubly-fed variable speed pumped storage unit (DFVSPSU) or battery energy storage system (BESS) provide an opportunity for advanced frequency regulation. As opposed to fixed-speed pumped storage units, DFVSPSU can respond to grid frequency changes in both generating and pumping conditions with large capacity. With the rapid discharge/charge characteristics, BESS can participate in the power grid frequency regulation quickly. Therefore, combining different frequency regulation advantages of DFVSPSU and BESS, a frequency regulation strategy considering different operating conditions to ensure frequency safety is put forward in this paper. Firstly, the advanced strategy adopts power priority and speed priority control methods for the control of DFVSPSU. Furthermore, a coordinated control method of virtual inertia and virtual droop is developed for the control of BESS. Finally, using MATLAB/Simulink platform, dynamic simulations are carried out in a modified IEEE-9 bus system integrated with DFVSPSU and BESS to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

Author Keywords: doubly-fed variable speed pumped storage unit

articleTitle: Signal-Phase Virtual Synchronous Generator Control Strategy for Energy Storage Converters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of economy and society, the use of a large number of precision instruments and equipment makes the requirements for the safety and reliability of electric energy higher. To solve the power interruption caused by conventional control strategy and drawback of the relay, the virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control strategy is applied for single-phase energy storage converters system. Analysis the active and reactive power control scheme based on virtual torque and virtual excitation and modify the calculation method of single-phase power. Add pre-synchronization to reduce current surge and realize the seamless switching between islanding mode and grid-connected mode under the single-phase VSG control strategy in the energy storage converters. Finally, the simulation of Matlab/Simulink and the experiment of a 1kVA prototype are conducted to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed VSG control strategy for a single-interactive energy storage converters system. The experimental results show that the proposed VSG control strategy can realize the seamless switching between two operating modes of the energy storage converters system.

articleTitle: An Optimal Variable-Frequency Asymmetrical-Phase-Shift Strategy for Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In wireless power transfer (WPT) systems, the transfer efficiency will be significantly affected by coils misalignment or power variation by traditional control strategy. In this paper, a variable-frequency asymmetrical-phase-shift (VFAPS) control strategy is proposed, which simultaneously controls the system frequency and phase shift angles to regulate the transmission power with maximum transmission efficiency regardless of coils misalignment or power variation. System frequency is controlled to compensate the reactive component of the secondary circuit. Asymmetrical-phase-shift can reduce reactive power loss and narrow the regulation range of system frequency on the basis of a wide range of ZVS. Finally, a mathematical model for solving the optimal control variables is established. Contrast experiments with the traditional triple-phase-shift (TPS) strategy on a 3.7kW WPT platform are constructed to verify the effectiveness of proposed strategy. The results demonstrate VFAPS strategy enables the system to operate at maximum efficiency and has great advantages in resisting coils misalignment and power variations.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Different Connection Schemes for Power balance Machine in Power Plant System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The reduction of auxiliary power is critical for the efficiency improvement of power plants. For coal power plants, the auxiliary power can be reduced by replacing the driving source of auxiliary motors with a small steam turbine driven by the steam with high temperature and pressure. To make sure the power of auxiliary motors is suitable for plant requirements, a power balance machine is required to balance the extra power from steam. In this paper, the connection scheme of the power balance machine is studied for a power plant with two 630°C 1000MW double reheat units. Various electrical connection schemes connecting the power balance machine to the power system are designed. The power flow calculation and system stability analysis are carried out to ensure the system’s reliability.

articleTitle: A Weighted Deep Learning Model with Sampling Strategy for Unbalanced Bearing Condition Assessment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Rolling bearings play an extremely important role in rotating machinery. The unique position of bearings dictates that in the event of a failure, this could result in huge economic losses as well as endangering personal safety. Therefore, the assessment of the failure state of bearings has been a popular area of research. This paper addresses two challenges that exist in traditional bearing condition assessment methods: the first is the need to manually extract features from bearing data, which is overly dependent on professional knowledge; the second is the general imbalance between faulty and normal samples, which affects the performance of the model. The paper proposes a two-layer CNN-LSTM weighted deep learning model with sampling strategy (wTLCL-O) to address these challenges, which contains two layers of CNN, two layers of LSTM with both an oversampling strategy and a weighted cost-sensitive loss function. The article conducts experiments on the French PRONOSTIA bearing failure dataset, and the results show that wTLCL-O outperforms other traditional algorithms in terms of robustness and stability, and improves the prediction accuracy of bearing condition assessment under non-equilibrium conditions.

articleTitle: Accurate Calculation Method of Rectifier Load and Time-Domain Analysis in PS/S Current-Fed WPT System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The fundamental harmonic approximation method is the main research method of wireless power transfer (WPT) technology. This method equates the rectifier load fundamental impedance to a pure resistance, which provides a basis for modeling and analysis of the WPT system. However, this method ignores the effect of rectifier load harmonic impedance, which leads to a large error between the actual response and the theoretical analysis, affects the model accuracy of the system and limits the further optimization design of WPT system. In this paper, the WPT system based on parallel-series/series (PS/S) compensation network is taken as the research object, the reason for the error generated by the fundamental harmonic approximation method is analyzed and an accurate calculation method based on the iterative method for the rectifier load equivalent impedance is proposed. On this basis, an accurate circuit response model of the WPT system is established. Finally, the correctness of the system response model is verified through simulation.

Author Keywords: accurate calculation method of rectifier load

articleTitle: Current Predictive Control Strategy of T-Type Grid-Tied Inverter Based on Sliding Mode Observer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Conventional model predictive control (MPC) strategy is highly dependent on grid parameters. The mismatch of grid parameters and the nonlinearity of inverters will seriously affect the control performance of conventional grid-tied inverters. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a current predictive control strategy based on sliding mode observer (SMO) for T-type inverter. Firstly, according to the structure of T-type grid-tied inverter, a mathematical model considering lumped disturbance is constructed. Next, the SMO is designed to observe lumped disturbances. The purpose of predicting the current without relying on the grid parameters is achieved. The parameter robustness of grid-tied inverters is improved. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Power System Operation Mode Generalization and Stability Control Strategy Modification Based on Data-Driven Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The power grid operating mode will grow more complicated and diversified as power grid structure becomes more complex, as does the high share of renewable energy and the rising permeability of power electronic equipment. As a result, evaluation and analysis methodologies designed for ordinary operating modes will not be able to fulfill the needs of future power system operation planning, analysis, and strategy selection. Therefore, this paper provides a data-driven power system operating mode analysis as well as a technique for selecting a stability control strategy This method first builds the characteristics of the typical scenario is suitable for the operation of the electric properties and the method of data preprocessing, then identifies the typical operation mode through clustering and tightness index saturation point, respectively, and selects the corresponding stability control strategy in place to ensure that the grid can still keep the stable operation unaffected. Finally, an example is generated and examined using real power grid operating data from southwest China to demonstrate the efficacy and dependability of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Interaction Between PMSG Based Wind Farm and VSC-HVDC System in ACC Timescale
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the interaction between the grid-side converter (GSC) of permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) based wind farm and voltage source converter-based high voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC) transmission system, power oscillations may occur in grid-connected PMSG based wind farm via VSC-HVDC system. Focusing on the interaction between the PMSG based wind farm and VSC-HVDC system in alternating current control (ACC) timescale, the amplitude-phase dynamics model of interconnected system between PMSG based wind farm and rectifier of VSC-HVDC system is first constructed, of which the validity is verified by time-domain simulation. Then, the influences of the bandwidth of PMSG current control loop, PMSG phase-locked loop and HVDC current control loop on system oscillation stability are analyzed. The results show that the system stability can be improved by reducing the bandwidth of the PMSG current control loop, PMSG phase-locked loop and HVDC current control loop, which provides reference for the design and operation.

articleTitle: Research on Pixel-Level Identification of Composite Insulator Defects Based on Threshold Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the excellent insulation performance of composite insulators, they are widely used in transmission and distribution lines, which also brings problems such as a large workload of composite insulator fault detection and an urgent need to improve the degree of intelligence. In this paper, a method for identifying abnormal temperature rise defects of composite insulators based on infrared image threshold segmentation is proposed. First, train and use the YOLOv4 convolutional neural network to detect the composite insulator in the complex infrared image, and initially locate the area where the composite insulator is located; then use the affine transformation correction algorithm to adjust the insulator mandrel to the horizontal direction to determine the temperature rise position of the defect; Then use TRIANGLE method to perform image threshold segmentation on the composite insulator area to obtain a binary image of the insulator, according to which the insulator in the infrared image is segmented; an infrared image contrast enhancement algorithm based on fuzzy algorithm is proposed, and the temperature rise area of the insulator is obtained by threshold segmentation; According to the infrared characteristics of temperature rise of the defects of composite insulators, the types of defects and the degree of failure of composite insulators can be judged. Finally, the identification and diagnosis of the abnormal temperature rise of the composite insulator is realized based on the visual information and the temperature rise information of the abnormal temperature rise area.

articleTitle: Harmonic Suppression Strategies and Seamless Transfer Control between Grid-Connected and Islanding Modes in Renewable Energy System for Hydrogen Production
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, using renewable energy to produce hydrogen has become one of the important ways to achieve carbon peak and carbon neutralization. However, thyristor rectifiers are commonly used in industry hydrogen production systems (HPS), which may bring power quality problems such as current harmonics. Besides, renewable energy system for hydrogen production (RSHP) is expected to operate in both grid-connected and islanding mode. Thus, it is necessary to propose uninterruptible harmonic suppression strategies, and have seamless transition between these two modes. Firstly, this paper proposes the impedance regulation strategy for islanding mode and direct harmonic compensation strategy for grid-connected mode, since the harmonic characteristics and control objectives of RSHP in two modes is different. On this basis, the improved voltage loop and the improved phase-locked loop are developed to enable a smooth transition between the grid-connected and islanding mode of the RSHP. Finally, Simulation results verifies the effectiveness of the proposed control strategies.

articleTitle: Feasibility Analysis of Applying Carbon Fiber Composite Conductor in Medium and Heavy Icing Area
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Carbon fiber composite conductor (CFCC) is an ideal new conductor that can replace traditional aluminum conductor steel reinforced(ACSR) in current overhead transmission and transformation lines. In severe ice coating areas, the iced conductor brings a greater load to the tower, the tower is thus more likely to be twisted or even collapsed. Therefore, it is necessary to use a lighter conductor which has a high tensile strength. On this occasion, CFCC is an ideal choice. This paper mainly used the self-developed non-linear dynamic model of the conductor-insulator system to establish a multi-span three-degree-of-freedom simulation line model which was in the medium and heavy icing area, and the relevant conclusions were summarized. The main content of this paper is divided into two parts: The first part set the wind speed to vary between 5m/s and 30m/s, and the thickness of the ice was 10mm-50mm. The dynamic tension of the conductor, the force of the insulator, and the displacement of the wind deviation were calculated. The above data were checked against safety standards, and compared with the calculation results of the same type of ACSR. The advantages and disadvantages of the CFCC when facing wind deviation in the medium and heavy icing area were summarized. The second part was aimed at ice-shedding in heavy icing and great lap area, on which occasion the length of span was 3000 m-5000 m. The conductor sag under different operating tensions, and the interphase clearance when the second uneven ice-shedding occurred were calculated. The above simulation results were checked for safety issue and the compared with the calculation results of ACSR. Then relevant conclusions about the application of CFCC in the heavy ice area of large spans were drawn.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Rotor Eccentricity on the Characteristics of Hybrid Stator Pole Bearingless Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Because the rotor of bearingless switched reluctance motor (BSRM) can only be supported by suspension force, and it cannot be supported by conventional mechanical bearings. Therefore, when the suspension force or load of the BSRM is disturbed, the rotation axis of rotor always rotates near the geometric center of the stator, it’s hard to make sure that it’s in the geometric center of the stator. That is to say, for bearingless motor, the rotor eccentricity is inevitable, in other words, electromagnetic characteristics of the motor must be affected by the eccentric operation of the rotor. In this paper, the influence of the rotor radial eccentricity, including three cases, on the electromagnetic characteristics is analyzed. At the same time, the influence of the rotor axial eccentricity on the electromagnetic characteristics is also analyzed. Finally, the finite element (FEM) analysis results are discussed, the relationship between rotor eccentricity and electromagnetic characteristics is also analyzed.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Pantograph Catenary Arc Motion Characteristics During High-speed Train Running
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
