abstract: The arc between catenary conductor and pantograph sliding plate will have an adverse impact on the stable current collection during train operation. Therefore, the research on the motion development characteristics of arc between pantograph and catenary is of great value for the safe and stable operation of train and improving the reliability and service life of pantograph and catenary system. In the process of high-speed running, the train is always affected by the head-on air flow in front of the train, and the difference between the head-on air flow and the cross wind is obvious. In order to clarify the influence of the frontal air flow on the arc motion characteristics between pantograph and catenary during train operation, the arc MHD model is established. The motion characteristics of the arc between pantograph and catenary under four different train speed conditions are simulated and analyzed, and the arc characteristics under different conditions are obtained. The results show that with the increase of train speed, the movement and development of arc is accelerated, the maximum offset distance of arc anode root is also gradually increased, the jumping frequency of anode root is more frequent, and the arc stability is gradually reduced. The research results provide a theoretical basis for the influence of frontal air flow on Pantograph catenary arc during train operation.

articleTitle: Thermal Field Study of Induction Rotary Transformer Based on Electric-thermal Coupling Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Different from the traditional transformer, a new type of rotary transformer which has a rotary secondary winding was proposed to replace the brushes and slip rings of double-fed induction machines. The rotary state makes the no-load loss and temperature distribution of the transformer have complex characteristics which could not be calculated by the traditional loss formula. In this paper, based on the electric -thermal coupling theory, the actual thermal distribution model of rotary transformer was analyzed and the equivalent no-load loss calculation method was applied to the thermal field. Compared with other methods, the new method has higher calculation accuracy, which can be used in practical engineering. The correctness and validity of the no-load loss calculation are verified by simulation experiment.

articleTitle: Research on plasma biomass straw liquefaction plant and its application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low comprehensive utilization rate of corn straw and environmental pollution caused by large-scale combustion of corn straw, a technical scheme of biomass-straw treatment by gas discharge and discharge plasma technology was put forward in this paper, and a biomass straw liquefaction mechatronics device was developed. With the help of big data analysis platform, the influence of different parameters on biomass liquefaction was studied. At the same time, data of big data platform were used to optimize and upgrade the experimental device. The device includes: plasma power supply, gas mixer, the plasma conversion reactor, detection device, cyclone separator, condenser, gas collection device, big data analysis platform, etc. The thermal efficiency of biomass liquefaction products generated by this device can reach 48%, and the conversion rate of biomass-straw is owned by 90.4%. The solid, liquid and gaseous products after reaction can be reused. The device gets the advantages of energy saving and environmental protection, and meets the requirements of carbon peak and carbon neutrality.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of DC-Biased Modular Linear Variable Flux Reluctance Machines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a dc-biased modular linear variable flux reluctance machines (DCB-MLVFRMs) for magnetless long stroke application. First, the machine topology and drive circuit are present, where the primary is constituted by modular $\pi-$shaped lamination segments. Through dc-biased sinusoidal currents, the dc field winding can be eliminated and single set of integrated armature winding is required. Then, the electromagnetic performances are investigated based on two-dimensional (2D) finite element (FE) analysis. It reveals that the thrust force density can be greatly improved about 43% by using dc-biased phase current under the same copper loss. Moreover, the phase to phase mutual inductances are very small and negligible with 11/13 secondary poles, hence the fault-tolerant capability can be greatly enhanced. Finally, three-dimensional (3D) model is built to validate the 2D FE predicted results.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-objective Configuration of Wind and Solar Storage Based on Cascade Utilization of Retired Batteries
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to serve the green and low-carbon transformation of the energy system, coordinate the reliability, economy and low-carbon of the energy system, and consider the rational cascade utilization of retired power batteries, a multi-objective energy storage allocation model is established with the distribution network containing wind and light resources as the research object. The optimization objectives of the model are total system cost, wind/solar abandonment rate and load power shortage rate, which are solved by improved differential evolution algorithm. Through the analysis of an example, the distributed generation and energy storage system are optimized at the same time, which verifies the rationality of the used retired battery utilization strategy and the effectiveness of the improved algorithm. The method can effectively improve the utilization rate of renewable energy, reduce the system configuration cost and support the reliable operation of the distribution network.

articleTitle: A Defects Detection System for Substation Based on YOLOX
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To improve the intelligent supervision level of substation, a defects images dataset facing to substation scenario was built by collecting and labeling a huge number of images about substation equipment defects. Then a transfer learning model based on the YOLOX model was trained by adjusting the model training parameters. Finally, a model with 87.4 % mean average precision and affordable speed (about 0.07 second per image) was constructed. And the experiments results proved that this model can detect the preset defects of substation equipment accurately in acceptable speed according to the visible image obtained from monitoring equipment, which means it has satisfying application potential in future.

articleTitle: Key Technologies of Structure Design of 385m Super-high Long-span Transmission Tower
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: the project summary of the super-high steel tubular tower of 500kV Fengcheng to Meili transmission line is introduced. The dynamic characteristics analysis of the tower models with and without inner elevator shaft is conducted. The influence of elevator shaft on dynamic performance of tower model is focused on. Afterwards, the selection of leg member is performed, and concrete filled steel tube with new type of annular steel frameworks inside is selected for the leg members. Finally, the selection of the joint of compression chord of lower crossarm to main member is carried out. The cast steel joint adopts monolithic casting technology, it helps to solve the problem of space intersection of multiple members, and avoid complex welding process. The cast steel joint is selected, and the steel material is G20Mn5QT. The key technologies introduced can be wildly used in long span transmission tower.

articleTitle: Group equivalent modeling and analysis of group subsynchronous oscillation of direct-drive wind turbine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Taking the direct drive wind farm connected to weak AC system as the research object, combined with the actual topology of a wind farm in Hami, Xinjiang, this paper establishes the detailed model and cluster aggregation model of direct drive wind farm on PSCAD / EMTDC platform, and comprehensively analyzes the effectiveness of aggregation model under sub synchronous oscillation (SSO). The results show that when SSO occurs, the cluster equivalent model can accurately reflect the output characteristics, damping characteristics and oscillation frequency of the wind farm. According to the actual topology of a wind power collection station in Hami, Xinjiang and the actual operation of a wind power collection station on a certain day, the equivalent clustering is carried out.

articleTitle: Synergic Optimizing Energy-Water System in Hot Spring Resort Based on General Flow Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Rural tourism across the country is in the ascendant. Rural tourism featuring hot springs has been loved by leisure tourists in recent years, and the hot spring tourism industry has developed rapidly. How to support the sustained growth and development of the local hot spring tourism industry without increasing the amount of geothermal water intake, and to slow down the impact of geothermal exploitation and utilization on the local environment is a problem that needs to be solved. In this study, combined with the existing hot spring utilization process, the relationship between the hot spring water intake and the scale of tourism was calculated and analyzed, combined with the existing data analysis, and the local hot spring water intake limit was set. Established a mutual restriction between the amount of hot spring water withdrawal and the scale of the local tourism industry. Combining the investigation of various energy supply and demand, through the analysis and optimization of energy flow, the optimization design of the energy flow-geothermal water flow network coupling system for the recycling of geothermal water resources is proposed, and the recycling mode of geothermal water resources is proposed. Combined with the case, based on the geothermal water resource recycling model, through the optimization design of the energy system that drives the recycling of water resources, it is proposed to increase the installation of photovoltaic power generation systems to meet the additional energy demand of geothermal water recycling, while constructing self-sustaining water -The thermal-electric coupling system realizes clean and low-carbon development. This study uses energy-water coupling analysis to promote the recycling of non-renewable geothermal water resources with renewable energy input, promote the green and sustainable development of local industries, avoid resource depletion due to unnecessary use of resources, and achieve low-carbon sustainable development in rural areas.

articleTitle: Two-stage Optimal Allocation of Generalised Energy Storage Based on Building Regulable Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Building loads make up a significant proportion of urban distribution network. Commercial buildings as carriers of flexible loads and distributed energy storage resources, have a rich regulating potential for participating in the electricity market to gain revenue through further adjustment. This paper present a two-stage generalised energy storage (GES) optimisation allocation method based on commercial building loads, include heating ventilation and airconditioning system (HVAC), building charging piles (BCPs) and stationary energy storage (SES). Simulations are carried out in the IEEE 33-node distribution network system, the results show that the proposed method can suppress the power fluctuations significantly as well as reduce the SES costs.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of monitoring and management system for battery energy storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Battery energy storage technology plays an indispensable role in new energy, carbon neutralization and national sustainable development. The monitoring and management system of battery energy storage is the key part of battery energy storage technology. This paper proposes a monitoring and management system for battery energy storage, which can monitor the voltage and temperature of the battery in real time through the visual man-machine interface, support authority management, support protection and control actions such as battery access and connection, regularly count and analyze battery performance indicators, support 61850 background monitoring and support PCs for power conversion. Through the practice of network connection experiment in many substations, it is proved that the system can significantly improve the management efficiency of battery energy storage, improve man-machine friendliness and safety, reduce maintenance cost.

articleTitle: Real-time Simulation Hardware-in-the-loop Test Platform for DC Integrated Power System Containing a Large Number of Switches
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to analyze the DC integrated power systems containing a large number of switches accurately and quantitatively, this paper constructs a real-time simulation hardware-in-the-loop test platform. The platform integrates three key technologies, the first one is the real-time simulation method of large-scale power systems. This method is composed of modeling method of crucial equipment, network partitioning method, and electrical decoupling method. The second one is the construction of asynchronous communication interface. This platform realizes the function of uploading the system data to the database by UDP protocol and sending the control instructions to the system model by TCP protocol. The last one is the joint debugging of physical equipment and real-time simulator. Taking the integrated power system (IPS) as an example, the power system model is simulated by the real-time simulator, the network and energy management system are actual physical equipment, constructing the real-time simulation hardware-in-the-loop experimental platform. The real-time simulation performance and dynamic calculation results of the system verify the effectiveness of the real-time simulation method of large-scale power systems and the superiority of the platform.

Author Keywords: power systems containing a large number of switches

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of Guano Flashover of TYPE I Composite Insulator on Overhead Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Guano flashover is one of the main faults involving birds in overhead transmission lines, which seriously affects the reliability of power grids. In order to determine the effects of different factors on the guano flashover, a 110kV TYPE I composite insulator was taken as an example to design and build a test platform, build 3D electric field simulation models to simulate the guano flashover test, and to study the effects of the guano viscosity, conductivity, whether there was a voltage equalization ring or not, and the dropping path on the guano flashover probability. The results showed that the higher the viscosity of the guano was, the higher the flashover probability was when the distance from the edge of the composite insulator was 15-21cm. The higher the conductivity of the guano was, the higher the flashover probability was when the viscosity was the same. Composite insulators were more likely to flashover when voltage equalization ring was installed than when not installed. The closer the guano plane was to the wire plane, the larger the critical flashover distance was and there was no linear relationship between them.

articleTitle: Farm Energy System Optimization Considering Cost Variation In Demand and Production Side
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the integrated energy system of farms with flexible loads, the supply of cold, heat, electricity, steam and other energy products can be changed by adjusting the output of energy conversion equipment, and the real-time demand for various energy products can also be adjusted through demand-side management. The elasticity of energy supply capacity is mainly the change in the utilization of different renewable energy resources (solar energy, wind energy and biomass energy). The elastic changes on the energy demand side are mainly the changes in the demand curve caused by the reduction of demand for cooling, heating and electricity and energy storage. Changes in the utilization of different renewable energy resources will lead to changes in the construction cost of an integrated energy system. Demand response cost, energy storage costs and secondary energy production costs such as cooling, heating and power are constantly changing. By constructing a mathematical model of the dynamic cost of various types of energy conversion systems and demand adjustment measures for heating and cooling, with the goal of minimizing the comprehensive cost of energy supply and use, the output and demand adjustment of energy conversion equipment are comprehensively optimized. Combined with the comprehensive energy utilization system of a farm, it illustrates the economic value and energy efficiency value of the optimization of the comprehensive energy system of the farm when both energy supply and demand are elastic. The results show that, compared with simply adjusting the output of energy conversion equipment, the comprehensive optimization of energy conversion equipment output and demand response of farms can further reduce the cost of energy supply and increase the consumption of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Design of low power transmission tower assembly monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The traditional transmission tower assembly monitoring system has the idle state of data transmission with invalid energy consumption, which makes its endurance time unable to meet the actual engineering needs. Therefore, based on the idea of turning the sensors in the idle time period into low-power sleep state, this paper deduces the distribution equation of data transmission in the monitoring system, determines the data transmission idle time of each sensor in the system, and realizes the low-power working mode of turning the sensors in the idle time period into sleep state. At the same time, many low-power hardware modules and system software working procedures are prepared to complete the design of low-power transmission tower assembly monitoring system.

articleTitle: Abnormal signal analysis of GIS voltage transformer based on ultrasonic detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Ultrasonic detection is an important means of gas insulated substation equipment internal defect detection. This paper analyzes the abnormal ultrasonic signal of a voltage transformer in a 220kV GIS substation in Jiangsu Province. According to the rising trend and the characteristic maps of signal detection results, it is inferred that there may be obvious floating or vibration defects accompanied by slight corona inside the gas chamber. Combined with the disassembly results, it was found that the nylon bolts and nuts were loose, the tightening torque of the iron core steel sheets was invalid, the position of the shielding plate was shifted, and the shielding case had pits and scratches. Comparing the results of energized test and disassembly, it verifies the effectiveness of partial discharge ultrasonic detection in discovering early hidden dangers in gas insulated substation equipment.

articleTitle: Analysis and adjust of temperature drift in current measurement based on hall sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the temperature drift of the output voltage of hall sensor, according to the input-output relationship of sensor, by using the method of theoretical derivation and analysis, influence degree of each element on the output voltage of sensor with change of temperature can be obtained. It can be found the product sensitivity of the hall current sensor has the greatest influence on the output voltage of the sensor with the change of temperature, and the relative error can reach 123.7%. At the same time, a cubic linear interpolation correction method is proposed to reduce the error in measurement. The experiments show that the relative measurement error of the sensor is reduced from 12.4% to 4.3%, which greatly improves the measurement accuracy of the sensor.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Wireless Power and Information Synchronous Transmission System with Shared Coupling Channel
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The technology of wireless power and information synchronous transmission (WPIT) broadens the application scenario of the system. In this paper, the power transmission channel and information transmission channel of WPIT system are modeled and analyzed in detail. Frequency division multiplexing technology is adopted, and different frequency carriers are used for power and information transmission. The composite circuit of power and information transmission is introduced, and the function of each element of the circuit is explained in detail. Furthermore, the methods of signal modulation and demodulation are given. In order to realize the decoupling design of power and information transmission circuit, the crosstalk between power and information carrier is discussed. Then, the channel of power and information transmission are given respectively to analyze the power transmission performance and communication transmission gain. It provides guidance for the parameter design of information transmission circuit. Finally, an experimental prototype is built, with an output power of 200W and a data transmission rate of 200kbps.

articleTitle: Experimental study of plasma anti-icing over an airfoil based on two different electrode layouts
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents experimental investigation on plasma anti-icing in icing wind tunnel based on two different electrode layouts. Under the same excitation parameters, the voltage and current waveform, surface temperature distribution and dynamic anti-icing process of the plasma actuator are collected and analyzed, from which the influence of electrode layout on anti-icing effect is studied. With the same excitation parameters, the layout of the actuators has little effect on the single pulse energy and average power of SDBD when the total length of the high voltage electrodes of the actuator is approximately the same. The temperature in the leading-edge area of the actuator is lower than that of the trailing edge area. At the leading edge of the airfoil, the temperature between two adjacent high-voltage electrodes presents a ‘V’ distribution. With the time evolution, under the continuous impact of supercooled water droplets, the aera of high temperature region on the surface of the actuator decreases gradually. Under the same excitation parameters, the streamwise actuators with an interval of 5mm have good anti-icing ability during 0-240s. When the peak-to-peak value of the applied voltage is set to 8kV and the pulse repetition frequency is set to 6kHz, the streamwise actuator with electrode spacing of 5mm has excellent anti-icing effect. However, the anti-icing effect of the streamwise/ spanwise combined actuator is not ideal. Continuously distributed ice layer is formed at the leading edge of the airfoil, indicating that the spanwise electrode at the leading edge can’t improve the anti-icing effect, but reduce the anti-icing ability of the actuator.

articleTitle: Study on Breakdown Characteristics of Transformer Oil under Negative Oscillation Lightning Impulse Voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Field impulse voltage withstand test is an important step to ensure the safety of a transformer. The double exponential impulse voltage generator has large volume and low efficiency, which is hard to adjust the output waveform and is not convenient for field test. IEC 60060-3 recommends that the oscillating impulse voltage can be used in filed test and the generator has high efficiency. This paper constructs a generator which can output 5 kinds of Negative lightning impulse voltage waveforms and studies the breakdown characteristics of transformer oil under these lightning impulse voltages. The five types of lightning impulse voltages are standard lightning impulse (LI) voltage and oscillating lightning impulse (OLI) voltages with the oscillation frequency of 100 kHz, 200kHz, 300kHz and 400 kHz. The results prove that, in oscillating lightning impulse voltage test, the breakdown point always occurs at the peak of the oscillation period. And as the oscillation frequency increases, the maximum discharge time delay decreases, the voltage-time curve moves up, the slope of the probability curve of the Weibull distribution decreases, the scale parameter of the Weibull distribution curve decreases, and both the initial breakdown voltage and the 50% breakdown voltage increase gradually. Comparing with the standard lightning impulse voltage test, the results of the oscillating lightning impulse voltages test has larger maximum discharge delay, higher voltage-time curve and higher slope and scale parameter of the Weibull distribution curve. The probability curve of the Weibull distribution converges in high voltage.

articleTitle: Research on energy balance control strategy for distributed multi-port energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The distributed energy storage system in microgrid has developed rapidly in recent years, which has significant advantages in stabilizing energy fluctuations. However, in practical application, the energy balance of each subsystem in the distributed energy storage system will bring hidden dangers to the safe and reliable operation of microgrid. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved droop control based on model predictive control. In this paper, the power control instructions of each port in the distributed energy storage system are obtained by using the model prediction theory, taking the energy balance as the control objective and the nature of the energy storage elements as the constraints. According to the power instruction, the real-time updated droop coefficient is generated. Through the change of droop coefficient, the real-time power redistribution is carried out for each subsystem, so as to achieve the energy balance of each subsystem. Finally, the simulation results based on MATLAB / Simulink model are given to verify the feasibility of the proposed droop control based on model prediction.

articleTitle: A Switched Tank Converter Integrated Buck-boost Converter with Partial Energy Transfer for Data Center Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Switched tank converter (STC) has received more and more attention due to its advantages of high efficiency and high power density, especially its application in data centers, but its development is limited due to its inability to regulate voltage. This paper proposes a STC integrated Buck-boost converter. The converter adopts the method of partial energy transfer, and the efficient energy transfer and the voltage regulation capability of the converter are realized. In addition, by adopting the method of bridge integration, the number of power devices is reduced. After integration, the inductor current of Buck-boost is injected into the integrated bridge, and the soft switching of the bridge is easier to realize. Therefore, the efficiency of the converter at light load is improved. Through improvement, the converter proposed in this paper greatly improves the efficiency. Finally, the theoretical analysis is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Investigation for the degradation mechanism of avermectins exposed to non-thermal atmospheric plasma
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the application of non-thermal atmospheric plasma to pesticide residue treatment has attracted widespread attention, among which the analysis of degradation products is one of the key factors restricting the application of this technology in practice. Dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) is an ideal way to treat pesticides residues. In this paper, an experimental device of DBD is designed, and the electrical diagnosis and optical diagnosis of the device were made. The results of electrical diagnosis show that DBD discharge is resistance-capacitance discharge. The optical diagnosis results show that the discharge mode of the device is filament discharge, and the reactive oxygen components in the plasma produced are mainly $\cdot$OH and O. Based on the diagnosis of reactive oxygen species in plasma, molecular dynamics simulation of the reaction between reactive oxygen species and avermectin (AVM) was carried out using Material Studio. The simulation results show that O and $\cdot$OH destroy AVM molecules through hydrogen abstraction reaction and adsorption reaction, resulting in the breaking of C-O bond and the formation of C=O, C=C bond. When O acts alone, AVM would be degraded into two different products. When $\cdot$OH acted alone, AVM would be degraded into two different products. When O and $\cdot$OH react with avermectins together, AVM will be degraded into five different products.

articleTitle: Offshore Wind Power Grid-connected Technology Based on Self-starting System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the long period of the current offshore wind power project construction, a self-starting wind turbine grid-connected method is proposed, and a set of wind turbine grid-connected self-starting device is developed based on this method. Through this device, it is available to provide a stable power supply for the wind turbine through the submarine cable before the grid power on the land is delivered to the offshore substation. After the grid power is delivered, the wind turbines are directly connected to the grid, which greatly shortens the construction period of offshore wind power projects, creates considerable economic value. The technology had been applied in many offshore wind farms in Rudong, Jiangsu, and the field test data verified the advancement and effectiveness of the developed system and the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Front-Middle-Back Platform Architecture Design of Dispatch Center to Support the Transition to the New Power System with Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Front-Middle-Back Platform (FMBP) Architecture is proposed in this paper. FMBP Architecture concludes the technical framework of Data Middle Platform, Business Middle Platform, and Technical Middle Platform, combined with the core concept of data sharing and capability reuse. The FMBP architecture was developed and implemented at the dispatch center of Guangdong Power Grid Co., the operation effects show that it’s high available, stable, and agile. The FMBP’s ability of supporting the transition to the New Power System and feeding the digital energy ecosystem has been proved.

articleTitle: Effect of plasma modification on the dispersion of high thermal conductive nano-filler
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of high voltage engineering and microelectronic products, insulating materials with high thermal conductivity are demanded urgently. Epoxy resin (ER) is one of the widely used polymer for insulating materials. However, the thermal conductivity of ER is low, which limits the application in the area requiring heat dissipation. In general, adding inorganic filler with high thermal conductivity into ER is a solution to increase the thermal conductivity of the composites. In this solution, the dispersion and stability of filler is the key for the fabrication of composites. In this paper, the plasma modification of fillers (alumina nanoparticles) is investigated. The fillers are modified in gas discharge and gas-liquid discharge, respectively. The dispersion of filler is evaluated before and after modification by Zeta potential. After DBD modification for 6 min, the dispersion of alumina nanoparticles in water increased with 113% at zeta potential. After discharge in gas-liquid environment, the particle size changes relatively. This may be caused by the introduction of functional groups and covalent bonds on the surface of the filler by plasma modification. This study provides key support for the mass production of nano-filler for high voltage insulation.

articleTitle: Flashover strength improvement in vacuum using surface microstructure of printed metal wires
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Vacuum plays a vital role in the high-voltage insulation field as a special dielectric. For most of the vacuum-dielectric devices, vacuum flashovers usually occur at the solid-vacuum interface due to its weaker surface strength, leading to the damage of the whole insulation system. In this paper, an investigation is conducted regarding the vacuum flashover inhibition and positive charge accumulation reduction using microstructure of embedded silver wires. The mechanism of multipactor suppression through surface printed metal structure is studied by establishing a particle-in-cell (PIC) simulation based on secondary electron emission avalanche (SEEA) theory. Meanwhile, the multipactor expansion and the charge accumulation process on the interface are simulated to study the multipactor mitigation phenomenon of printed metal wires. Different widths, positions and numbers of metal wires are also simulated. It is found that a certain amount of negative charge can gather on the silver metal microstructure due to its low secondary emission yield (SEY), forming an electric field to scatter electrons and inhibit multipactor propagation. Increasing width of printed metal wires is beneficial for improving this suppression effect on vacuum flashover. At last, some relative experiments are conducted and a considerable improvement in flashover strength is acquired, to provide further confirmation of the simulation results.

articleTitle: Future Demand and Innovative Development of Advanced UHV Power Transmission technology in the Scenarios of Global Energy Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the demand of clean and low-carbon power consumption, the construction of energy interconnection poses new challenges to clean energy power access and transmission technologies, which needs to solve key technical problems in complex scenarios such as the access of different clean energies, the interconnection of strong and weak power systems, and the operation control of complex network topology, in order to improve the system reliability and power quality, as well as transmission capacity and operational stability of large-scale AC-DC hybrid power grids. This paper sorts out various power transmission scenarios under Global Energy Interconnection (GEI), summarizes the needs of advanced transmission technologies, and proposes the key technologies including IGCT-based UHV VSC DC transmission, storage-based active DC power transmission, and wide DC grid. Europe is taken as an example to make a DC power grid simulation model research to verify the feasibility and applicability of the above advanced transmission technologies.

articleTitle: An optimal configuration method of voltage sag monitoring points considering monitoring redundancy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to make full use of the redundant information of voltage sag monitoring devices and form a unified configuration scheme selection sequence, an optimal configuration method of voltage sag monitoring devices considering the monitoring redundancy is proposed. Based on the observability matrix of the system, a multi-objective optimization model that satisfies the observable sag state of the entire network is established. The model takes the minimum number of monitoring devices and the maximum average redundancy as the objective functions, and it is solved by Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm -II(NSGA-II). The obtained results have a small number of monitoring devices, a large average redundancy and a unique optimal configuration scheme. The proposed method is proved to be correct and effective by simulating a newly constructed diamond distribution network in a certain area of Shanghai.

articleTitle: Research on Approximate Fault Current Expression in Hybrid Multi-terminal HVDC Network During DC-Side Fault
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the traditional DC fault analysis without considering in detail the nonlinear change in the trigger angle and the influence of AC current feeding on the DC-side during a fault, a new DC-side fault analysis method for hybrid multi-terminal HVDC networks is proposed in this paper, which can provide some theoretical reference for DC protection configuration of HVDC transmission project under construction. Firstly, the equivalent Laplace transform model of three terminal LCC-VSC-VSC network is established, and the trigger angle of LCC-side in case of fault is linearized by the least square method, and then the approximate fault current expression is obtained. Secondly, using the commonly used inner-loop PI control model of inverter-side VSC-HVDC to analyze the influence of AC current feeding on DC side fault current, and then obtain its expression. Finally, the simulation based on Matlab / Simulink verifies the correctness of the fault analysis method.

articleTitle: Study on flashover characteristics of vehicle train roof insulator under off-line overvoltage of bow mesh based on HANKE model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The article discusses whether the high-speed train roof insulators will flashover under the impact of the off-line overvoltage at the pantograph network in certain environment. Taking the epoxy resin insulator of the roof pantograph as the research object, establish a calculation and analysis model for the transient overvoltage which the roof high voltage system composed of the pantograph catenary, rail and integrated grounding system. A insulator flashover model also is established which considering the pollution distribution and high-speed airflow. The flashover characteristics on the insulator is obtained by combining the test wind tunnel and COMSOL simulation. This research provides a reference value for structural design and optimization based on improving the insulation performance of roof insulators.

articleTitle: Transient DC Bias Elimination of Dual Active Bridge Based on Minimum RMS Current
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposed a strategy to suppress the transient dc bias current of dual active bridge (DAB) converters. To investigate the modulation scheme for suppressing the transient dc bias current, the article reviews the fundamental-duty-modulation (FDM) control strategy derived from the minimum RMS current. The improved-Fundamental-Duty-Cycle (IFDM) method can transition to a steady state within one cycle by changing the shift phase of the transient period. Finally, the IFDM strategy is verified and compared with the traditional phase-shift modulation strategy through simulation experiments. Simulation results show that the IFDM scheme for the change of transmission power can obtain faster dynamic response speed and fewer losses, further developing transmission effectiveness.

articleTitle: Four Segment Deadbeat Control with Dead Time Compensation for PMSM Drive
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new four segment deadbeat control strategy with dead time compensation for permanent magnet synchronous motor is proposed. This control strategy is based on three vector deadbeat control strategy. Due to its zero vector sorting method, it has the advantages of good steady-state performance and low switching frequency. On this basis, the dead time effect is judged, and deadbeat principle and minimum pulsation theory are adopted, the calculation of vector action time is optimized.

articleTitle: A Voltage Level Shifter with Fast Level Translation Speed
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In modern integrated circuit design, in order to pursue low power consumption, different circuits could be set to work in different operating voltages. In order to achieve correct signal transmission between different operating voltages, voltage level shifter circuit is needed. This paper proposes a new structure of voltage level shifter, by using edge fast response and current transient enhancement mechanism, which can achieve stable voltage conversion with fast conversion speed. The circuit is designed based on the SMIC 180 nm standard CMOS process. Based on simulation results, the voltage conversion from 1.8 V to 5 V with delay time of 1.51 ns can be achieved.

articleTitle: Dual-Redundancy Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors Phase-to-Phase Short Circuit Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the design of permanent magnet synchronous motors, the residual degree technique is used to improve the reliability of motor operation. In this paper, to solve the problem of single-phase, two-phase or three-phase short-circuit faults in the winding of a dual-redundancy permanent magnet synchronous motors(DRPMSM), a variational modal decomposition(VMD)method is proposed to use the energy information of the intrinsic modal component(IMF)of the non-faulty winding phase current signal as the fault feature vector. By splitting the stator winding and changing the control circuit, a finite element model of motor short-circuit fault based on the joint simulation of Ansys and Simulink is constructed. Finally, a genetic algorithm is used for fault diagnosis, while a support vector machine(GA-SVM)fault diagnosis model based on a genetic algorithm is established and analyzed for fault samples. The results show that the diagnosis is accurate and reliable, and the effectiveness of the method is verified.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Windproof Cylinder on the Performance of Solar Vortex Power-desalination Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Environmental crosswinds have a negative impact on the stability of the cyclone column of the solar vortex power-desalination integrated system. The setting of windproof cylinder is one of the measures to deal with its impact. In this paper, the flow field characteristics of the system are analyzed on the basis of the established three-dimensional numerical simulation. The effects of crosswinds in the vortex area and windproof cylinder height on the system performance are studied. The research shows the existence of windproof cylinder delays the direct contact between the hot air flow and the outside air, thus raising the temperature of the vortex center. At the same windproof cylinder height, the freshwater production of the system slightly increases when the crosswind speed increases from 0 m/s to 1 m/s. But as the incoming wind speed continues to increase, the system performance deteriorates. As the windproof cylinder height increases, the maximum negative pressure at the vortex center, the mass flow rate at the heat collector entrance and the hourly freshwater production continue to increase. But too high a windproof cylinder will weaken the rotating wind field, aggravate the negative effect of the windproof cylinder shadow and increase the construction cost. Considering the technical economy, the reasonable height of the windproof cylinder in this example is 20-30 m.

articleTitle: Dynamic Stability Analysis of Active Distribution Network Based on Recovery in Off-grid Process
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper studied the dynamic stability in active distribution network's off-grid process, which included dynamic rotor angle, frequency and voltage stability. From perspectives of theory and experiments, they both proved that an active distribution network which includes high percent of new energy generators could keep dynamic stable in its off-grid process under certain conditions, which lays the foundation for regional recovery of distribution network.

articleTitle: Independent Voltage Regulation Method of Multi-frequency Multiple-Receiver WPT Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to better improve the compatibility of wireless charging devices, multi-frequency multiple-receiver wireless power transfer systems with a single inverter have attracted attention increasingly. However, how to regulate each load voltage is still a unique challenge in such system. To solve the problem, this paper proposes a regulation method combining multi-frequency modulation and proportional integral (PI) control. The multi-frequency modulation is based on delta-sigma modulation (DSM) principle and improved specific harmonic elimination pulse-width modulation (SHEPWM) principle. In proposed method, a hybrid multi-frequency modulator is designed to drive inverter to transmit multi-frequency power, which can not only make each receiver absorb power simultaneously, but also adjust load voltage of multiple receivers independently and continuously. Further, multiple PI controllers are applied to constitute a closed-loop controller, which achieves precise regulation and enhances the stability and dynamic response capability of system. With this method, just one full-bridge inverter supplies power to multiple receivers simultaneously, and the switching frequency is lower compared with other methods. Finally, the feasibility and superiority of proposed method are verified by theoretical analysis and experiments.

Author Keywords: specific harmonic elimination pulse width modulation (SHEPWM)

articleTitle: Effect of Silicone Grease Coating on Space Charge Characteristics of XLPE / SIR Interface
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Silicone rubber (SIR) for cable accessories insulation is easy to absorb the silicone grease coated on the interface between accessories and cable insulation to swell, thus affecting the interface charge characteristics. In order to study the effect of silicone grease coating on the spatial charge distribution of the cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) / SIR interface under different aging methods, two silicone greases with large polarity difference were selected, one was ordinary silicone grease, and the other was silicon fluoride grease with large polarity. The silicone rubber coated with silicone grease was subjected to normal temperature aging, corona aging and wet aging, respectively. The spatial charge distribution of the XLPE / SIR sample coated with silicone grease was measured by electroacoustic pulse method (PEA). The results show that under different aging conditions, the charge polarity accumulated at the interface of the samples coated with two kinds of silicone greases is mainly positive polarity, that is, the polarity is the same as the polarity of the electrode on the side of the silicone rubber, and the silicone grease with larger polarity makes the interface of the samples easier to accumulate charge. Under different aging modes, both silicone resins have swelling effects on silicone rubber, resulting in the migration of positive charges at the XLPE / SIR interlayer interface to silicone rubber. The interface charge accumulation caused by wet aging is the largest, followed by room temperature aging, and finally corona aging.

articleTitle: Analysis on a Novel Eddy current - magnet track composite brake for high-speed train
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A novel eddy current-magnetic track composite brake (EC-MTB) for high-speed trains is first proposed in this paper. As a non-adhesive braking device, the brake can effectively make up for braking force shortage resulted by adhesion coefficient decrease of a high-speed train. The brake, consisting of alternating permanent magnet (PM) braking sections and electromagnetic braking sections, can work under eddy current braking and magnetic track braking modes. The function of excitation can be turned on and off by rotating the upper PM in the PM brake. Alternating or isotropic magnetic fields can be generated on the rail by changing the current direction in the electromagnetic brake. The paper firstly introduces the structure and working principle of the composite brake and then investigates characteristics of static and transient magnetic fields as well as braking performance through 3D finite element simulation (3D-FEM), which proves that the brake can lead to a deceleration of not less than 0.1m/s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> for a 60T carriage in the magnetic track mode and generate around IOOON braking force under the eddy current mode.

articleTitle: Operation optimization of section III of distance protection based on DC information
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Failure of the DC system itself to withdraw from operation or failure of the AC system causing blocking of the DC system may result in a tidal shift to overload the AC line. Unreasonable tripping of the AC line's distance III backup protection based on local information drives the development of chain tripping incidents and can lead to significant outages. For this reason, a method based on conservation and control synergy is proposed, using DC control information to optimise AC distance III backup protection action behaviour. When the tidal shift triggered by the DC phase change failure blocking makes the distance protection section III act unreasonably, the DC control information is used as the activation condition for the backup protection action range adjustment to improve reliability and prevent the backup protection from acting unreasonably. Finally, the effectiveness of the above strategy is verified by PSCAD software simulation.

articleTitle: Orderly Charging Control Strategy of Electric Vehicles Based on Optimal Power Allocation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Disorderly charging of large-scale electric vehicles will affect the economic and safety operation of power grid. An orderly charging control strategy based on optimal power dispatch is proposed for the coordination of charging demand of electric vehicle and safety operation of power grid in this paper. The strategy comprehensively considers the charging demand, resident load level and the peak-valley different of the day’s load. The objective function of the proposed method is to minimum the peak-valley load of distribution network, and shifting the demand charging of electric vehicle from the peak period of power consumption to the power valley period and improve the charging effective of electric vehicles. Finally, an example is presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method applied in the orderly charging of large-scale electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Hybrid Scheduling Strategy Based on New Energy Consumption And Optimal Operation Cost
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of large-scale new energy consumption and the problems of randomness, volatility and intermittence, a multi-objective optimization model with the largest new energy consumption and the smallest system operation cost is established in this paper. By introducing the hybrid NSGAII-MOPSO algorithm, on the premise of maximizing the consumption of wind power and photovoltaic power, the primary energy consumption of thermal power units is reduced as much as possible, so as to achieve the purpose of energy conservation and emission reduction. The hybrid algorithm can obtain well distributed and diversified Pareto optimal solutions, and converge to the actual Pareto optimal frontier faster than some existing algorithms. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness of the model and algorithm. The simulation results show that the model can well reduce the operation cost and greatly promote the consumption of wind power and photovoltaic power generation.

articleTitle: Research on Management Method of System of Records in Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Data is one of the core production factors and coreassets of the power industry. The effective management of system of records is the key to efficient data sharing and effective value development. We considered the limitations of the existing data management methods in the power industry, and analyzed the new demand of the power industry for system of records management in digital transformation. On the basis of “a data has only one data source, a data is managed by a subject of liability, a data can be used many times”, we proposed a new management system of system of records that enables the system of records management institutionalized and standardized. Combined with typical application scenarios, the specific application process of the method is given in this paper.

articleTitle: A Day-ahead Scheduling Strategy for Electric vehicles Based on Converted Economical Objective
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of electric vehicles (EVs), the connection of a large number of EVs to the power grid has adversely affected the economic operation and system stability of the power grid. Therefore, research on the effective dispatch of EVs is of great significance. This paper proposes a day-ahead scheduling strategy for EVs based on converted economical objective, which makes full use of the flexibility of EV loads, takes into account the interests of the grid side and the user side, and reduces the negative impact of EVs connected to the grid. For the limitation of the objective function with the smallest variance, objective function converts the technical index of grid load peak-to-valley difference into an economic index with the smallest charging cost for users, and uses CPLEX to solve the day-ahead scheduling model of small-scale fast charging stations. The calculation example shows that this strategy can effectively reduce the peak-to-valley difference of grid load, which proves the rationality of the strategy.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Adaptive Power Control of Frequency Regulation of PV and Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increase of photovoltaic (PV) generation in microgrid, the frequency response capability of system decrease continuously, it is urgent to participate in frequency regulation of PV generation system and energy storage system. Therefore, a fuzzy adaptive sliding mode control strategy for PV system and a droop control strategy for the energy storage system is proposed for making the PV system and the energy storage system cooperatively participate in frequency regulation of the microgrid. For the PV fuzzy adaptive sliding mode control of the PV system, the sliding mode surface function is firstly designed according to the PV power-voltage characteristic curve, and then the adaptive sliding mode surface compensation is designed to provide adaptive power reserve for regulating frequency of microgrid in both the up and down directions. For the droop control strategy of the energy storage system, the current control loop and power control loop are designed, and the adaptive charging and discharging power control strategy is designed to collaboratively participate in the frequency regulation of the microgrid by frequency deviation. The control strategy is designed that has some advantages. It doesn’t need maximum power estimators, irradiance sensors, communication devices, and detailed PV models. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed control strategy can effectively suppress the bidirectional frequency fluctuation of the microgrid.

articleTitle: High-precision Digital Phase Discriminator Based on Adaptive Sampling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A high-precision digital phase discriminator based on adaptive sampling is proposed for an antenna automatic tuning system. FFT is used to detect the phase. The output signal of the tuning system is a periodic signal with a non-constant frequency. To reduce spectrum leakage, adaptive sampling is employed to realize phase detection of sinusoidal periodic signals in a certain frequency range. In addition, the antenna automatic tuning system outputs non-sinusoidal periodic low-power signals during tuning. By adding a frequency comparison in the adaptive sampling process, the phase detection of non-sinusoidal periodic signal in a certain frequency range is realized. The combination of odd-even frequency division and half-integer frequency division is adopted to reduce the phenomenon of spectrum leakage. A phase discrimination experiment platform is constructed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed phase discriminator. The accordance between the analysis and experimental results further testify to the advantages.

articleTitle: Implementation Scheme and Feasibility Analysis of Intensification of Maintenance and Inspection for Offshore Wind Power in Guangdong Province
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The offshore wind power in Guangdong Province has developed to a certain scale, but the maintenance and inspection of the offshore wind power is not systematic, and the management is relatively loose. Therefore, it is necessary to implement intensive maintenance and inspection mode for offshore wind power in Guangdong Province. In this paper, combined with the actual situation of wind power development in Guangdong Province, an implementation scheme intensification of maintenance and inspection scheme for offshore wind power is proposed, and the feasibility of the scheme is analyzed in combination with the actual situation of Yangjiang center. Some valuable conclusions are obtained, which have certain guiding significance for the specific offshore wind power maintenance and inspection.

articleTitle: Design and development of smart terminal self-sensing module
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of the Internet of Things, the scalability and efficiency of the Internet are not enough to process the big data of the Internet of Things. The edge agent platform tilts the powerful computing and storage capabilities and user-satisfactory business service capabilities to the user side and migrates to the edge of the network to meet the needs of users to securely obtain Internet of Things services. This paper designs a security monitoring module, including host system security monitoring; Docker system security configuration monitoring; container security monitoring; linkage control configuration management and eBPF kernel-level security monitoring. The architecture, technology and design of each part are described in detail, and the interface of the module is configured. It provides a new and available solution for the security protection of edge IoT agents.

articleTitle: Research on calculation of ship magnetic field based on recursive iterative algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the current magnetic field estimation method has poor estimation accuracy due to insufficient magnetic field data, a recursive iterative algorithm suitable for the magnetic field estimation of ships with small data amount is proposed. The formula of the recursive iterative algorithm was deduced first, and the feasibility of the method was verified by numerical simulation. Then the calculation results of the recursive iteration method were compared with the boundary integral method, and finally the validity of the simulation conclusion was verified by the magnetic ship model experiment. The results show that the magnetic field estimation accuracy of the proposed recursive iterative algorithm in the near field of the ship is higher than that of the boundary integration method, and the reduction of magnetic field data has less influence on the algorithm than the boundary integration method. The proposed recursive iterative algorithm is suitable for the near-field magnetic field estimation of ships with a small amount of data. The relative root mean square error of the estimation is less than 5% within the estimation depth of 1.5B, and the relative root mean square error of the estimation within the estimation depth of 2.5B is less than 10%.

articleTitle: Experimental study on electrical characteristics of iced glass suspension ground wire insulator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under cold weather conditions, the icing of ground wire insulator will pose a challenge to the insulation coordination between air gap and the insulator itself. It can also increase the probability of abnormal discharge which will lead to power loss. In this paper, the development process of arc is recorded by an ultrahigh-speed camera, and the effects of icing thickness and freezing water conductivity on air gap breakdown voltage are studied. The surface electric field of ground wire insulator under different icing thicknesses and freezing water conductivities is simulated and analyzed by simulation software. Furthermore, the influence of the above factors on the maximum surface electric field intensity of ground wire insulator is also investigated. The simulation and experimental results show that both the gap breakdown voltage decreases while the maximum surface electric field intensity increases with the increase of icing thickness. The increase of freezing water conductivity will cause the gap breakdown voltage to decrease first and then levels off. For the maximum surface electric field intensity, it increases first and then remain unchanged with the increase of freezing water conductivity. In addition, the observation results show that the arc is always initiated from the bottom of the plate electrode during air gap breakdown.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Feedforward Compensation For 3-Phase Coupled Buck-Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, asymmetric operation of the 3-phase coupled buck-boost converter is analyzed. The form and solution process of the asymmetric operation are complicate, but the solution can be expressed and calculated in a simple form. By using parallel feedforward control, the dynamic performance of 3-phase coupled buck-boost converter can be improved obviously. Accuracy and effectiveness of the analysis and calculation are verified with the results of simulation and experiments.

articleTitle: The Partial Discharge Characteristics of PI Film Modified by Nano-Al₂O₃ in Liquid Nitrogen
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The polyimide (PI) film is used as the internal insulation system in the high-temperature superconducting transformer due to its excellent mechanical and electrical performance. Many researchers had found that nanoparticle mixing can improve the polymer’s insulation properties. The partial discharge(PD) will induce the deterioration and even breakdown of the insulating materials. In the paper, the PI films modified by nano-A1<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> were prepared in situ polymerization. The particle size of Al<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> nanoparticle used in this research is 10 nm, and the mass fraction is 1wt%, 3wt%, 5wt% and 7wt%, respectively. The volume resistivity, surface resistivity and partial discharge initial voltage (PDIV) are measured in liquid nitrogen(LN). The experimental results indicate that adding of 3wt% nanoparticle is the optimum ratio to suppress the PD in the PI films.

articleTitle: Research on integrated calculation method of theoretical line loss of MV and LV distribution Network based on Adaboost integrated learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of system and index dispersion of line loss assessment in MV and LV distribution network, this paper proposes a integrational theoretical line loss calculation method of MV and LV distribution network based on rough set and Adaboost. The influence factors of theoretical line loss of medium and low voltage distribution network are analyzed from three aspects: network structure, operation characteristics and equipment characteristics. Combined with rough set theory, the influence degree of each influencing factor on theoretical line loss was calculated, and the characteristic parameters of model training were selected based on this. Finally, based on integrated adaboost learning algorithm, the integrated theoretical line loss calculation model of MV and LV distribution network is constructed. The calculated theoretical line loss can provide unified line loss assessment index for daily line loss management of MV and LV network, simplify line loss management workflow, optimize operation and maintenance resource allocation, and then improve line loss management efficiency of MV and LV distribution network.

articleTitle: Stochastic optimization scheme of power cost in intelligent community with energy storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, we aim to improve the utilization rate of renewable energy, and reduce the power consumption cost of intelligent community with the help of energy storage units. Considering the stochastic characteristics of the renewable energy and the load demand, we formulate a stochastic optimization problem to minimize the time average power cost while meeting the maximum delay demand. Using Lyapunov stochastic optimization theory, we first transform the NP-hard stochastic optimization problem into a series of linear optimization problems, in which the allocation strategy of elastic load is optimized for each time slot. Simulation results show that our proposed approach can effectively reduce the time average cost of power consumption.

articleTitle: Calculation of Short-Circuit Current of Doubly-Fed Variable-Speed Pumped Storage Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The calculation of short-circuit current of doubly-fed variable-speed pumped storage unit (DFVSPSU) is studied, this paper studies the analytical expression of short-circuit current from the flux transient process. Based on the transient analysis method of three-phase short-circuit current of DFVSPSU, this paper firstly establishes the mathematical model of DFVSPSU and the transient equivalent circuits of stator and rotor when three-phase short-circuit fault occurs in the grid. The transient process of stator and rotor flux faults is analyzed, and then the expressions of steady-state and transient components of stator flux after faults are obtained. On this basis, the expression of three-phase short-circuit current of DFVSPSU is derived. Simulation verifies the accuracy of the three-phase current expression proposed in this paper. This paper studies the influence of the distance between the short-circuit point and DFVSPSU on the feedback short-circuit current under pumping operation mode, and proposes the distance of short-circuit point that can ignore the influence of feedback short-circuit current, which provides technical support for safe and stable operation of pumped storage power station.

articleTitle: A Primary Frequency Control Strategy for the Hybrid PV-CSP System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The hybrid PV (photovoltaic)- CSP (concentrating solar power) system is developing rapidly in recent years due to the cost reduction and operational flexibility, which makes it a good candidate in power system frequency regulation. This paper proposes a primary frequency control strategy for the hybrid PV-CSP system. The proposed strategy is based on a hierarchical control structure and take the state of energy (SOE) into consideration, which coordinates the PV and CSP subsystems to provide frequency support. The effectiveness of the strategy is verified by Matlab/Simulink. The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy has good frequency regulation ability under various operating conditions.

articleTitle: Influence of hybrid reactive power compensation on interrupting characteristics of three-phase grounding fault
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Referring to the relevant parameters of UHV demonstration project, aiming at the three-phase grounding fault of UHV transmission line with hybrid reactive power compensation, the changes of open current and transient recovery voltage are analyzed by numerical calculation and simulation. Based on the arc extinguishing mode and arc extinguishing medium of circuit breaker, the evaluation index of circuit breaker caustic scale is proposed. Based on the equivalent model of three-phase grounding fault of UHV transmission line, the calculation formula affecting the breaking performance of circuit breaker is derived, and the effects of fault location, hybrid reactive power compensation degree and other factors on the interrupting characteristics of three-phase grounding fault circuit breaker are analyzed.

articleTitle: Terminal Sliding-Mode Observer for PMSM with Resistance Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposed a sensorless speed control strategy of a permanent-magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) using a full-order terminal sliding-mode observer (FOTSMO) with the stator resistance estimated. In the proposed observer, the low pass filter (LPF) in the conventional sliding-mode observer (SMO) is removed, so the control strategy can overcome the time delay and weaken the chattering phenomenon. Meanwhile, the time-varying stator resistance is identified online to improve the steady-state performance of the observer. The stator resistance adaptive law is determined by the Lyapunov second method, and the stability of the FOTSMO is proved. the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by simulations and experiments.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis for Transformer Rectifier Unit on More-Electric Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As important secondary power supply equipment in aircraft power supply system, the normal operation of transformer rectifier unit is of great significance for the safe operation of aircraft. Taking the transformer rectifier unit as the research object, the paper has completed the diode fault analysis and fault characteristic parameter extraction. First of all, the simulation analysis was carried out for the two kinds of abrupt faults of diode short-circuit and open-circuit in TRU. By comparing the different characteristics of diodes at different positions under different fault types, the parameters with obvious changes such as the effective value and amplitude of three-phase input current, the output current of rectifier bridges I and II, and output voltage of TRU were selected as the characteristic parameters of diode fault type diagnosis and location. At the same time, aiming at the problem that the characteristic parameters of open-circuit fault are not obvious and cannot be located accurately, PCA dimensionality reduction algorithm and SVM classification algorithm were used to study the fault location of open-circuit diode.

articleTitle: Economical Configuration of Shared Energy Storage for Industrial Consumers and Profit Allocation Based on Cooperative Game
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Many industrial energy consumers spontaneously install energy storage (ES) to reduce the electricity cost by modifying the original load profiles. But the economic feedback is often poor because of the high installation cost of ES, the low utilization rate and their relatively fixed load patterns. In order to motivate more consumers to participate in demand management with ES and cater for the commercial application of ES on the user side, an economical configuration model of shared ES for industrial consumers and profit allocation is proposed based on cooperative game in this paper. Considering the benefit of each consumer in the whole shared ES life cycle under the two-part and the time-of-use (TOU) electricity price mechanism, a Nash bargaining problem is formulated and solved by being equivalently transformed into two consecutive subproblems. Case study of four industrial consumers in Jiangsu, China shows the model proposed in this paper can greatly improve the collective welfare and individual welfare by fully taking advantage of different load characteristics compared with individual ES scenario. On the other hand, consumers using shared ES respond to the guidance of TOU electricity price policy to a greater extent, further easing the pressure of the power grid during peak period.

articleTitle: A method for detecting a novel stealthy profit-oriented cyber attack
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper studies the behavior of profit-oriented stealthy aggregate load attack on the power grid, and designs the corresponding countermeasures. As for the attack behavior analysis, from the perspective of attackers, we study the stealthy FDIA scenarios that can elude BDD and bring more benefits to the attacker (accomplice generators). With the aid of raw load data obtained from the studied attack scenarios and normal operational scenarios, a random forest-based classifier is used for data expansion. Based on the expanded data, a detector that can distinguish the profit-oriented aggregate load attacks is designed using the support vector machine. We use the benchmark IEEE 30-bus system to demonstrate the stealthy load attack and validate the effectiveness of the proposed detector. The simulation results show that when the threshold is selected appropriately, the designed attack detection classifier can achieve nearly 100% detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Performance of High-Speed PM Machine with Different Materials
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-speed permanent magnet (HSPM) machines need higher power density with the department of electrification. In order to obtain higher torque density, HSPM machines have been operated under high electromagnetic load. Meanwhile, the selection of materials with different properties can greatly influence the performance of the high power density HSPM machines. In this paper, the influence of different combinations of stator core and rotor PM material on the performance of a high-speed PM machine is compared and analyzed. The electromagnetic performance of the machines including air-gap flux density, back-EMF, electromagnetic torque and loss distribution, and mechanical performance of PM and rotor sleeve are obtained using finite element analysis, and some conclusions are drawn based on the comparison results.

articleTitle: A Stochastic Security-Constrained Unit Commitment Model Considering Uncertain Dynamic Capacity-Increase of Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The rapid increase of the penetration of renewable energy resources in power systems brings great difficulties to the power system operator in solving the security-constrained unit commitment (SCUC). This paper proposes a SCUC model considering the impact of uncertainties of environmental factors on the transmission power limits by the dynamic capacity-increase technique. The heat distribution process, including thermal radiation, thermal convection, and solar absorption, is regarded as the decisive factor of the steady-state temperature of the transmission line conductor. Along with uncertainties of other factors like wind speed and sunshine intensity, this paper applies multi-scenario technology to transform the uncertain problem into multiple deterministic scenario problems. Finally, the proposed model is verified on the IEEE 24-bus test system. Finally, the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed model are demonstrated on several test systems.

articleTitle: Effect of Pulse Polarity and Dielectric Configuration on the Spatio-Temporal Evolution Characteristics of Methane Pulsed Dielectric Barrier Discharge Plasma
