abstract: Power electronic transformer is the key equipment to realize the flexible access of distributed energy and new load/energy storage in distribution network. In this paper, the robustness analysis and optimal design of circuit parameters are carried out for CLLC DC transformer used in high frequency isolation link of SST. CLLC DC transformer can use open loop control to simplify control complexity, realize nearly constant bidirectional voltage gain in a wide range, and use the leakage inductance of high-frequency transformer as resonant inductance to reduce the difficulty of circuit design. In this paper, a parameter design method for CLLC DC transformer is proposed. Using this method, the designed CLLC DC transformer has good voltage regulation ability and wide range soft switching characteristics even when the inductance and capacitance value have design deviation. The influence of parasitic parameters of high-frequency isolation transformer and device on the voltage gain of DC transformer under light load is analyzed, Finally, a typical DC transformer is designed and verified by simulation in PSIM software.

articleTitle: Thermal Stability Analysis of 2G High Temperature Superconducting (HTS) Tapes under DC Shock
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the electro-thermal coupling calculation of 2G HTS tapes are carried out through theoretical analysis and finite element simulation to analyze the temperature change and heat accumulation process of tapes during DC impact, and the influence of the reinforcement layer on the thermal stability of 2G THS tapes at impact is studied. The temperature change and quenching of superconductivity recovery process of 2G HTS tapes were measured at different impulse current amplitudes and impulse times. For superconducting cables with clad insulation, the heat generated during a short-circuit shock will be absorbed mainly by the 2G HTS tapes at the beginning and will be gradually conducted out only after a few seconds. Since superconducting cables often use a thicker copper reinforcement layer, their thermal stability is also relatively high, which is more conducive to enhancing the stability of superconducting cables in the event of a short-circuit fault. Based on the simulation and experimental results, this paper describes the electro-thermal change law of 2G THS tapes during DC impact, and obtains the critical threshold and thermal stability boundary of 2G THS tapes, which provides the basis for the analysis and design of high temperature superconducting DC cables.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influencing Factors of Discrete Equipment Action in Converter station Considering DC Control Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the background of AC/DC hybrid power grid with “strong DC and weak AC”, the safe operation of DC system has attracted more and more attention, especially the frequent action of discrete equipment in converter station. The frequent action of discrete equipment will reduce the service life of equipment and even cause equipment failure. Therefore, it is very necessary to fully consider the voltage and reactive power characteristics and control mode of converter station in the voltage control strategy of DC near area. On the basis of fully considering the voltage and reactive power characteristics of converter station and the control strategy of discrete equipment, this paper deduces the quantitative formula of voltage and reactive power sensitivity of rectifier and inverter under the typical control mode of constant power at rectifier and constant extinction angle at inverter. Under the DC control mode considering the correlation between the sending and receiving converter stations, the multi angle simulation analysis is carried out on the influence of the two main factors of DC transmission power and converter bus voltage on the action frequency of discrete equipment in the converter station, and finally the corresponding conclusions are drawn, which provides theoretical support for the subsequent research of AC and DC systems.

articleTitle: IoT Terminal Recognition Method Based on Linear Discriminant Spectral Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Access to a large number of wireless devices brings serious security risks to the Internet of Things (IoT). The RF fingerprint (RFF) identification technology realizes the device’s unique authentication by extracting the subtle characteristics of the wireless device hardware, which can effectively solve the wireless network security problem. Aiming that the accuracy of traditional RFF identification methods declines rapidly with the decrease of SNR, this paper proposed an RFF identification method based on linear discriminate spectral analysis (LDSA). First, we calculated the optimal projection matrix, then extracted the average power spectral density characteristics of multiple consecutive preambles of the candidate device, and finally used the minimum centroid criterion in the subspace for device identification. Based on theoretical analysis, we conduct experiments on different software-defined radios and achieves an accuracy of more than 75% above 15 dB. Compared with the baseline algorithms, the identification accuracy is improved by more than 10% on average.

articleTitle: Improved Current-type LC Parallel Resonant Converter Based on Energy Storage Application and Frequency Regulation Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved current type LC parallel resonant bi-directional isolated DC-DC converter with high efficiency and wide current regulation range for the application of interconnection of battery bank and DC bus in distributed energy storage as the interface between battery and DC bus. By establishing a simplified model of the converter and deriving the resonant inductor current, resonant capacitor voltage and output inductor current in the time domain, the resonant capacitor voltage gain curve and current transfer ratio curve are obtained in the average value, and the time domain analysis avoids the errors caused by the conventional fundamental analysis method when the switching frequency differs from the resonant frequency. The above derived current transfer ratio curves show that the proposed converter has a wide current regulation range for energy storage applications, and therefore, the converter can realize the control of energy storage charging and discharging with frequency modulation. Finally, a 7.5kW, 50V to 300V prototype with a power density of 1.15W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and a peak efficiency of 96.70% is built, and the validity of the previous analysis is experimentally verified.

articleTitle: Solution and analysis of the electromagnetic scattering field of the substation under the radiation of the 5G base station antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the irradiation of electromagnetic waves from the 5G base station antenna, the densely distributed equipment in the substation produces a strong secondary scattering phenomenon due to the coupling effect, which may have a great impact on the solution of the electromagnetic scattering field in the substation. Therefore, on the basis of the electromagnetic scattering of electrically large targets in traditional wide-area space, this paper proposes a scattering field calculation method that considers the mutual coupling of electrical equipment in substations. The accuracy of the algorithm is verified by the actual measurement of the 500kV Guandu substation. Taking the 500kV Guandu substation as an example, the algorithm is used to solve the electric field strength near the electrical equipment under different antenna powers and inclination angles of the 5G base station antenna, it is then compared to traditional algorithms. The results show that when the 5G base station antenna power is 200W and the inclination angle is 10°, the secondary scattering between substation equipment is the most serious.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Coordinated Control Strategy of Multi-port Energy Router
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper takes the energy router with DC bus as the research object. Due to the needs of DC bus voltage stability regulation in the energy router, a voltage hierarchical coordinated control method using the droop control principle is proposed. The DC bus voltage of the system is divided into three layers. In different voltage control layers, grid connected unit, energy storage unit and photovoltaic unit are used as voltage sources to control bus voltage stability and power balance. This control method only needs each converter to control its own working state according to the local voltage signal, and does not need the communication line between the central controller and each converter, which can simplify the system structure. A simulation model is built in Matlab / Simulink to verify the proposed voltage hierarchical coordinated control strategy. The simulation results show that the control strategy can realize the stable operation of the energy router, and the operation modes of each converter can switch smoothly, which verifies the effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: A Novel Dynamic Energy Model and Damping Evaluation Method of DFIG Grid-connected System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the uncertain mechanism of sub-synchronous oscillation caused by the connection of Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) and series compensation equipment, this paper proposes a method for analyzing the damping characteristics of sub-synchronous oscillations based on dynamic energy model. Firstly, using the dynamic energy of the DFIG and series compensation, combined with the induction generator equation of the DFIG, the converter control equation and the series compensation equation, the dynamic energy function under the electromagnetic transient scale is constructed. On this basis, considering the actual measurement conditions, calculating the dynamic energy under sub-synchronous frequency disturbance, obtaining the oscillation energy reflecting the interaction of the DFIG turbine and series compensation, and then construct the oscillation energy stability criterion for grid-connected system of the DFIG. Quantitative analysis of the energy interaction between the DFIG and series compensation by the oscillation energy reveals the influence mechanism of series compensation on the sub-synchronous oscillation. Finally, combined with the DFIG actual parameters, the above method is verified on the RTLAB simulation platform. The results show that the dynamic energy can accurately reflect the influence of DFIG-Series compensation, which showing negative damping characteristics in the sub-synchronous oscillation.

articleTitle: Research on Pantograph Condition Monitoring Based on Video Image
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: During the high-speed operation of the train, sparks are generated between the pantograph and the contact line, and electrical wear affects the reliability of the train’s pantograph network, which may cause operational safety accidents in severe cases. In this paper, a video image-based pantograph spark recognition algorithm is proposed. The pantograph area can be determined through the YOLOv4 neural network algorithm. The RGB and HIS color model criteria are used to obtain the spark color feature area, combined with the R component dynamic background differential judgment. The Wiener filter algorithm is used to process the dithered and blurred image. According to the spark generation area, the three-frame dynamic background subtraction and gray difference area criterion are used to eliminate the background interference of train operation, which can accurately identify the intensity of spark discharge in the video image, and the frequency of sparks can be combined to give an alarm. The simulation experiment results show that the detection accuracy of the spark recognition algorithm proposed in this paper is 98.0%, which significantly improves the accuracy of spark recognition and detection.

articleTitle: Study on the Electric Water Shock Effects in the Bursting Energy Tests on the Capacitor Case for HVDC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: From the development evolution the bursting energy test on the capacitor case, combining with the principle of electric water shocks, it is analyzed that the electric water shock effects in the bursting energy test on the capacitor case by divided it into model 1 with short circuit and model 2 with no short circuit in this paper. Got the calculation method of the impulse current increase rate in the test and proposed the methods estimate the pressure caused by the current wave front in test and got a result that the pressure may reach 1112 atmospheres by the electric water shocks in model 1. It is explained the failure phenomenon of bushing fracture in the bursting energy test on the capacitor case and put forward a typical failure current waveform that in the test. The writer hope this paper be helpful to solve the problems of the bursting energy test on the capacitor case.

Author Keywords: Bursting Energy Test on Capacitor Case

articleTitle: Reconfiguration of the electric vehicle integrated distribution system considering carbon-reduction benefit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The extensive use of electric vehicles (EVs) can reduce carbon emission. However, when electric vehicles are getting plugged into the grid on a large scale, it will bring power fluctuations to the grid and affect its stable operation. In order to ensure the smooth, economic and low-carbon operation of the distribution network, this paper proposes a reconfiguration method of the electric vehicle integrated distribution system with consideration of carbon-reduction benefits. The proposed model takes the factors that affect the comprehensive cost of the distribution network into accounts, such as network losses cost and system carbon emission cost, and realizes the optimal dispatch of power resources. To verify the effectiveness of the model, this paper uses the IEEE 33-node distribution system connected to electric vehicle charging stations as an example, and uses MATLAB to conduct simulations. The simulation result shows that the established optimization model can effectively cut down the comprehensive cost of distribution system.

articleTitle: Transient Voltage Stability Assessment Based on an Improved TCN-BiLSTM Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to further improve the accuracy of power system transient voltage stability assessment, a power system transient stability assessment method based on improved TCN-BiLSTM is proposed in this paper. Taking the time series of power system bottom measurement data as the input, TCN network with attention enhancement module and BiLSTM network are used to extract timing features in parallel, Then, the transient voltage stability of the system is judged by feature fusion, and the cost-sensitivity coefficient is added to the loss function to improve the correct judgment ability of unstable samples. The test results of New England 10 machine 39 node test system show that the proposed method has better evaluation performance than monomer neural network and traditional machine learning methods

Author Keywords: Bi directional long short memory network

articleTitle: A linearized battery degradation model based on NN for V2G coordination programming
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Vehicle to grid (V2G) is an important way to enhance stability and reliability of the power grid and to promote renewable energy consumption. Optimal coordination of charging/discharging considering peak shaving and battery aging simultaneously is crucial to achieve whole-system social benefits. However, precise battery degradation, as a highly non-linear model, can hardly be embedded into mixed-integer linear programming. In this paper, a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) model based on hierarchical optimization is developed. The non-linear battery degradation model is linearized through ReLU-activated neural network and coupled with the V2G coordination MILP problem. First, the modeling of the behavioral boundary of the electric vehicle is obtained based on the Monte Carlo method. After that, the linearized replacement of the battery degradation model is realized by using segmented linear neural networks. Finally, a multi-objective optimization model of coordinated charging is developed for the load shifting and battery degradation problems. The simulation results show that compared with the optimization scenario with merely load regulation, the multi-objective algorithm considering battery degradation can effectively reduce the battery capacity decay by significantly decreasing intense EV charging/discharging profiles, while eliminating load fluctuations to a considerable extent.

articleTitle: Two-layer Progressive Hedging-Benders Decomposition Algorithm for Stochastic Unit Commitment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the large-scale development of renewable energy generation, the uncertainty of power system has increased significantly. In order to make proper day-ahead scheduling decisions, the stochastic unit commitment (SUC) problem considering reserve capacity and line power flow limit is studied, and multiple independent random scenarios are used to represent the uncertainty of load and renewable generation in the system. In order to solve this large-scale problem caused by too many scenarios, a two-layer PH-BD decomposition algorithm is designed to further improve the computing speed. The outer Progressive hedging (PH) algorithm is used to decompose the scenarios to realize parallel solution of the corresponding problems in each scenario. The inner Benders decomposition (BD) algorithm is used to decompose the corresponding problems of each scenario into the main problem without line constraints and the subproblem with line constraints. The calculation results of IEEE 118-bus system show that the calculation speed of the proposed algorithm is faster and the solution time is shorter than that of the traditional PH algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of coupling photovoltaic power and gas power on power system operation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Humanity’s concern for energy security and anxiety over environmental degradation has made it a global consensus to make full use of renewable energy. Grid-connected power generation from large-scale renewable energy sources, represented by solar energy, has become an unstoppable trend in new power systems. At the same time, in view of the volatility and abandonment problems caused by the increasing installed capacity of photovoltaic power generation, the role of gas turbines to smooth out the volatility and promote the consumption of new energy sources has become increasingly prominent. Based on the IES-SIM simulation software, a steady-state simulation model of a comprehensive energy system considering the coupling of photovoltaic power generation and gas power is established based on the topology map of the power grid and substation drawings in Ruili, Yunnan. Finally, the simulation results of the case section in IES-SIM are compared and analyzed to investigate the impact of the coupling between PV and gas power on the operation of the power system. The case study analysis verifies that the coupling of photovoltaic power generation and gas power has great potential to reduce network losses and improve power quality.

articleTitle: Bidding Strategy of Electricity Retailers Based on Joint Optimization of Energy Market and Ancillary Services Market
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The connection of large amounts of renewable energy needs to allow more regulatory resources to enter the ancillary services market(ASM) to improve the operational flexibility of the power system. Electricity retailers(ERs) or distribution companies can aggregate users' regulation resources to participate in the ASM and increase the competitiveness in the ASM. In this paper, the joint optimization model of ERs participating in the energy market(EM) and ASM under the background of joint optimization of EM and ASM is established. The example analysis shows that, in peak load periods, ERs can gain profits by participating in the ASM with demand response and distributed generation resources, and gain more profits by reducing the clearing price in the EM. Independent system operator should take some measures to encourage ERs to participate in the ASM and improve the flexibility of the power system.

articleTitle: A Distributed Photovoltaic Power Transaction Mode Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The global new energy market is undergoing reform, so every resident could participate in the energy market. By taking advantage of the characteristics of Blockchain, the direct exchange of information flow, capital flow and energy flow can be safely realized. In this paper, a photovoltaic trading mode based on Blockchain technology is proposed. The benefit function is constructed and Stackelberg game theory is used to get the equilibrium solution to determine the internal electricity price. Furthermore, a credit value is introduced to design a trading incentive mechanism, and the energy storage unit is installed, which ultimately avoids "light abandoning" phenomenon. The simulation results prove that this transaction mode using Blockchain technology increases the benefits of both buyers and sellers and improves the utilization rate of photovoltaic power generation.

articleTitle: Discrete-Time Zero-Dynamic Control for 1500V Battery Three-Phase Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The output of the three-phase inverter should have fewer harmonics, differential-free control, and fast dynamic response. In this paper, the off-grid voltage control of the three-phase inverter is proposed that provides excellent steady-state and dynamic performance of the output voltage. State feedback and complex variable resonant controllers are used to achieve zero steady-state control of the output voltage based on the state-space model. Feedforward links of load current and reference are added to the control structure. The feedforward gain is designed according to the principle of closed-loop zero and dominant pole pair elimination, so that the feedforward link can greatly speed up the dynamic process when the load and reference change abruptly and improve the response speed of the output voltage. Simulink simulation results show that the output voltage of the proposed inverter control method tracks the voltage reference without steady-state errors, and has a fast dynamic response.

articleTitle: Optimal Substation Planning Considering Demand Response and Energy Storage System Based on Mesh Distribution Networks Planning Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The substation planning method in mesh planning framework is mainly determined by power and energy balance between substations and loads in the mesh area. Due to the integration of massive DG and various loads, demand response (DR) and energy storage system (ESS) become important elements in distribution networks. Therefore, characteristics of net load have become very complex. It is necessary to design a novel method for substation planning. And the interactive relationship between substation, DR and ESS let the substation planning be a coordinated optimization problem. In this paper, an optimal substation planning considering DR and ESS is proposed. Firstly, the operation and cost models of substation, demand response and energy storage system are formulated. Then, a coordinated optimal planning method based on power and energy balance is proposed, which can be transformed as a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) model. A real distribution network in eastern China is used to verify the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A Review of Research on Portrait Technology of Power Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development and application of power grid, the power equipment present more and more intelligent and high-integrated, which brought the new challenges of power equipment state estimation and fault diagnosis. At the same time, the integrated development of the power big data and AI techniques gives out the new opportunity. Thanks to the above description, power equipment portrait technology develops rapidly and has broad application prospects in the state estimation and fault diagnosis of power equipment. This paper first introduces the framework of power equipment portrait, and then introduces the research status of power equipment portrait data collection and processing methods from four aspects, and then introduces the establishment method of power equipment label system and the analysis method and application scenarios of power equipment portrait. Finally, the future research direction of power equipment portrait is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Innovation of Energy Storage Industry Based on the Tripartite Evolutionary Game
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Energy storage technology(EST) as a key technology and effective means to deal with the intermittence and volatility of renewable energy. The energy storage industry in China is still in the early commercial stage due to its cost and technical reasons. The development of an industry is always affected by a variety of factors, and energy storage industry is no exception. This paper summarizes the basic concepts of evolutionary game(EG) theory and analyzes the factors that affect the development of energy storage industry: driving behavior by government forces, market demand and technological innovation, constructs an EG dynamic system model, analyzes the strategic choice among enterprises, scientific research institutions and governments in the process of collaborative innovation of EST. The influence of government supervision intensity and the proportion of synergistic benefits on the evolution trend of the system are analyzed, and some suggestions are given to promote the evolution of energy storage industry in China. The results show that whether enterprises and scientific research institutions adopt the “active cooperation” strategy in the process of collaborative innovation of EST is influenced by many factors, such as government input and supervision intensity, the input cost and benefits of partners, and technology spillover benefits.

articleTitle: Insurance Premium Setting Based On Power System Reliability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the deepening of power system reform and the wide application of renewable energy generation. Consumers need more reliable power systems. An insurance premium based on power system reliability analysis is presented in this paper presents. This method embeds system reliability into actuarial science. Based on the outage losses from reliability analysis, premiums are calculated for different kinds of users. And then an advanced principle of value-at-risk is used to improve the computational methods of premium. Firstly, Monte Carlo method is used in the analysis of power system reliability. Secondly, the model of outage loss is designed according to the failure time, and the characteristics of different power customers are taken into account. Finally, considering the value-at-risk theory, the loss of power outage is used to calculate the premiums. The application of insurance mechanisms to power systems can provide users with an economic method to avoid major unexpected losses.

articleTitle: Offshore Wind Turbine Condition Assessment Method Based on GRU and Improved Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of fuzzy state boundary and many unit parameters of offshore wind turbines, this paper proposes an improved fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to significantly improve the accuracy of offshore wind turbine state evaluation and provide reference for the formulation of wind farm operation and maintenance strategy.

articleTitle: Checking and Preventing Measures of Short-Circuit Current Breaking Level of 220kV Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the serious problems caused by the system short-circuit current exceeding the standard and the circuit breaker cannot reliably break the short-circuit current, this paper proposes a method to check the short-circuit current breaking capacity of the circuit breaker in 220kV and above substations. The first step is to compare the short-circuit current in actual working conditions with the effective value of the AC component of the circuit breaker’s rated short-circuit current. The second step is to calculate the DC component time constant under actual working conditions and compare the amplitude of the most half-wave current with the duration of the most half-wave. Multiply the product and type test T100a test value to check the circuit breaker’s ability to break short-circuit current. Finally, the corresponding preventive measures for circuit breakers and the means to limit short-circuit current are proposed, which provide a reference for the safe operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Study on Electromagnetic Force Characteristics of Asymmetric 8-Figure Coils in EDS System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In Electrodynamic Suspension (EDS) system, the lack of levitation force is an important factor restricting the take-off speed. The structure of 8-Figure ground coil affects the performance of levitation and guidance. It is an important task to design a new type of 8-Figure coil to reduce the take-off speed of EDS Maglev. In this paper, the characteristics of Figure 8 coil with different upper and lower coil heights are studied, and the equivalent circuit model of asymmetric Figure 8 coil is established based on the dynamic circuit theory. By determining the interaction between the Figure 8 coil and the moving Superconducting Magnet (SCM), parameters such as levitation force, guidance force, drag-to-lift ratio are calculated. The variation of levitation force and guidance force under different type of asymmetric Figure 8 coil was compared, and the influence of the asymmetry degree of Figure 8 coil on the train floating height is analyzed. The results show that the asymmetric structure can improve the floating height and reduce the take-off speed of EDS train, but weaken the guiding force. By comparing the analytical calculation of the dynamic circuit model with the simulation results of 3D finite element method (FEM), the calculation error is less than 10%, which verifies the validity of the analytical model.

articleTitle: Online DGA Sensor Calibration Using GANN and Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The online dissolved gas analysis (DGA) sensors can diagnose the incipient faults of the transformer in real-time. However, these sensors suffer from low accuracy, and may provide unreliable even misleading maintenance suggestions. To tackle this problem, this paper proposes a hybrid genetic algorithm neural network (GANN) to adaptively build the calibration model for online DGA devices. As offline data is too few, a perturbation data augmentation method is also proposed to generate synthetic offline DGA data. The online data can be calibrated by the model thus providing real-time power transformer condition monitoring. The comparison with popular calibration methods confirms the superior of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Cable insulation defect diagnosis based on harmonic characteristic label
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The current harmonic method combines the harmonic analysis and the current method, which can analyze the cable insulation status on the basis of non-stop operation. It has great significance of accurately analyze the cable insulation status. This paper describes the traditional and unitary problems of harmonic method of cable insulation defects. Therefore, a diagnosis method based on current harmonic characteristic label of cable insulation defects is proposed. We first build a harmonic characteristic database of cable insulation defects, then extract current harmonic feature tags, finally combine the harmonic features with big data technology to classify the types of cable insulation defects through the random forest algorithm. The method was effectively and accurately realized the integration of cable insulation defects detection and diagnosis, and improves accuracy effectively in cable insulation state prediction. The scheme ensures the continuous and stable operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Predictive Control Strategy of Power Electronic Traction Transformer for Fault Tolerance Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a predictive control strategy of power electronic traction transformer for fault tolerance condition is proposed to ensure the safe operation of the system after fault. The working principle and the fault-tolerant method for H-bridge and dual active bridge are introduced first as the basis. Then the predictive control strategy is illustrated. Based on the analysis, the predictive control combined strategy fault-tolerant method is proposed, which can effectively solve the problem of power distribution between the fault-tolerant module and the normal working module, maintain the voltage balancing and ensure the stable operation of the power electronic traction transformer. The experiment results are given to show the efficiency and correctness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Analysis of Self-excited Voltage Building of High-low Voltage Dual Stator-winding Induction Generator Considering Mutual Leakage Inductance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The transient analysis of self-excited voltage building of high-low voltage dual stator-winding induction generator system is carried out by using eigenvalue analysis method. Based on the transient equivalent circuit considering the mutual leakage inductance between stator windings, the state equation of the system is deduced and the eigenvalues of the system are solved. According to the one-dimensional blind-walking optimization method, the minimum capacitance required for voltage building of generator system is calculated, and the accuracy of the results is verified by comparison with other methods. The transient waveforms of generator voltage building are obtained by simulation. The experimental waveforms are consistent with the simulation results, which shows the effectiveness of the method.

Author Keywords: high-low voltage dual stator-winding induction generator

articleTitle: Short-term Load Forecast Using Improved Long-short Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Short-term load forecast is an important task for power system scheduling and operation. In recent years, deep learning methods have been widely applied to load forecast problems because of high accuracy. Among various deep learning models, the Long Short-Term Memory network (LSTM) is one of the most popular models because it can effectively capture the temporal dependencies of load data thus achieving great performance. Different from existing works that combine LSTM with other models, this paper improves the load forecast performance of LSTM by modifying the network structure and fully utilizing multi-time scale load features. First, an Improved LSTM model is proposed by adding a zigzag pathway in the network which helps to improve the transfer of information between different time steps and layers. In the meanwhile, a framework is also proposed for short-term load forecast which utilizes multi-time scale information including weekly features, daily features, and recent-hour features. Such a framework can well capture the load trend at different time scales, thus helping to improve forecast accuracy. Case studies on a public load dataset demonstrate the performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Robust Model Predictive Current Control for PMSM Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To enhance the robustness of conventional model predictive current control (MPCC) for PMSM drive, a robust MPCC is put forward. Because the motor parameters have a great influence on its control system, the sensitivity analysis of these parameters is carried out. Then, according to the parameter error and predictive current error model, the parameter error is calculated and compensated to the predictive model. Experimental results prove that the proposed method enhance the robustness of the system and erase the negative impact of parameter mismatch ultimately.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Wireless Power Transfer System Employing Reconfigurable Topology for Misalignment Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) is developing rapidly, whose charging is one big issue. EV wireless charging technology has many advantages like safety, convenience, and automation. However, there are also issues concerning EV wireless charging, one of which is misalignment tolerance along the EV door-to-door direction. In this paper, an EV wireless charging system is proposed by employing a reconfigurable topology with two side-by-side transmitting coils. The system can be switched to Working Mode I where the two transmitting coils are connected in series to simultaneously supply power to the receiver at central positions or Working Mode II where the two transmitting coils constitute the LCCC-S (inductor-capacitor-capacitor-capacitor-series) topology to supply power for the receiver at boundary positions. Under this arrangement, the output power can be smoothed along the door-to-door misalignment. Also, the proposed wireless charging system can tolerate weak couplings without overvoltage or overcurrent issues. Experimental results have validated the proposed wireless charging system.

articleTitle: Study on Electrical Treeing Characteristics of ERIP under High Temperature with Combined AC-Positive DC Voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Dry Bushing core adopts epoxy resin impregnated paper (ERIP) material as the main insulation, which can bear the stress of high temperature with combined AC-DC voltage under actual operating conditions. In order to avoid bushing insulation failure under high temperature, it is urgent to study the electrical treeing characteristics of ERIP material under high temperature with combined AC-DC voltage. In this paper, a 16kV AC combined 0kV, 8kV, 12kV and 16kV positive DC voltage was applied to ERIP samples at 80°C. Under the same AC voltage, the higher the amplitude of the positive DC voltage, the shorter the breakdown time of the sample. The breakdown time of samples corresponding to different morphologies of electrical trees is obviously different, and the breakdown time decreases with the increase of the density of electrical trees. The research results of this paper are helpful to understand the insulation failure process of ERIP materials under the combined effect of electricity and heat.

articleTitle: Research on phase change cooling technology of vehicle fraction converter module
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on the operation process of vehicle traction converter, the design scheme of phase change cooling system is proposed, and the evaporation heat transfer process and flow characteristics of working medium in cold plate with parallel channels are theoretically calculated and experimentally studied. By comparing the pressure and temperature changes of each measuring point of the system under different heating power and flow conditions, the flow resistance of two-phase working medium and the heat transfer performance of cold plate are studied. Experimental results show that the decrease of flow rate or the increase of heating power will increase the vapor quality of channel outlet and wall temperature. At the same time, comparing the calculation results of the experimental correlation of frictional pressure drop and heat transfer of two-phase flow with the experimental data, it can be seen that the flow and heat transfer process of two-phase fluid in parallel channels can be well simulated and estimated by using a separated two-phase flow model and Steiner-Taborek asymptotic method.

articleTitle: Research on Technical Line Loss Reduction of Distribution Network with SVG in the Case of Using Underground Cable
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the line loss problem caused by the actual engineering of the underground cable in the distribution network, this paper studies the optimal operation strategy of static var generator (SVG) and traditional reactive power compensation devices with the goal of reducing the active power loss of the distribution network. Firstly, the influence of cable entry to the ground on line loss and line voltage is analyzed. Secondly, a mathematical model is established with the goal of reducing active power loss and improving static voltage stability. Finally, through MATLAB simulation and verification of the actual distribution network, it is proved that the reactive power optimization loss reduction strategy considering SVG has good effects in the case of using underground cable, especially in reducing the loss of the distribution network and improving the power supply quality.

articleTitle: Construction of distribution network topology identification model based on voltage correlation coefficient
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of China’s distribution system, large-scale interconnection of power grids has become an inevitable trend of development, and distribution network as an important part of the distribution system, its safe and reliable operation is an important guarantee of production and life. In recent years, power outage accidents and chain failures are frequent, which urges us to further explore the optimization of network characteristics of power system from a scientific point of view. In the actual operation process, the distribution network topology will change irregularly due to uncertain factors such as the change of contact relationship, equipment maintenance, and supply transfer in the case of failure. Therefore, scientific and effective identification of the distribution network topology is very important for the stable operation of the network. In this paper, a topology identification model construction method based on voltage correlation coefficient is proposed. According to the principle of electrical distance and voltage correlation of nodes, a physical-probability model of switching state and voltage correlation of distribution network nodes is formed as state variables.

articleTitle: Modeling and Reduction of conducted common mode EMI in a-single-switch forward converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the development of switching power supply, electromagnetic interference(EMI) should be much attended. This paper investigated the transmission mechanism of conducted common-mode(CM) noise in a-single-switch forward converter. Based on the analysis, a CM transmission mode can be built. Through theory analysis, methods of designing circuit structure and transformer construction can improve CM noise. Experimental results validated the proposed model and the developed CM noise reduction techniques.

articleTitle: Application Scenarios and Analysis of NB-IoT Communication in Substation and Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power Internet of Things (IoT) is a comprehensive technology which obtains power system operation and electrical equipment conditions via deploying various intelligent devices with sensing, computing and communication functions in power grid. It can achieve the transmission and processing of information through network, so as to realize the interconnection of all things in power system. Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) is a novel approach of low power wide area network (LPWAN) communication technology which exhibits long-distance wireless signal transmission capability with relatively low power dissipation. Due to its low cost and huge connection capacity in networking, NB-IoT has been widely employed in the industrial field and considered to be one of the promising and potential technical schemes to the communication and data transmission issues in IoT. However, the application of NB-IoT in power transmission and transformation especially in substation has been rarely investigated. In this work, the characteristics and merits of NB-IoT communication are presented followed by the application scenarios of NB-IoT in power Internet of Things. Particularly, the structure and application analysis of NB-IoT communication in substation IoT are proposed. Moreover, the challenges and prospects of NB-IoT in substation that need to be resolved in the future are discussed. The advanced NB-IoT communication will facilitate the deployment and application progress of power Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Research on Topology Design and Configuration optimization of Hybrid Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When hybrid energy storage technology is applied in different occasions, there are key problems in topology design and configuration optimization. For electromagnetic emission application scenarios with strict volume-weight constraints and large power-energy requirements, a hybrid energy storage group chopper discharge topology is designed, and its working principle and operation boundary are introduced. Then, taking the single maximum power demand, continuous maximum energy demand and multiple constraints of the transmitting load as the design input, the optimal con-figuration of supercapacitor and lithium battery is carried out. Taking the weight, volume and cost as the comprehensive optimization objectives, iterative approximation is carried out, and finally the optimal configuration solution of the hybrid energy storage system is obtained. The effectiveness of the topology is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Charging Load Acceptance Capacity of Electric Vehicles in Residential Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the large-scale access of electric vehicles to the distribution network in residential areas, the load of the distribution network increases significantly, which affects its safe and reliable operation. This paper can provide a theoretical basis for the planning of charging facilities and distribution networks in residential areas by analyzing the electric vehicle charging load acceptance capacity of the distribution network in residential areas. Firstly, a mathematical model for the analysis of the charging load acceptance capacity of the distribution network in the residential area is established, and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the maximum acceptance capacity. The simulation adopts the IEEE33 node calculation example to optimize the distribution network. The optimization results prove the feasibility of this method to analyze the charging load capacity of electric vehicles in the distribution network in residential areas.

articleTitle: Optimal Siting and Sizing of Distributed Generation Based on Chaotic Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The large-scale grid connection of distributed generation (DG) will change the traditional operation mode of the distribution network. It is significant to reasonably plan and conFigure DG. A two-stage DG location and capacity planning method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the set of candidate nodes of DG is determined by voltage stability index and quadric moment of reactive power, then the optimization model considering the minimum annual comprehensive cost of distribution network is established. In order to overcome the prematurity of particle swarm optimization (PSO), the chaotic PSO is used to solve the optimization problem by combining the PSO and chaos search strategy. Finally, the proposed method is simulated in IEEE33, and the simulation results show that the proposed method can reasonably conFigure DG.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity Configuration Method for CHP Island Microgrid Considering Carbon Emission
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A rational system capacity configuration scheme is vital to realize satisfactory performances for integrated energy systems. In this article, an optimal capacity configuration method is proposed for the representative combined heat and power (CHP) island microgrid, which consists of renewable energy generation element, electricity-heat conversion device, electric storage, heat storage, and load. Firstly, three optimization objectives are chosen from the perspectives of cost, renewable utilization and carbon emission. Constraints are supplemented to guarantee reliable electric and heat supply. Accordingly, a radar chart evaluation (RCE) solution is employed to calculate the fitness function and assess overall system performances. As a result, a capacity configuration optimization model is established with a genetic algorithm adopted for optimization implementation. Based on the real data in a remote area of southwest China, a study case of the CHP microgrid is provided to validate the effectiveness of proposed optimal capacity configuration method.

articleTitle: Research on the Security Analysis of Integrated Electricity and Gas Systems based on the Vulnerability Index
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The coupling characteristics of the integrated energy systems makes the security problems more complicated. For the integrated electricity and gas systems (IEGS), a security analysis method based on the vulnerability index, which quantitatively describes the influence of control variables on the security of state variables, is proposed. First, the IEGS steady-state model is given. Then, the gas pressure-electricity load sensitivity matrix is derived based on the IEGS model. Furthermore, the vulnerability index that considers the current value of state variables, operating limits, and the sensitivity of state variables to control variables is defined and a security analysis method based on it is established. The case study shows that the proposed security analysis method can accurately identify vulnerable state variables in the system.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Vibration Signal of Converter Transformer and AC Power Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, in order to carry out vibration test of converter transformer, principle of vibration, test equipment and arrangement of sensors was studied. Several characteristics of vibration signal, such as amplitude and proportion of basic frequency, main frequency, amplitude and proportion of main frequency, complexity of frequency domain spectrum, were chosen as muti-dimension characteristics of the vibration signals. And the difference of vibration signals between converter transformer and AC power transformer were studied.

articleTitle: State estimation of AC/DC distribution network based on pseudo measurement modeling of load distribution coefficient
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of insufficient configuration of real-time measurement in AC/DC distribution network, a state estimation of AC/DC distribution network based on pseudo measurement modeling of load distribution coefficient is proposed. Firstly, the historical data of load distribution coefficient is calculated according to the historical data of node load, then the pseudo measurement of node load is calculated by using adaptive exponential smoothing algorithm combined with real-time measurement, and finally the state estimation of AC/DC distribution network based on weighted least square method is carried out. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the pseudo measurement error and improve the accuracy of distribution network state estimation.

articleTitle: Control of Permanent-Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Linear Hall Device
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, in order to reduce the weight and volume of the motor system, a permanent-magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) with low ripple torque is controlled based on linear Hall angle measuring device. First, the magnetic field directional vector control method and space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) are applied in our novel model. In addition, the influence on the speed fluctuation and load torque ripple comes from angle measurement errors, which was caused by noise, linear hall installation error and machining error, are anlyzed. In order to reduce the influence, the discrete Kalman filter and the least square method were used to achieve real time dynamic error compensation. Finally, the effectiveness and reliability of the method is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of the Health of Electric Vehicle Charging Equipment Based on Combination Weighting of Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a method to evaluate the health of electric vehicle charging equipment based on game theory combined weighting. Firstly, the evaluation indicator system of charging facility health degree is established from three aspects of electrical performance, protection device performance, and other performance. Secondly, the subjective weight of the indicator is determined by the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) method, and the objective weight of the indicator is determined by the Coefficient of Variation method and the CRITIC method. On this basis, the combination weight is determined by using the idea of game theory. Finally, the combined membership function is selected to determine the membership degree of each indicator, and the evaluation of the health of charging equipment is completed by the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control for SPMSM Control System with Parameter Robustness Improvement
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Model predictive current control (MPCC) is a control method based on a parametric model. By using this method, the surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motor (SPMSM) can operate at high efficiency by predicting its working current at a future time and performing the appropriate control operation according to the predicted current value. However, the control performance of the traditional MPCC approach is greatly affected by the parameters of the prediction model. This article proposes a newly-designed robust MPCC strategy in an effort to improve the robustness of the traditional MPCC approach. An inductance mismatch is a leading cause of d-axis current errors, thus an inductance calculation link based on the current difference of the d-axis is designed to extract accurate inductance information. In addition, a flux linkage calculation link is designed in this article and the value of the flux linkage can be determined by this link. Through simulation and experimentation, the effectiveness of the newly-designed control strategy is tested under a variety of working conditions.

articleTitle: Experimental on Corona performance of Double Pendulum Damper for UHV Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The corona discharges appear on the surface of the SHB8-400/630-900/12D type double pendulum damper which installed on the 1000kV transmission lines. The audible noise caused complaints from residents. For this reason the structure of the double pendulum damper was optimized to suppress the corona. Using finite method the distributions of electric field on the surface of hammer head under the conditions of simplified simulated layout for the test are simulated. Corona test was carried out to the original structure and the optimized design samples. The results show that the original structure of hammer head cannot meet the demand the corona test, however the spherical pendulum for the radius of 100mm can meet. The recommended result was carried out on the same tower double circuit test line in the UHV AC base and the observations by UVI show that there were no corona discharge occurred. The new pendulum dampers were manufactured and hung on operating lines, there have no corona discharge on their hammer dead and bodies which validate the optimizations. This study can provide experiences and references for the design of anti-corona hardware fittings on UHV transmission lines.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Hybrid ANPC Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Active neutral point clamp (ANPC) is a three-level circuit suitable for high power. Using SiC MOSFET instead of part of Si IGBT to construct hybrid ANPC circuit can reduce loss and improve the efficiency of converter. This paper proposes a control strategy suitable for hybrid ANPC circuits. By concentrating switching actions on SiC devices, Si devices only need to bear the conduction loss, making full use of the advantages of low switching losses of SiC devices and low cost of Si devices. Firstly, working principle of the proposed control strategy is analyzed, and then a 3kW single-phase ANPC converter prototype is built. Comparing device temperatures when using different control strategies. It is proved that the proposed control scheme is more suitable for the hybrid ANPC circuit. Finally, the proposed control strategy is used to compare the efficiency of all SiC devices, all Si devices and hybrid converters. Experimental results show that this control strategy can achieve high efficiency while keeping low cost of hybrid ANPC converter.

articleTitle: Analytical Calculation and Experimental Measurement of Dq Inductance of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to obtain the dq inductance of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) accurately, a method combining analytical calculation and experimental measurement is proposed, which is more universal and more accurate than traditional methods. In this paper, the main inductance and leakage inductances of PMSM are deduced by analytical method, then the dq inductance of nine-phase PMSM is calculated by programming. The extremum method is used for experimental measurement, that is, the maximum and minimum of equivalent impedance between phases are measured by impedance measuring instrument, and the dq inductance can be obtained through the derived relationship. The results measured by extremum method are compared with those calculated by the analytical method. The experimental results are highly consistent with the calculated results, which verifies the accuracy of the two methods.

articleTitle: Small Amounts of Transformer Oil Leakage Fluorescence Detection Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Mental oil, as a major type of transformer insulating dielectric, plays a significant role in ensuring safe operation of transformers. However, oil leakage has become one of the most frequent defects because of ageing sealing elements. Thus, it is significant to propose efficient, intellectual and automatic detection methods of oil leakage for ensuring equipment severity. The characteristic that the fluorescence appears in ultraviolet light for mental oil is utilized in this paper. A detection method of oil leakage through automatic analysis and processing based on ultraviolet fluorescence images is proposed, which can identify transformer oil intellectually in the dark. First, the fluorescence images are analyzed through image processing methods. Based on morphological processing and Otsu threshold segmentation, the oil leakage was identified in YUV color space using background subtraction. Then, the filed ultraviolet fluorescent pictures are collected to testify the method. The field results indicate that the proposed method could effectively recognize the oil traces with fluorescence effect and their approximate areas, which lay the theoretical and experimental foundation for intelligent maintenance of transformer oil leakage.

articleTitle: Research on MMC Improved Sub-module Topology with Capacitor Voltage Self-balancing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Sub-module capacitor voltage balancing and DC fault ride-through are essential to ensure the safe and reliable operation of modular multilevel converters (MMC) in voltage source converter based high voltage direct current(VSC-HVDC). Hence, this paper proposes the improved sub-module(ISM) topology that can meet the demand of DC fault ride-through and capacitor voltage self-balancing at the same time. Under the normal operating state, ISM can get the output level of 2uc, uc and 0 by connecting the two capacitors in sub-module under series, parallel and bypass modes, respectively. Considering the characteristics of parallel-connected sub-module capacitors, capacitor voltage balancing can be realized only with the hardware without additional control schemes. Moreover, in the case of the system DC short-circuit fault, ISM can solve the problem with the counter electromotive force generated by capacitor voltage. The simulation results of MATLAB/Simulink verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed ISM topology

articleTitle: Research on New Design and Analysis of Stator Tooth Splicing Structure Using Anisotropic Electrical Steel in an Electric Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In response to the design requirements of electric vehicles for high torque density and high-power density of traction motors, based on finite element simulation, the splicing research of anisotropic electrical steel (AES) and isotropic electrical steel (IES) in motor stator is analyzed. Firstly, the material properties of AES are studied to provide theoretical guidance for motor design. Secondly, the influence of different splicing schemes of AES on the motor is compared and analyzed. Finally, the influence of splicing structure on the performance of motor core is analyzed and measured. The results obtained in this research indicate the splicing structure will reduce the magnetic properties of the stator core in the test, but the simulation analysis shows that the torque of the circular splicing structure is increased by 1% and the iron loss is reduced by 35.6% compared with IES motor.

articleTitle: Stochastic Dynamic Programming based Energy Management of a Residential Cogeneration System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Decarburization of building is a crucial part of the era of carbon neutrality. This paper considers the energy management of a sustainable residential cogeneration system consisting of fuel cell, battery pack, photovoltaic (PV), thermal energy system (TES) and heat pump. To overcome the difficulties caused by the uncertainties in PV power and loads, an optimal economic day-ahead scheduling problem is formulated, subject to the constraints on the balance of supply and demand of the heat and electricity. Random variables are modeled based on the time-varying transition matrix of Markov chain. Furthermore, stochastic dynamic programming (SDP) algorithm is used to minimize the system operation cost, i.e., total fuel cost of the fuel cell in 24 hours under uncertainty. Simulation results show that the derived control strategies of each stage are energy-efficient in managing the power output of fuel cell and heat pump.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control Strategy of Nine-phase PMSM Based on Piecewise Combination of Open-loop and Sliding Mode Observer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To overcome the inaccurate measurement of rotor position in low-speed range of nine-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor by sliding mode observer, current and frequency (IF) open-loop starting strategy is adopted. In the high-speed range, the rotor position is measured by sliding mode observer. The chattering problem of sliding mode observer is improved by using sinusoidal saturation function and phase locked loop (PLL). The smooth switching from IF open-loop control to sensorless vector control based on sliding mode observer is realized by adopting an improved switching strategy based on double d-q spaces. The feasibility of the proposed compound control strategy is confirmed by experimental results.

articleTitle: A New On-line Location Method of Inter-turn Short-circuit Fault in Hydro-generator Rotor Winding Based on the Harmonic Phase of Unbalanced Current
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: During the actual operation of the hydro-generator, there is often a dynamic inter-turn short-circuit fault of the rotor winding. However, it is difficult to locate the fault since it will disappear after the generator is shutdown. Hence, in order to quickly eliminate the dynamic inter-turn short-circuit fault of hydro generator, this paper presents a theoretically analysis of the relationship between the position of the fault magnetic pole and the harmonic phase of stator unbalanced current. Firstly, combined with the characteristic of polarity between two adjacent poles, the spatial phase difference of two adjacent magnetic poles is analyzed to obtain the relationship between the harmonic expression of unbalanced stator current and the position of the fault magnetic pole. Secondly, through the specific analysis of a synchronous generator with six poles, the changing law of the fractional harmonic phase of the stator unbalanced current in general synchronous generator is obtained. Then an on-line location method of fault magnetic poles of the hydrogenerator based on harmonic phase of stator unbalanced current is proposed. Simulation and field experiment are carried out finally, which both show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively realize the real-time monitoring and on-line location of fault magnetic poles of the hydro-generator.

articleTitle: Research on power frequency electric field of 750 kV Four-Circuit on the same tower
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The electromagnetic environment under the lines has become an important factor restricting the development of transmission lines. This paper takes a 750kV four-circuit AC transmission lines on the same tower as an example, calculates the power frequency electric field under the lines based on the simulated charge method, build the calculation models of power frequency electric field under different line parameters, analyzes the distribution of power frequency electric field under the influence of different line parameters. The results show that changing the phase sequence arrangement can reduce the power frequency electric field intensity under the line by up to 11.8%, and the field intensity can be reduced by up to 9.4% for each additional meter of the wire height. The increase in the number of wire splits and the split spacing will increase the field intensity under the line, while the influence of the change in the diameter of the sub-conductor on the field intensity is negligible. The research results can provide guidance and suggestions for circuit design.

articleTitle: A New Start-up Method for Dual Active Bridge Power Converters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Dual active bridge (DAB) converters are widely adopted in DC micro-grids. The conventional start-up methods usually require complex operations and a time-consuming parameter tuning process. In this work, we propose a new simple and effective closed-loop start-up method for DAB converters. First, based on extended phase-shift modulation, the transmission power and the peak inductor current are analyzed. Then, to reach the maximum transmission power under the current limit, the Lagrange Multiplier method is applied to solve the optimal phase-shift ratios. Besides, the magnetic bias component is eliminated by using a dynamic reference generator for the set value of the current limit. Simulation results are provided to demonstrate the merits of the proposed method, which includes a more rapid start process and controllable inductor current compared with the conventional start-up method.

articleTitle: An Energy Storage Test Power Supply Based on Fuzzy Quasi Proportional Resonance Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper is devoted to designed a set of energy storage test power supply topology circuit based on phase-shifting transformer, energy storage capacitor and power electronic conversion device in order to provide a stable current source with fast control in the large-capacity type test of 10kV switchgear. A set of energy storage test power supply control strategy based on fuzzy quasi proportional resonance (QPR) control is designed. Finally, the simulation experiment is carried out on the MATLAB/Simulink experiment platform. The results show that this power supply can control the output waveform fast and accurately. And this power supply can provide the large current required for the short-time current withstand test of the switchgear.

articleTitle: Modeling and active power control strategy of wind-photovoltaic-pumped storage hybrid generation system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the randomness of wind speed and solar radiation intensity, lager-scale photovoltaic (PV) power station and wind farm connected to grid seriously affecting the stability of power system. With the advantage of flexible operation, quick start up and close down, pumped storage power station will be critical for renewable energy grid-connection in the future. In this paper, a wind-PV-pumped storage hybrid generation framework is put forward. The mathematical model which can reflect the generation characteristics of each unit is introduced. Based on the principle of low-pass filtering, an active power coordinated control strategy is designed to smooth power curves by filtering high frequency components of wind and solar power fluctuations. The proposed system is verified by MATLAB/Simulink software platform. The simulation results show that the control strategy is able to smooth out the fluctuation of renewable energy power output, and hybrid generation system can operate stably.

articleTitle: Data Valuation in Electricity Transactions with Uncertainty Considering Risk Preferences
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Uncertainty is an inherent characteristic in power systems, especially under the high penetration of renewable energies, and will probably lead to economic losses of entities. With the development of data technology, acquiring related data to eliminate uncertainty and prevent from being affected by it is feasible. However, the data value depends on multiple endogenous or exogenous factors, thus data transactions are difficult to organize since the vagueness of the data valuation. Based on the scenario that wind power producers (WPPs) participating in electricity markets, the data value is defined as the profit enhancement related to the improvement of the wind power forecast and derived from the perspective of WPPs in this paper. To promote the accuracy of the data valuation, risk preferences of WPPs are taken into consideration, where the commonly used conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) is used in quantitative analysis of their perceptions of risk and the WPPs are divided into risk-neutral, risk-averse, and risk-prone WPPs. Then, the risk premium in the data value is extracted and analyzed to illustrate the impact of WPPs’ risk preferences on the data value. Finally, case studies with real wind power data are employed to indicate the feasibility and significance of the data valuation considering risk preferences.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Prospective Power Supply Structure Considering Demand Response and Dynamic Generation Cost
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the wildly concerns on carbon emission around the world, it has become a broad consensus to vigorously develop new energy. The high portion of new energy means great challenge in power balance. In order to meet the dual requirements of low carbon emission and high power supply reliability, it is of great significance to fully mobilize flexible resources on the load side and reasonably plan the power supply structure. This paper proposes an optimal planning model of prospective power supply structure, in which the demand response and seasonal energy storage have been considered. And the generation cost of various power supplies is divided into three categories, in which the carbon emission cost has been considered. Stochastic production simulation and particle swarm optimization algorithm are adopted to look for the optimal power supply scheme. At last, a case study is conducted to verified the feasibility of the model.

articleTitle: Technology research on adjustable load resource participating in power grid dispatching control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: According to the change of the characteristics of the power grid, the dispatching space of the traditional load adjustment resources is getting smaller, and it is necessary to effectively expand the adjustment resources of the power grid to realize the coordinated mode of source-load interaction. Based on the current structure of the smart grid dispatching control system, this paper proposes a technical framework for the participation of adjustable load resource in power grid regulation, and builds a three-level business system of Regulation agency-Aggregator-Load resource, which can effectively realize the real-time interaction of data of monitoring, control and marketing between regulation agency and aggregators and promote the power of the load resource cluster continuously adjusted to participate in the scheduling optimization of the entire power grid through the function of automatic generation control.

articleTitle: Impact of Control Mode on Small-Signal Stability of Hybrid Cascaded UHVDC System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The hybrid cascaded UHVDC technology is especially suitable for large-capacity, long-distance and overhead line power transmission, and is one of the important technical approaches to solve the problem of large-scale renewable energy transmission over long distances. This paper establishes the small-signal model of the hybrid cascaded UHVDC system and validates the accuracy of the small-signal model by comparing the step responses obtained from the small-signal model with those from the detailed electromagnetic transient model. Based on the developed small-signal model, the impact of two different control modes of the system, the master-slave control mode and all constant DC voltage control mode, on the small-signal stability is investigated.

articleTitle: Repetitive Control-Based Torque Ripple Reduction Method for SRM Drive
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a torque ripple suppression strategy of SRM based on repetitive control was proposed. Due to the doubly salient structure of SRM, the rate of rising current and falling current is different in the current commutation period, which leads to a large fluctuation of electromagnetic torque. In the conventional current chopping control, the current would exceed the hysteresis range in practical application due to the insufficient switching frequency. Therefore, a repetitive controller has been used in the speed loop to generate a periodic current reference signal, which can improve the reference current in advance.
