And the improved soft current chopper control combined with PWM is adopted in current loop to reduce the torque ripple caused by current overshoot in the single-phase excitation stage. In this paper, an SRM control system based on repetitive control has been constructed. The proposed control strategy is verified by simulation, and the FFT analysis is used to illustrate the effect of the strategy on the suppression of torque ripple, which proves that the proposed control method can effectively reduce the torque ripple.

articleTitle: Optimization Analysis of 220kV Substation grounding Network based on CDEGS
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid improvement of automation of power plants and substations, digital electronic equipment and weak electronic equipment are widely used. But at the same time, the electromagnetic interference resistance and insulation level of intelligent equipment are generally low, and the electromagnetic compatibility problem is increasingly prominent. Therefore, the requirements of secondary equipment and micro-electronic equipment for safety indicators such as potential increase of ground grid and pressure difference in plant area are gradually increased. Based on CDEGS software, this paper studies the optimal compression ratio and mesh size of unequal spacing ground grid. The influence of short vertical grounding pole on ground resistance is evaluated from the physical model of grounding network. The grounding effect of long vertical grounding pole with different number and length is simulated and analyzed. The safety indexes of the grounding network after optimization and before optimization are compared. The results show that the design scheme of the unequal spacing horizontal grounding network with 4 40m vertical grounding poles can effectively reduce the contact potential and grounding resistance compared with the traditional design scheme, and meet the requirements of the safety indexes of the grounding network.

articleTitle: Analysis of multiple influencing factors of low-carbon energy consumption of urban users based on DEMATEL
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Focusing on two major types of urban user energy consumption low-carbon businesses, namely electric energy substitution and clean energy construction, the multi-dimensional factors that affect business development are sorted out. Based on the Decision-making Trial and Evaluation Laboratory (DEMATEL) model, calculate the influencing degree, influenced degree, centrality and causality of each factor, and determine the causal relationship of each factor by analyzing the influence of each factor on other factors and the degree affected by other factors, assist in exploring the market-oriented promotion model of low-carbon business, to support the ecological construction of a sustainable low-carbon market and help achieve the national dual-carbon goal.

articleTitle: Control Control Design for 1500V Battery Three-Phase Inverter Considering Black Start
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the off-grid voltage control of the three-phase inverter is proposed that provides excellent steady-state and dynamic performance of the output voltage for the application of the 1500V Battery Three-Phase Inverter with consideration of the black start function. State feedback and complex variable resonant controllers are used to achieve based on the state-space model. A soft start control is designed for the black start to avoid the inrush current of the transformer. Simulink simulation results show that the output voltage of the proposed inverter design method tracks the voltage reference without steady-state errors, and has a fast dynamic response.

articleTitle: Complex Feedforward Compensation for Current Control of Ultra-High-Speed PMSM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In traditional low-speed ac drives, the stability and design of the current closed-loop system are well-studied areas. However, in the case of ultra-high-speed (UHS) motors, the same stability analysis, and current closed-loop design techniques cannot be applied directly. In this work, the stability issues of the current controller of the UHS permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) are analyzed. The three sources of instability are found and explained in detail. Next, a new method of complex feedforward compensation for the current controller of UHS PMSM is proposed. With the proposed method, the transfer function of a closed-loop current system can be set to have the desired behavior of a low-pass filter even at very high fundamental frequencies. Finally, its performance is compared with the traditional proportional-integral (PI) controller and high-bandwidth deadbeat controller. The comparison is made through extensive simulations using MATLAB/Simulink. It is found that with the proposed current controller, the motor is able to stably operate at very high rotational speeds and achieves smooth transient performance.

articleTitle: Intelligent video analysis platform based on edge artificial intelligence technology in power industry
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at improving the safety management level and operational efficiency of power plant, an intelligent video analysis platform based on edge artificial intelligence technology is proposed. By integrated applications of artificial intelligence, machine learning and edge computing, the platform is structured of three components, named as end device, edge computing and cloud. We use front-end sensing devices to collect scene video and other data, by using traditional computer vision, neural networks, deep learning and other algorithms to analyze the collected data, to discover as far as possible the irregular behavior of personnel, equipment and environmental abnormalities. The platform forms corresponding event and alarm information and actively pushing alarm results, improving intrinsic safety management and control capabilities. Moreover, the container technology is used to expand the platform flexibility. The cloud supports remote update and replacement of edge-side functions. Based on cloud-edge collaboration, intelligent release can be directly realized, which guarantees the reliability, availability and scalability of the platform.

Author Keywords: power plant intelligent video analysis platform

articleTitle: Economic dispatch of multi-agent network systems based on distributed finite-step consensus algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the economic dispatch problem of multi-agent network systems is investigated based on distributed finite-step consensus iteration algorithm. In the proposed consensus strategy, the finite iteration steps can be decided based on the numbers of distinct nonzero eigenvalues of constructed Laplacian matrix, and different network topologies own the same results once given the same initial values. Besides, the power constraints of each generator node are considered to ensure the demand-supply balance of the whole multi-agents network systems. Finally, several case studies with different multi-agents network topologies are provided to verify the validity and correctness of the proposed iteration algorithm.

articleTitle: A Multi-Objective optimization Method for Multi-Energy Flow Coupling System Considering Environmental Protection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Multi-energy flow coupling system can provide solutions to the problems of independent energy supply, low cascade utilization level, energy waste and environmental pollution in traditional energy systems. The operation optimization is a key step to ensure the reliability of energy supply. Therefore, under the current “double carbon” background, a multi-objective optimization model of multi-energy flow coupling system is established based on environmental protection and comprehensive consideration of system economy and energy efficiency. Then, three objectives are weighted by analytic hierarchy process-improved entropy weight method, which is transformed into a single objective optimization model, namely collaborative optimization model. Finally, a simplified primal dual interior point method is proposed to solve the model. The results of case study show that the multi-objective collaborative optimization can optimize the comprehensive satisfaction of the system. At the same time, the convergence and global optimization ability of the simplified primal dual interior point method show good characteristics when solving the model.

articleTitle: An investigation on Grounding System of AC Single-core Submarine Cable Based on Multi-conductor Analysis Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Submarine cables are now widely used in offshore wind power interconnection. Due to the electromagnetic coupling effect and the large power transmission distance, the submarine cable has the extremely high risk of excessively large accumulation of the induced voltage on the sheath, and the sheath grounding of the submarine cable will also cause sheath loss, leading to a decreasing in the power transmission capacity. Therefore, investigating the induced voltage and loss of submarine cables is of great significance to practical engineering. In this paper, an optimized calculation model of sheath induced voltage and current loss is established. The non-decoupling form of the matrix is introduced to simplify the nodal admittance matrix. The influence of cable characteristics on the induced voltage and loss of the sheath is investigated and the cable loss reduction methods are analyzed and summarized. The results show that the laying mode has little effect on the induced voltage loss of the sheath. When the connection resistance is 0.5$\Omega$, the induced voltage requirement is met, and the total loss is the lowest. When the conductivity of the armor layer is 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> S/m, the total loss of the submarine cable is the lowest.

articleTitle: Distributed state estimation of distribution network with adaptive network partition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing scale of distribution network, massive data information has brought huge challenges for traditional centralized state estimation (CSE). Distributed state estimation (DSE) which has the advantage of being plug-and-play, without requirement of global communication and computation, is being studied and applied widely. In this paper, a distributed state estimation method with adaptive network partition is proposed. Firstly, the distribution network is partitioned into several subareas with overlapping nodes using the adaptive network partition method based on affinity propagation clustering algorithm. Then, the local state estimation of the subareas is performed using the weighted least squares method (WLS), and the information exchange between different subareas is carried out using consensus algorithm at boundary nodes. Simulation results of IEEE69 bus system verify the effectiveness of the proposed distributed state estimation method.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of LoRa Technology in Substations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: LoRa, as a low-power wide area communication technology, has been applied in the field of substation. This paper briefly introduces the characteristics of LoRa technology, analyzes the current situation and existing problems of LoRa technology in communication rate, communication distance, network architecture and information security, demonstrates its application scenario combined with the characteristics of substation communication network, and finally prospects the application of LoRa technology in substations.

articleTitle: Small-signal Modeling and Input Impedance of ISOP DC Transformer with Switched Resonant Branches for Self-Voltage Balancing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the input-series-output-parallel (ISOP) DC transformer (DCT), the input voltage sharing (IVS) control is an essential but complex design process. This paper proposes an improved ISOPDCT based on dual-active-bridge modules. By integrating the switched resonant branches in the input bridges of the modules, this topology not only succeeds in the self-voltage balancing without any IVS control but also has few impacts on the dual-active-bridge modules operation. This paper builds a full-order continuous-time small-signal model of the proposed DCT and the closed-loop input impedance for the future unified controller design of the proposed topology. The experimental results and simulation have verified the functions and impedance modeling of the proposed self-voltage balancing DC transformer.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of a Tubular Flux-Switching Permanent Magnet Linear Motor for aviation actuator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Traditional linear actuators are driven by rotating motors and use a mechanical structure to converts rotational motion into linear motion. Due to the complex transmission mechanism, this kind of actuator is difficult to meet the need of rapid action, high reliability, high frequency response in the aviation field. Therefore, linear motor actuators have received extensive attention from scholars at home and abroad, but traditional linear motors have their own drawbacks. In this paper, a Tubular Flux-Switching Permanent Magnet Linear Motor (TFSPMLM) is proposed, which combines the high efficiency and high power density of the traditional Permanent Magnet Linear Motor (PMLM) with the high reliability of the Switched Reluctance Linear Motor (SRLM). Firstly, a novel segmented secondary structure based on the traditional slotted secondary structure is proposed, and their topological structures and working principles are introduced. Secondly, combined with finite element method (FEM), the two motors are designed and optimized respectively based on the performance requirements of an existing aeronautical actuator. Finally, the FEM is used to analyze and compare the electromagnetic characteristics of the two types of motors. The results show that the novel secondary structure has the advantages of small positioning force, small thrust fluctuation and low back EMF THD, and it is feasible to apply them to this kind of aviation actuator.

Author Keywords: Tubular flux-Switching permanent magnet linear motor

articleTitle: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Voltage Control Method for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the distributed voltage control optimally in real-time for distribution network with high penetration of renewable energy sources, a deep reinforcement learning voltage control (DRLVC) method is proposed in this paper. Based on the network partition, the voltage control method with coordinated optimizing the reactive power output of PV inverter and active power output of energy storage system (ESS) is formulated as the Markov decision process for each sub-network. Then, with information communication, the distributed voltage control model is formulated as the multi-agent deep reinforcement learning model. And the improved multi-agent depth determination strategy gradient (MADDPG) algorithm is employed to solve the constructed model efficiently. Finally, numerical simulations are conducted on the 322-bus test network to show the effectiveness of the proposed DRLVC method.

articleTitle: Safety Management in Substation Project Construction Based on Advanced Internet of Things and Smart Sensors Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The infrastructure construction of the power grid is a key part of the national power supply. Power construction is characterized by a complex environment, including many personnel and equipment, and cross-industry multi-unit collaboration. Therefore, it is difficult to achieve precise safety management in substation project construction (SPC). To improve the safety management and control of SPC, a security management and control system is proposed and realized based on the advanced Internet of Things (IoT) and smart sensors technologies. Based on the characteristics of the SPC, the analysis of the construction process of the safety management system is carried out. The operation parameters are sampled by smart sensors, and uploaded by industrial gateway devices and IoT communication devices. The monitoring data would be analyzed by artificial intelligence algorithms and the results would be shown in the building information modeling (BIM) map. Finally, a management and control system covering monitoring, early warning and alarming has been constructed. The application of smart construction site systems is also discussed in the safety management and control of SPC. Combined with the application of the actual field system, the rationality of the safety management and control system is verified.

articleTitle: Design of fast charging magnetic circuit structure for AGV wireless charging
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the wired power transmission mode of automatic guided vehicle (AGV) needs to be charged regularly, which increases the additional charging time, resulting in the discontinuity of work and the potential safety hazards in the process of plugging in and out, the design scheme of AGV dynamic wireless power transmission system is proposed. Because the AGV circulates back and forth on the whole running track, and stops regularly at both ends of the running guide rail according to the work requirements to install goods, load and unload materials and carry personnel, and change the running direction, the two ends of the guide rail are set as static wireless charging stations to realize the fast charging design at the ends, so as to improve the working efficiency of the AGV.

articleTitle: A Method for Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Transformer Based on the CNN-LSTM Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The transformer is one of the core equipment of the power distribution network, and its reliability determines the safety of the distribution network. Therefore, it is significant to study the prediction of the remaining useful life (RUL) to prevent the catastrophic failures of the distribution network. In this paper, an advanced RUL prediction model based on the CNN (convolutional neural network) -LSTM (long short-term memory network) network is proposed. The proposed model can identify the fault characteristics of the transformer from the original data, and then accurately predict the RUL of the transformer. Compared with the traditional data-driven method, the proposed method does not rely on signal processing technology and the prior knowledge of diagnostic experts. The method in this paper has better performance during complex operating conditions. The experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Application of Internet + digital technology in the integrated management of feasibility study and design of UHV transmission line project
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, the digital application of UHV engineering design is still at initial stage. In order to solve problems, such as mixed majors, tons of participants, hard to collaborate, and lack of unified work platform, this article is going to introduce a method of construction the platform, which could be used for the integrated management of feasibility study and design of UHV transmission line project. By using WebGIS, cloud computing, with remote sensing data, engineering design data and real sense 3D modeling, this method will create a platform for substation (converter) stations and transmission lines with visualization of 3D models, progress query and process control, etc. This new method will create a closed-loop for line feasibility study design results and online business management. Furthermore, it will accumulate engineering digital results dynamically and provides sustainable services in the follow-up projects. By using this new application, the collaborative design and lean management level of UHV projects will be efficiently improved.

articleTitle: Switch State optimization of Doubly Salient Electromagnetic Motor Based on Torque Closed-loop Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the problem that the torque ripple increases when the torque closed-loop control of doubly salient electromagnetic motor (DSEM) is large in speed or load, this paper proposes a switch state optimization strategy based on torque closed-loop control. In order to ensure that the conduction phase can output enough torque to compensate for the non-conduction phase torque during commutation, an electrical cycle of DSEM was divided into 9 sectors. Combined with the influence of the phase current change rate on the torque output in different switch states, the method of switch state optimization in each sector was determined. Finally, a 12/8-pole DSEM model is simulated, and the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed switch state optimization method, which can effectively suppress the torque ripple when the motor speed or load increases.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Distributed Synchronous Condenser For High-Proportion Renewable Sending End Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The continuous increase in the proportion of renewables leads to a decline in the voltage support capability of the direct-current transmission sending grid. Configuring distributed synchronous condenser in renewables stations can effectively solve the transient voltage problem. In order to maximize the configuration effect, this paper proposes an optimal configuration method for distributed synchronous condenser that considers the characteristics of high-proportion renewables direct current transmission systems. This method uses the improved trajectory sensitivity to screen out the candidate installation nodes that can improve the transient voltage stability of the system with the application of the synchronous condenser. In order to improve the capability of the system voltage support, the minimum configuration capacity is optimized by using the multiple renewable station short circuit ratio. Then a regulator that satisfies the safety, stability and economy of the power system is obtained. The validity of the synchronous condenser optimal configuration scheme is verified through a typical example.

Author Keywords: multiple renewabls station short circuit ratio

articleTitle: Power Quality Disturbance Identification Method Based on Improved GSA-SVM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the power quality problems caused by the use of a large amount of power electronic equipment, nonlinear load and electrified railway in the distribution network, nine common models of power quality disturbance signals are built in MATLAB / simulink for simulation analysis. In this paper, a 10-layer fast wavelet decomposition method using db4 wavelet transform is proposed, and the energy values of detail components in each layer are calculated as eigenvectors. Aiming at the problem that the penalty factor and kernel function parameters of support vector machine (SVM) are easy to fall into local optimal solution in the course of optimization, an improved universal gravitation search algorithm (IGSA) is proposed to optimize the penalty factor and kernel function parameters of SVM. By optimizing the parameters, the IGSA-SVM classifier is constructed. The extracted feature vectors are normalized and input into the constructed IGSA-SVM classifier to train and identify the datas. The proposed method is tested by adding 0dB, 20dB and 30 dB Gaussian white noise to the signal, and compared with the GSA-SVM classifier. The results of simulation indicate that the proposed method is effective and precise.

articleTitle: Research Progress of Integrated Solar Chimney Power Plant System coupled with Low-Temperature Heat Source
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the research progress of integrated solar chimney power plant system coupled with industrial waste flue gas, hot waste water, geothermal water and other heat sources is first introduced, from the perspective of coupling utilization of low-temperature heat source and solar chimney power generation technology. The use of low-temperature heat sources can greatly improve system performance, smooth the peak-to-valley difference of generated power and reduce the sensitivity of system performance to dynamic changes in the external environment, thus ensuring the stable and efficient operation of the system. In particular, the recycling of waste heat from industrial flue gas, wastewater and garbage greatly improves environmental thermal pollution. The integrated system coupled with low-temperature heat sources has positive significance for the commercial promotion of solar chimney power plant and the solution of environmental problems. In further exploration, attention should be paid, from the perspectives of system performance and its economy, to optimizing the layout design of the integrated system, scaling down the system and making it easier for multiple heat sources to deploy and complement each other.

articleTitle: A Modulation Scheme to Suppress Common-Mode Voltage of Four-Level Dual Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The dual-inverter system can achieve multilevel operation with only two two-level converters. It can generate up to five levels with appropriate DC-link voltage configurations. Yet, the dual inverter system suffers from the common-mode voltage issue which generates zero-sequence currents and thereby deteriorates the load performance. To address this issue, this paper proposes a novel modulation scheme to suppress the common-mode voltage for the dual inverter. The four-level configuration is taken as an example since it performs better than the three-level and is simpler than the five-level. Firstly, the operation principle of the dual-inverter system is introduced, and the mathematical model is established. Secondly, the space vector modulation method based on line voltage vector is presented, and the modulation area is classified, so that the number of line voltage levels output by the dual-inverter system changes with the size of the load. Thirdly, by analyzing the expression of common-mode voltage, a method for suppressing common-mode voltage of the four-level dual inverters is proposed. Finally, the simulation results in Matlab/Simulink are provided to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-level Staircase Signal Based Quadrature Phase Detection for Fundamental Power Angle Acquisition of BIPT Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Bidirectional inductive power transfer (BIPT) allows power to be transferred bidirectionally between two electrical systems. In BIPT systems, phase synchronization of the AC port excitation voltage with the resonant current is essential for a stable transmission of power, which requires the detection of the phase difference between the fundamental components of the voltage and current, which is the fundamental power angle. To detect the fundamental power angle, this paper proposes a quadrature phase detection based fundamental power angle acquisition method with multi-level staircase signal as multiplicand. By using the multi-level staircase signal with eliminated low order harmonics, the phase detection error caused by the resonant current harmonics can be reduced. The basic characteristics of the BIPT system as well as the working principle of the quadrature phase detection method are introduced. The impact of harmonics on the fundamental power angle detection result is analyzed. The low order harmonics elimination parameters of the multi-level staircase signal are calculated. And the method to implement the multiplication of the resonant current with the equivalent multi-level staircase signal without using any multiplier, is proposed. Simulations are performed with the proposed method under various conditions, which show the improvement of the accuracy of the phase detection result with the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on Corona Discharge Characteristics of Soil under Pulse High Voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of industrialization and urbanization, soil pollution is becoming more and more serious. As soil pollution is closely related to human health, soil pollution control is imminent. Since the 20th century, plasma technology is developing rapidly, and the low temperature plasma technology in the application in the field of environmental protection has received great attention. Therefore, the study of soil discharge characteristics is of great significance to explore the treatment of soil pollution by low temperature plasma technology. In this paper, the corona discharge characteristics of soil under pulse high voltage are studied by combining experiment with theory. In view of the problem that soil discharge phenomenon is difficult to observe or the observation cost is too high, this paper adopts CCD method to obtain the typical soil discharge image, and analyzes the discharge phenomenon. At the same time, the characteristics of soil discharge voltammetry under pulse high voltage were studied, and the typical current waveform of soil corona discharge under pulse high voltage was given. In addition, a spectrum diagnostic experiment platform was built to study the concentration of active particles corresponding to soil discharge through emission spectrum. In this paper, the effects of pulse voltage with different frequency and rising time on soil discharge characteristics were studied experimentally. Based on the typical discharge images, volt-ampere characteristics and spectral diagnostic data, the mechanism behind the experimental phenomenon was discussed. The research results have certain guiding significance for soil remediation by low-temperature plasma.

articleTitle: An coupling vibration suppression method based SDDC for PMSM traction drive system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The issue of electromechanical coupling vibration (EMCV) in permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) traction drive system is of concern, which may lead to the instability of system. To address this, an EMCV suppression method based on the difference damping compensation (SDDC) is proposed in this paper. In the proposed SDDC method, with the double inertia system model of the PMSM traction drive system, the mechanism of the EMCV is first analyzed. It is revealed from the analysis that the angle deviation contributes to the EMCV. Then, the proposed SDDC method is accordingly performed, in which the electromagnetic torque and shaft moment disturbance caused by speed deviation are compensated. By doing so, the electromechanical coupling oscillations in PMSM traction drive system are effectively suppressed, and consequently the electromechanical performance is obviously improved. Extensive simulations are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed SDDC method.

articleTitle: Two-stage allocation of electric vehicle charging stations considering coordinated charging scenario
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with people’s increasing attention to environmental pollution and greenhouse effect, the number of electric vehicles (EVs) more in line with green development has grown rapidly and become a non-negligible part of the distribution system. At present, with the continuous growth of EV penetration, how to establish electric vehicle charging stations (EVCSs) with more reasonable location, more abundant capacity and higher utilization rate of charging facilities (CFs) have become an urgent problem to be solved. In this context, two-stage allocation of EVCS considering coordinated charging scenario is proposed. In the site selection stage, the driving distance of EV charging in the region has been taken into account, the distance weight coefficient is introduced. In the capacity planning stage, this paper fully considers the influence of EV charging behavior on EVCS capacity, and builds EV charging behavior model participating in temporal scheduling. The location and capacity planning scheme of EVCS proposed in this paper can fully reduce the extra driving distance generated by EV charging, improve the utilization rate of CFs, improve the safety and economy of distribution network, and make the location and capacity of EVCS more in line with the actual demand. The comprehensive model is established as a mixed integer second order cone programming (MISOCP) problem, and tested on a real urban area to demonstrate its effectiveness.

Author Keywords: mixed integer second order cone programming (MISOCP)

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship between Building Energy-saving Performance and Building Spacing in Regions with Hot Summer and Cold Winter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Since the beginning of the 21st century, there has been a growing call for public attention on low carbon emissions and reduction of energy consumption in the world. Nowadays, about 40% of the world’s total energy is consumed by buildings. Through effective design of building form, reasonable planning and layout of the building group, energy consumption of buildings can be reduced. This paper focuses on teaching building. Taking the teaching building of Jiulonghu Campus of Southeast University as an example, it analyzes the energy consumption of teaching building in the geographical environment of the campus, focuses on the surrounding buildings’ impact and changes on the energy consumption and researches on how radiation changes with different building spacing. This paper chooses Rhino automatic modeling platform and Grasshopper visual node programming plug-in and decides on Energy-plus as simulation tools. The results shows that when the building spacing increases by 1.1 times, the overall solar radiation increases and the total thermal load decreases by 0.479%. When the spacing is reduced by 0.9 times, the overall solar radiation is reduced, but the overall thermal energy consumption is reduced by 1.336%, which is more than the energy saved by increasing the spacing by 1.1 times.

articleTitle: YASA axial flux machine with non-uniform arrangement of stator segmented modules for reducing harmonics of back EMF
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Stator yokeless and segmented armature (YASA) axial flux permanent magnet (AFPM) machine with soft magnetic composite (SMC) core has the advantages of compact structure and high power density, but the concentrated winding will product abundant harmonics of back EMF. In this paper, the non-uniform arrangement of segmented stator modules is proposed for YASA machine, which are each segmented-stator module is arranged non-uniformly in the circumferential direction. Firstly, the relationship between segmented-stator module uniform arrangement and non-uniform arrangement of no-load back EMF is obtained by phasor diagram. Then, the non-uniform distribution coefficient of no-load back EMF is established, and its no-load characteristics are analyzed. Finally, the proposed method and structure are proved by finite element analysis (FEA). The results show that the non-uniform distribution coefficient is accurate within the allowable error range, and the non-uniform arrangement of segmented-stator module can effectively reduce harmonics and improve the sinusoidal properties of no-load back EMF to improve the performance of YASA machine.

articleTitle: Toluene conversion by gliding arc discharge in the simulated gasified product gas
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Gasification is a flexible approach to utilizing biomass efficiently and effectively. However, this process suffers from tar formation. Here we performed the plasmas-assisted conversion biomass gasification tar in a gliding arc discharge reactor. Toluene and the simulated product gas were used as the model tar compound and the carrier gas, respectively. The discharge characteristic measurement and the reaction performance evaluation were carried out to under the effect of gas flow rate and regulator voltage. Results show that increasing the regulator voltage and decreasing the gas flow rate promoted the discharge, evidenced by the enhanced discharge area and the intensity of reactive species, which increased the toluene conversion but decreased the energy efficiency. The highest energy efficiency of 102.8 g/kWh is achieved when the total gas flow rate and the regulator voltage is 7.5 L/min and 175 V, respectively. In addition, the concentration of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and CO in the product gas is enhanced, but that of CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is reduced by the plasma reforming process, which might contribute to enhancement in the lower heating value of the product gas.

articleTitle: Research on Parameter Identification Method of Asynchronous Motor Considering Load Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the existing asynchronous motor parameter identification method only identifies the parameters of the motor itself, ignoring the parameters of the asynchronous motor load, this paper proposes a particle swarm optimization algorithm combined with spatial disturbance to realize the integrated parameter identification of the asynchronous motor, machine and pump. On the premise of identifying the parameters of the asynchronous motor itself, the load parameters of the pump are identified, and the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to realize the integrated identification of the asynchronous motor and the load. By combining the particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO) and the spatial disturbance (SD), the six equivalent parameters of the asynchronous motor and the pump load factor can be accurately and effectively identified. Compared with the traditional PSO algorithm, the global search method is increased. Excellent ability. An example proves the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Diffusion Motion Analysis of gas Molecules in Oil - paper Insulation System Based on Molecular Dynamics Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The diffusion movement of small gas molecules in oil-paper insulation has an important influence on the insulation state evaluation. In order to reveal the diffusion mechanism of small molecules in oil-paper insulation system from the microscopic level, the diffusion behavior of small molecules in common H2O, CO2 and C2H4 gases was simulated by molecular dynamics. Molecular simulation software was used to build the model of insulating paper and insulating oil, and two kinds of small molecule diffusion models were built on this basis. The difference of diffusion characteristics of gas small molecules in oil-paper medium was discussed, and the distribution influence and diffusion mechanism of gas small molecules in insulating oilpaper were obtained. Studies have shown that the diffusion coefficient of gas small molecules in cellulose is one order of magnitude smaller than that in insulating oil, and the order of diffusion coefficients of three gas small molecules in two media is also different. Water molecules are especially easy to do diffusion movement in insulating oil. When encountering insulating paper, the movement will be hindered, and the macroscopic performance is the water absorption characteristics of insulating paper.

articleTitle: Performance Quantization and Comparative Assessment of Three Differential Power Processing Converters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To address the mismatching issues in photovoltaic (PV) module and sub-module level, distributed power processing (DPP) displays advantages in power-improvement and efficiency. There are two main methods utilized in DPP converter, e.g. voltage equalization (VE) and true maximum power point tracking (MPPT), based on which multi typologies are explored. However, the experiment conducted in previous research almost focused on the efficiency in particular mismatch condition, while the performances under real irradiation and temperature were rarely studied. In this paper, an algorithm is developed in MATLAB to quantify performance of different DPP typologies with daily irradiation and temperature under different mismatching conditions to measure performance of different DPP architectures. The comparison is conducted, including processed power under mismatching conditions, output powers, efficiency and total power losses. The PV-to-bus architecture shows the best adaptability under all conditions, whereas the (Seirs-Resonant Voltage Multiplier) SRVM shows the worst performance under severely shaded condition.

articleTitle: Cantilever enhanced PA spectroscopy detection for CO decomposition in SF6 equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The internal decomposition gases of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> internal gas insulation equipment is closely related to the insulation state of the equipment. According to the relevant regulations, CO is an important component, and its concentration information can be used as the basis to judge the internal insulation state of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> equipment. Gas detection based on photoacoustic spectroscopy is an effective method for current line monitoring. In this study, the distributed feedback semiconductor laser was used as the light source and the interferometer cantilever acoustic sensor was used as the acoustic sensor to set up the photoacoustic spectrum detection device. The CO molecular spectral line of 2.33 $\mu$m was selected as the research object to detect CO by photoacoustic spectroscopy, and the pressure characteristics of the photoacoustic signal is studied. The results show that the detected signal has high stability and a good linear relationship with gas concentration. The minimum detection limit of CO in SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas is 5.1 ppm, and the photoacoustic signal detected by interferometric cantilever excited by CO decreases with the increase of pressure, which is mainly caused by the decline of the response ability of interferometric cantilever with the increase of pressure.

articleTitle: Analysis of Excitation Magnetic Field of Air-cored Superconducting Linear Synchronous Motor for EDS Train
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The propulsion force of electrodynamic suspension train is provided by air-cored superconducting linear synchronous motor (AC-SLSM). In this paper, the excitation magnetic field of the AC-SLSM is analyzed in detail. Firstly, the basic configuration of the motor is described. Secondly, the excitation magnetic field of AC-SLSM is analyzed in detail by Biot–Savart law. Finally, the effects of superconducting magnetomotive force, armature current and air gap length on propulsion force of AC-SLSM are analyzed by finite element software.

articleTitle: Few-shot Electric Equipment Classification via Mutual Learning of Transfer-learning Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Commonly, developing an accurate model to classify power equipment requires a host of equipment images. However, because of the security and sensitivity problems, the industry could provide a limited number of those images. It, therefore, raises a challenge: what makes a limited number of images effective to generate feature information for training the classification model. To address this challenge, this paper develops a Mutual Learning of Transfer-Learning (MLTL) method based on few-shot learning. Firstly, this paper utilized enhanced preprocessing on the image dataset, including rotation, random cropping, and normalization, to expand the original data. Secondly, two transfer-learning based models with different parameters are trained by the weighted sum of the cross-entropy loss and the self-supervised loss. The output of each model provides a regularization term for each other, which can be further improved by mutual learning between two models. Finally, given the K shots for each new class on the support set, the MLTL computers class weight vectors and make a prediction on the query set. Case studies on EEI-40 demonstrate that the developed MLTL method achieves 95.4% classification accuracy by collecting only 5-shot images. Additionally, to ensure the interpretability and reliability of the MLTL model, this paper visualizes the parameters of each convolution layer.

articleTitle: Influence of Waterway Blockage Fault on Temperature Distribution of Stator Transposition Winding
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Stator winding waterway blockage fault is a serious body fault of water-cooled turbo-generator. Mastering the corresponding law between waterway blockage fault and stator winding temperature distribution is the premise of on-line monitoring and fault diagnosis. In this paper, a three-dimensional thermal network model for calculating the temperature of water-cooled stator winding considering the actual transposition structure is proposed. By comparing with the experimental data, the necessity of considering the transposition structure and the correctness of the calculation results are verified. Furthermore, the temperature distribution law of stator winding under different blocking positions and different blocking numbers of hollow strands is studied, and compared with the temperature distribution law obtained by the existing calculation method without considering transposition structure.

articleTitle: A parametric modeling method for planar coil design in wireless power transfer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A parametric modeling method is proposed to study the inductance and resistance of planar disk coil. The proposed method takes account of almost all the structural features and simplified the complexity of modeling. A finite element model was established by this method and indicates the variation of inductance and resistance. The validity of the proposed method is verified by comparing the measured and calculated inductance and resistance. Compared with traditional modeling methods, the proposed method improves the portability, logicality, and scalability of the model and 70% of the modeling time is saved in this work. This work provides a new idea for the optimal design of planar circular coil especially with a large number of models.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Detection and Location Method of Avionic Data Bus
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Avionic data bus is an important channel to transmit information for aircraft control system and mechatronic system. Once it occurs a disconnection or short circuit fault, the communication of control system would fail and man-machine safety would be endangered. In this paper, several reflection methods are introduced. Among them, Spread Spectrum Time Domain Reflectometry (SSTDR) is emphatically discussed. The feasibility of applying SSTDR to fault detection and location of avionic data bus is analyzed theoretically. The transmission characteristics of several typical avionic data buses are introduced, and the reliability of communication under the interference of detection signal is analyzed. The amplitude and attenuation of SSTDR signal applied to data transmission bus is calculated. Simulation and experimental verification proves that the fault detection and location of avionic data bus using SSTDR method can ensure the accuracy, low bit error rate and feasibility.

articleTitle: Research on the method of enhancing the hydrophobicity of planar and cylindrical-curved ceramic by atmospheric pressure plasma jet
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Atmospheric pressure plasma jet (APPJ) has unique advantage for treating materials with non-planar structure. Current studies mainly focus on the performance of plane surface, while the effect of surface geometry on the treatment method and performance requires to be further investigated. In this paper, comparative studies are carried out for the treatment of planar and cylindrical curved ceramic with APPJ to improve surface hydrophobicity. The Ar plasma jet was generated by nanosecond pulse power excitation, and the influence of treatment material shape on discharge characteristics was studied with discharge images and discharge voltage and current waveforms. The momentum PDMS was mixed with Ar to conduct hydrophobic treatment on the planar and columnar ceramic materials respectively. The treatment effects were compared and analyzed through the distribution of water contact angles on the surfaces under different treatment distance. The results show that the shape of the material has little effect on the discharge characteristics of the jet, and it is explained combining with the equivalent circuit model. The treatment effect shows that the material shape has a significant influence on the water contact angle distribution, where the plane is in a circular distribution, and the cylinder is in an elliptical distribution. When the processing distance is in the range of 10 ~ 20 mm, no matter the plane or cylindrical material, the super-hydrophobic treatment can be realized at the center position, and increasing or reducing the processing distance will make the treatment effect worse. In addition, when the treatment distance is 20 mm, the surface treatment effect is the best, as the super-hydrophobic treatment covers a larger region. This result can provide guidance for the application of atmospheric pressure plasma jet for non-planar material surface treatment.

articleTitle: A Stator Design of Traveling-Wave Ultrasonic Micromotor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of Microelectromechanical systems technology, piezoelectric traveling-wave ultrasonic micromotor has been widely used in micro equipment due to excellent performance, such as high-density output, high torque at low speed. A stator structure of ultrasonic motor working under the B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</inf> mode is analyzed and designed, which consists of a ring Si substrate of 3mm in radius, twenty Lead zirconate titanate (PZT) blocks and twenty supporting beams. The finite element simulation results show that the structure can generate two nearly symmetrical standing wave modes with a quarter wavelength difference in phase, and has a high quality factor (Q), so the micromotor can be driven by synthesizing high quality traveling-wave from the two standing waves, and can control the rotate speed through the drive voltage.

articleTitle: Research on Position Sensorless Control of Doubly Salient Electromagnetic Generator Based on Phase Flux
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Compared with the uncontrolled rectification power generation system, the doubly salient electromagnetic generator(DSEG) can effectively improve its power generation under the controllable rectification power generation mode. However, the position sensor required for controlled rectification has a high failure rate in harsh environments, which reduces the stability of the system. To solve this problem, a position sensorless operation control strategy for DSEG based on phase flux linkage calculation is proposed in this paper. The phase flux linkage is calculated by detecting the phase voltage and phase current of the winding, and there is a correspondence between the intersection point of the phase flux linkage and the specific position of the rotor, so as to obtain the rotor sector switching signal and calculate the rotor angle in real-time according to the sector switching signal. This method does not require rotor initial position information and is suitable for DSEG rotor position detection in medium and high-speed operation. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by MATLAB/Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: PSCAD/EMTDC Based Arc Model Simulation Method for Single-pole Grounding Fault
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: True bipolar voltage source converter (VSC) based high voltage direct current (HVDC) systems have been extensively developed in recent years. An effective arc model simulation method based on PSCAD/EMTDC platform is the basis and key for studying the fault arc characteristics in true bipolar VSC-HVDC systems. First, the arc model theory is analyzed to provide a theoretical basis for modeling the arc model. Then, the arc model simulation method is proposed, which includes: primary arc resistance module, secondary arc resistance module, secondary arc length control module, secondary arc self-extinction module, and arc resistance output module. Finally, simulation results in PSCAD/EMTDC verify the effectiveness of the proposed arc model simulation method.

articleTitle: Comparison and Analysis of Pickup of New Monorail-based Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the existing segmented suspension monorail-based wireless power supply system, some coupling mechanisms have low coupling performance, insufficient output power, and some are not flexible enough to pass through the transition node. In view of the above shortcomings, a new AUI type coupling mechanism is proposed in this paper, which has both high coupling ability and high flexibility. By theoretical analysis and experimental verification, it is proved that AUI type coupling mechanism has the characteristics of high coupling performance, high power density and high anti offset ability compared with the traditional E-type coupling mechanism. Under the same excitation and load change conditions, the relative power density of AUI type coupling mechanism is about 3.51 times that of E-type coupling mechanism, and the efficiency of AUI type coupling mechanism is 95.876%.

articleTitle: Comparison of 2-pole Slotted High-speed Motors with Toroidal and Tooth-coil Windings
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper compares the electromagnetic performance between 6-slot/2-pole slotted high-speed permanent magnet (HSPM) motors with toroidal and tooth-coil windings. Both HSPM motors are optimized to achieve maximum torque by using genetic algorithm based on the finite element method accounting for thermal limitation. For the 6-slot/2-pole slotted HSPM motors with toroidal and tooth-coil windings, even though their winding factors are the same, the optimized motor with toroidal windings has higher torque, higher PM utilization, and smaller winding inductance. With any stator stack length, the toroidal windings can offer advantages of higher torque/copper loss and torque/stator iron and copper losses.

articleTitle: Impedance Analysis of Buffer Layer of High Voltage XLPE Cables
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the buffer layer of high voltage XLPE cable is ablated, white powders often appear at the contact position between water blocking tape and aluminum sheath, which changes the impedance of the buffer layer. In order to study the impact of white powders on the buffer layer impedance, an impedance circuit model of buffer layer in 110 kV XLPE cable was established, and the amplitudes of the new buffer layer as well as the defective one at different lengths were simulated and calculated by Simulink. Also, the repairing method for cables with white powder defects is studied, by replacing the water blocking tape with the new one in different positions and some suggestions were given. The results have shown that the buffer layer with white powder defects will significantly increase the impedance between the cable insulation screen and the aluminum sheath. The impedance of the new buffer layer is almost unchanged with the length increasing, while the impedance of the water blocking tape with white powders decreases with the length increasing and gradually tends to a steady value. Using replacement units with good conductivity in different positions of the defective cables can provide a reference for the remediation of cable buffer layer defects with white powders.

articleTitle: Six-phase cylindrical linear induction motor with high-frequency vibration suppression and experimental study
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The six-phase cylindrical linear induction motor has been applied in many fields due to its symmetrical structure, high utilization of the primary winding and no transverse end effect. However, the inverter adopts the sinusoidal pulse width modulation (SPWM) strategy to power the motor, which causes the phase currents to generate harmonic currents at the switching frequency and its double or side-band frequencies, which in turn causes the motor to vibrate at high frequencies. To address the above problem, this paper investigates a carrier phase shifted control for suppressing high frequency vibrations in the six-phase cylindrical linear induction motor. In this paper, by staggering the carriers of the two sets three-phase windings by a certain angle and properly adjusting the carrier phase of two inverters in the motor system, certain side-band harmonics can be cancelled out by each other, which reduces the harmonic magnetomotive force in the air gap, and achieves the purpose of suppressing high frequency vibration of the motor. The simulation analysis and experimental results verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Load Frequency Control Based on Age-of-Information
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, load frequency control (LFC) systems employ open communication networks to meet the requirement of modern power system communication. However, some new risks were introduced into the LFC system, such as information staleness. The communication delay, which is a packet-centric metric, is used to portray the degree of information staleness in the existing works, whereas it cannot fully capture the freshness degree of information updates. In this paper, age-of-information (AoI) is introduced to describe the freshness of the whole information update process. An AoI based stability criterion for sampled-data LFC systems is formulated. Results show that the LFC stability is dependent on AoI and the delay-dependent criteria is a special case of the AoI- dependent one.

articleTitle: An Open-circuit Fault Diagnosis Method based on Virtual Current Coefficients for Power Converter of Doubly Salient Electro-Magnetic Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power converter is a weak link in motor system. The failure of power converter will cause the motor working in an unbalanced state, affecting the stability of the whole system and even damaging the motor. Therefore, the fault diagnosis of power converter is the key to improve the reliability of motor system. In this paper, three open-circuit fault types of power converter in doubly salient electro-magnetic motor(DSEM) drive system are studied, and an open-circuit fault diagnosis method based on virtual current coefficients is proposed. This method leads out the upper and lower bridge arm buses in the traditional three-phase bridge power converter topology, and changes the installation position of current sensors. Based on current information obtained by the current sensors in the new position and driving signal, two virtual current coefficients are obtained. The difference between the two current coefficients is used as fault characteristics to realize fault diagnosis. Finally, the effectiveness of proposed method is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: A Simple Calculation Method for Lightning Stroke Flashover Rate of 10 kV Distribution Overhead Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In China, the lightning damage seriously affects the safety of power supply in 10 kV distribution networks. The calculation of lightning stroke flashover rate is an important part of the lightning protection of distribution networks. Currently, simulation software and differential numerical calculation methods are mainly used in the field of simulation calculation research. However, the complexity of the simulation model building process and the low efficiency of the calculation do not meet the needs of designers and operators of power grid. In this paper, a simple calculation method for lightning stroke flashover rate of 10 kV distribution overhead lines is proposed by analysing the main influencing factors and influence laws. The direct and indirect lightning stroke flashover rate of 10 kV distribution overhead lines can be obtained quickly, avoiding complex physical simulation modeling and numerical calculation processes, and greatly improving work efficiency.

articleTitle: Repetitive Operation and Insulation Recovery Characteristics of a Sealed-off Double-gap Pseudospark Switch
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Repetitive operation and insulation recovery characteristics of a sealed-off double-gap pseudospark switch have been experimentally investigated in this paper. The influence of hydrogen heater current is emphasized, and the results are analyzed from the discharge waveforms. As the heater current increases, the values of self-breakdown voltage and trigger delay decrease. In a relatively wide range of heater current, the hold-off voltage is higher than 50 kV, and the trigger jitter is below 3 ns. The minimum jitter is smaller than 1 ns. The direct repetitive operation of 2 kHz is achieved at the 15 kV anode voltage and the 1 kA current amplitude. Tests of higher repetition rate cannot be achieved due to the limitation of the charging circuit and trigger system. According to double-pulse tests, the insulation recovery speed is higher at lower heater current. As the time delay between two pulses increases, the second pulse breakdown voltage increases nonlinearly, and the insulation recovery curve shows different features from high-pressure switches. The maximum repetition rate can be higher than 8kHz for 40 kV pulsed voltage.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation Strategy of Low-Carbon Integrated Energy System Considering Power to Gas and Carbon Capture Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to promote the accommodation of renewable energy and carbon emission reduction, an integrated energy system (IES) optimal operation strategy based on power to gas (P2G) and carbon capture system (CCS) is proposed. The system is equipped with wind turbine, photovoltaic unit, combined heat and power (CHP), gas boiler, natural gas source and electric refrigerator. Then, an optimal scheduling model of IES using P2G and carbon capture technology is established. The carbon trading mechanism, equipment constraints and energy balance constraints are also considered in this operation model. The accommodation capacity, carbon emission and operation costs of the system are analyzed and compared under different modes. Finally, the simulation results verify that the proposed model can effectively improve the wind power accommodation capacity, also reduce carbon emission and comprehensive economic operation costs.

articleTitle: The Torque Elimination Control Strategy for Integrated Charging System of Electric Vehicle with Dual-Battery
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a reconfigured topology of the open-end winding permanent magnet synchronous motor (OW-PMSM) driving system is proposed to achieve the onboard integrated battery charger (IBC) for electric vehicles. The neutral points of the split-phase windings could be employed to reconFigure the on-board battery charger, where the dual-inverter is reused as the bridgeless PFC rectifier and the parallel buck converter, and the simultaneous charging control for the dual-battery with different voltages could be achieved. Since the split-phase windings of OW-PMSM are multiplexed as the filter inductor in the charging mode, the electromagnetic torque with respect to the current distribution scheme with different rotor positions is analyzed, then an eight-state interleaved control strategy for the bridgeless PFC rectifier is proposed to eliminate the electromagnetic torque, and the corresponding charging loss and noise could also be mitigated. Finally, simulation results are implemented to validate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed torque elimination strategy.

Author Keywords: open-end winding permanent magnet synchronous motor (OW-PMSM)

articleTitle: Design of DSOGI-PLL for Power Converters Tied to Fractional Frequency Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Fractional frequency transmission system (FFTS) is a promising solution for integrating large-scale wind energy into power systems. In FFTS, the grid frequency is much less than the typical 50 Hz or 60 Hz. Therefore, the phase-locked-loop (PLL) designed for power converters used in traditional systems could not be suitable in FFTS. This paper proposes the design of dual second-order generalized integrator (DSOGI) based PLL, so as to achieve satisfactory dynamic and steady-state performance. The accurate small-signal model is firstly built. Then the optimal parameters are obtained to achieve fast dynamic responses with small transient oscillations. Simulation results have verified the superior performance of the designed DSOGI-PLL.

articleTitle: Transient Power Sharing Control Algorithm between Virtual Synchronous Generator and Diesel Generator in Isolated Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Mixed-source isolated microgrid is usually composed of renewable energy, energy storage devices and diesel generators (DGs). Virtual synchronous generator (VSG) has been developed recently years. In such an isolated microgrid, transient power cannot be shared due to the faster response of the VSGs, which may cause the overcurrent of the VSGs. Inverter capacity can not be fully utilized. To solve this problem, first, the cause of unequal transient load sharing is analyzed. Then, an improved VSG control algorithm is proposed. The speed governor characteristics of DG is added in VSG, and the virtual impedance of VSG is designed. Finally, the proposed control algorithm is validated by simulation.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of PIV-Based and Model-Based Methods in Calculating Electrical Force Produced by a Blade-Plane Actuator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When a blade-plane actuator is subjected to a high voltage, an electrohydrodynamic (EHD) force is exerted on the dielectric liquid to produce an electroconvective flow. Experimental estimation of the electrical force can be carried out through the momentum integration method based on the velocity fields of particle image velocimetry (PIV) measurements. It is a force-averaged approach which is conducted by integrating the instantaneous Navier-Stokes' momentum equation over a designated control volume. Theoretically, a new method inspired by turbulent plume model is proposed to estimate the EHD force through the axial velocity curve and half-width curve of the time-averaged field. It is found that the calculation error of this effective calculation is within an acceptable range when compared with results obtained by the PIV based method.

articleTitle: Carbon-aware Integrated Energy System Operation with Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The power and gas sectors must take the responsibility to pave the way to reduce their carbon emissions to realize the commitment of carbon peak and carbon neutrality. The developing power-to-gas and gas turbines tighten the relationship between power and gas networks. So this paper proposes the carbon-aware integrated energy system optimization model with demand response. It formulates the DC power flow-based power network, piecewise-based gas transmission network, energy hub, and the demand response model. Based on the models, It presents the carbon model, which analyzes carbon emission from power generators and energy hubs and utilizes the emission quota-based trading mechanism to incentivize low carbon operation of the IES. We finally propose the carbon-aware IES operation model based on the cost of carbon trading, demand response, and fuel. The case study on the 9-node system verifies the carbon reduction effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Multi-model aggregation method for non-intrusive load monitoring based on stacking
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that different non-intrusive load decomposition models are applicable to different loads and different states of the same load, a load decomposition integrated model based on stacking integrated denoising autoencoder model and gated neural network model is proposed. The model first uses the denoising autoencoder model and the gated neural network model to decompose the target load of the bus active power sequence, and obtains the active power sequence of the target load corresponding to the two models; Then the fully connected neural network is used to initially aggregate the two active power sequences into an active power sequence of the target load, and the denoising autoencoder model is used for optimization to obtain the final decomposition result of the target load. Experimental results show that the integration model based on stacking can combine the decomposition advantages of the base model, give full play to the respective advantages of DAE model and Gru model, and realize accurate load decomposition.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy of STATCOM Control Parameters Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An optimization strategy of STATCOM control parameters based on digital twin (DT) is proposed to reduce the risk of cascading failures and improving the refined dynamic response in ultra high voltage direct current system (UHVDC). The strategy aims to solve the problems such as transient instability and large voltage overshoot when the fault occurs. Firstly, the physical model of the UHVDC containing STATCOM is established, which is used as the perception access of the DT. Then, the DT is built based on the deep neural network (DNN), the situation awareness of system is collected for real-time data interaction which is from physical model, and achieves online parameters adjusting and correcting. Finally, the simulation results under typical faults before and after STATCOM control parameter optimization are compared and analyzed to verify the efficiency of proposed optimization strategy.

articleTitle: MPC Active and Reactive Coordinated Voltage Control Considering Adjustment Cost
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When a high proportion of distributed photovoltaic (PV) is connected to the distribution network, the mismatch of source and charge may lead to voltage overrun. In this paper, a coordinated control method of active and reactive power considering equipment adjustment cost is proposed to reduce the adjustment cost of voltage control. Firstly, based on the lack of reactive power margin, a multi-layer distributed mathematical model is established. Among them, the economic adjustment layer puts forward the adjustment cost coefficient, builds the system adjustment cost model based on the uncontrollable cost and controllable cost, calculates the state variable mathematical model of the PV inverter and energy storage, and solves the output of each fast-moving equipment with the goal of minimizing the system voltage danger coefficient and adjustment cost. The recovery control layer establishes the optimization model with the goal of minimizing the security fluctuation of the power grid in each period of the day after releasing the capacity. The simulation results show that the proposed control method can effectively eliminate the influence of voltage deviation and voltage prediction error on real-time operation, and ensure the optimal adjustment cost of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Power Smoothing Control Method of Impulse Load
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The extensive use of impulse loads will not only cause power quality problems such as voltage fluctuation, but also increase the power loss of the power grid, which is not conducive to the realization of the goal of energy conservation and carbon dioxide emission reduction. At present, Static var generator and active power filter, which are widely used in low-voltage power grid, can well compensate the load reactive power and harmonics including impulse reactive power. On this basis, this paper will further study the active power flow controller with low-voltage reactive power compensation, harmonic mitigation and impulse active power smoothing. By improving the detection method of command current of power flow controller, the command current includes the impulse active component of load current, so as to complete the compensation of impulse active power. Finally, the effectiveness of the improved command current detection method is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Detection of SF₆ characteristic decomposition component H₂S by cavity ring-down spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S is one of the characteristic decomposition components in SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>. The detection of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S concentration by optical cavity ring-down spectroscopy is of great value to the evaluation of equipment insulation state. Based on distributed feedback semiconductor laser (DFB), an optical cavity ring-down spectrometer (CRDS) was built to measure the hydrogen sulfide content in SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas by measuring the absorption spectrum of hydrogen sulfide at 1.578μm. The effect of characteristic decomposition products of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> on the detection results of hydrogen sulfide was studied. The results show that the absorption spectra of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and CO molecules overlap with H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S at 1.578 μm, which makes the presence of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and CO in SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas more difficult to detect H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S. CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and CO concentrations are important factors affecting the detection results of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S. With the decrease of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and CO concentrations, the detection error of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S decreases.

articleTitle: Hierarchical and distributed optimal scheduling of virtual power plant based on alternating direction multiplier method
