publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the gradual expansion of the scale of distributed new energy such as wind power and photovoltaic, the volatility and uncertainty of power grid operation have increased significantly. The virtual power plant aggregates the wider distributed resources and loads into a whole to participate in the main network dispatching, which can not only give play to the stable output characteristics of the traditional power plant, but also have good complementary due to the aggregation of a variety of power generation and consumption units, and can better participate in the main network day-to-day, real-time dispatching and auxiliary services. However, there are many kinds of resources in the virtual power plant. How to reasonably arrange the power arrangement of each physical entity and meet the needs of system engineering scheduling is an urgent problem. Aiming at the optimal scheduling problem of virtual power plant participating in day ahead and real-time market, this paper proposes a hierarchical distributed optimal scheduling method of virtual power plant based on alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM).Based on the ADMM algorithm, the centralized optimization problem of the virtual power plant is converted into a distributed optimization problem, and the internal coordination and optimization problem of the virtual power plant with multiple physical entities is solved.

articleTitle: Analysis and Test of Insulation Terminal Defects in Electrical Strength Test of Model Cable
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the model cable is used for electrical strength test, the handling of the terminal is a difficult point. Improper handling can easily cause the breakdown of the internal cable of the terminal, leading to unsuccessful testing. In this paper, with the help of COMSOL finite element analysis software, a simulation analysis of several defects commonly encountered in the terminal processing of the electrical strength test of the model cable, Including the electric field distribution at defects on the surface of the cable insulation under the oil terminal and water terminal, such as: scratches, bumps, external shielding fractures, copper chips, etc. The results show that the oil terminal can effectively weaken the field strength distortion caused by scratches on the insulation surface and copper chips, and reduce the overall field strength in the model cable insulation inside the terminal, but it will increase the field strength distortion at the fracture of the external screen. which is the main reason for the breakdown. The water terminal can effectively weaken the field strength distortion at the fracture of the external screen, but it will increase the field strength distortion caused by the scratches on the insulation surface and copper chips. The internal defects of the model cable insulation are the main reason for the breakdown. The influence of the bumps under the two terminals is not obvious. This research provides a guiding basis for the terminal processing methods of using model cables for electrical strength testing in the future.

articleTitle: Development of polarization and depolarization current testing device for crosslinked polyethylene cables
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The polarization/depolarization current method is based on the dielectric response theory and is one of the nondestructive testing methods for the integral insulation state of crosslinked polyethylene cables. In this paper, a polarization-depolarization current test device for crosslinked polyethylene cables is developed, which is mainly composed of a high voltage circuit board, a current measurement circuit board and a current to voltage conversion module. This paper firstly introduces the principle of the polarization/depolarization current method and analyzes the shortcomings of the commonly used test devices; Then this paper introduces the structure of the developed device and focuses on determining the key parameters. Finally, a laboratory three-branch resistance-capacitance circuit is built to simulate the three-branch Debye model of the power cable and verifies the effectiveness of the developed device.

articleTitle: A Switched Capacitor DC-DC Boost Converter With High Voltage Gain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As renewable energy sources have low output voltage levels and intermittent power generation, high gain boost converters are needed to improve the voltage level when powering equipment with renewable energy sources. Aiming to deal with the issue of low output voltage level, a high voltage gain boost converter is put forward with the introduction of a switched capacitor unit. The put forward converter uses two switch tubes and the driving signals of the two switch tubes are synchronized, which greatly simplifies the control strategy. It is specifically analyzed the operating principle and characteristics of the put forward converter and compared with the existing high gain boost converter. Finally, the theoretical analysis of the put forward dual-switch non-isolated boost converter is verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Study on Partial Discharge Information Entropy Characteristics in Oil-paper Insulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The detection and characteristic of partial discharge of oil-paper insulation is an important means to detect the insulation status of converter transformers. In this paper, we simulate the actual operating environment of transformer, establish the oil-paper insulation needle-plate model, and obtain the partial discharge signal data under different conditions by changing the thickness of cardboard and the spacing between needle and plate. The feasibility of information entropy theory and application to partial discharge signal processing is analyzed. For the whole process of partial discharge, the characteristic parameters of the discharge signal are extracted and characterized according to the PRPD spectrogram and signal data. It provides an idea to explore more effective characteristic parameters to study the development characteristics of partial discharge of oil-paper insulation.

articleTitle: Study on Microcapsules for Self-healing System of Silicone Rubber Insulating Material
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The pollution flashover resistance of silicone rubber insulating material is better than that of other insulating materials, but it is prone to aging (e.g., cracks and microcracks) during long-term use, and as a result its service life is limited. Using microcapsule self-healing technology, the extrinsic self-healing polymer materials have the ability to realize the automatic repair of machanical micocracks. The combination of microcapsule self-healing technology and silicone rubbuer insulating material makes it possible to repair microcracks and delay the aging process of silicone rubber. In this study, methyl hydrogen siloxane was selected as the representative of polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) healing agent, poly (ureaformaldehyde) (PUF) microcapsules were obtained by in-situ polymerization. Furthermore, the influence of emulsifier on the preparation effect of microcapsule was considered. On this basis, the obtained microcapsule was analyzed by optical microscope, scanning electron microscope, Fourier infrared spectroscopy and thermogravimetric analysis. Test results show that poly (ethylene-alt-maleic anhydride) (EMA) + polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) has the best preparation effect of microcapsule. The microcapsule samples with regular shape and intact coating were successfully prepared. Microcapsules had good thermal performance unber 222°C. The analysis results show that microcapsules have the potential to be used in self-healing silicone rubber insulating material system.

articleTitle: Backstepping Sliding Mode Control for Turntable Friction Compensation Using Stribeck Model and Extended State Observer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Friction nonlinearity generally exists in turntable systems, which may reduce servo performance severely. To improve tracking performance of non-direct driven turntable system, a backstepping sliding mode control (BSMC) method with compensation based on stribeck friction model is proposed in this paper. Identification of friction model parameters uses particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm, extended state observer (ESO) is added to control pattern to improve the chattering brought by sliding surface switching process. The stability of system with BSMC is guaranteed by Lyapunov theory. BSMC and its performance are validated by comparative experiments, the results of experiment demonstrate that the proposed method can realize better accuracy and stability than traditional proportional-integral (PI) controller.

articleTitle: Compression and Restoration Identification Method of Wide-band Oscillation Data Based on Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of power electronic power systems, the dynamic characteristics of power systems become much more complex, which may cause wide-band oscillation problems. However, due to the constraints of Nyquist sampling theorem and communication bandwidth, it is difficult for the existing dynamic monitoring devices to transmit and monitor wide-band oscillation signals. In this paper, a method for wide-band oscillation data compression and restoration identification based on autoencoder is proposed. Firstly, the encoder is used at the sub-station to reduce the dimension of the measurement data. On the one hand, it is convenient to carry out the wide-band oscillation signal transmission with the existing bandwidth. On the other hand, it also effectively reduces the redundancy of the oscillation data. On this basis, the master station uses the decoder to restore and identify the uploaded compressed data, which can not only verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method, but also enable the master station to conduct a more comprehensive monitoring and analysis of wide-band oscillation. Finally, case study is carried out in the four-machine and two-area system with a wind farm. The results show that the method can be applied to the data transmission of subsynchronous, supersynchronous and even medium/high frequency oscillation, and has high restoration accuracy and good anti-noise performance.

articleTitle: Research on fiber optic temperature measurement and simulation of lightning arrester on the roof of a moving train
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The lightning arrester undertakes the important task of protecting the high voltage electrical equipment of EMU(Electric Multiple Units), so the operation state of lightning arrester is very important for the safe and stable operation of EMU. In this paper, the fluorescent optical fiber temperature measurement system of the lightning arrester was built by customizing the roof arrester with holes, and the temperature change of the internal valve plate was analyzed under the continuous operating voltage and operating shock overvoltage. At the same time, a simulation model is established, and the electrothermal coupling simulation calculation of the lightning arrester is carried out. The simulation results are close to the results of the temperature measurement test, which verifies the accuracy of the model. Finally, suggestions are put forward for the improvement of the lightning arrester according to the results of the test and simulation.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Model Predictive Control for Neutral Point Clamped Three-level Virtual Synchronous Generator with AC Current Sensors Fault
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control scheme needs accurate three-phase currents, the AC current sensor fault will greatly deteriorate the performance of conventional VSG control method. To improve the stability of VSG, this paper proposes a fault-tolerant model predictive control (MPC) method to reconstruct three-phase currents when AC current sensors fail. To solve the problem of current unmeasurable area in current reconstruction, they are analyzed and classified into two types. And virtual vectors that are not affected by these two types of area are designed. By selecting optimal voltage vector from virtual vectors, two-phase currents can be directly sampled by DC link current sensor. Then, the remaining phase current can be calculated. And the three-phase currents are obtained, the stable operation of VSG can be realized when all AC current sensors fail. Simulation verifies the effectiveness of the proposed fault-tolerant MPC method.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Timing of Demagnetization for Variable Flux Memory Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The timing of demagnetization for variable flux memory motor (VFMM) and the corresponding performance are investigated under load operation. A demagnetization grid is proposed based on the torque-speed curves under different magnetization states. A look up table is then used to determine the best timing of demagnetization for VFMM. The performance of proposed demagnetization process is simulated for a dual layer hybrid magnet memory motor. The simulation results verify that the proposed method shows better performance on the demagnetization grid.

articleTitle: The Spot Market Clearing Simulation Research of Guangdong Power Grid Incorporating Demand Response Resource
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Combined with the trial operation of electricity spot market in South China (starting from Guangdong province) in 2021, this paper carries out simulation research on the spot electricity energy market in Guangdong with demand response. Firstly, it summarizes and analyzes different types of demand responsere source, the participation modes and the organizational process of Guangdong spot market incorporating demand response resource. Secondly, the time-sharing output characteristics and bidding characteristics of demand response resources are analyzed. A day-ahead clearing model and a settlement model taking into account the demand response are established. Then, based on the electricity market simulation system designed by the research institute of China Southern power grid, the boundary conditions such as unit bidding information, demand response bidding information and supply and demand curve under the spot market environment of Guangdong are simulated. Finally, the paper simulated the clearing results of Guangdong day-ahead spot market, analyzed the impact of demand response on spot price, unit power generation cost and user electricity charges, and studied the benefits of demand response participating in the spot market under different settlement modes.

articleTitle: Virtual Energy Storage Model of District Cooling System Based on Minimum Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: District cooling system (DCS) has been widely used in recent years because of its advantages of energy saving and high efficiency. As an alternative resource of adjustable capacity on the grid side, it can effectively alleviate the imbalance between supply and demand and improve the comprehensive operation efficiency of power system. In this paper, the energy consumption model considering the temperature rise of pipeline network and indoor comfort is established according to the DCS, DCS in the fixed temperature difference variable flow mode of operation, through the reasonable setting of chilled water supply temperature and indoor temperature, optimize chilled water supply flow and fan air volume, so that energy consumption reaches the minimum. The calculation and simulation verification are carried out by using an example. The virtual energy storage model is also established. Using its thermal inertia, the storage and transfer of electric energy can be realized without affecting the user’s feelings.

articleTitle: Research on Wind-Solar-Thermal-Storage Configuration Schemes of DC Near-field Based on Time Sequential Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the increasing degree of penetration of new energy in the power system, the traditional methods of scheduling and planning are challenged as the wind and solar generations will be the majority power supply in the future China. And the DC transmission has gradually become the major inter-provincial power transmission, providing the suitable way of consuming clean power through out multiple regions. Thus, a comprehensive model that could take demand side, supply side, and the DC transmission into consideration, and advice configuration or planning is proposed in this paper. The supply side resources, like different types of thermal power plants and new energy plants has been studied and modeled in aggregated way. Followed by the modeling of aggregated power grid, demand side, and battery storage, major aspects of power system are presented in mathematical expressions. Object of the model is to maximize the output of wind and solar power output, while satisfying the system constrains. In case study, different configurations consisting wind, solar, thermal, and storage units are studied in order to support the DC near-field power balance and to reduce dependence to the main grid. The results show that, the proposed time series simulation model could simulate realistic situations considering the characteristics of new energy and grid operation, and advice future grid planning by giving plausible configuration schemes with desired constrains.

articleTitle: Robust Model Predictive Current Control for SPMSM Drives
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The model predictive control (MPC) adopts the variable values obtained by sampling to predict the target variable value at the next moment, and then selects the optimal voltage vector from the eight voltage vectors generated by the two-level inverter to act on the next control cycle in the motor. However, the control performance of the traditional MPC approach is deeply affected by the parameters of the prediction model. Aiming to improve the robustness of MPC, a robust MPC method is proposed in this paper. An inductance mismatch is the cause of d-axis current errors, so a discrete integral controller is designed to extract accurate inductance information. In this paper, the flux linkage calculation link is designed and the value of flux linkage is obtained. The simulation and experiment verify the effectiveness of the proposed method in the different working conditions.

articleTitle: Frequency Control Approach of Sending-end Power Grid of Hybrid Cascaded HVDC System with Active Support of Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Because the capacity of AC grid at the sending-end of DC transmission system is small and the proportion of wind power is relatively high, there is a problem of poor frequency control ability. Therefore, it is of practical significance to use the hybrid DC system with wind farm access to control the frequency of AC system at the sending end. In the paper, a frequency control method is proposed, which makes the hybrid DC system and wind farm jointly support the frequency of the sending-end power grid. Aiming at the problem that the hybrid cascaded DC system reduces the transmission DC current due to the modular multilevel converter (MMC) connected to the power grid operates at full load, an improved frequency control of hybrid cascaded DC system under the heavy load operation of converter is proposed. Finally, the corresponding simulation model is established on PSCAD / EMTDC simulation platform to verify the effectiveness of the proposed frequency control method.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of graphite fiber attached insulator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Insulator is an important electrical equipment in power transmission and transformation lines.During long-term operation, abnormal surface violations such as pollution, bird damage, ice and snow, foreign matter adhesion and so on may occur. Among them, graphite fiber is one of the foreign matters attached to the insulator surface, which will cause great damage to the normal operation of the insulator. In this paper, the finite element three-dimensional simulation models of disc suspension porcelain insulator and rod suspension composite insulator are established. Under the thermoelectric coupling of multiple physical fields, the electric field and temperature distribution of insulator are calculated.The influence of the attachment mode and location of graphite fiber on the electric field distribution of insulator is analyzed, which provides reference for insulator operation and maintenance.

Author Keywords: thermoelectric coupling of multiple physical fields

articleTitle: Demand Side optimization of Integrated Energy System Based on Two-level Energy Station
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of energy market reform, the competition between different subjects of integrated energy system is further deepened. However, it is difficult to make production and dispatching plan for integrated energy system due to its multi-energy coupling and numerous operating variables. In this context, this paper establishes hierarchical integrated energy stations on the basis of integrated energy system grid planning, and establishes the interest models of integrated energy service operator and users on the demand side. Particle swarm optimization is used to solve this problem. The results of the simulation case show the feasibility of the optimized operation of the two-level energy station proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Analysis of magnetization process of nanocrystalline alloy under different external conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to study the relationship between the movement of magnetic moment and external magnetic field during magnetization of nanocrystalline alloy. Based on G. Herzer’s theory of stochastic anisotropy, a three-dimensional mesoscopic model of nanocrystalline alloy was established by using micromagnetic simulation software. Taking magnetic moment deflection angular velocity $\omega$ as the research parameter, the magnetic moment deflection in the magnetization process of materials is quantitatively investigated, and the function expression between alternating magnetic field and $\omega$ is obtained. The results show that $\omega$ is negative, and its absolute value increases first and then decreases. At the same time, when the amplitude and frequency of external magnetic field increase, the value of $\omega$ increases significantly. When external magnetic field is 20 kHz and 50mT, its $\omega_{max}=0.5099{\mathrm rad/ns}$; When frequency and amplitude are increased to 65 kHz, 95mT, $\omega_{max}=1.9741{\mathrm rad/ns}$, increased by 287.15%. Then, the function relation between $\omega$ and amplitude, frequency is obtained, and verified by simulation results. It is found that the maximal error of the mean value occurs in 60kHz_90mT, and the relative error is 5.28%. The maximal error of maximum value occurs in 65kHz_95mT, and the relative error is 2.08%.

articleTitle: Measurement of NO₂- penetration concentration in surface microdischarge treated model tissue, based on image processing technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Plasma has a wide range of applications in the medical field. The reactive oxygen species and reactive nitrogen species generated by plasma play a major role during the plasma treatment. However, the measurement of penetration concentration of reactive species into tissues has always been a major problem in the application of plasma medicine. In this paper, based on the digital image processing technology, we realized the measurement of $\mathrm{NO}_{2}^{-}$ penetration concentration inside model tissues by SMD treatment. Firstly, based on the specific color reaction of Griess and $\mathrm{NO}_{2}^{-}$, the multivariate linear relationship between image color and standard concentration was established. Then, the model tissues were treated by SMD under different time and treating distance. Finally, the concentration of each point in each layer of the model tissue under SMD treatment was measured and calculated. It is found that the $\mathrm{NO}_{2}^{-}$ concentration distribution in the central part of each layer was uniform under SMD treatment, and the concentration gradually decreased with the penetration depth. This study offers a fast and smart diagnostic method for reactive species amount into tissue and provide data for clinic as well as numerical modeling investigation.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Transfer Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It is difficult to obtain bearing fault data under actual operating conditions, so a small number of data samples are captured, which leads to over-fitting problems in model training, and the trained model can only diagnose the fault under current operating conditions. In order to improve the adaptability and accuracy of bearing fault diagnosis, the bearing fault diagnosis method based on transfer ensemble learning is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the method completes model training on public datasets. Secondly, through the transfer of task domain and feature space, the problem of poor model adaptability is solved. Finally, the voting mechanism in ensemble learning is reconstructed to improve the model’s ability to diagnose bearing fault under actual conditions. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has better bearing fault diagnosis ability compared with similar methods.

articleTitle: Line Overload Risk Assessment under Typical Operating Scenarios of Wind Power Grid-Connected System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Renewable energy connecting to the grid increases the uncertainty of power system. In order to realize the risk assessment of power system, a novel method of line overload safety risk assessment under typical operating scenarios for wind power grid-connected system is proposed in this paper. Firstly, K-means algorithm is used to construct typical system scenarios. Furthermore, the risk indicator of line overload is evaluated combined with risk theory, which characterizes the fluctuation of the line power flow and the change of the system state. Finally, a simulation is carried out to calculate the risk indicators under typical scenarios. The results show that the changes in typical system scenarios directly affect the operation of power system and risk indicators. Among them, in scenarios where the wind power level is higher and the load level is lower, the risk indicators are higher.

articleTitle: Research on Fault-Tolerant Control of Axial Field Flux-Switching Permanent Magnet Motor under Open-Circuit Fault
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Axial field flux-switching permanent magnet (AFFSPM) motor is a double salient topology with a rotor between two stators, which has the advantages of small axial size, large torque density, and high efficiency. It is suitable for direct drive systems with limited application space. In order to improve the fault tolerance of the direct drive system, this paper studies and compares the constant magnetomotive force fault-tolerant control based on the three-phase four-bridge arm topology and the current distribution hysteresis fault-tolerant control based on the H-bridge topology for the AFFSPM motor. The results show that the current distribution hysteresis fault-tolerant control has stronger fault tolerance and faster response speed. Finally, the experimental platform of the current distribution hysteresis fault-tolerant control is built to validate the reliability of the control method under the condition of serious open-circuit fault.

Author Keywords: Axial field flux-switching permanent magnet motor

articleTitle: Degradation of Pesticide Residues in Apples by Dielectric Barrier Discharge Plasma Device
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper demonstrates a device with crossed electrode array by dielectric barrier discharge (DBD). The device was used for the degradation experiments of pesticide residues on the apples’ surface. The apples were analyzed using infrared hyperspectral imaging. The results show that the purification efficiency of pesticide residues is more than 92%, and the purification efficiency of emamectin benzoate (A) is up to 99.99%. The color, flavor and nutritional value of the apples are not significantly affected. The condition required for the experiment is that the flow rate of air gas is 2 L/min. In additions, the frequency of power is 6.5 kHz and the optimal discharge voltage (peak-to-peak voltage) is 15.6 kV. Therefore, the device offers a new approach to fruits and vegetable purification and other research fields.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis based on Parameter Sensitivity for Large-Scale Renewable Energy Bases Considering Frequency Coupling Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Nowadays, with the gradual evolution of the traditional power system into a modern one containing a high proportion of renewable energy, some noteworthy issues may emerge caused by the dynamic interactions between the renewable energy bases and weak AC grid. In this paper, based on the established impedance network model of large-scale renewable energy bases with considering frequency coupling, the s-domain nodal admittance matrix (SNAM) is derived. Then by using the SNAM method, the stability analysis of a 10-node system containing 4 PMSG-based wind farms is studied. Combined with parameter sensitivity analysis, the sensitive parameters in unstable resonance mode are found, and the corresponding parameter adjustment strategies are proposed to suppress the unstable resonance and improve the stability of system. Finally, the analysis results and parameter adjustment strategies are verified in the MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Fast Estimation of Power Grid Operation State Based on Multi-source Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The rapid change and uncertainty of power grid operation state put-forward higher requirements for the basic data of online calculation. A fast estimation method of grid operation state based on multi-source data is proposed. Based on the different characteristics of multi-source heterogeneous data, a unified data storage method is established to realize efficient storage and access of different data sources. A self-check and correction method of PMU and RTU based on historical measurement error is proposed to reduce the influence of abnormal data on data integration accuracy. A multi-source data fusion method is utilized to realize the rapid generation of sectional-power flow and topological information at the current moment. The correctness and feasibility of the proposed method are verified based on the actual power grid.

articleTitle: The Study of SF6 Decomposition Detection by Photoacoustic Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to study the application of photoacoustic spectroscopy in detection and analysis of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> decomposition gas, the infrared absorption characteristic spectra of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> decomposition gases were obtained through literature research, and the infrared characteristic spectra of three kinds of target gas (CO, SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S) were determined. A SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> decomposition gas detection system based on PAS was designed, the corresponding filters of these typical decomposition gases were determined, and the experimental sample gas was tested by this detection system. The results showed that photoacoustic signal and the concentration have a perfect linear relationship, this detection system can qualitatively and quantitatively analyze the SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> decomposition gases, which could be applied to online monitor the SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> decomposition gases.

articleTitle: Research on feature extraction and fault diagnosis of mechanical vibration and sound signal of Disconnector
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As an important switching device in power system, disconnector plays a role of protection and control in the system. However, the research and application of disconnector on-line monitoring technology is still less. In order to improve its operation reliability, it is necessary to study its condition monitoring and fault diagnosis methods. The action of the disconnector will be accompanied by a series of mechanical, electrical, acoustic and other information. Through data collection and theoretical analysis, the vibration signal, acoustic signal and opening coil current of the operating mechanism box of the disconnector are selected to monitor and analyze the disconnector in this paper. A physical test platform is built to study its fault diagnosis method. The random error empirical mode decomposition method is used to analyze the distribution of the vibration signal of the disconnector, and the vibration signal in the characteristic frequency band is extracted for the mechanical fault diagnosis of the disconnector. Through the simulation, the diagnostic schemes of mechanism jamming and loosening are obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Lightning Protection of VMIP ±350kV Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The lightning protection performance of the transmission lines will be very important for the safe operation of HVDC transmission lines. The lightning day in the Philippines is 90 days, and the terrain is mainly mountainous. The lightning protection measures adopted for a ± 350 kv line built 20 years ago are not effective. Therefore, the lightning protection research of this line should be paid great attention. Based on the parameters of VMIP (Visayas Mindanao Interconnection Project), considering the lightning flashover rate of ± 350 kV transmission line built 20 years ago and relative standards to control lightning flashover rate, we will carry out simulation and achieve such goals as follows: Compute the lightning flashover rate of VMIP, determine the proper shielding angle and determine the proper length of the insulator. The results obtained in this paper has been used in the engineering design.

articleTitle: Construction of a PV-driven plasma nitrogen fixation test platform and its application prospect in agricultural production
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Nowadays, countries and regions around the world are doing a solid and effective job of carbon peaking and carbon neutralization, and environment friendly artificial nitrogen fixation pathways have become a major development trend. Based on the nitrogen fixation by sliding arc plasma, the power supply side is directly driven by photovoltaic panels and the design of a photovoltaic-driven nitrogen fixation plasma reactor is improved. The PV-driven plasma nitrogen fixation process is described and a PV-driven plasma nitrogen fixation testbed is built. The scope of application in some rural areas and agricultural production processes is discussed. The paper is a significant theoretical basis for the construction of a test platform for a new nitrogen fixation plant combining clean energy and plasma nitrogen fixation. This is of guiding significance for future data analysis of the electrical parameters of photovoltaic driven nitrogen fixation.

articleTitle: Control strategy of three-phase T-type three-level converter with reactive power compensation function
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Through the analysis of the three-phase T-type three-level converter and the feedforward decoupling control strategy, a mathematical model in the d-q coordinate system is established. In order to realize the independent control of active and reactive power, a double closed-loop control strategy of current inner loop and voltage outer loop is designed, and the reactive power compensation function is realized on the basis of changing the reactive power component. Finally, the correctness and rationality of the current loop and voltage loop controller parameter design are verified through PLECS simulation.

articleTitle: Design and Practice of Yunnan Thermal Power Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Since the new round of power system reform, Yunnan’s power market has achieved outstanding results, but the marketization of thermal power has not been smooth sailing, and thermal power is facing operating difficulties. On the basis of combing the survival dilemma of thermal power in Yunnan, this paper designs a series of “long-term backup compensation”, “thermal power regulation price subsidy”, “thermal power regulation power”, “and “market + regulation’ dual price bidding mechanism” according to market changes. The thermal power relief mechanism analyzes. In the Yunnan power market, the mechanism of the project design has achieved good practical results. The thermal power mechanism design in this article and the ways to get rid of thermal power can provide a reference for other provinces in China to solve thermal power relief.

articleTitle: Coordinated Frequency Control of Interconnected Two-Area Power System With Electric Vehicle Aggregator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the high penetration of renewable new energy in the power system, the unbalanced distribution of new energy incurs difficulty to the frequency control in the interconnected two-area power system. To solve this problem, this paper firstly proposes a method to predict three time-domain frequency response parameters after power disturbance for the two-area interconnected power system. Then, considering the different regulation depths of electric vehicle aggregator (EVA) in different areas and the obtained frequency response parameters, the frequency control factor is predicted for the EVA to participate in the system frequency control. Finally, according to the obtained frequency control factor, a coordinated control strategy (CCS) is proposed for the EVA to participate in the primary frequency regulation (PFR) in the interconnected two-area power system. Study results show that the effectiveness of the predicting method for system frequency response parameters is verified. The proposed CCS effectively reduces the impact of new energy fluctuations, and improves frequency stability by making full use of the regulation capacity of EVA in each area.

articleTitle: Micromagnetic Simulation of Improved Nanocrystalline Alloy Model under kHz Magnetization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Nanocrystalline alloy materials have become the most promising soft magnetic alloy materials in the electric power industry, because of its excellent characteristics of high permeability and low loss. At present, most of the research on nanocrystalline alloys focus on the preparation process, microstructure and soft magnetic properties, but studies at the mesoscopic scale are rare. In this paper, the single size grain model is improved in mesoscopic scale, and the improved double size grain model is simulated several times after changing the conditions of accessional bias magnetic field. Then the double size grain model and single size grain model are simulated under the same accessional bias magnetic field. The results show that the magnetization process of nanocrystalline alloy can be promoted by decreasing the grain size when the DC and AC bias magnetic fields are accessional, and the accuracy of the improved model is higher than that of the original single-size model.

articleTitle: Influence Factors of Acoustic Fingerprint Detection of M-Type On-Load Tap Changer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The on-load tap changer is a device which can operate under the excitation or load state of transformer and is used to change the tap connection position of winding. The mechanical fault accounts for nearly 90% of the on-load tap changer fault, so it is necessary to detect the mechanical fault of on load tap changer. In this paper, M-type 220kV transfer switch and voltage output accelerometer are selected, the tap changer is placed in a 1.98m high and lm diameter oil tank. The acoustic fingerprint data of 108 repeated tests are statistically analyzed. The influence of sensor sensitivity, coupling method and installation location on acoustic fingerprint and short-time energy method spectrum is summarized. The results show that in OLTC acoustic fingerprints testing, under the appropriate display range, the higher the sensor sensitivity, the more obvious difference between peak and valley of the short-time energy spectrum. Combined with the convenience and feasibility of onsite measurement viscous connection should be used on the OLTCs in operation, and magnetic connection should be used in some special cases. As for newly-bought OLTCs, setting rigid connection hole can be better option. The installation position should remain the same within the same test, mostly at upper or middle parts of OLTCs.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation for Combined Power Generation System of Wind-Photovoltaic and Hybrid Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Using the adjustment capabilities of the pumped storage and battery energy storage, the uncertainties of wind power and photovoltaic (PV) output power can be alleviated. Considering the complementary regulating speed and capacity, the combined exploitation of wind and photovoltaic generation with the hybrid storage such as pumped storage and battery energy storage would potentially promote the accommodation of renewable energy. The economic and technical advantages of the grid-connected combined power generation system need to be evaluated. Therefore, a comprehensive evaluation method for the combined power generation system consisting of wind-photovoltaic and hybrid storage is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the comprehensive evaluation index system for combined power generation system is designed, and the definition and connotation of each index are summarized. Then, aiming at the evaluation indexes, a comprehensive evaluation model method is proposed, in which the analytic hierarchy process is used to determine the weight of each index, and a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is presented to obtain evaluation results. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method is validated by the case analysis.

Author Keywords: wind-photovoltaic and hybrid storage power generation

articleTitle: An improved line differential protection based on average compensation for synchronous sampling in power systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The sensitivity of line differential protection inevitably deteriorates in case of asynchronous sampling values caused by sampling devices. This paper proposes a new scheme to compensate the sampling synchronization error based on the average value of sampling value. The numerical processing method of this scheme processes the sampling values of the current on both sides, takes the current sampling value on one side as the reference sampling value sequence, and generates a data curve according to the original sampling value sequence affected by the sampling synchronization error on the other side. The average value is selected on the data curve in the middle of adjacent sampling points as the new data value of the sampling value sequence at the reference time to reduce the sampling synchronization error. Additionally, the effects of two error compensation methods (i.e. fitting and interpolation) are compared and the influences of sampling frequency on operation results are analyzed. The feasibility of the proposed method is verified through simulation.

articleTitle: Control Parameters Optimization of Photovoltaic Grid-Connected System Based on Sensitivity Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the gradual penetration of new energy power generation devices represented by photovoltaic power generation and wind power generation in the power system, the stability of new energy grid-connected system is facing greater challenges. In order to ensure the stable operation of the system when working conditions change, the control parameters of the inverter need to be optimized follow the change. The commonly used optimization method is based on the state-space sensitivity, but there are redundant calculations in the optimization process. When applied to complex systems, the optimization time will increase due to the computation of large matrix dimension. This paper takes photovoltaic grid-connected system as an example, establishing the state-space model of the system, and the recognition of the corresponding sensitivity of the mode which is the basic of simplifying optimization steps is completed in advance. Under the premise of achieving the same function, the amount of calculation is greatly reduced compared with the original method. Finally, this paper verifies the effectiveness of control parameters optimization method based on the hardware-in-the-loop platform.

articleTitle: SF₆ Leak Alarm Monitoring Technology for LoRa-based Gas Insulated Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Effectively monitoring the sulfur hexafluoride (SF6) gas leakage of a gas-insulated Switchgear is important to ensure the safety of substation staff and the environment. At present, the SF6 leak alarm device needs to connect the power and communication lines to transmit the monitoring data of sensor module to the host. However, some drawbacks, such as difficulty in installing the monitoring module, immovability, and difficulty in maintenance, are encountered in this process. In this study, a SF6 leak alarm monitoring technology based on long range technology is proposed and developed, and relevant tests are conducted. LoRa transmission effective of 100%, and the measurement error of oxygen sensor and SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> sensors are within ±1% and ±2%. Test results show that the test parameters of the proposed device meet the test requirements in this field.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Smoothing Reactors and Current Limiting Reactors in LCC-MMC HVDC Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Rationally configuring the capacity of the DC side reactor and restraining the rising rate of short-circuit current at the same time is one of the difficult points in the research of hybrid high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission technology. This paper proposes an optimization algorithm that fully considers the relationship between reactor capacity and short-circuit current, and applies it to line commutated converter (LCC)-modular multilevel converter (MMC) hybrid HVDC network. Firstly, the mathematical expression of short-circuit current including smoothing reactor (SR) and current limiting reactor (CLR) is derived when the fault occurs on the DC-side. Secondly, taking the minimum reactor capacity and the minimum sum of the short-circuit current as two objective functions, the variable weight coefficient method and the penalty function method are used to obtain the optimally configured reactor capacity. Finally, a two-port hybrid LCC-MMC HVDC transmission system is built in Matlab/Simulink, and the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Analysis of Transformer Audible Noise Based on Redundant Convolutional Encoder Decoder
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: During the field acquisition of transformer acoustic signals, it is easy to be interfered by the outside world. The collected acoustic signals are often mixed with many noise interferences from non-transformer bodies, especially when the acoustic signals are interfered by various noises or even submerged in extremely harsh environments. The measuring instrument cannot effectively carry out preprocessing, which will cause interference to the transformer acoustic signal online monitoring system, and may lead to the misjudgment of the transformer operating state. In this paper, a method named Redundant Convolutional Encoder Decoder (R -CED) is proposed to de-noising transformer-containing noise signals. Short time Fourier transform (STFT) is used to extract the features of clean sound signals and noisy signals. The transformer acoustic signal denoising model based on R -CED is constructed by reasonably selecting the number of convolutional network layers and the size of the convolutional kernel. Finally, the denoising model is used to denoise the acoustic signal of a 72.5 kV converter transformer, the results show that the model has a good denoising effect, and the method has reference significance for the transformer operating state monitoring based on acoustic signals.

articleTitle: Flexibility Evaluation for Integrated Gas, Steam, and Electricity Systems of Steel Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper investigates the flexibility evaluation of integrated, gas, and steam systems in steel plants for supporting the power grid. Multi-energy coupling behaviors of typical steel plants are analyzed and modelled to characterize the impact of energy production and consumption of industrial processes on the electricity system regulations. Indices that consider the needs of both steel plants and the power grid are used to measure the flexibility. Based on the multi-energy model, a comprehensive model is proposed to evaluate the indices. The proposed flexibility evaluation model is tested using the data of a real steel plant. The results show that the steel plant can provide flexibility by coordinating the steam and gas systems, and the main factors that limit the flexibility lie in the capacity and ramp rate of boilers, capacity of valve, and variation of industrial steam and gas demands. Moreover, the cost of flexibility services is closely related to the time-of-use electricity price.

articleTitle: Reactor combination optimization method in submarine cable withstand voltage test
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The basic principles of series resonance are analyzed. Combined with the instrument model and the actual parameters of the wind farm submarine cable, a combination optimization method including series resonance and parallel compensation is proposed. The calculation process of this method is summarized, which can effectively reduce the number and power of test equipment. Based on the proposed method, the AC withstand voltage test of 66kV submarine cable is completed by using portable and small capacity test instruments for offshore wind power.

articleTitle: A Pre-Synchronization Strategy for Grid-Forming Loop-Closing Device in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of economy and society and the advancement of smart grid construction, loop-closing operation can improve power supply reliability, ensure power supply continuity, reduce power supply losses, and improve user satisfaction, laying the foundation for the intelligent development of distribution networks. This paper proposes an pre-synchronization strategy for grid-forming loop-closing device in distribution network. The loop closing strategy proposed in this paper includes three parts. The first part controls the DC bus voltage through VSCI, the second part controls the capacitor voltage through VSC2, and the third part realizes the loop closing operation through pre-synchronization control. Finally, the simulation analysis of distribution network system in MATLAB/Simulink environment verifies the effectiveness of the proposed pre-synchronization strategy for grid-forming loop-closing device.

articleTitle: Urban rail transit stray current on 500kV transformers along the line Test analysis of dc magnetic bias effect
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to study the influence of the stray current of urban rail transit on the dc magnetic bias characteristics of a 500kV transformer in Shanghai along the line, the dc, vibration and noise characteristics of the transformer neutral point after the normal operation, peak operation and shutdown of rail transit were tested by means of synchronous measurement of multiple physical quantities. Transformer neutral DC, vibration, noise and rail transit load change show consistent change law, rail transit peak operation, transformer neutral DC maximum 30.2A, transformer will appear different degrees of polarization phenomenon, noise is 10dB higher than normal operation. It is proved that the stray current caused by rail transit operation will affect the dc, vibration and noise of the neutral point of the transformer along the line. The research results can provide reference for metro line planning and power grid development planning.

articleTitle: PD characteristics and defect type recognition of “rapidly-developing” fault in oil-pressboard insulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the high voltage grade of UHV transformers and wide area of high field intensity, the discharge phenomenon that the average apparent discharge and the number of discharge pulses of per second increase rapidly often occurs within the transformer oil-pressboard insulation. In order to effectively analyze the discharge characteristics of this type of discharge faults and enhance the recognition technology of discharge types, three kinds of simulated defects were prepared and a small simulation experimental platform was built in this paper. Based on the power frequency data of PD, PRPD spectrum was drawn to analyze the discharge characteristics of “rapidly-developing” faults. According to improved D-S evidence theory, the features information between high frequency pulse and UHF pulse are fused to achieve the high accuracy recognition of defect types.

articleTitle: Game-theoretic Model of Day-ahead Electricity Market Considering Penalties for Retailers’ Bid Deviations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the uncertainty in consumers’ forecasted demand, it is inevitable that there exist deviations between retailers’ bidding demand in the day-ahead wholesale market and their actual demand, which will be penalized by the market operator. In order to investigate the impacts of the deviation penalty mechanism on retailers’ bidding strategies, a game-theoretic model of the day-ahead wholesale market considering retailers’ bid deviation penalty mechanism is proposed. In this model, it is considered that retailers strategically bid their load demand and generators strategically offer their supply functions. In addition, retailers have to pay penalties for their over-bidding and under-bidding deviations with different penalty prices. A scenario reduction technique is employed to describe the uncertainties of retailers’ actual demand. This model is solved using the nonlinear complementarity method. Numerical examples show that the deviation penalty mechanism can effectively induce retailers to reduce their bid deviations. This study will help the market operator to mitigate the retailers’ bid deviations by means of appropriate penalty prices.

articleTitle: Research on power flow optimization control strategy of AC-DC hybrid microgrid based on power electronic transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The increase of electricity loads and the penetration of renewable energy sources are putting enormous pressure on grid operations and driving grid system operators to take more efficient and smarter measures to manage power flow. The technology of power electronic transformer (PET), as an emerging dynamic response power flow control technology, has been expected to become a solution for power flow control in the future. We propose a power electronic transformer-based to power flow regulation through an optimization strategy.

articleTitle: A Self-healing Power Cable Sheathing Material
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: During the installation and operation of the power cable, the surface is easily damaged by mechanical damage, shortening its service life, and even causing safety problems such as leakage and power failure. The current damage-repairing method is complicated and requires fault location technology to cooperate, which hinders the repairing effect. Self-healing materials are a class of smart materials that can identify breakages and repair themselves automatically. However, the performance of self-healing materials often does not meet the requirements of power cable materials. In order to meet the special requirements of cable materials for mechanical and electrical performance, specific modifications of self-healing materials are required. In this paper, a novel self-healing material (Poly-CD-PHEA) is polymerized based on the cooperation between host-guest molecules, with Poly-CD as the host molecule, HEMA-Ad as the guest molecule, single-substituted HEA as the reactive monomer. The 2-D NOESY spectra were used to verify the cooperation between Poly-CD and HEMA-Ad. The results showed that there is a significant correlation signal between the protons of the Ad functional group and the protons of $\beta-CD$, indicating that a stable inclusion complex is formed between host and guest. The thermal properties of the material were examined by TGA. The results showed that the Poly-CD-PHEA material can withstand the high temperature of 250 °C, which proves that the thermal stability of the material is good. The self-healing effect of Poly-CD-PHEA was observed by SEM and 3D digital microscope. The results showed that the wound self-healed completely after a period of time, and can complete at least 3 damage-healing processes. The self-healing efficiency of the material is close to 100%. The mechanical properties of the material after self-healing were evaluated by dynamic mechanical analysis (DMA) and tensile test. The results showed that the stress-strain of Poly-CD-PHEA can be restored by more than 80% after self-healing. The volume resistivity test was used to measure the recovery of electrical properties. The results showed that the volume resistivity is basically unchanged before and after self-healing, and both meet the requirements of GB/T 32129-2015. The shape memory effect of the Poly-CD-PHEA material was examined by a shape recovery test, and the results indicated that the material could recover to 98% of the original shape.

articleTitle: Motor Bearing Remaining Life Prediction Based on Unsupervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of industry, the machine becomes more and more large and complicate, correspondingly, the requirement of industrial machine reliability is more strict. As an important part of the rotating machine, the safety of the motor bearing is the key for the reliability of the machine. Recently, the development of artificial intelligence industry developed rapidly, it is popular to combine artificial intelligence technology with the reliability of the machine to predict the remaining life or fault of the bearing. Traditionally, the method would be trained by the signals and the corresponding condition first, which means it is the supervised learning method and much labeled data is required. However, it is not easy to obtain too much labeled data. A unsupervised learning method to predict the remaining life of bearing is proposed in this paper. The Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) is used to construct frequency-domain features first, then, moving the clustering centers appropriately to obtain the optimal boundary for remaining life prediction based on Euclidean distance. The superiority of the proposed method is shown by the results of the experiments.

articleTitle: The installation of the island divertor coils on the J–TEXT tokamak
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to investigate the effect of island divertor on the peak heat load reduction in a tokamak, a new island divertor was developed and installed in J-TEXT tokamak. The engineering design takes into account the complexity of the device based on the physical design, and also needs to ensure the insulation performance of the coil. Before installing the coil, electromagnetic forces on conductors and thermal conditions were simulated, the electromagnetic force on the magnetic island divertor coil will not cause damage to the coil, and there will be no thermal failure behavior.

articleTitle: Single Switch High Gain Boost-Cuk Integrated Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel single-switch high-gain DC/DC converter is proposed. The topology combines Boost converter and Cuk converter organically, which not only improves the voltage gain of the converter, but also reduces the voltage stress of the switching tube, and preserves the advantages of current continuity of the original Boost converter and Cuk converter. The converter uses a single switch, only using a single PWM signal can be driven, driven simple and high efficiency. Finally, the correctness and validity of the theoretical analysis are verified by the experimental prototype.

articleTitle: Research on Predictive Control Method of an Induction Machine Fed by a Matrix Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to get unit input power factor, and achieve decoupling control of the exciting component and the torque component of the stator current, the rotor field-oriented vector control of the induction machine and the predictive control of the matrix converter are combined. Double closed loop with flux and speed is adopted, and the stator current and reactive power are multi-objective predictive controlled. Simulation results verified that the predictive control method of an induction machine fed by a matrix converter not only retain advantages of the traditional rotor flux-oriented vector control of the induction machine, but also make advantage of the predictive control. The input power factor is at unity, the power quality is improved; The decoupling control of the torque component and the exciting component of the stator current is achieved, the dynamic performance of the speed regulation system is improved.

articleTitle: Study of Dissociation Characteristic of SF₆-N₂ Mixture Under Corona Discharge with Pin-to-Plate Electrode
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: $\text{SF}_{6} / \text{N}_{2}$ mixed gas has the huge potential in high voltage power equipment for the sake of reduction of $\mathbf{S F}_{6}$. However, due to the inevitable fault conditions, $\text{SF}_{6} / \text{N}_{2}$ will decompose and react with the impurities in equipment generating various gaseous components, which ultimately endangers the safe operation of the equipment. The study on the decomposition of $\text{SF}_{6} / \text{N}_{2}$ mixture in corona discharge is of guiding significance to the timely detection of early failure of equipment and the insulation of diagnostic equipment. In this paper, the characteristics of $\text{SF}_{6} / \text{N}_{2}$ mixed gas decomposition products under typical corona discharge condition were studied. The experimental results show that the SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> mixture decomposition produces $\text{NF}_{3}, \text{SOF}_{2}$ and SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> characteristic products under the defect of the corona discharge of the needle plate electrode. The production rate of NF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> is relatively low, while $\text{SOF}_{2}\gt\text{SO}_{2} \text{F}_{2}$. Decomposition products increase along with the discharge time increasing, the $\text{SF}_{6} / \text{N}_{2}$ pressure and the proportion of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> reducing. The ratio of $\text{SF}_{6} / \text{N}_{2}$ mixture, and the total yield of decomposition products can be used as the characteristic parameters to distinguish the spark discharge and corona discharge of the needle plate electrode.

articleTitle: Identification and Correction Method of Bad Data of Renewable Energy Plants with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Given the problem of real-time data acquisition errors in renewable energy plants, the data of the renewable energy plants have the characteristics of mass and mutually coupled characteristics, a deep learning-based method for identifying and correcting bad data from renewable energy plants is proposed. Firstly, a deep neural network identification model is constructed to identify the real-time bad data, and the bad data of the real-time identification was obtained. Secondly, the BP neural network correction model was constructed to correct the bad data of the identification, and the reliable data of the operation of the renewable energy station is obtained. Finally, the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified through the analysis of the real historical data of a typical wind farm.

articleTitle: Electrical metrology based on quantum technology: a review of current progress
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The development of power system has put forward higher requirements for electrical metrology. However, the traditional measurement based on artefact has encountered a bottleneck due to its instability. In order to reduce the uncertainty of measurement, metrology based on quantum technology has been wildly studied. This paper introduces the principle of quantum voltage and two types of Josephson voltage standards, programmable Josephson voltage standards and AC Josephson voltage standards. The development and current progress of quantum voltage is introduced.

articleTitle: Research on High Voltage and High Power Density Power Supply Technology for Space
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The traditional non-isolated Weinberg converter has the advantages of high power density, continuous current and easy parallel connection, which is suitable to be used as power converter and power regulator in satellite power system. This paper analyzes the working principle of traditional Weinberg converter and establishes its small signal model. Based on the traditional Weinberg converter, LC snubber circuit is added to damp the off voltage oscillation of the main switch, reduce the off loss, and offset the adverse effects of the freewheeling modes caused by the leakage inductance of the transformer and the parasitic capacitance of the main switch on the output of the topology. A detailed analysis is made on the working process of the snubber circuit, and the parameters of each part of the discharge topology are designed in detail. The discharge topology adopts the control strategy of voltage loop. Through the simulation results, the influence of the snubber circuit on the topology and the topology of the output when the load changes are analyzed. The results show that the topology design is feasible.

articleTitle: Influence of different metal materials on the gas production characteristics of insulating oil
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Mineral oil is the most commonly used fluid for the insulation of power transformers and has excellent physicochemical and electrical properties. Dissolved gas analysis (DGA) is commonly used in transformers as a fault identification method to monitor the operating condition of the transformer and to detect faults. However, in oil-immersed power transformers, metal materials such as copper, alloys and silicon steel are used in parts such as windings and cores, which can have an impact on dissolved gases in mineral oil. The effect of the different metals present in oil-immersed transformers on the dissolved gases in the insulating oil was explored. The results show that alloys and silicon steel contribute to the production of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and copper contributes to the production of CO and C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>. When the tests were carried out to 70 days, the C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> gas content in the mineral oil samples containing copper strips at 120 °C was 22.19 times that at 90 °C. This paper provides the data basis and experimental proof for investigating the effect of metals on the gas production characteristics of transformer insulating oil.

articleTitle: A Load Share Circuit without Current Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In applications of parallel DC power supplies, active current balancing requires current sensing and extra control loop, which limits the application of parallel power supply in low-cost power supply system. To solve this problem, a load share circuit is proposed, realizing automatic current balancing through the characteristics of the circuit topology. Dependence of current balancing control on current sensing and signal transmission between modules are eliminated, achieving low-cost parallel power supply system by adopting commercially available general power supplies. The working principle and expected performance of the circuit are analyzed in detail, and a 24V 6A test prototype is built to verify the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Perspectives on the use of advanced nuclear energy systems for new energy vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Powering new energy vehicles with low-carbon energy is a promising approach towards peak emissions and carbon neutral goal in China. Advanced nuclear energy systems are expected to provide green, reliable, and sustainable energy from 2030. Here we prospect the use of future Gen IV nuclear reactors and fusion reactors for the rapidly growing fleet of new energy vehicles. The next generation of fission and fusion power plants can not only generate electricity for battery electric vehicles but also produce hydrogen, an emission-free engine fuel, for fuel cell vehicles. Advanced nuclear energy systems could make sure that new energy vehicles deliver their full potential as low-carbon transportation.

articleTitle: Research on Measuring Method of Power Frequency Superimposed Impulse Voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the actual power system, when lightning strikes the transmission line or forms an operating overvoltage, the transient voltage waveform on the system is often the superposition of the impulse voltage and the power frequency voltage. At present, it is common to use acquisition instruments to measure superimposed voltages. The superimposed waveform contains a very large frequency range, from 50Hz to MHz. The power frequency voltage needs to be measured for at least 3 cycles, so that the sampling rate cannot be too high, and the sampling rate is too low to completely record the impulse voltage waveform, resulting in inaccurate voltage peak calculation. A sample rate that is too high in turn may result in a total recording time that is too short. Therefore, an accurate measurement method of power frequency superimposed impulse voltage waveform is proposed in this paper, which not only satisfies the accurate acquisition of superimposed voltage waveform, but also improves the calculation speed and ensures work efficiency.

articleTitle: Rapid Treatment with Pulsed Gliding Arc Plasma in Ambient Air to Increase the Hydrophobicity of Silicone Rubber for Electrical Insulators
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Hydrophobicity of silicone rubber (SR) is important for its anti-ice and anti-pollution property and the pollution flash-over performance of electrical insulators in transmission lines. In this work, a pulsed high-voltage source is used to generate gliding arc (GA) with ambient air flow, combining the advantage of high reactivity and low power consumption. This plasma source is adapted for enhancing the hydrophobicity of SR. Contaminating suspension composed of Kaolin and NaC1 solution with different non-soluble deposit density (NSDD, from 0.125 to 1 mg/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) is imposed on SR. With NSDD of 0.125 mg/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and only 1-min treatment with pulsed GA, the water contact angle (WCA) of SR increases from ~68° to 145° and excellent wearing performance is achieved. As a comparison, natural migration takes tens of hours to reach a similar WCA. For higher NSDD, longer plasma-treatment time is needed, while the best WCA achieved is smaller. Optical emission spectroscopy from pulsed GA illustrates that O atoms have the highest emission intensity and quenching of excited N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> by O2 contributes to a high O2 dissociation degree. Assisted with Fourier transform infrared analysis of clean, contaminated, and plasma-treated SR surface, it is speculated that high-density O atoms generated by pulsed GA accelerate the migration of hydrophobic component in contaminant. This work proposes a rapid, low-cost, and environmental-friendly treatment method for increasing SR hydrophobicity, showing a good potential for application in engineering field.

articleTitle: Neutral point voltage drift suppression method of large hydro generator based on active compensation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the target requirements of emission peak and carbon neutralization strategy, the large-scale development and utilization of clean energy such as hydropower is an inevitable trend. However, with the continuous increase of single unit capacity of hydro generator, the capacitance of stator winding to ground also increases, which leads to the problem of neutral point voltage drift caused by the imbalance of three-phase parameters of generator, which poses a serious threat to the safe operation of generator. Therefore, aiming at the phenomenon of neutral point voltage drift of hydro generator, taking the 1000MW hydro generator of Crane beach hydropower station as the research object, this paper puts forward the neutral point voltage drift suppression method of hydro generator, injects zero sequence current into the neutral point of generator, and realizes the suppression of neutral point voltage by controlling the size and phase of current. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that this method can effectively suppress the neutral point voltage drift of hydro generator, and provide a reference for the research of protection strategy of large hydro generator.

articleTitle: Microgrid Pre-dispatch Considering Battery Low-temperature Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The use of storage batteries helps to reduce peak load and improve microgrid economics.
