publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A bidirectional LLC converter topology with auxiliary inductor added is proposed. The equivalent circuit of the circuit in forward and reverse operation is given, and the working modes of forward buck and reverse boost of the converter are analyzed. The converter is completely symmetrical in the forward and reverse working modes, and the control circuit is simple and easy to implement. At the same time, it can further reduce the transformer turns ratio and improve the conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: High Gain Inductive Power Transfer System Design Based on the S/SP Topology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Recently, the requests for high gain wireless power systems are increasing rapidly in the new material and renewable resource field. The high voltage gain is still challenging in the wireless power transfer research. This paper presents a high voltage gain inductive power transfer system design method using the S/SP topology. The misalignment effect on voltage gain and the ZVS state achievement is considered. To reduce the system weight and volume, the PCB coil is used to design the prototype system. Experiments have shown that the designed prototype can provide a high voltage gain with the anti-misalignment ability and light-weight feature.

articleTitle: Improved Frequency Response Model for Power System with Photovoltaic Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the gradual increase of renewable generation integration, power system with high-penetration photovoltaic(PV) integrated is one of the typical operating scenarios. Large-scale PV entry affects the dynamic frequency characteristics of the power system greatly. Based on the analysis of the insufficiency of the traditional power system frequency response (SFR) model, an improved SFR model of the power system with PV generation is established, considering the effect of PV frequency regulation, equivalent governor delay and frequency regulation deadband. Secondly, the parameter calculation method for the improved SFR model is proposed, in which some parameters are achieved by the weighted average of the information of each unit, and the remaining parameters are identified. Finally, the effect of the improved model and parameter calculation method are verified by simulation cases. Simulation results show that the improved SFR model can reflect the frequency response characteristics of the power system, and its accuracy is better than the traditional SFR model.

articleTitle: Research on the Knowledge Graph Construction Technology and its Power Grid Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the booming development of Internet, cloud computing and big data, the demand for processing massive data has greatly increased. As a key technology of knowledge engineering in artificial intelligence, knowledge graph can effectively manage massive information and realize intelligent knowledge extraction, reasoning, storage and retrieval. Its characteristics and application scenarios fit well with power grid systems. This paper introduces the development history of knowledge graph technology and analyzes the construction process of knowledge graph in detail. A review of its existing applications in the power grid from different perspective is presented. And the future challenges of knowledge graph construction have been put forward in the paper.

articleTitle: Research on Efficiency Optimization of Wireless Power Transfer System Using a Quasi-Z-source Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the source of energy, the transmitter of the magnetic coupling resonant wireless power transfer (WPT) system has a crucial impact on the performance of the system. The traditional H-bridge inverter is subject to many constraints in the application of high-power WPT due to the defects of the topology itself. In order to make up for the above shortcomings, a quasi-Z-source inverter is used as the transmitting end power converter of the WPT system. From the perspective of control strategy, this paper studies the power and efficiency characteristics of the system in the shoot-through control mode, and the optimal efficiency point of the system is solved on the basis of steady-state analysis, which is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Low Temperature Characteristics and Application of Temperature Sensor in Alpine Region
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Alpine regions have higher requirements on the temperature tolerance of sensors, especially the durability of sensors and the accuracy of measurement data under low temperature conditions, which directly affect the long-term stable operation of power transmission and transformation equipment. In this paper, the application of temperature sensors in alpine regions is investigated, and the application principle types, application quantities, main installation locations, low temperature operation time, low temperature failure conditions and treatment measures of sensors in alpine regions are mastered. The low temperature characteristics of optical fiber temperature sensor and surface acoustic wave temperature sensor (referred to as SAW temperature sensor) were tested at $- 50^{\circ}\mathrm{C} \sim 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, and the sensor output characteristics at different temperatures and different low temperature examination time were studied. The results indicated that the low temperature performance of optical fiber temperature sensor was relatively stable at $- 50^{\circ}\mathrm{C} \sim 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, but the package at low temperature was not tight and the temperature drift of resistance exceeded the accuracy range. The low temperature performance of SAW temperature sensor was acceptable at $-30^{\circ}\mathrm{C} \sim 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, but poor at $-30^{\circ}\mathrm{C} \sim 40^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. With the decrease of temperature, the measurement error of the sensor increased sharply. The metal film inside the sensor had a slight mass change after the low temperature test, resulting in a mass loading effect, and the resonant frequency was shifted.

articleTitle: Research on Batch Non-Intrusive Fault Detection Method for Fractional Frequency Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The modular multilevel matrix converter (M3C) is an important part of the fractional frequency transmission system (FFTS). With many sub-modules, the single fault detection method is cumbersome and complicated. This paper analyzes the changes of the arm current and the capacitor voltage of the sub-module under different sub-module faults in the pre-charging process of the bridge arm, analyzes and summarizes the fault types and fault location criteria of the sub-module fault of the bridge arm, and verifies the pre-charging process of the fault bridge arm by simulation software. Finally, a batch non-invasive fault detection method for M3C converter is proposed by using the control system arm current and sub-module capacitor voltage sensors.

articleTitle: Breakdown Properties of Solid-Solid Interface between Epoxy Resin and Silicone Rubber under Vertical Stress
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wind power and photovoltaic power generation are far away from the power load center, which requires high-voltage DC cables for power transmission. However, the breakdown strength of the solid-solid interface composed of epoxy resin/silicon rubber (EP/SiR) in the cable accessories is low, which may easily lead to the failure of the cable. Therefore, it is urgent to study the influencing factors and improvement methods of the breakdown strength of the EP/SiR interface. A test system for measuring the breakdown characteristics of EP/SiR interface is established, and the breakdown characteristics of EP/SiR interface under different stresses are measured. The breakdown test found that the contact interface between EP and SiR is a weak area, and obvious ablation and carbonization traces can be observed. The breakdown strength of the EP/SiR interface increases with the increase of the applied stress perpendicular to the interface. The breakdown strengths of the interfaces formed by EP microcomposite/SiR and polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane modified EP microcomposite/SiR are higher than that of pure EP/SiR interface. From the perspective of changing the length of the interfacial air gap and suppressing the impact ionization in the air gap, the effect of stress on the breakdown strength is analyzed. The influence mechanism of doping modification on breakdown strength is analyzed from the viewpoint that polar materials easily form bound charges at the interface, thereby attracting carriers and hindering their movement. The research results provide experimental results and model support for material formulation optimization and breakdown strength improvement methods of plug-in cable joints.

articleTitle: Design of Optimized Gate Driver of SiC MOSFET for High-Frequency High-Power-Density CSI
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wide bandgap (WBG) devices are becoming increasingly popular because they can switch with higher speed and work at higher switching frequency, resulting in a significant reduction of sizes of passive components for power converters. On the other hand, faster switching speed also makes the switching characteristics of the WBG devices more susceptible to parasitic parameters. In this paper, different gate drivers are compared for silicon carbide (SiC) MOSFET, and a simple and reliable solution is designed optimally for a high-frequency high-power-density current-source-inverter (CSI). The practicality and feasibility of the optimized gate driver circuit has been confirmed by simulation and experiment respectively. Moreover, a 5-kW CSI prototype with optimized gate driver is designed and tested.

articleTitle: Current and Light Emission Characteristics of Unstable Leader under Positive Voltage in Long Air Gap
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Unstable positive leader propagation is of great interest for lightning and spark researchers. However, there are few detailed studies about this phenomenon. To research the current and light emission characteristics of the unstable leader, a digital time-resolved current measurement system and high-speed camera with high sensitivity are used to observe the process. Based on the analysis of the results, two types of the current waveform are classified, and the relationship between the restrike frequency and voltage rise rate is explained. The results and analysis in this paper could help to understand the discontinuous and unstable leader phenomenon.

articleTitle: Parameter Adaptive Adjustment Super Twisting Sliding Mode Observer Based on Complex Coefficient Filter for PMSM Sensorless Drive
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a sensorless speed control strategy for permanent magnet synchronous motor based on a new super twisting sliding mode observer (STSMO). In this strategy, a complex coefficient filter(CCF) is used to remove the high-frequency disturbance in the observed inverse electromotive force. Since CCF has a unit gain and zero phase shift at the center frequency, the phase lag caused by the traditional low-pass filter is avoided without compensation. At the same time, STSMO parameters are adjusted online to improve the dynamic property of STSMO. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Torque Optimization of One High Specific Power Three-Phase FTPMM Based on FEM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Fault-tolerant permanent magnet motor(FTPMM) is one of the important power sources in aerospace actuation system. Its output torque performance would affect the efficiency, safety and reliability of aircraft directly. The topology of one high specific power three-phase FTPMM is introduced in this paper and its output torque performance is analyzed. The critical dimensions of motor are adjusted by the finite element method while the motor under the conditions of no fault, single-phase short circuit and single-phase open circuit. The result shows that the motor torque ripple could be restrained effectively while reducing the loss of average torque. Additionally, the relationship between the fluctuation ratio of comprehensive torque performance and partial dimension is researched to guide the designing and optimization of this motor.

articleTitle: Analysis on Levitation Force Characteristics of Axial-Flux Hybrid-Excitation Generator for Offshore Vertical Axis Maglev Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Vertical axis wind turbine is gradually playing a great potential in offshore floating wind power generation system. In order to improve the starting performance of vertical axis wind turbine, an asymmetric-primary axial-flux hybrid-excitation generator (APAFHG) for offshore vertical axis maglev wind turbine is proposed. However, the complexity of the controllable levitation force makes it difficult to control the generator. In this paper, the levitation force characteristics of APAFHG under different currents are analyzed and the mathematical model of levitation force is derived. First, the topology and operation principle of APAFHG are introduced, Second, the levitation force performance of APAFHG under DC excitation, d-axis and q-axis current is obtained by finite element method, and the characteristics of levitation force are analyzed with the change of applied current. Finally, the mathematical model of APAFHG levitation force is deduced and verified. The results show that the characteristics and the mathematical model of levitation force can play an important role in the control of levitation force and the decoupling control of power and levitation force.

articleTitle: Research on a new type of grid reactive power control strategy based on multi-station integration
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to make full use of the reactive power regulation capabilities of photovoltaic power stations, energy storage stations, and charging/swap stations, a dynamic reactive power optimization strategy for the distribution network that considers traditional regulation methods and photovoltaic reactive power regulation, energy storage, and charging/swap stations has been established. The article first builds a reactive power optimization mathematical model that comprehensively considers energy storage stations, charging and swapping stations, and photovoltaic stations. Taking into account the volatility of photovoltaics and the coordination between energy storage and the limited timing of charging and discharging stations, a co-evolutionary artificial bee colony is adopted. The algorithm optimizes the multi-station fusion strategy to construct a coordinated reactive power control strategy that can meet the economic and reliable operation of the power grid. Finally, a simulation is performed based on a network example. The simulation results show that the reactive power control strategy proposed in this paper can make full use of the voltage regulation resources of various power stations in the power grid and improve the voltage level of the power grid.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerance Capability Comparison of Different Connection Types for Dual-Three Phase Motors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Dual three-phase motors (DTPM) are gaining increasing popularity in motor drive applications, especially requiring high reliability. For dual three-phase motors, there are different types of the stator winding connections. This paper analyzes the fault-tolerant capability of different stator winding connections of DTPM, gives a detailed comparison, and finally recommends the symmetrical 6-phase connection with single natural point as the best choice for fault-tolerant operation.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Self-adaptive Withstand Voltage Test Electrode for Insulation Blanket based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: According to the standard requirements, the insulation blanket should be subjected to a dielectric withstand voltage test before use. Aiming at the poor versatility and low efficiency of the existing insulation blanket withstand voltage test electrodes, an adaptive insulation blanket withstand voltage test electrode device based on machine vision is proposed. The hardware and software of the device are designed to achieve the expected effect. By building a small-scale prototype, and selecting a representative insulation blanket sample for testing. The test results prove that the device can complete the insulation blanket withstand voltage test according to the standard requirements, and is superior to the traditional method in terms of adaptability and detection efficiency for samples of different models, sizes and shapes. The new device can meet the automation and intelligence needs of insulation blanket withstand voltage test, and has certain application value.

articleTitle: Influence of Gate Resistance on Crosstalk of SiC MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: SiC MOSFETs are widely used in high frequency applications due to the material advantages of SiC, which causes SiC MOSFETs suffer more from crosstalk in bridge topology. In the half-bridge modules with alternately conductive devices, the gate resistance of the two arms should keep the same. However, existing researches about crosstalk all consider that the gate resistance of a certain bridge-arm is constant. This paper studies the influence of changing upper and lower bridge gate resistance synchronously on crosstalk. The theoretical analysis of the influence of gate resistance on crosstalk is presented first. Then a double-pulse test platform is built to verify the theoretical analysis. Compared with just regarding the gate resistance of off-state device as univariate, the positive spike of crosstalk voltage is much smaller. Consequently, the upper limit of gate resistance to avoid shoot-through current is larger. This conclusion can provide better guidance for driver design of SiC MOSFETs in half-bridge topology.

articleTitle: Mechanism Analysis of the Stator Inter-tum Short Circuit Fault of New Synchronous Condenser
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the large-scale operation of the new synchronous condenser, the security problem of the Condenser has gradually become prominent. The stator inter-turn short circuit fault is a common serious fault of the condenser, which has a serious impact on the long-term operation of the condenser and the stability of the power grid. In this paper, theoretical analysis and finite element simulation are used to analyze and verify the influence of the fault on the current amplitude and phase of the two branches of the faulted phase, and to provide mechanism analysis and help for fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on temperature response of secondary loop of district heating system with XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: District heating system is an important part of the urban energy system. But its large scale and numerous coupling variables bring many difficulties to its regulation and control. At present, rough regulation carried out by manual experience is hard to guarantee the quality of regulation, thus caused problems about heating comfort and efficiency. This paper proposes a data-driven temperature response prediction model to predict secondary supply temperature considering the historical operating status of heating substation, valve opening degree, and weather conditions, etc. XGBoost model was established under different input step and prediction step respectively are proposed and tested in this article. Results show that the prediction performance of the XGBoost model of 72 input steps and 24 prediction steps is best, with a mean square error of 0.117°C, Then it is applied to an urban central heating system for an application example. Based on this data-driven model, different operation strategies on primary loop valve opening are compared for temperature response analysis. Operators can check the actual temperature response of the valve control strategy before they are about to apply.

articleTitle: Research on Active Damping of Grid-side Inductor Voltage Feedback with Bandpass Filter and Lead Correction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Differential feedback of the grid-side inductor voltage can effectively suppress the resonant peak of LCL filter, and can increase the output impedance of the inverter compared to other active damping methods such as filter capacitor current proportional feedback and filter capacitor voltage differential feedback. In the case of weak grid, it is more beneficial to reduce the influence of grid background harmonics and grid impedance. However, the conventional differential implementation methods are easy to amplify the high-frequency components in the grid-side inductor voltage, which is easy to affect the grid-in current. For this reason, this paper proposes a band-pass filter + lead correction to feedback the grid-side inductor voltage. Through reasonable design of parameters, it can be equivalent to an ideal differential at the resonance, and has a lower gain except for the resonance point. By adopting the proposed strategy, the active damping can be better achieved, the influence on the fundamental wave can be reduced, and the higher harmonics can be better suppressed. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Interactive Operation and Maintenance Service Mode of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the electric vehicle industry has developed rapidly, but the operation and maintenance service system are not perfect, resulting in low efficiency in early warning and handling of charging faults and safety risks. This paper proposes an interactive operation and maintenance service model. Firstly, the characteristics of different types of charging facilities and the space-time characteristics of EVs are analyzed, and the matching model of EVs and corresponding charging facilities is established. Secondly, based on the driving force of safe operation and maintenance and the safety factors in the charging process, a safe operation and maintenance mechanism of charging piles was proposed. Thirdly, considering the main interconnection characteristics of the charging process, the combination of local service and remote service mode is proposed to construct the EV charging operation and maintenance service mode. Finally, the evaluation system of operation and maintenance service mode is established.

articleTitle: The Deterioration Mechanism of Underground Grounding Body under Impulse Current
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The metal part of the grounding body will be deteriorated while experiencing impulse current, which can weaken the electrical conductivity. Therefore, the grounding body is unable to discharge the impulse current into the ground, which means that the grounding potential will rise and may cause electric shock. In order to obtain the deterioration mechanism of grounding body under impulse current, the deterioration test at different parts of grounding body under different values of impulse current is carried out in this paper. The variation of corrosion rate under different influencing factors can be obtained in the deterioration test. In addition, the influence of current amplitude and soil environment on the grounding body is carried out from the perspective of grounding resistance in this paper. Finally, the deterioration mechanism of grounding body is obtained. It can be found in the study that the soil environment and current amplitude have common influence on the corrosion rate of the grounding body, and impulse current can aggravate the deterioration of the grounding body. The corrosion mechanism is microcell corrosion when there is no impulse current, and electrolytic corrosion when there is impulse current. The latter has the most significant impact on the deterioration of the grounding body.

articleTitle: Microwave reflection characteristics of flake-shaped Fe50 Ni50/paraffine composites with various volume concentration
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Microwave reflection characteristics of flake-shaped F$\mathrm{e}_{50}N\mathrm{i}_{50}$/paraffine composites with various volume concentration V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf> varying from 5% to 20% have been investigated in the microwave frequency band. The effect of V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf> on the resonance frequency, relative bandwidth and the mass of unit area have been studied. Microwave reflection result shows that the $\mu,\ \varepsilon$, matching thickness and peak frequency of the dips can be dipicted with the quarter wavelength and three quarters wavelength matching condition. When V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf> decreases to 5%, the relative bandwidth is enhanced, while the mass of unit area is reduced. The flake-shaped F$\mathrm{e}_{50}\mathrm{N}\mathrm{i}_{50}/$paraffine composite with low volume concentration can be attractive candidates for light weight and broad bandwidth microwave absorbers.

articleTitle: Self-optimizing Control Strategy of Conduction Angle for Doubly Salient Electromagnetic Generator to Minimize Excitation Current
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Compared with the uncontrolled rectifier, the controlled rectifier with angular position control (APC) can improve the output capacity of the doubly salient electromagnetic generator (DSEG) effectively. By adjusting the conduction angle in APC strategy, the excitation current can be minimized to avoid being too large at low speed, broadening the operating range of the DSEG and minimizing excitation loss. For the relation between the conduction angle and the excitation current is nonlinear and changes with the working conditions, the conduction angle corresponding to minimum excitation current is usually given by the lookup table or the fit function which requires massive work and is low in generality. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a self-optimizing control strategy for the conduction angle, according to the characteristic of the relation between the excitation current and the conduction angle. This strategy which based on the perturbation and observation method is convenient and has high generality. By adding perturbation to the system to change the conduction angle, the minimum excitation current is tracked online. Finally, the effectiveness of the strategy is verified by simulations under different working conditions.

articleTitle: Real-time simulation of PMSG based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) has a high degree of parallelization and pipeline computing capabilities, and is widely used in real-time simulation. Based on FPGA, this paper studies PMSG (Permanent Magnetic Synchronous Machine). The real-time simulation modeling method of wind turbines was developed. The main work of the paper is as follows: Based on the closed-loop simulation model of the permanent magnet direct-drive wind turbine, the whole system is divided into an electrical system and a control system. Based on the electromagnetic transient simulation framework, combined with the multi-zone Thevenin equivalent method, the data of each module in the electrical system is decoupled, which improves the FPGA solation speed and resource utilization. Based on this real-time simulator, a real-time simulation example of the electromagnetic system of the wind turbine is realized, and the simulation results during the start-up process of the wind turbine are analyzed, and are compared with the simulation results of MATLAB; the simulation results show that this real-time simulator has high accuracy, and the real-time performance can be guaranteed under the simulation step size of $10 \mu \mathrm{s}$.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Evolution Characteristics of Discharge Channel after Air Gap Breakdown
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The evolution of the discharge channel after air gap breakdown has a critical influence on the gap recovery process. In this paper, a simple model of the discharge channel is established, the evolution of discharge channel after the gap breakdown is simulated and studied, and the calculation method of the temperature recovery degree of the channel is proposed. The simulation results show that, according to the definition of the gap recovery degree, the discharge channel completes the insulation recovery process within 200ms when the initial temperature is 10000°C and 20000 °C with the channel radius of 0.5mm and 1mm; both the initial temperature and radius of the discharge channel play an important role in the recovery process.

articleTitle: Source-load Coordinated Optimal Scheduling in Stochastic Unit Commitment Considered Electrolytic Aluminum Load and Wind Power Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper studies the stochastic unit commitment and explore the potential of the electrolytic aluminum load to take part in demand response(DR) with the aim of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals. Wind power has trouble in consumption as its uncertainty and the regulation capacity of traditional thermal power are limited, meanwhile, the electrolytic aluminum load has great potential to be a flexible demand-side resource. This paper establishes a detailed model of the electrolytic aluminum and the optimal scheduling method proposed in this paper can consider uncertainty well. This paper evaluates the proposed optimal scheduling method by using the modified IEEE 39-bus testing system, and the participation of electrolytic aluminum in DR will reduce wind power curtailment as shown in the results. This paper provides help for electrolytic aluminum enterprises to participate in DR.

articleTitle: A New Method for Cable AC Voltage Test of Insulation Based on Replacing Test Reactor Combination by Shunt Reactor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The large-scale usage of power cables plays an important role in ensuring the reliability of production and domestic electricity. The AC voltage test of insulation should be conducted before the cable is put into operation, and usually the frequency conversion series resonance method shall be adopted. With the increase of cable voltage level and distance, the number and capacity of test reactors also increase greatly, thus a test method using the shunt reactor instead of the test reactor is proposed in this paper. Considering the voltage and frequency requirements of cable AC voltage test, the voltage withstand level of terminal and neutral point of shunt reactor, magnetic density distribution of iron core and other limiting factors, a variety of different test connection modes and test programme are proposed. The new method is verified in the power cable project in the northeast suburb of Xi’an, China. The test result shows that the method is effective and feasible, and the test power capacity demand, test floor space and time of this method are significantly reduced compared with the traditional method.

articleTitle: Research on 220kV Spare Power Automatic Switching Equipment Standardized Application of Local functions Based on Real-Time Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Currently, the power grid is carrying out the standardized design and application of 220kV spare power automatic switching equipment. It is more difficult to carry out the on-site standby automatic switching function test in the actual power grid. The power supply department urgently needs a simulation environment that can truly simulate the actual power grid to support the development of this functional test. Real-time simulation has the ability to carry out on-site automatic transfer function tests in terms of technical feasibility. To verify its effectiveness, this paper built a standardized closed-loop test system for 220kV spare power automatic switching equipment based on real-time simulation. A number of tests have been carried out for the automatic switch-on function of on-site equipment, and the device action events on the actual site have been inverted. The test results show that the established RTDS real-time simulation model has the ability to simulate the actual 220kV power grid. It has been verified that the action logic of the standby automatic input device in various modes meets the requirements of the standard specification, which strongly supports the standardized application of the 220kV spare power automatic switching equipment function of the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on loss and thermal reliability for Neutral Point Clamped Three-level SVG
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Thermal reliability has a very important influence on the performance and service life of Neutral Point Clamped (NPC) three-level SVG. Continuous pulse width modulation (CPWM) has the disadvantages of high switching loss and low reliability when applied to three levels. To solve this problem, a dynamic discontinuous pulse width modulation (DDPWM) strategy is proposed in this paper, which can reduce the switching loss of power components of the three-level converter and improve the thermal reliability of the converter. At the same time, the thermal reliability of the three-level converter is analyzed from the Angle of the influence of junction temperature on the device bond line. Finally, Simulation and experiments verify that the algorithm proposed in this paper is simple and reliable, can effectively reduce the loss, and has a certain engineering.

articleTitle: Fault Cause Analysis of Elbow Cable Joint of 10kV Pole-Type Transformer caused by Grounding Non-standard
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the basic structure of elbow cable joint of 10kV pole-type transformer. By actual measurement and laboratory simulation, author emphatically analyzes the incorrect grounding of pole-type transformer, which is an important reason for the fault causes. At last, the solutions and preventive measures are put forward.

articleTitle: A Response Potential Evaluation Method of Inverter Air Conditioner Clusters Considering User Willingness
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power aggregation and potential evaluation of dispersed air-conditioning (AC) loads are the prerequisites for air-conditioning loads to participate in grid dispatch. Existing power aggregation and potential assessment for air conditioning load are mainly focused on fixed frequency air conditioners, and less for inverter air conditioners. In this regard, this paper proposes a method for evaluating the response potential of inverter air-conditioning clusters that considers the wishes of users. First, according to the load model of a single inverter air conditioner and the thermodynamic model of the air-conditioned room, the aggregation model of the inverter air conditioner cluster is derived. Secondly, the user’s comfortable temperature range is obtained by using the predicted mean vote (PMV) index, and the user’s willingness to participate in demand response model is established based on the comfortable temperature range. Finally, the air-conditioning cluster aggregation model and the user willingness model are used to evaluate the load flexibility potential of the AC cluster. A system with 5000 inverter air conditioners was simulated to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the evaluation method.

articleTitle: Segmental PWM Variable Duty Cycle Control of Switched Reluctance Motor Based on Current Chopping
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The switched reluctance motor generally adopt current chopping control at startup or at low speeds, but the problem of large torque ripple occurs in actual control. This paper analyzes the causes of torque ripple under current chopping control, and proposes a subsection PWM variable duty cycle control method based on current chopping. This control strategy adjusts the excitation voltage of the winding by changing the PWM duty cycle, and is segmented according to the inductance characteristic curve, and uses different PWM duty cycles in areas where the current rate of change is different. In this paper, a three-phase 6/20SRM simulation model is established through Matlab/Simulink, and the optimal duty cycle at different speeds is obtained through simulation, and the functional relationship between the duty cycle and the motor speed is fitted. Through simulation analysis, the control strategy in this paper has significantly reduced torque ripple at different speeds compared with traditional current chopping control, which shows that the control strategy in this paper has a significant effect on suppressing torque ripple and has good dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Carbon Quantum Dots by Gas-liquid Plasma Using Ethanol as Precursor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This work demonstrates a simple and fast method for synthesizing carbon quantum dots (CQDs) at atmospheric pressure and room temperature by gas-liquid plasma. The method utilizes a pair of hollow stainless-steel electrodes to introduce argon (Ar) gas bubbles in ethanol, which greatly reduces difficulty of synthesis. The observation results showed that both crystallization and fluorescence properties of the CQDs were found to be altered by varying the gas flow rate. This may provide a technical guide for the further application of synthesizing CQDs by gas-liquid plasma.

articleTitle: Development of Multi-Domain Design Tool for Medium Voltage High Frequency Power Transformers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Medium voltage high frequency (MVHF)transformers with high power density are required by emerging medium voltage DC systems such as PV generation, data centers, etc. However, design tools for MVHF transformers are with limited functions and low accuracy, which makes the optimal design hard to achieve in all electrical, magnetic and thermal domains. This paper proposed a new multi-domain design tool for MVHF transformers. It includes three main parts: I/O interface, dataset of materials and structures, and performance estimator. This tool provides a clear and convenient interface and can complete the complicate optimization process automatically. Compared with existing design methods, this design tool is more comprehensive in both optimization methodologies and transformer parameters which can be optimized. The tool also realized the combination with circuit simulation software such as MATLAB/Simulink. In addition, an improved method to calculate transformer temperature rise based on thermal network method is used. The feasibility and accuracy of this design tool are verified through an optimization process of a power transformer in a typical DAB converter.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of output short-circuit capacitor discharge of intrinsically safe switching transistor converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the intrinsically safe switching converter adopts the IEC spark experimental device for opening and closing explosive test evaluation, the output circuit can be equivalent to a capacitor circuit. In order to study the micro characteristics in the process of short-circuit discharge, the capacitor circuit is equivalent to the same amount of charge according to the law of charge conservation, A two-dimensional plate-to-plate electrostatic model with tungsten wire as anode and cadmium disk as cathode in explosive gas gap is established by particle method (PIC / MCC). The discharge processes of dielectric breakdown, spark discharge and spark maintenance are simulated, and the correctness and feasibility are verified. By analyzing the number of charged particles, the spatial distribution of particles and the change of electric field intensity in the electrode gap, the discharge process of the first three stages of capacitor short-circuit discharge is explained. It is found that the dielectric breakdown in the discharge process of capacitor circuit is only related to the electric field intensity formed by the plate voltage in the electrode gap. When the field enhancement factor is 100 and the field strength is greater than 2x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> v/m, there is field emission between the electrodes, and the electrode gap can be broken down. The critical breakdown spacing of the electrode plate is 1.2um During the discharge process, the number of electrons in the gap first increases rapidly, then increases slowly, and then decreases slowly after reaching the peak. When the external capacitance is greater than lpF, the number of electrons increases by 1X10? for every 10pF increase. Based on the flat two-dimensional model, this paper analyzes the change trend of electric field in the discharge process, and obtains that the electric field intensity of capacitor in the spark maintenance stage is a fixed value, which is independent of the capacitance value. When the electric field intensity is 9x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> v/m, the voltage will not drop and maintain at 9V, and the capacitor discharge is in the spark maintenance stage.

articleTitle: Short-Circuit Current Mechanism in Three-Core Submarine Cable for Offshore Wind Power Transmission System Under Grid Faults
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Three-core submarine cable has been widely used in the offshore wind power transmission field, and its fault characteristics are different from single-core submarine cable. The short-circuit current mechanism in three-core submarine cable for offshore wind power transmission system under grid faults is studied in this paper. The positive, negative and zero sequence mathematical models are established under different fault states. On this basis, the reason of the fault current dc offset problem and its impact to the circuit breaker is analyzed. In addition, the main influence factors of the fault current zero-crossing time are analyzed. Finally, comparative simulation studies are conducted under different fault conditions. Simulation results show that the fault position and the duration time of different fault states have major influence to the fault current. When the time intervals between different faults are around 5ms, and the fault position is near the step-up transformer, the fault current dc offset problem will be pretty serious.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dynamic analysis of the PCC buck converter with MR parallel load
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper adopts a new type of voltage controlled memristor simulator which is easy to manufacture, the nonlinear dynamic behavior of the peak current controlled (PCC) buck converter with parallel load of memristor and resistance (MR) is studied. Firstly, the state equations of the (PCC) buck converter with (MR) parallel load under two switching states are derived and normalized; Secondly, the time sequences, phase orbit portraits and bifurcation plots are drawn by MATLAB, the nonlinear dynamic behavior of the system with varying system parameters is studied. Taking the reference current I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ref</inf> as the bifurcation parameter, compared with the conventional load, it is found that the buck converter has a wider stable operating range with MR parallel load.

articleTitle: Power grid engineering data knowledge retrieval and graph construction technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The power grid infrastructure project has the characteristics of large scale, long period, and multiple subjects. Therefore, it is determined that a large amount of data with rich sources and complex formats will be generated in the whole process of power grid engineering from design, construction to acceptance. However, due to the lack of effective data extraction and sorting technical means, these data results have a single search method and related queries are difficult, and they cannot be displayed intuitively. This article takes the noise-containing multi-source heterogeneous infrastructure engineering data as the research object, and relies on natural language processing technology to carry out research on the information extraction model and method and the knowledge map construction technology. This method automatically analyzes the natural semantics contained in the text data of the power grid infrastructure project, excavates the valuable information contained therein, and then constructs a data knowledge graph to realize hierarchical storage, visual display and related information recommendation.

articleTitle: Suppression Mechanism and Strategy of Commutation Failure in Hybrid Dual-infeed HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the hybrid dual-infeed High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) system, simulation methods are mainly used to study the inhibitory effect of Modular Multilevel Converter based HVDC (MMC-HVDC) on the commutation failure of Line Commutated Converter based HVDC (LCC-HVDC), but there is no mechanism analysis, which leads to a lack of universality. To solve the problem, this paper derives the expressions of LCC inverter bus voltage and short-circuit current after fault, quantitatively analyzes the support effect of MMC-HVDC on LCC inverter bus voltage, which provides theoretical support for MMC-HVDC to suppress the commutation failure of LCC-HVDC by providing reactive current. On this basis, a commutation failure suppression strategy for hybrid dual-infeed HVDC system is proposed. The reactive power compensation is obtained according to the required reduction of firing angle order and added to the MMC’s reactive-power outer control. This method can improve the reactive power support from MMC to ac system and suppress commutation failure. Finally, the mechanism analysis is proved correct and the control strategy is proved effective in PSCAD.

articleTitle: Research on multi-modal integrated access of intelligent switch
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The introduction of electronic transformer brings a new problem to the test of the primary and secondary integrated intelligent switch. This paper presents a method to increase the access function of the integrated access device, which can simultaneously access multi-mode intelligent switches with mixed large and small signals of various transformers. The influence on the voltage and current measurement accuracy can be ignored. At the same time, it uses the method of multi-channel synchronous sampling, and the large-signal and small-signal synchronous acquisition is carried out on the primary side and the secondary side. The detection of the multi-modal integrated intelligent switch is realized.

articleTitle: Anti-interference method for measuring radiated electromagnetic waves of circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Among the various methods for onsite test of circuit breakers, it is effective to use radiated electromagnetic waves during the operation of circuit breakers to determine the arc extinguishing process of circuit breakers, but there is still some interference in the field test. Analyzing the principle of circuit breaker action, the control loop of the circuit breaker operating mechanism is the source of disturbance in the field test. Building a test platform, the relay, coil and auxiliary switch of the control circuit of the circuit breaker operating mechanism are tested. The test results show that during the period when the control loop is energized, an interfering electromagnetic wave signal will be generated. Using the time domain characteristics of the interference signal, anti-interference processing is carried out on the field test results.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Aggregation Method for Virtual Energy Plants Considering Real-time Contribution
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In a complex Integrated Energy Distribution Network (IEDN) environment, how to select demand side regulated resources with aggregation value and provide attractive aggregation incentives is an urgent problem to be solved in the process of aggregating resources in a virtual energy plant (VEP). In this paper, a dynamic aggregation method for VEP considering real-time contribution is proposed. It is applied to IEDN-based VEP multi-type resources aggregation for electricity, gas and heat. Firstly, the basic structure and aggregation principle of IEDN-based VEP are established, and the calculation method of real-time contribution is proposed. Then, a VEP aggregation model considering real-time contribution is developed to achieve dynamic aggregation of multi-type resources for electricity, gas and heat. The aggregation incentives and strategies to improve the efficiency of VEP aggregation are given. Finally, a case is established to verify the aggregation method, the dynamic method of VEP aggregation considering real-time contribution improves the aggregation gain by 6.92% compared with the single aggregation throughout the day without considering real-time contribution, the effectiveness of the method in this paper is verified.

articleTitle: Parallel Load Restoration of Distribution Network via A Shortest-path-based Grid Partitioning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: After the power system fails, it is necessary to restore the power supply to the important loads as soon as possible. For the distribution network with multiple black-start units, dividing the distribution network into multiple subsystems for parallel restoration can speed up the speed of distribution network restoration. This paper proposes a parallel restoration model for distribution networks via a shortest-path-based portioning approach. A distribution network partitioning method based on the shortest path algorithm is introduced, which filters out the unimportant load nodes on the edge by means of power verification. Based on the obtained partition scheme, a parallel restoration model for distribution networks is established aiming at maximizing the cumulative weighted load recovery amount. Restoration constraints of multiple components are comprehensively incorporated, including the power flow equation constraints, DG output constraints, load constraints, node voltage constraints, line power constraints, restoration sequence constraints, network topology constraints and initial constraints. The linear programming solver ILOG CPLEX is used to solve the proposed optimization model, so as to obtain the load recovery optimization scheme in each partition. The effectiveness of the proposed model and strategy is verified on a modified IEEE-69 bus distribution system.

articleTitle: Insulation repair of flashover damaged polymer using plasma spraying
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In high-voltage equipment such as high-power microwave instruments, flashover accident is considered permanent damage that can cause this point to become a system insulation weakness. The material repair process can repair the insulation performance of this point in a targeted manner so that the equipment parts can be exempted from large-scale replacement, which increases the life of the equipment and reduces the maintenance cost. However, the existing repair methods rely on the modification of raw materials, and it is difficult to both have convenience and cost-effectiveness, and it is not conducive to the performance of specific functions, which may not be suitable for flashover damage repair. Here, we use the method of plasma spraying to achieve the surface repair of the material damaged by the flashover and realize the improvement of the insulation performance after the flashover. The SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> particles and reactive oxygen species generated by the plasma jet treatment of air and tetraethyl orthosilicate are deposited on the surface of polystyrene (PS) with the airflow, oxidizing the surface carbon and covering the ablated surface with a layer of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> to achieve recovery The purpose of PS surface insulation capacity after flashover. The repair performance of the surface after flashover and after the repair was analyzed by electron microscopy, infrared spectroscopy, scanning electron microscopy, and flashover tests. This research method can finally improve the surface dielectric strength of the dielectric material after flashover by 18.2%, which provides a new idea for the repair of insulating materials.

articleTitle: Comparison and Investigation of Outer-Rotor Flux-Modulated Permanent Magnet Motor With Different Pole Ratios and Rotor Poles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new method based on the investigation of pole ratio (PR) and rotor poles is proposed for pole-slot combination design of an outer-rotor flux-modulated permanent magnet (OR-FMPM) motor to improve output torque and reduce permanent magnet (PM) eddy current loss. Firstly, through the analytical method, the relationships of the PR and the rotor poles with output torque and PM eddy current loss, respectively, are derived. Then, the performances of topologies with different PRs and rotor poles, respectively, are compared and investigated by finite element analysis (FEA). The result reveals that the PR and the rotor poles significantly influence the performance. Subsequently, the optimal pole-slot is selected for the OR-FMPM motor, and other basic performances are evaluated, including the flux distribution and flux density distribution, no-load back electromotive force (EMF), etc. Finally, the theoretical analysis and the simulation results verify the rationality and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Energy storage system participates in frequency modulation control and capacity balance strategy of power system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The grid-connected wind power generation leads to frequent frequency safety problems in the system, and new primary frequency modulation measures are urgently needed. In order to ensure the economy and safety of power grid operation, it is necessary to conFigure energy storage system for wind farm. In this paper, the control strategy is designed to use energy storage for primary frequency modulation. At present, the SOC imbalance of internal battery components is common in energy storage batteries. Therefore, this paper proposes an adjustable capacity proportional equalization control algorithm based on the current capacity of energy storage batteries. According to the different SOC of each battery component of energy storage batteries and its operating state (charge and discharge), it determines how to reasonably distribute the power deviation signal generated by frequency modulation to each energy storage battery component, so that the energy storage battery can not only support the frequency adjustment of power grid, but also improve its own SOC imbalance. Finally, based on EMTDC/PSCAD simulation model, the effectiveness of this method is verified. Simulation results show that this method can effectively balance the system SOC.

articleTitle: Identiftcation Method of Photovoltaic Roofs Based on High Resolution Images
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to reduce carbon emissions as well as save energy, people have been looking for ways to effectively utilize solar energy. While photovoltaic (PV) power generation is an effective way to utilize solar energy, distributed photovoltaic installed on the roof of a building can replace the traditional mode of power generation. In order to popularize PV roofs, roof resources need to be evaluated. With the development of remote sensing technology, the resolution of remote sensing images is getting higher and higher, and the research of this paper focuses on extracting the outline of roofs from remote sensing images. This paper proposes a method to extract PV developable roofs using remote sensing optical images. Firstly, the image is subjected to principal component analysis, threshold segmentation and classification process to get the roof class; the threshold segmentation result is used for masking and edge detection; the edge detection result is edited by ArcGIS software, and finally the result is processed by mathematical morphology method. The accuracy of roof extraction is 91.2215%. This result shows that the method is effective and with proper accuracy.

articleTitle: Simulation research on mechanical performance of converter transformer on-load tap-changer based on transient dynamic analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the high switching frequency, the on-load tap changer of converter transformer has been exposed for many time. The internal metal or insulating structural parts have cracks or even fractures, which seriously endangers the safety of high-capacity HVDC transmission system. In this paper, the transient dynamic model of the converter on-load tap changer is established. The stress analysis of the action process of the new vacuum on-load tap changer is carried out. The stress distribution of each part of the tap changer under different boss angles is analyzed. The optimal angle of the tap on/ off boss is given based on the yield strength of the material. This paper provides a useful numerical simulation method for the research and development of new tap changer..

articleTitle: Research on Bus Voltage of Dual PWM Frequency Conversion System Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the high-end manufacturing industry, a large number of motors and their control systems are used. In order to make the motor system operate normally and not be affected by grid fluctuations. The bus voltage model predictive control (BV-MPC) is used to improve the response speed of bus voltage fluctuations and smooth the fluctuations for grid output. To compensate for the delay of the system, the two-step prediction is proposed based on the one-step prediction for optimization. The results of the simulations show that the model predictive control (MPC) has good response speed. Finally, an experimental platform is established and the experimental results demonstrate the MPC of the bus voltage can further suppress the voltage fluctuation during sudden changes and improve the dynamic response on the DC side.

articleTitle: Research on the Statistical Characteristics of the Discharge Inception Electric Field Strength of Gap Defect in Insulation pressboard Based on Three-parameter Weibull Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Partial discharge (PD) has been paid much attention as an essential factor of insulation deterioration of various large equipment in power system. Partial discharges are prone to occur when there are air gaps in insulation pressboard. Based on different sizes of air-gap of air-gap discharge models, this paper proposes a three-parameter Weibull distribution to describe the probability distribution of partial discharge onset field strength in the air-gap model. The results show that the internal air-gap discharge of the pressboard has an obvious size effect. When the air gap diameter increases, the position parameter E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> and the scale parameter a decrease due to increased inhomogeneity and area effect, while the initial voltage data concentration increases and shape parameter $\beta$ increases. When the separation of the gap defect inside the insulation pressboard is small, the separation of the gap defect is not the main factor affecting the partial discharge. The cross-sectional area of the air gap in the direction perpendicular to the electric field largely determines the initial field strength of the air gap.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of a 12Slot/11Pole-Pairs Linear Permanent Magnet Vernier Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The linear servo system has attracted more and more people’s attention at this stage, In this paper, a novel 12slot-11pole-pairs linear permanent magnet vernier motor (LPMVM) is proposed. Compared with the linear permanent magnet synchronous motor, the main features of the proposed motor are high thrust density and low thrust ripple, which is suitable for high definition numerical control machine tool. Firstly, the basic structure and operation principles of LPMVM are presented. Then, the electromagnetic thrust is derived by analyzing the airgap magnetic field through classical electromagnetic theory. Thirdly, the electromagnetic properties of motors such as permanent magnet flux linkage, no-load back electromotive force, detent force and electromagnetic thrust are analyzed by a simplified three-phase model with a symmetry boundary in the 2-D finite element analysis (FEA).

articleTitle: Transformer Mechanical Condition Assessment Method Based on Improved Grey Similarity Correlation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Transformer mechanical condition assessment methods based on transformer vibration signals have received a lot of attention due to their non-stop, safe and other characteristics. At present, many studies of transformer body vibration signals are based on their amplitude, which has a high mistaken judgment rate. At the same time, for different loads and types of transformers, their single frequency varies widely, making it difficult to reflect the mechanical condition of the transformer effectively. In this paper, the energy share of the vibration signal is calculated in frequency bands according to the vibration characteristics of the transformer body to reduce the influence of signal fluctuations in low frequency bands on the assessment of the mechanical condition. Combining the energy distribution and frequency components of the vibration signal in different frequency bands, an improved grey similarity correlation is used to assess the mechanical condition of the transformer.

articleTitle: Delayed Complementation Control for Wind Turbines Participating in Primary Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of renewable energy power generation, the power grid urgently needs wind turbines (WTs) with power regulation ability to participate in primary frequency regulation (PFR). For a class of WTs’ control strategies for PFR based on kinetic energy release, the setting of the time-domine power curve to improve frequency nadir during system frequency events is a hot issue. This paper proposes a delayed complementation control (DCC) for WTs considering the frequency response of synchronous generators (SGs). Based on WTs’ flexible power regulation ability, DCC complements SGs’ power to restore the active power balance of the grid and prevents the frequency from falling further. Due to the limitation of the kinetic energy that wind turbines can release, the complementation is not completed immediately but delayed for some time. Simulation results show that WTs with DCC can effectively achieve higher frequency nadir in contingency.

articleTitle: Intraday PV-storage power reporting model considering temporal correlation of forecast error
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a strategy for reporting the intraday output plan of photovoltaic (PV) power plants considering the power correction of energy storage devices. First, an intraday PV power scenario generation method which considers the temporal correlation of intraday rolling forecasts is proposed. Secondly, considering the adjustment capability of energy storage devices, an intraday joint power reporting model of PV-storage system at different time periods is established. Finally, based on the actual data of the PV-storage power station in China, the simulation is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Aggressive Level-based Offering Method for Hybrid PV Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Over the past few years, the penetration of solar power plants increased dramatically. Unlike traditional power plants, the uncertainty of Photovoltaic (PV) generation makes the offering process very challenging for PV plant operators. The uncertainty can be addressed by using the worst-case-based robust optimization. However, the solution to this method may be overly conservative. On the other hand, the battery energy storage system (BESS) is commonly used in PV plants, which can be used to reduce the uncertainty of PV generation. In this paper, a day-ahead offering method for the PV plant operator is proposed. As part of the proposed method, the optimal aggressive level of the offering decision is calculated by a data-driven method. Two scenarios that include a PV-only plant and a hybrid PV+BESS plant have been considered in our study. This paper also analyzed the potential advantage of pairing a BESS to a PV plant in the offering process. We found that the BESS can generate more revenue while reducing the risk of paying an under-generation charge under some conditions.

articleTitle: Optimal-Parameters-Based Model Predictive Position Control of Planar Switched Reluctance Motors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this article, an adaptive simulated annealing particle swarm optimization (ASAPSO) algorithm is proposed to optimize the parameters of the model predictive position control (MPPC) algorithm for planar switched reluctance motors (PSRMs). Based on the self-designed PSRM in our lab, the dynamic model of discrete state space equation is established, and then the prediction model is established and the cost function is defined, the optimal control sequence is calculated. In addition, the ASAPSO algorithm was used to optimize the parameters of the MPPC. The algorithm adopted the nonlinear dynamic inertia weight coefficient to balance the global search ability and local improvement ability of particles. The hyperbolic tangent function is used to control the acceleration coefficient and balance the self-cognition ability of particles. Simulated annealing operator is introduced to increase the ability of particles to jump out of local optimum. Finally, the optimal parameters obtained by the ASAPSO algorithm are used for simulation verification, and compared with the traversal method. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed MPPC based on optimal parameters.

Author Keywords: adaptive simulated annealing particle swarm optimization

articleTitle: Research on Control Parameter Setting Method of AC Excitation System of Variable Speed Pumped Storage Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This work focuses on the converter control links of variable speed pumped storage unit, proposed the principle of dynamic correction for AC excitation system of variable speed pumped storage unit, based on the dynamic correction method widely used in synchronous generator. According to the best second order parameter rule, the parameter setting derivation of converter control loops is completed. Without changing the stability of the system, the simulation cases verified the parameter adjustment effects.

articleTitle: Online optimization method of system protection setting value based on transient minimum frequency prediction model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Bulk power grid security coordinated defense system plays an important role in quick frequency recovery due to large-scale power shortage after DC fault. The off-line setting value of system protection has high risk of severe mismatch with the grid operation situation. Therefore, an online optimization method of system protection setting based on transient minimum frequency prediction model is proposed. According to influencing factors of transient minimum frequency, prediction model of transient minimum frequency is established. Parameters of transient minimum frequency prediction model are determined according to transient simulation results of real-time power grid operation situation. System protection setting value are optimized by the combination of transient minimum frequency prediction model and frequency control target. The effectiveness of the method is verified by an example of AC/DC hybrid power grid.

articleTitle: Operation region determination method for MMC-HVDC system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An operation region determination method for modular multilevel converter high-voltage direction current (MMC-HVDC) system is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the mathematical model of MMC-HVDC system is illustrated, where the voltage stability constraint, voltage magnitude constraint and the current constraint is considered. Secondly, the operation region determination problem is transformed into checking the possible solution for a series of equations. Thirdly, the proposed method is applied based on the planning Xiamen-Jinmen power system inter-connection project, which aims to provide electricity supply for Jinmen with safety and economy. It is illustrated by numerical case study that the operation region of MMC-HVDC is not ideally as a unit circle, in which case the region is limited by the system parameter of Jinmen power system, voltage magnitude and operation current. Furthermore, it is shown that the operation region is reduced with the decrease of short circuit ratio (SCR), in which case the Jinmen power system should be strengthened to improve its system characteristic.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Power Generation Allocation Scheme of DC Transmission Line under the Guidance of Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutralization Targets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: After China clearly put forward the goal of carbon peak and carbon neutralization targets, the clean energy transformation has accelerated. Under the background of large-scale development of renewable energy, high-voltage DC (HVDC) and ultra-high voltage DC (UHVDC)transmission become more effective way to transmit the resources of renewable energy from rich areas such as northwest and southwest to economically developed areas such as North China and East China. It is an important means of realizing the optimal allocation of resources through long-distance power transmission. This paper proposes an optimal power allocation scheme for DC transmission lines, which takes the minimum grid power as the objective function, focusing on the constraints such as the proportion of renewable energy and power constraint rate. The scheme adds the calculation method of economic analysis and carbon emission level, which gives a better understanding for result selection. Finally, a case study is performed by using the proposed optimal power allocation scheme. Taking the typical daily output as an example, it can be seen that the scheme not only meets the load demand, but also improves the consumption level of renewable energy.

articleTitle: A Forecasting Method for EV Charging Demand Considering Refined Division of Functional Areas
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The dynamic spatial-temporal distribution prediction of electric vehicle charging demand is of great significance for the charging operation management in the power grid. To achieve accurate prediction of charging load distribution in urban areas, firstly, the characteristics of different functional areas in the city are considered. Then, the POI data in Baidu Map platform is used to carry on the data mining and modeling, which helps model the division of urban functional areas. Then, a spatial-temporal distribution model of EV charging demand is established based on the theory of Agent-cellular automata (CA) to accurately describe the mathematical model for EVs. The model contains the changes of location and state of charge (SOC) in the drive. Finally, a certain city area is selected as an example to conduct the charging demand load prediction under multiple scenarios. The results show that the proposed model can effectively predict the spatial-temporal distribution of charging demand loads for different date types.

articleTitle: Characteristics analysis for Axial-flux Permanent Magnet Eddy Current Brake with Slotted Disc
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents an axial-flux permanent-magnet eddy current brake with a slotted disc. The brake with the structure of the double-side series magnetic circuit and radial slotted conductor disk could generate high braking torque compared with that with solid conductor discs. A 3D FEA simulation model was built to calculate the electromagnetic field and analyze the braking characteristics. The structural parameters of pole pairs, PM thickness, slots, cogging width, and depth were analyzed specifically.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Construction for Electric Substation Based on Multiple-source Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Knowledge graph (KG) is a database that stores the information and relationship between entities in the form of graph. This paper presents a knowledge graph construction method for grid substation knowledge graph based on multi-source data. The device connection, alarm information and ledgers are contained in KG, which benefits the substation operation and maintenance. First, entities and relationships are selected according to the actual composition of substation. Then, triples are extracted through domain dictionaries and conditional random field. Entity disambiguation is carried out before establishing the knowledge graph based on corresponding data sources. Finally, knowledge fusion is used to remove the redundancy in the database to complete the construction of the KG. Compared to traditional relational database, graph database can more intuitively show the connection relationship between devices. By adding more links to knowledge graph, it takes less time for monitoring personnel to locate accidents when dealing with alarm information.

articleTitle: Three-Voltage Vector Model Predictive Torque Control Strategy for Open-Winding PMSM Under Variable DC Bus Voltage Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the steady and dynamic performance of the direct torque control(DTC) for open-winding permanent magnet synchronous machine(OW-PMSM) with the isolated dual power source, a three-voltage vector model predictive torque control(TVMPTC) strategy is proposed in this manuscript. The reference voltage vector is predicted directly by deadbeat model predictive torque control, based on the analysis of the coordinated modulation method for the dual-inverter, the three-voltage vector selection scheme in different sectors is given. With the elimination of the traditional inner loop regulator, the proposed control strategy could effectively improve the dynamic performance of the OW-PMSM driving system Finally, the experimental results of the proposed system have been implemented to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed TVMPTC strategy for OW-PMSM under the variable DC bus voltage condition.

Author Keywords: Open winding permanent magnet synchronous machine
three-voltage vector model predictive torque control

articleTitle: Quantum annealing computing for grid partition in large-scale power systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
