abstract: As more and more controllable devices equiped in the smart grid, the inceasing scale of binary virables brings time-consuming dimension explosion problems to traditional optimizations problems. As a parallel computing method, quantum computing is valuable for exploration to accelerate the optimization computation. The classic quantum annealer (QA) only can be used for quadratic unconstraint binary optimization (QUBO) problems. This paper is to explore a novel algorithm based on the quantum annealer for grid partition problems. It is a typical large-scale Integer Quadratic Programming (IQP) problems. The proposed quantum algorithm attemped to apply Lagrangian relaxation (LR) and alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), to transform an IQP problem to general format of QUBO problems. Some numerical cases of the grid partition are discussed to compare the performance of the proposed algorithm with some typical methods, thus verifing the feasibility and performance of this ADMM-QA algorithm.

articleTitle: Cluster division and optimal scheduling of offshore wind power with energy storage based on fast unfolding algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of offshore wind power, its volatility also brings suffering to prediction, regulation and risk assessment. Aiming at the large-scale access scenario of offshore wind power, an offshore wind power cluster division and optimal scheduling strategy with energy storage is proposed. Firstly, the cluster partition index is normalized, and the fast unfolding clustering algorithm is used to partition the offshore wind power cluster by optimizing the modularity function; Then, taking the cluster as the unit, the offshore wind power output is optimized through energy storage to reduce the fluctuation of offshore wind power output; Finally, the results are verified by simulation based on MATLAB platform.

articleTitle: Study on the Quantitative Analysis Method of Polydimethylsiloxane of High Temperature Vulcanized Silicone Rubber
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For previous studies on the aging state of silicone rubber composite insulators, the second step of the thermogravimetric curve is usually considered to be the polydimethylsiloxane content, but there is no discussion on the decomposition products. In this study, thermogravimetric-IR coupling experiments were carried out on silicone rubber samples and filler components under a nitrogen atmosphere to qualitatively and quantitatively analyze the weight loss process of silicone rubber during thermogravimetric analysis and to relate the thermogravimetric curves and IR spectra by time variation. The infrared experimental data yielded products of silicone rubber during thermal decomposition that were different from the expected results. To verify the plausibility of the causes, single component experiments with silicone rubber fillers were carried out. The experimental results are analyzed and interpreted in terms of both temperature and the characteristic peaks of the infrared spectrum. Solutions to the causes of the experimental errors are also proposed, and the next step of the work is envisaged.

articleTitle: Review of Typical Energy Storage Resources From the Perspective of Generalized Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Although renewable energy has the advantages of cleanness and non-pollution, the more the renewable energy penetrate into the power grid, the worse flexibility and stability of the grid will be. Energy storage is the key to improve the stability and utilization of renewable energy. Traditional energy storage systems, such as battery energy storage, have expensive cost and limited servicing life. As an extension of conventional energy storage, generalized energy storage can reduce the deployment and use cost and improve the economy. This paper expounds the related concepts of generalized energy storage, and sorts out the typical energy storage resources and related models in generalized energy storage, so as to further coordinate a variety of flexible resources with the uncertainty of distributed generation and load, and better apply them to power system, so as to promote the successful transformation of the power system and further reform of the future power market.

articleTitle: Non-intrusive load perception and flexibility evaluation for electric vehicle charging station: a deep learning based approach
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electric vehicles have the advantages of zero carbon emission, high energy efficiency and simple structure, and have been widely used today. Under the control of V2G, electric vehicles can be used as loads and distributed power sources, and become participants in the operation of auxiliary systems. Aiming at how to evaluate the load states and controllability of electric vehicle charging stations, this paper proposes a load sensing method for electric vehicle charging stations based on unsupervised learning and non-intrusive load monitoring. The proposed load sensing method firstly establishes the load sensing model according to the unsupervised learning strategy, and then uses the neural network model of the supervised learning strategy to evaluate the available regulation capability, so as to realize the load perception and regulation capability evaluation of the electric vehicle charging station. Through the verification of simulation data, it is proved that the proposed method has good performance in the evaluation of load perception and controllability of electric vehicle charging stations, which provides a feasible solution to the practical implementation of auxiliary responses by electric vehicles.

articleTitle: A Multi-parameter Condition Monitoring Method for IGBT Bond Wire
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to monitor the aging degree of Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT) bond wire, an IGBT bond wire condition monitoring platform is established based on a half-bridge module, and an IGBT bond wire condition monitoring model based on back-propagation (BP) neural network is proposed. The on-state voltage is measured at the intersection point current, the Miller platform voltage and Miller platform duration are extracted by using the double-pulse testing, and the threshold voltage is obtained at the specified current. By cutting the bond wire to simulate the bond wire liftoff, the characteristic parameter data set under different bond wire states is established. Then, the bond wire state is monitored by a BP neural network model. The experimental results indicate the feasibility of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Influence of Phase Angle for Low-order Harmonics on Vibration of an Induction Traction Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The vibration and noise problem of induction traction motor has been widely concerned and studied in recent years. This paper focuses on the influence of low-order harmonics phase on electromagnetic force of induction motor. Firstly, the relationship between stator and rotor current phase with harmonics is analyzed qualitatively by equivalent circuit. Then, the electromagnetic force of an induction traction motor is studied. Using two-dimensional Fourier analysis, the main spatial order and frequency of electromagnetic force wave can be calculated. The variation of three main electromagnetic force waves with harmonic phases are analyzed. Finally, the vibration under different harmonic phases is obtained by finite element simulation. The results show that the relationship between electromagnetic force and motor vibration with harmonic phase is basically consistent under low spatial order.

articleTitle: Robust H∞ Position servo control for PMSM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This article presents a H∞ position controller for permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs) drives. By combining position loop and speed loop with H∞ controller, the control structure is optimized and the design work is simplified. The simulations and experiments are conducted on a PMSM servo platform, and the comparison between proposed control method and PI controller validates the H∞ controller has better performance and robustness for the PMSM servo drive.

articleTitle: Adaptive Harmonic Detection of Active Power Filter based on Improved VMD
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Harmonic detection accuracy is the key factor affecting the performance of active power filter (APF). As an effective harmonic detection method, any complex signal can be adaptively decomposed into several intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) with a certain bandwidth by Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD). Aiming at the problems that VMD will be affected under the background of strong noise and the parameters are difficult to determine, an adaptive harmonic detection method based on twice VMD is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the proposed method uses VMD with a fixed decomposition layer A of 2 for denoising. Secondly, the VMD parameters are optimized from the perspective of IMF energy, and the second VMD decomposition is performed on the denoised signal. The simulation results show that, compared with EMD, EEMD and VMD, the proposed method can not only effectively reduce the fundamental extraction error, but also be suitable for aperiodic and non-stationary signals. It shows that the harmonic detection accuracy of APF can be effectively improved by this method.

articleTitle: An improved BP neural network method for Wind Power Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For large wind farms with grid-connected power generation systems, power prediction is very important. A sparrow search algorithm is proposed for optimizing the wind power prediction in BP neural network to improve the accuracy and stability of wind power prediction. Tent chaotic mapping gets used to increase the species diversity of the sparrow search algorithm and improve the ability of the algorithm to step out of local optimization and global search. The improved SSA-BP algorithm and traditional BP neural network method are used to predict the wind power. The prediction results and errors of the two methods are compared. The comparative analysis of the actual measured data and model prediction data shows that the SSA-BP method can better track the trend of the actual wind speed data, reduce the error and improve the prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic transient modeling and verification of DFIG unit and wind farm based on RTLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electromagnetic transient modeling and verification of new energy unit and wind farm is becoming more and more important for new energy grid connection. This paper takes DFIG unit and DFIG wind farm as the research object. A new wind turbine generator modeling way of ‘ filed test - control hardware in the loop(CHIL) - dynamic link library(DLL) ’ is proposed, the two level time domain consistency verification proves the feasibility and accuracy of this modeling method. Furthermore, the multiplication equivalent model of wind farm is established, and the accuracy of wind farm model is verified.

articleTitle: Differential Protection of Active Distribution Networks Based on 5G Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The increasing penetration of distributed generations (DGs) challenges the reliability and safety operation of distribution networks. Conventional relay protection schemes usually ignore the detail features of DGs as well as the power electronics interfaces. Besides, the conventional communication technology cannot meet the requirements of modern power systems. For these reasons, a differential protection scheme based on 5G communication technology considering the transient characteristics of DGs is proposed in this paper. The parameters and the communication structure for the protection is designed. Moreover, the relay protections using different communication technology have been compared. Simulation results are provided to verify the effectiveness of the proposed protection scheme.

articleTitle: The Development of DC Leakage Current Monitoring Device
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of society, the power grid plays an increasingly important role. As a common accident, leakage current has had a serious impact on the normal operation of the power system. At present, the bridge method and the signal injection method are mainly used to detect DC leakage current. In view of this, this paper is based on a proportional-integral-multimode resonant controller, which determines whether there is leakage current by detecting the output current of the controller. The method is simple, and different times of resonance controllers can be selected according to the actual situation, -which is beneficial to make a portable leakage current detection device and has ideal development potential in the future.

articleTitle: Inverse Time Differential Current Protection for Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The different operation modes and a large number of inverter interfaced distributed generator of the microgrid make the inverse time over-current protection have shortcomings such as insufficient quickness and poor coordination in microgrid. This paper proposes an inverse time differential current protection which combines the advantages of differential current protection and considers the coordination of protection between lines. The correctness of the protection scheme is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: An Improved GWO Technique Integrated with P&O Algorithm for Photovoltaic System Considering Different Conditions in the Irradiance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Maximum power point tracking (MPPT) is an essential part for photovoltaic (PV) system, which can effectively improve the efficiency of PV system. The conventional MPPT techniques, such as perturb and observe (P&O), can track the maximum power point (MPP) well under uniform irradiance. On the other hand, bio-inspired techniques, such as grey wolf optimization (GWO), can track the global maximum power point (GMPP) effectively under partial shading conditions (PSC). However, slow speed of tracking and power oscillations often occur when applying meta-heuristic optimization techniques to track GMPP. Therefore, this paper modifies GWO technique and integrates the improved GWO technique with P&O algorithm (IGWO-P&O) to improve the speed and accuracy of MPPT under PSC. Meanwhile, this paper takes both uniform irradiance and non-uniform irradiance into account, a hybrid MPPT algorithm is proposed, which combines P&O with IGWO-P&O in order to effectively improve the speed and accuracy of MPPT under different conditions in the irradiance. The simulation results clearly show the superiority of the MPPT algorithm proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: An Improved Position and Speed Estimation Scheme for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor with Low-cost Hall Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) with Hall sensors has been widely used in the industrial electronic vehicle fields with the requirements of low cost, small volume and high performance in full speed region. Compared with sensorless control, the Hall sensor is the guarantee of low cost and control performance. However, the low-resolution Hall sensors deteriorate the accuracy of position and speed calculation in vector control scheme. Thus, an improved method for position and speed estimation is proposed in this paper. The proposed method combines the non-model-based least square algorithm (LSA) and the model-based sliding mode observer (SMO) to estimate position and speed effectively. Meanwhile, the load torque is estimated as a feedforward quantity of current loop to improve the anti-interference performance. Compared with the traditional average speed method, the proposed combined estimation method has superior performance. The effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method is verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Operation Anlysis and Torque Performance optimization of a Novel Self-aligning Limited-Angle Vibration Torque Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a new machine topology configuration of self-aligning limited-angle vibration torque permanent magnet machine (LAVM). This kind of machine has a simple structure including 4 pieces of PMs and 2 stator teeth. It can generate high frequency vibration torque and its rotor can return to initial position automatically when the current is released. The design and characterization of LAVM were analyzed through finite element analysis (FEA) to Figure out its operation principle. Furthermore, in order to increase the zero-position torque and obtain a better auto zero-returning (ZR) capacity, the parameters of this machine are optimized in the aspects of applied current value, PM geometric, PM-pole angle and stator tooth-tip profile using parametric sweep method.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Noise Analysis of the PMSM motor caused by Carrier Frequency of the Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Lower noise and vibration level of driving motors is becoming more and more important in most of the application areas. In this paper, the electromagnetic noise caused by the sideband harmonic currents is analyzed. According to the FEM analyzing results, the radial force waveform caused by the sideband harmonic currents is likely to generate the resonance of the stator, in condition that the natural frequency of the breathing vibration mode of the stator is close to the frequency of the sideband harmonic currents. This can result in the annoying electromagnetic noise of the motor. The most effective optimization solutions s to solve this noise and vibration problem include: 1) changing the carrier frequency of the controller; 2) enhancing the rigidity of the stator. The influence of the motor parameters to the sideband harmonic currents is analyzed based on a water-cooled 85kW permanent magnet synchronize motor (PMSM). Also, the radial force waveform caused by the sideband harmonic currents is studied. At last, the stator lamination is optimized to reduce the electromagnetic noise caused by the sideband harmonic currents. The experiment is done to test the noise sound pressure and vibration level of the motor. According to the experimental results, the noise and vibration level are greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Load recovery strategy based on mobile energy storage flexibility and distribution network reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To address the issue of low load recovery rate after distribution network failure, this paper proposes a load recovery strategy that considers the operation flexibility of mobile energy storage (MES) and distribution network reconfiguration. Firstly, the spatiotemporal position mobility and energy shifting properties of MES are analyzed. Constrained by the operating limits of DG and the static security of distribution network, a load recovery model based on MES flexible mobility and distribution network reconfiguration is established to minimize the total cost of load reduction, MES operation and DG generation. Afterward, the proposed load recovery model is transformed into a mixed integer second-order cone programming problem through linearization and solved by YALMIP toolkit. Finally, the simulations of IEEE 33-bus distribution system validated that the proposed load recovery strategy could fully exploit the spatiotemporal operation flexibility of MES to improve the load recovery rate and reduce the comprehensive operation cost of distribution network.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control for Open Winding PMSM with Variable Dead-Zone Time
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An optimized model predictive control strategy for open winding PMSM (OW-PMSM) considering dead-zone effect is proposed so as to improve the steady-state performance of OW-PMSM system with common dc bus in conventional single vector MPC (CSV-MPC). First, the impact of dead-zone voltage vector (DZVV) in CSV-MPC is analyzed and then the judgement process of DZVV is explained. Next, the optimized MPC strategy is proposed where the applied time of DZVV is variable which makes it different from CSV-MPC. Finally, the experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Nonintrusive load disaggregation method based on graph signal processing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problems of mining load data with low sampling rate and inaccurate load prediction, a non-invasive load decomposition prediction model based on graph signal processing is proposed to realize unsupervised learning and energy efficiency analysis and prediction by integrating graph signals. The model is based on Graph signal processing (GSP), which is applied to solve adaptive threshold, event clustering and feature matching respectively. From the perspective of signal processing, the noninvasive load decomposition problem is an event detection and data classification. The RDD data set, the sliding window with margins and the event detection algorithm are combined and superposed to obtain the final prediction results. Experiment results show that the proposed graph signal model can accurately monitor the overall variation trend of electric power load and real-time electricity consumption, track and decompose electric power more effectively, and have higher monitoring accuracy.

articleTitle: AC-DC Bidirectional Fault Ride-through Control Strategy of Flexible DC Distribution Network Based on MMC Active Current Limiting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The flexible DC distribution network based on the modular multilevel converter (MMC) has developed rapidly in recent years. However, the negative sequence voltage and current generated after the AC side fault affect the stable operation of the system, and the surge of fault current after the DC side fault also seriously threatens the equipment safety. Therefore, the fault ride-through issue puts forward new requirements for the control strategy of the converter station. Because of this situation, firstly, the fault current characteristics are analyzed, and the hybrid MMC converter station topology is proposed. Then, based on the idea of positive and negative sequence separation and active current limiting control, and considering the demand of AC and DC bidirectional fault ride-through, the AC and DC bidirectional fault ride-through control strategy is designed. In addition, hybrid modulation technology is proposed to realize the switching of working modes to meet the operation requirements under various working conditions. Finally, a simulation model is built in MATLAB/Simulink to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Online Topology Identification Method for MV and LV Distribution Network Based on GA-SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: China’s recent efforts to implement carbon peaking and neutrality goals have accelerated the integration of distributed renewable energy, which will impact the operation of distribution network. Exact topology information is the basis of the integration of distributed sources. However, the current distribution automation system cannot realize accurate monitoring of network topologies. This paper proposes a GASVM based medium and low voltage network topology identification method. By training the nodal SVM models with historical nodal voltage magnitude and topology information, the proposed method can realize offline training and online identification. The test results on IEEE 33 Bus System demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method under different noise and topology configuration.

articleTitle: Research on Revenue Risk of Electricity Retailers Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the formation of the market-oriented competition pattern on the electricity selling side, the electricity retailers face vast risks caused by the electricity price uncertainty from the purchase and sale markets. It is urgent to optimize the revenue risk to improve the market competitiveness of the electricity retailers. Fortunately, the smart grid development provides technical support for demand response to participate in electricity market transactions. Considering demand response, we propose a novel model of electricity retailers’ revenue risk in this paper based on the conditional value at risk theory. In an illustrative example, revenue risks of electricity retailers with and without demand response are discussed. Simulation results highlight that the demand response based on the model can effectively reduce the risk of electricity retailers and highly enhance the profitability of electricity retailers.

articleTitle: Fault Location Method of Distribution Network Based on Improved Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When there is a power failure in distribution network, the service level of power supply enterprises is reflected whether the fault location can be located quickly and accurately and the power supply can be restored. At present, in the study of distribution network fault location, intelligent algorithm based on genetic algorithm is the research trend. This paper proposes an improved method to solve the problems of traditional genetic algorithm, such as local convergence and poor optimization speed. By introducing adaptive genetic operation adjustment coefficient and individual selection in the process of mutation, the algorithm can effectively improve the speed of optimization, and enhance the global optimization ability through the comprehensive consideration of population diversity level, and avoid the algorithm falling into the local optimal solution. Finally, a 20-node power distribution network is simulated to verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An unmanned aerial vehicle wireless charging system using a novel coupling structure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the practical requirements of lightweight, convenient and large offset wireless charging structure for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), a transformer-type parallel coil coupling structure with strong anti-offset capability and easy to install on drones is proposed. The transmitting device consists of a Leeds coil wound on a special magnetic core shaped like a "U-shaped structure", and the receiving device is located at the bottom of the drone and consists of a Leeds coil wound on a magnetic core rod. It is used in COMSOL to analyze the magnetic field distribution and anti-offset. It is found that the magnetic field can effectively pass through the closed magnetic core loop, avoiding the interference caused by magnetic leakage, and the receiving end of the structure is horizontally offset on the X and Y axes. It has good anti-offset ability when moving and diagonally sideways. The LCC impedance compensation topology is selected to meet the constant voltage charging requirements of the drone battery. Appropriate parameters are Selected, a system model is established, and the construction of the overall physical system for experiments is guided. After experimental measurement, the experimental results are basically consistent with the theoretical values of the model. The 14V voltage for the UAV is stabilized by the new coupling structure system within the offset range of 40mm, the charging power is 35W.

articleTitle: Field-Circuit Coupled Modelling of Superconducting Cable for Positive and Zero Sequence Impedance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a simulation analysis method for the sequence impedance of three-phase cold insulated superconducting cable based on the field-circuit coupling model. In this model, the induced electric field of screening layer is calculated by the magnetic field model, and the time domain current in the superconducting cable is calculated by the circuit model. Then, the positive sequence and zero sequence impedance of the superconducting cable circuit are calculated. The simulation results are as follows: for the positive sequence impedance, under the same structural parameters, the positive sequence impedance of the superconducting cable is half of the conventional cable; When the screening coefficient of the superconducting screen is 80% ~ 90%, the positive sequence reactance increases by 18% ~ 35%. For the zero sequence impedence, it is about 5 times of the positive sequence impedence, which is slightly greater than the handbook recommended value X<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> ≈ (3.5 – 4.6)X<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>. When the screening coefficient of the superconducting screen is 80% ~ 90%., the zero sequence impedence increases by 2.8 ~ 5 times.

articleTitle: Corona Discharge of Practical Operated Transmission AC Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The corona discharge of transmission lines is one of the main reasons causing electromagnetic environmental issues. We selected practical operated lines from Shandong province of China to explore the effect of pollution grade and service year on the corona discharge of practical operated lines. Experimental results show that corona discharge becomes more serious as the service year lengthens. When the operated years are close, the general environment along the transmission lines plays an important role in electromagnetic environment degradation. Comparation of the photon number of operated lines with data obtained using corona cage improve that corona cage test can be equivalent to the transmission line.

articleTitle: research on lightning protection and grounding safety evaluation of base station shared power tower
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Building 5g base station on power tower is an effective way to realize resource integration and save national resources. However, the voltage level and installed capacity of power system and communication system are far from each other. We must take into account their lightning protection and grounding requirements, conduct comprehensive research, and put forward reliable measures to ensure the safe operation of shared tower. Based on the structure of 220kV power tower and communication machine room, the simulation model of shared tower is established, and multiple observation potentials are set in the shared tower. By analyzing and calculating the ground potential appreciation of observation points under different lightning currents, different earth resistivity and different installation positions, an important conclusion is drawn: in order to ensure the power line in communication machine room The optical cable, antenna metal support and iron tower will not be broken down. The grounding grid of communication machine room and power tower must adopt the joint grounding mode, and the improvement suggestions for the original grounding mode are put forward.

articleTitle: Finite Element Study on Electric Field Distortion and Maxwell Stress Distribution Characteristics of XLPE Insulation Considering Water tree under Different Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Water tree is one of the important factors that affect the service life of XLPE insulation cable and seriously threaten the safety of cable operation. In order to study the electric field distortion and Maxwell stress distribution characteristics considering water tree under different circumstances, the paper takes position, length and dispersion into consideration, and then a cable insulaton model with water tree defects under different conditions is established in the finite element simulation software. By applying a fixed voltage on both sides of the insulation, the axial electric field intensity of water tree is scanned, the maximum electric field intensity in the insulation is counted, and the influence characteristics of water tree on the electric field distortion of cable XLPE insulation are studied. At the same time, the Maxwell stress caused by electric field distortion is calculated, and the maximum axial stress of water tree is extracted and analyzed. The results show that when the size is approximately the same, the electric field distortion caused by Inner dispersed water tree is significantly higher than that on Outer dispersed water tree, and the electric field distortion caused by the Butterfly-shaped water tree whose size is approximately twice that of the dispersed water tree is between the two; The effect of length and dispersion on electric field distortion varies with water tree type and location.In terms of stress, the Maxwell stress caused by the Inner dispersed water tree is greater than the Outer dispersed water tree with approximately the same size and the Butterfly-shaped water tree with approximately twice the size. The increase of length is conducive to the reduction of the maximum Maxwell stress caused by the dispersed water tree.

articleTitle: Wideband Circuit Modeling of a Adjustable VFTO Simulator Considering Frequency-Dependent Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Very fast transient overvoltage (VFTO) induced by switching operation in gas insulated switchgears (GIS) might cause disturbances and damages to terminated devices and equipment of both the primary and secondary sides. This paper introduces a VFTO simulator design for experimental researches and tests in laboratory. The wideband circuit model has been built considering both the pulse generator and equivalent transmission line model in frequency domain. The simulation result shows good agreement with the time-domain Spice model, and the adjustment of frequency-dependent characteristics by circuit parameters is also discussed.

articleTitle: Subsynchronous Oscillation Research of LCC-HVDC Receiving End System with Large-scale Renewable Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The line-commutated-converter (LCC) based high voltage direct current (HVDC), and renewable power generation have developed rapidly in central China. However, the risk of subsynchronous oscillation (SSO) for this typical LCC-HVDC receiving end system with large-scale renewable power generations (LCCre-RPGs) is unclear. In this paper, a small-signal model of LCCre-RPGs is constructed. The renewable power generations are simulated by a permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) and a doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG). Then, the interaction between LCC-HVDC and renewable power generations is analyzed through the eigenvalue analysis and participation factor analysis. Moreover, the interaction may lead to the risk of SSO. Finally, the influence of controller parameters on the SSO modes is investigated in detail, which provides theoretical support for optimizing relevant parameters. The time-domain simulation of the original nonlinear model verifies the above analysis results.

articleTitle: Full-Characteristic Power Flow of Wind Power System with Consideration of Generator Set Frequency Variation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As wind power plays an increasingly important role in the power system, it is of great practical significance to study the power flow calculation with wind turbines. In this paper, a mathematical model of asynchronous wind turbines considering the system frequency is proposed, and applied to the full-characteristic power flow calculation considering the power generation frequency of each synchronous generator. It is verified with the conventional power flow algorithm including wind turbines, and the feasibility of the proposed method is proved by comparing the calculation results.

articleTitle: Real-time Grid Impedance Identification for Synchronization Stability Control in Grid-following Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The synchronization instability is one of the serious problems for grid-following converter (GFL). Real-time identification of AC grid impedance enables improves the application of adaptive current injection synchronous stabilization control method in practical power systems. In this paper, a Thevenin equivalent (TE) impedance identification method using Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) analysis is proposed and applied to GFL synchronous stability control. First, according to the analysis of the static and dynamic instability mechanism of phase-locked loop (PLL), the necessity of impedance identification is explained. Then, using FFT analysis, the TE impedance of the AC system is calculated in real-time. Finally, the estimated TE parameters are used to determine the current references of GFL during the fault to ensure that no loss of synchronization (LOS) occurs in the GFL. The simulation results show that the proposed identification method can quickly track the AC grid impedance changes of system after a fault, and can be used in the adaptive current control strategy.

articleTitle: A Feedforward Current Control for Two-Stage AC/DC converters with Good Dynamic Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes the current load feedforward control of a two-stage three-phase AC/DC converter. By comparing the dynamic optimization effect of inductor current feedforward and output current feedforward, the feasibility of inductor current feedforward is demonstrated, and the applicability of the device is further optimized. The interaction of the two-stage system between the front-end and back-end load feedforward is analyzed. In this paper, a feedforward load current control is presented to both the front-end and the backend converters by using the inductor current to reveal the negative effects of the excessive feedforward coefficient. The theoretical basis for regulating the feedforward coefficient is given as well. Finally, the simulation is conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control.

articleTitle: Key Equipment Status Assessment in Distribution Network Based on Heterogeneous Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the equipment maintenance data in the power network are scattered, the knowledge structure is different from each other, and the single source information is difficult to accurately characterize the overall condition of the equipment, it is necessary to evaluate the state of the power grid equipment in order to reduce the requirements of reducing power outage or even no power outage in the power grid maintenance. In this paper, a state evaluation method of distribution network equipment based on multi-source heterogeneous information fusion is proposed. Firstly, the multi-source heterogeneous information is processed, the structured data is transformed into a recursive graph corresponding to the unstructured data by using variational modal decomposition and Hilbert transform, and the unstructured data and structured data are unified into the same dimension, Then the unified multi-source data are input into the improved convolutional neural network for training and feature vector extraction. The obtained feature vectors are spliced and fused to realize equipment state perception. Finally, an example of switchgear is used to verify the correctness of the proposed method. The results show that the distribution network equipment status evaluation method based on multi-source heterogeneous information fusion can well retain the original input information, complement each other between multi-source heterogeneous information, have higher fusion diagnosis accuracy, and can realize more accurate evaluation of equipment status.

articleTitle: Equivalent analysis of Stator Inter-Turn Fault in Different Winding Topologies of Synchronous Condenser
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of UHVDC transmission project, synchronous condenser has attracted much attention because of its superior dynamic reactive power compensation ability. However, the failure risk of synchronous condenser will bring hidden dangers to the safe operation of power grid. In this paper, the stator inter-turn fault in different winding topologies of synchronous condenser are compared. Firstly, the mathematical models of different winding topologies are derived. Then the equivalence of phase resistance and inductance are analyzed based on the equivalent operation principle. The short circuit-current, short-circuit resistance and short-circuit ratio are analyzed in the fault state. The analysis result is helpful to the unification of stator inter-turn short-circuit fault diagnosis method of different topologies. Finally, the analysis has been validated by simulated results.

articleTitle: Comparative Synthetic Inertia Assessment Between Droop And Virtual Synchronous Generator Control For Weak Grids Integration
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous increase of the penetration of renewable power generation (RPG), the rotating reserve capacity and moment of inertia in the power system are relatively reduced, which brings serious challenges to the safe and stable operation of power systems. To address this issue, the droop control and virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control strategies have been proposed, their configuration and dynamic characteristics have been fully investigated. To further investigate the synthetic inertia and dynamic response of these two methods, theoretical analysis of the inverter implanting these two control strategies is performed. The results indicate that both control strategy has inertia, the inertia of droop-controlled inverter is only determined by damping factor, while the virtual inertia of virtual synchronous generator-controlled inverter is simultaneously affected by the virtual inertia coefficient and damping coefficient, it is much similar with an actual synchronous generator (SG). Finally, electromagnetic transient simulations are conducted to validate the inertia analyze and the dynamic characteristics.

articleTitle: Key Technology of Integrated Power Generation System containing Wind/Solar/Hydro/Thermal and Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The deep-seated contradictions such as the low comprehensive efficiency of the power system and the lack of complementarity and mutual assistance of various power sources have become increasingly prominent, which need to be coordinated and optimized. The integration of wind, solar, hydro, thermal, and energy storage can improve the clean utilization level of energy and the operation efficiency of power systems, give full play to the advantages of regions rich in new energy resources and realize the large-scale consumption of clean power. Starting from the composition structure and overall solution of the integrated system, this paper analyzes the system boundary of the multiple energy complementary system, different composition forms of the system, as well as the key technologies such as joint monitoring, energy coupling scheduling, and optimal allocation of energy storage in the process of building the integration, to provide support for the construction of wind, solar, hydrothermal storage integrated power generation system.

Author Keywords: integration of wind/solar/hydro/thermal and energy storage
complementary cooperation of various forms of power generation

articleTitle: Research on Location Planning of Integrated Service Station of Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The energy integrated service hub (EISH) integrates data center, energy storage station, charging station, and cold and hot gas pipe network, which gathers power flow, information flow, and business flow. Therefore, the reasonable location of EISH contributes to the smooth and reliable operation of the cyber-physical system (CPS) of the energy network. This paper proposed a CPS-based EISH location planning model according to the influence on the reliability and delay of the information system as well as the load fluctuation and load saturation of the integrated energy system. Then the simulation of the energy consumption system of a province in southern China was carried out in MATLAB/Simulink. The optimal site for EISH was node 13 through the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. Finally, the improvement of the information system delay and power system flow fluctuation after the installation of EISH at different nodes was compared through the simulation and the effectiveness of the proposed location model was verified.

Author Keywords: cold and hot gas pipe network

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of a New Hybrid Transformer for Metro Traction Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The hybrid transformer is used to improve the metro traction power supply system, which can reduce the volume and cost of the overall equipment. In this paper, the circuit models of a hybrid transformer and a rectifier transformer are established by the two methods, namely, the single-phase multi-winding transformer method and the mutual inductance transformer method. First, the finite element models of the hybrid transformer and rectifier transformer are established to calculate some parameters which are used in two methods. Then, the circuit models are established and investigated using the proposed two methods. The results obtained by the mutual inductance transformer method are compared with the finite element results. Finally, the presented two methods are used to establish the DC traction power supply system, and the pros and cons of these two methods are compared.

articleTitle: Calculation of Renewable Energy Grid-Connected Potential
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Clarifying the grid connection potential of renewable energy is the basis for improving the penetration rate of renewable energy in regional distribution grids. In this paper, a method for calculating the grid connection potential of renewable energy in regional distribution networks with multiple loads is proposed. First, the calculation model of renewable energy the grid-connected potential was designed, including the constraints of the normal operation of the system after the renewable energy was connected to the grid. Then, the calculation process of renewable energy the grid-connected potential in the regional distribution network was studied, that is, on the basis of calculating the grid-connected potential of single-point wind power, the grid-connected potential of renewable energy in the regional distribution network with multiple load nodes was calculated. Finally, a 33-node calculation system with five types of load nodes including office buildings, university campuses, industrial parks, commercial areas and residential areas was used to verify the effectiveness of the method. The results show that when the combined wind power capacity is 1:1:1:1:1, the maximum installable capacity of the wind farm is (1026+337j)kVA. It provides a reference for the selection of renewable energy access capacity in regional distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Slot-Pole Combination on the Performance of Quadruped Robot Joint Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The motor requirements of the quadruped robot joint module are low speed, high torque, thin and light. The existing permanent magnet synchronous external rotor motors basically meet this application. However, for this type of motor with the same size limit, how to optimize the design of the motor to achieve high-performance output, there are still few studies. In the robot joint module, the torque-mass density ratio that expresses the motor torque/mass is a very critical motor performance evaluation parameter. Based on the external rotor permanent magnet synchronous motor of the same size, this paper analyzes the influence of different slot pole numbers on the performance of the motor, and studies the electromagnetic and mechanical characteristics of the external rotor surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motor with the same pole number and different slot number combination. From the perspectives of motor average torque, cogging torque, winding factor, back-EMF, air gap flux density and unbalanced force, comprehensively analyze and compare the effects of four slot-pole combinations on motor performance. The finite element simulation results show that 30 slots/26 poles is a better and feasible option to achieve high torque, low speed and meet size requirements.

Author Keywords: permanent magnet synchronous outer rotor motor

articleTitle: Fault Modeling and Traceability of Power Grid Dispatching Control System based on Data-driven method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The power grid dispatching control system is an important part of the power system operation, including a large number of components. Once a system component fails, it will cause a series of component alarms, which will endanger the security of the power system. Aiming at this problem, a fault tracing method based on the combination of system fault time series modeling and knowledge graph is proposed. Firstly, the hardware components of the power grid dispatching control system are modeled with prior knowledge, and then the fault time series of the modeled system components are simulated and transformed into the fault network represented by the knowledge graph using the Monte Carlo-based Choesky factor linear transformation. A network fitting similarity algorithm calculates the similarity of the fitted network, and finally uses the real network and the fault network fitting to trace the source of the fault. Numerical experiments were carried out on simulated data. The test results demonstrate the effectiveness and correctness of the method.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on the Performance of High-Speed IPM Motor with Single-layer PM for Electric Spindle
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-speed permanent magnet (PM) motors have received extensive attention in the field of electric spindle due to their merits of high-power density and high efficiency. To meet the requirement of electric spindle, high-speed interior permanent magnet (IPM) motors with six different single-layer PM rotor structures for electric spindle are comparatively analyzed and designed in this paper. Firstly, the main structural parameters of the high-speed IPM motor are derived. Then, the electromagnetic performance of IPM motors with six different rotor structures is comparatively analyzed in detail. Finally, the mechanical performance and temperature of these motors are investigated. The results show that, when using square wave current control, the IPM motor with single tile type rotor has the best electromagnetic performance and is thus recommended as the best candidate.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling method for wind power-captive power plants
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the shortage of power grid peak regulation capacity and the problem of wind curtailment has become increasingly prominent, while the regulation potential of a large number of coal-fired self-generation power plants has not been utilized and valued. Aiming at cogeneration self-generation power plants participating in transactions and promoting wind power consumption, a short-time-scale power generation right trading mode is designed for captive power plants. The settlement takes days as the time scale; in the self-generation power plant, the electric heating device is used to absorb wind power and participate in the joint heating, decouple the thermoelectric coupling constraints of the unit, and reduce the power output of the unit; with the goal of the lowest operating cost of the self-generation power plant, the wind power plant is constructed a clean alternative cogeneration captive power plant dispatch model. The simulation results show that this method can effectively improve the level of wind power consumption, reduce the operating cost of self-generation power plants, reduce coal consumption, and achieve clean substitution of electric energy.

Author Keywords: short time scale generation rights trading

articleTitle: Winding Condition Monitoring of Power Transformer Based on the optimized TQWT
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: How to accurately judge the winding condition after the sudden short-circuit impacts is an essential issue for the secure and reliable operation of power system. Since the vibration signals of transformer tank are mainly caused by winding vibration under the short-circuit impacts, this study is focused to recognize the winding condition by using the vibration signals decomposed by the tunable Q-factor wavelet transform (TQWT) with the optimized parameters of the Q-factor and redundancy according to the singular spectrum entropy. With the obtained sub-bands energy of vibration signals, the index of standard deviation (SD) and average power (AP) are defined to accurately recognize the winding condition of transformer. The short-circuit impact experiment is made for a real 110kV transformer with different short-circuit impact currents. The calculated results that the proposed method can better decompose the transient vibration signals and the judgement of winding condition of transformer are agreed well with its real mechanical condition.

articleTitle: Backlash Compensation using Backstepping Adaptive Control in Servo Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel control strategy to improve the positioning accuracy of the dual-mass systems with the backstepping adaptive method. Firstly, based on the identified amplitude, a dead-zone model of backlash is established. Then, a state feedback based backstepping adaptive controller is designed to compensate for the adverse effects of the backlash. The tracking differential in ADRC control is incorporated into the method to obtain the desired differential value. The proposed method can suppress the influence of backlash on servo performance, whilst the tracking accuracy is improved. Finally, experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Switch Duty Cycle Based Model Predictive Control for Hybrid-Inverter Driven Open-Winding PMSM System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a switch duty cycle (SDC) based model predictive control (MPC) strategy is proposed for the hybrid-inverter driven open-winding permanent magnet synchronous motor (HI-OW-PMSM) system. The voltage equation of OW-PMSM, PI controller and power distribution method are combined with switch duty cycle. Then, the conventional cost function is transformed into only switch duty cycle constraint, thus the weighting factors are eliminated. Besides, the duty cycle of each switch device is calculated directly, which realizes the multi-vector MPC in the HI-OW-PMSM system without iterative or modulated process for voltage vector. Experimental results show that the proposed method has stable static performance, fast response speed and simple control process.

Author Keywords: Open winding permanent magnet synchronous motor (OW-PMSM)

articleTitle: Adhesion Control of Bogie-Controlled Inner-city Trains
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Adhesion control is an essential prerequisite to ensure safe operation of inner-city trains. Inner-city trains are operated jointly on the ground and underground. External factors, such as passenger capacity changes, different rail surface conditions, will cause inefficient traction of inner-city trains, low rate of adhesion utilization, and frequent idling. Aiming at these problems, an adhesion control method based on the optimal torque searching and receiving is proposed. Firstly, the dynamic model of inner-city trains is established according to the bogie-controlled characteristics of inner-city trains traction system. Secondly, the bogies are set as searching and receiving bogies, which adopt different adhesion control method respectively to realize the optimal adjustment of traction torque. Finally, real-time simulation based on two different track surface conditions is carried out on the Starsim platform to verify the effectiveness. Compared with traditional combined correction adhesion control method, the simulation results show that the proposed method increases average traction torque, increases average adhesion utilization, and decreases the idling times. When the inner-city train is unloaded, the average traction torque increases by 9.47 % and 11.51 %, the average adhesion utilization increases by 7.12 % and 8.38 %, the average idling times decreases by 57.14 % and 78.95 % respectively; When the inner-city train is overloaded, the average traction torque increases by 13.05 % and 19.27 %, the average adhesion utilization increases by 8.96 % and 13.54 %, the average idling times decreases by 55.56 % and 77.78 % respectively.

articleTitle: Robustness Investigation of Grid-Connected Inverter in Weak Grid and Optimization Based on an Improved Grid Voltage Feedforward Path
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For grid-connected inverter, phase-locked loop (PLL) and the grid voltage feedforward scheme are generally employed. While, both of them may deteriorate the system stability in weak grid. In view of this, the weighted grid voltage feedforward is adopted to make a trade-off between the system stability and the harmonics rejection ability, and this strategy has an optimized effect on PLL concurrently. Faced with larger grid impedance, an additional feedforward path is proposed for stabilizing the inverter. The results show that the inverter with the improved feedforward path can maintain good robustness against the wide grid impedance variation.

articleTitle: Research on green construction evaluation of power grid construction under the background of dual carbon
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In 2020, President Xi Jinping proposed the "dual carbon" goal at the 75th United Nations General Assembly. Therefore, as a high energy-consuming and high-emission industry, it is particularly important to realize the green construction of the power grid. In recent years, the content of green construction has mostly appeared in the construction industry, but the content of green construction evaluation of power grid is different from that of civil buildings, so this paper puts forward a research on the evaluation of green construction of power grid. This paper mainly takes the substation as an example, establishes a hierarchical structure model of the evaluation index system and calculates the weight of each layer index; secondly, it studies to determine the evaluation level; thirdly, the on-site data acquisition device is studied, and finally a substation green construction evaluation system is established to evaluate the construction process of the substation.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Dual-frequency Fluctuation Suppression of Inductor Current in a Single-phase Single-stage Current-Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The presence of dual-frequency power fluctuation on the output side of a single-phase inverter leads to dual-frequency fluctuations of the inductor current on the input side, which in turn leads to an increase in the third harmonic of the output current and affects the power quality. A very large DC-side inductor is required in order to guarantee that the output waveform quality could meet the requirements, which has limitations when applied to small and medium power systems. To address this problem, this paper proposes a method for suppressing diametral fluctuations in the inductor current of a single-phase, single-stage current-type inverter based on feedforward duty cycle. Taking the three-level current source inverter as an example, this paper takes a constant inductor current as a prerequisite to discount the duty cycle disturbance of the switching devices on the DC side. With a smaller inductor on the dc side, the inductor current is still maintained constant, while the low harmonics, mainly the third harmonic, on the AC side are also suppressed and the output current quality is high. Based on the above analysis, the corresponding experimental platform is built to verify the correctness of the proposed theory.

articleTitle: Implementation of an On-line Diagnosis Algorithm of PMSM Inter-turn Short Circuit Based on Search Coil and FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents an online fault diagnosis system for PMSM inter-turn short circuit fault based on search coil with unique structure. The presented system uses FPGA hardware platform embedded in an original DSP control system. Based on SVPWM control, the system uses the method of signal processing to identify the fault. The terminal voltage of the search coil is collected, and the negative sequence harmonic component 0th a frequency near twice the PWM switching frequency is used as the basis for identifying the fault. In order to adapt to the operation structure of FPGA, a simplified fault feature extraction algorithm based on coordinate transformation is proposed. Compared with the traditional fault diagnosis system, the proposed system has the advantages of low cost, high precision and rapid response. Experiments are done to verify the validity of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Double Loop Control of Three-phase Inverters with Output LC Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to enhance the performance of three-phase inverters with output LC filter, an improved double loop control strategy is proposed in this paper. Firstly, based on the state equation and linear proportional integral feedback, a double loop controller is designed. Secondly, to speed up the current loop dynamic response, a bang-bang controller is activated in the cases where the current tracking error is far away from its prespecified threshold, and a proportion integral controller is switched on operation when the error was small. Finally, the voltage tracking error converges along with the exponential function trajectory by tracking the predicted integral state of voltage loop, which can eliminate the voltage overshoot when load changes and step signal acts. The validity of the proposed control strategy is verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Parameter Calculation Method of Large Thrust Short Primary Linear Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents an accurate calculation method to extract parameters of six-phase cylindrical linear induction motor for T type equivalent circuit from finite element analysis of electromagnetic field. The formula for calculating the physical quantities required for parameter extraction is given. According to the electromagnetic power relation and equivalent circuit of the motor, the expression of the thrust is deduced. The asymmetrical distribution of air gap flux density and the asymmetry law of induction potential are analyzed. Therefore, the secondary side parameters are treated symmetrically, then the calculation process of parameter extraction is given according to the principle of secondary thrust and port voltage equivalence. The change regulation of the circuit parameters extracted by this method is in good agreement with the physical process of motor operation. Finally, the accuracy of the proposed method is verified by static experiments.

articleTitle: optimization of Integrated Power Converter with Multiple Operating Modes for Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To improve the working performance of the motor and reduce the size of the module, an integrated power converter for the switched reluctance motor (SRM) with boost and regenerative braking functions is designed. The integrated power converter can work in driving mode, braking mode, and charging mode. The boost capacitor is used to increase the bus voltage, which effectively improves the driving and braking performance of the switched reluctance motor. Control the on-off of the power electronic devices to form a Buck circuit to feed the braking energy back to the battery. The multiplexing part of the power device realizes the charging with power factor correction (PFC) function. A simulation model was built in MATLAB/Simulink to verify the effectiveness of the integrated power converter.

articleTitle: A Unified Constant Power Control Method for DC/DC Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the parallel system of hydrogen power supply and pantograph power supply, this paper proposes a unified power control method for the DC/DC boost converter system, which can complete the seamlessly transfer from the grid-connected mode to the standalone mode without changing a control strategy, and vice versa. There is no need to detect the interconnection switch to identify whether it is grid-connected or standalone. It can meet the power reference value required by the load in different working modes, and can flexibly coordinate the output each power supply. And by analyzing the relationship between the droop coefficient and the dc bus voltage and power, the selection principle of the best droop coefficient is given. Finally, the experiments based on a 1MW DC/DC boost converter system are carried out to verify the proposed unified power control method.

articleTitle: Multiple-Consecutive-Samples Based Approach of Frequency Estimation in Three-Phase Grid Under DC-offsets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of frequency estimation based on multiple-consecutive-samples (MCS-FE) for a three-phase grid, which can estimate the grid frequency quickly and accurately. In particular, the proposed method shows strong robustness against dc-offsets. On the basis of the relationship of distorted grid voltage and four consecutive sampling signals, the model of MCS-FE is established. According to this, estimated frequency, positive-sequence and negative-sequence components can be obtained at the same time. Compared with traditional second-order generalized integrator (SOGI) based frequency locked loops (SOGI-PLLs), MCS-FE shows fast response, high accuracy and good capability of rejecting dc-offsets, and simulation results confirm that.

articleTitle: Coordinated Distribution Reconfiguration with Maintenance Scheduling Considering Electric Vehicles Charging Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the context of reducing carbon emissions, the use of electric motors instead of conventional car engines is considered an effective approach, and as a result a large number of electric vehicle (EV) charging stations have been set up around the world to cater for the rapidly growing user base. However, the access to large-scale EV charging loads has a significant negative impact on the power grid. Thus, the optimal distribution network reconfiguration with interconnection of charging station is this solution for this issue. In this paper, a distribution reconfiguration model considering EV charging loads is established. First, we model the EV charging load using probabilistic statistics. Based on the EV model, we develop the coordinated maintenance scheduling with distribution reconfiguration considering EV uncertainty. The second-order cone relaxation method are used to obtain the optimal solution. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified in the IEEE 33-bus system with EV charging load added.

articleTitle: Research on Load Control Strategy of Aggregate Water Heater Based on Artificial Immune Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Clean energy has strong randomness, high volatility, high wind and light abandonment rate and low energy utilization rate. However, demand side water heater has rich resources, wide control range and good energy storage function. Therefore, it is of great significance to carry out reasonable polymerization control on water heater. To solve this problem, this paper constructs the model of single water heater and aggregate water heater group, and studies the control method of power transfer of aggregate water heater group on this basis. The method first establishes an evaluation method for the adjustable capacity of aggregate water heaters, and then optimizes the allocation of clean energy absorption capacity with the constraints of user comfort (adjustable temperature range) and water heater physical parameters. Secondly, through artificial immune algorithm, iterative optimization is carried out to appropriately adjust the temperature set point of water heater load, so as to achieve the purpose of absorbing clean energy in advance at a proper time. Finally, it is verified by experiments that the algorithm in this paper can effectively consume clean energy, and at the same time, the intervention on the water heater is small, which ensures the user’s experience and economy.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the current pulses of positive corona discharge in SF6
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper investigates the current pulses of positive corona discharge in SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> at 0.4MPa. The 2D axisymmetric point-plane model is applied. Three continuity equations for electrons, positive ions and negative ions are combined with Poisson’s equation to predict the current pulses in positive corona discharge. In addition, the photoionization is simulated by adding a constant term in the continuity equations of electrons and positive ions. The current pulses, the distribution of the charged species are presented.

articleTitle: Input Admittance Modeling and Stability Analysis of DFIG under Different Modes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, wind power generation has attracted extensive attention because of its advantages such as large reserves and environmental friendliness. Among them, doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) is the most widely used type of wind turbine. There are generally two control modes, namely, the Current Controlled DFIG (CC-DFIG) and the Voltage-Controlled DFIG (VC-DFIG). CC-DFIG using the phase locked loop (PLL) to synchronous with the grid while VC-DIFG using the power loop instead. In this paper, the input admittance models of DFIG under two different modes are established, and the effects of different power grid strength and control parameters on system stability are studied by using the generalized Nyquist steady-state criterion. It is concluded that the VC-DFIG system has good adaptability of control parameters under weak grid. Finally, the correctness of the above theoretical analysis is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A Coordination Control Strategy Participating in Frequency Control for VSC-HVDC and LCC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a coordination control strategy participating in frequency control for the system interconnected by voltage source converter based high-voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC) inverter station and line commutated converter based high-voltage direct current (LCCHVDC) rectifier station. The strategy includes active power and reactive power coordination control for VSC-HVDC and LCCHVDC. The active power coordination control can improve the frequency stability of VSC-HVDC transmission network by reasonable switching additional frequency controllers. The reactive power coordination control can reduce the number of switching filters of LCC-HVDC and improve the voltage stability of power network during frequency regulation. Finally, an equivalent simplified model of practical grid is built in MATLAB/Simulink, and the effectiveness and adaptability of the additional frequency coordinated control strategy are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Study on Dielectric Model for Capacitance-Based Nondestructive Testing of Water Content in Concrete
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Water is one of the main factors causing the attenuation of compressive strength of concrete. Accurately measuring the water content of concrete is of great significance to evaluate the compressive strength of concrete and ensure the safety and stability of concrete structures. Thus, a dielectric model which can be applied to capacitance-based nondestructive testing of water content in concrete is proposed in this study. Firstly, a four-phase concrete meso-scale model composed of water, air, cement mortar and aggregate was established. A new numerical homogenization method was used to simulate and analyze the influence of the volume fraction of different components on the dielectric constant of concrete. The results of the numerical simulation were used to optimize the geometric factor in the LR (Lichtenecker-Rother equation) equation, and the LR equation with the optimized geometric factor was used to describe the influence. The LR equation with the optimized geometric factor provides the foundation for the capacitance-based nondestructive testing of water content in concrete and effectively improves the accuracy of the testing of water content.

articleTitle: A Hydrogen Refueling System for Fuel Cell Electric Vehicles: Towards Low Carbon Oriented Power and Transportation Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of the hydrogen industry, fuel cell electric vehicles (FCEVs) powered by hydrogen are believed to have a promising future and will play an important role in low carbon-oriented power and transportation systems. In this paper, we present a management strategy of the hydrogen refueling system for FCEVs that comprehensively considers the hydrogen supply chain, the operation of hydrogen production stations (HPSs), and the operation of hydrogen production stations (HPSs). Based on the proposed carbon footprint tracking method, the carbon emission caused by the HPSs can be estimated, and the HPSs are encouraged to utilize renewable energy to produce hydrogen by applying carbon tax. Hence, an efficient and low carbon-oriented hydrogen refueling system is established. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified in the case studies, and it is found that the proposed method can ensure the hydrogen supply while effectively realizing emission control.

articleTitle: Fast Computation Methods for Constructing Data-Driven Linear Power Flow Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To balance the construction computational efficiency and linearization accuracy of data-driven linear power flow (DD-LPF) models, this paper provides two fast computation methods to resolve two technical issues. First, for the issue of slow computation of the unknown LPF model parameters resulting from the large scale of historical data, this paper suggests employing a distributed stochastic gradient descent (DSGD)-based method to solve the problem in a distributed parallel mode, rather than in a batch way. Second, for online applications, to improve the linearization accuracy and to maintain high solution efficiency, this paper suggests using a recursive least squares (RLS) method to dynamically update the DD-LPF models. Case studies confirm that the DSGD-based method and the RLS method can all improve the computational efficiency with 2- to 50-fold less computing time and keeping a satisfactory linearization accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-stage Constant Current Charging Method Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
